content.text: {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les pages d'accueil de tous les auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT name, homepage FROM author;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les conférences avec leur page d'accueil, triées par nom ?","sql":"SELECT name, homepage FROM conference ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des domaines enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT name FROM domain ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Quels sont les journaux et leurs pages d'accueil ?","sql":"SELECT name, homepage FROM journal;"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés existent dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT kid, keyword FROM keyword ORDER BY keyword;"},{"question":"Quels organismes sont situés en Europe ?","sql":"SELECT oid, name FROM organization WHERE continent = 'Europe';"},{"question":"Quels organismes ne sont pas situés en Europe ?","sql":"SELECT name, continent FROM organization WHERE continent <> 'Europe';"},{"question":"Quels articles ont été publiés après 2015 ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, year FROM publication WHERE year > 2015 ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont été publiés entre 2010 et 2020 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, year FROM publication WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020 ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont plus de 100 citations ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, citation_num FROM publication WHERE citation_num > 100 ORDER BY citation_num DESC;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont au moins 10 références ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, reference_num FROM publication WHERE reference_num >= 10;"},{"question":"Quels articles n'ont encore reçu aucune citation ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE citation_num = 0;"},{"question":"Quels titres contiennent le mot « data » ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE title LIKE '%data%';"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un résumé renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE abstract IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels articles n'ont pas de résumé ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE abstract IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien y a-t-il d'auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_auteurs FROM author;"},{"question":"Combien de publications sont enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_publications FROM publication;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de conférences ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_conferences FROM conference;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de domaines distincts ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT did) AS nombre_domaines FROM domain;"},{"question":"Quelle est l'année de publication la plus ancienne ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(year) AS premiere_annee FROM publication;"},{"question":"Quelle est l'année de publication la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(year) AS derniere_annee FROM publication;"},{"question":"Combien de citations sont enregistrées au total pour les publications ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(citation_num) AS total_citations FROM publication;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de citations par publication ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(citation_num) AS moyenne_citations FROM publication;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de références par article ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(reference_num) AS moyenne_references FROM publication;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq articles les plus cités ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, citation_num FROM publication ORDER BY citation_num DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois articles les plus anciens ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, year FROM publication ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit au moins une publication ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.aid, a.name FROM author AS a JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs n'ont écrit aucune publication ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name FROM author AS a LEFT JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid WHERE w.pid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont au moins un auteur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid;"},{"question":"Quelles publications n'ont aucun auteur associé ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p LEFT JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid WHERE w.aid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit l'article intitulé « Machine Learning » ?","sql":"SELECT a.name FROM author AS a JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid JOIN publication AS p ON p.pid = w.pid WHERE p.title = 'Machine Learning';"},{"question":"Donne les titres écrits par l'auteur dont l'identifiant vaut 1.","sql":"SELECT p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid WHERE w.aid = 1;"},{"question":"Combien de publications chaque auteur a-t-il écrites ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name, COUNT(w.pid) AS nombre_publications FROM author AS a LEFT JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid GROUP BY a.aid, a.name ORDER BY nombre_publications DESC;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit plus de deux publications ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name, COUNT(*) AS nombre_publications FROM author AS a JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid GROUP BY a.aid, a.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;"},{"question":"Combien d'auteurs ont contribué à chaque publication ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title, COUNT(w.aid) AS nombre_auteurs FROM publication AS p LEFT JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont été écrites par au moins deux auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title HAVING COUNT(w.aid) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs appartiennent à au moins un domaine ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.aid, a.name FROM author AS a JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.aid = a.aid;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs n'appartiennent à aucun domaine ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name FROM author AS a LEFT JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.aid = a.aid WHERE da.did IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à l'auteur 1 ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.did = d.did WHERE da.aid = 1;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs sont associés au domaine 2 ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name FROM author AS a JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.aid = a.aid WHERE da.did = 2;"},{"question":"Combien d'auteurs sont associés à chaque domaine ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(da.aid) AS nombre_auteurs FROM domain AS d LEFT JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name;"},{"question":"Quels domaines comptent au moins trois auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(da.aid) AS nombre_auteurs FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name HAVING COUNT(da.aid) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels articles sont associés à au moins un domaine ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.pid = p.pid;"},{"question":"Quels articles ne sont associés à aucun domaine ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p LEFT JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.pid = p.pid WHERE dp.did IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à la publication 10 ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.did = d.did WHERE dp.pid = 10;"},{"question":"Quelles publications appartiennent au domaine 3 ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.pid = p.pid WHERE dp.did = 3;"},{"question":"Combien de publications sont rattachées à chaque domaine ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(dp.pid) AS nombre_publications FROM domain AS d LEFT JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name ORDER BY nombre_publications DESC;"},{"question":"Quels domaines regroupent plus de cinq publications ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(dp.pid) AS nombre_publications FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name HAVING COUNT(dp.pid) > 5;"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont utilisés par la publication 7 ?","sql":"SELECT k.kid, k.keyword FROM keyword AS k JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.kid = k.kid WHERE pk.pid = 7;"},{"question":"Quelles publications utilisent le mot-clé 4 ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.pid = p.pid WHERE pk.kid = 4;"},{"question":"Combien de mots-clés chaque publication possède-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title, COUNT(pk.kid) AS nombre_mots_cles FROM publication AS p LEFT JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.pid = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont au moins trois mots-clés ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.pid = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title HAVING COUNT(pk.kid) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont liés au mot-clé 2 ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_keyword AS dk ON dk.did = d.did WHERE dk.kid = 2;"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont associés au domaine 1 ?","sql":"SELECT k.kid, k.keyword FROM keyword AS k JOIN domain_keyword AS dk ON dk.kid = k.kid WHERE dk.did = 1;"},{"question":"Combien de mots-clés sont associés à chaque domaine ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(dk.kid) AS nombre_mots_cles FROM domain AS d LEFT JOIN domain_keyword AS dk ON dk.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un mot-clé contenant « network » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.pid = p.pid JOIN keyword AS k ON k.kid = pk.kid WHERE k.keyword LIKE '%network%';"},{"question":"Quels journaux sont liés à au moins un domaine ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT j.jid, j.name FROM journal AS j JOIN domain_journal AS dj ON dj.jid = j.jid;"},{"question":"Quels journaux ne sont liés à aucun domaine ?","sql":"SELECT j.jid, j.name FROM journal AS j LEFT JOIN domain_journal AS dj ON dj.jid = j.jid WHERE dj.did IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés au journal 5 ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_journal AS dj ON dj.did = d.did WHERE dj.jid = 5;"},{"question":"Quels journaux appartiennent au domaine 4 ?","sql":"SELECT j.jid, j.name FROM journal AS j JOIN domain_journal AS dj ON dj.jid = j.jid WHERE dj.did = 4;"},{"question":"Combien de journaux sont associés à chaque domaine ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(dj.jid) AS nombre_journaux FROM domain AS d LEFT JOIN domain_journal AS dj ON dj.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name;"},{"question":"Quels journaux publient au moins un article ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT j.jid, j.name FROM journal AS j JOIN publication AS p ON p.jid = j.jid;"},{"question":"Quels journaux n'ont publié aucun article ?","sql":"SELECT j.jid, j.name FROM journal AS j LEFT JOIN publication AS p ON p.jid = j.jid WHERE p.pid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'articles chaque journal a-t-il publiés ?","sql":"SELECT j.jid, j.name, COUNT(p.pid) AS nombre_articles FROM journal AS j LEFT JOIN publication AS p ON p.jid = j.jid GROUP BY j.jid, j.name ORDER BY nombre_articles DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de citations par journal ?","sql":"SELECT j.jid, j.name, AVG(p.citation_num) AS moyenne_citations FROM journal AS j JOIN publication AS p ON p.jid = j.jid GROUP BY j.jid, j.name;"},{"question":"Quels articles sont publiés dans le journal 2 ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, year FROM publication WHERE jid = 2 ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quels articles n'ont pas de journal associé ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE jid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles publications sont rattachées à une conférence ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title, c.name AS conference FROM publication AS p JOIN conference AS c ON CAST(p.cid AS INTEGER) = c.cid;"},{"question":"Quelles publications n'ont pas de conférence associée ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE cid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles conférences sont liées à au moins un domaine ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.cid, c.name FROM conference AS c JOIN domain_conference AS dc ON dc.cid = c.cid;"},{"question":"Quelles conférences ne sont liées à aucun domaine ?","sql":"SELECT c.cid, c.name FROM conference AS c LEFT JOIN domain_conference AS dc ON dc.cid = c.cid WHERE dc.did IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à la conférence 3 ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_conference AS dc ON dc.did = d.did WHERE dc.cid = 3;"},{"question":"Quelles conférences appartiennent au domaine 2 ?","sql":"SELECT c.cid, c.name FROM conference AS c JOIN domain_conference AS dc ON dc.cid = c.cid WHERE dc.did = 2;"},{"question":"Combien de conférences sont associées à chaque domaine ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(dc.cid) AS nombre_conferences FROM domain AS d LEFT JOIN domain_conference AS dc ON dc.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name;"},{"question":"Combien de publications chaque conférence accueille-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT c.cid, c.name, COUNT(p.pid) AS nombre_publications FROM conference AS c LEFT JOIN publication AS p ON CAST(p.cid AS INTEGER) = c.cid GROUP BY c.cid, c.name;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont été présentées lors de la conférence 1 ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE CAST(cid AS INTEGER) = 1;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs travaillent pour un organisme ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name, o.name AS organisme FROM author AS a JOIN organization AS o ON o.oid = a.oid;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs n'ont pas d'organisme renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT aid, name FROM author WHERE oid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels organismes n'ont aucun auteur associé ?","sql":"SELECT o.oid, o.name FROM organization AS o LEFT JOIN author AS a ON a.oid = o.oid WHERE a.aid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'auteurs chaque organisme compte-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT o.oid, o.name, COUNT(a.aid) AS nombre_auteurs FROM organization AS o LEFT JOIN author AS a ON a.oid = o.oid GROUP BY o.oid, o.name;"},{"question":"Quels organismes comptent plus de cinq auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT o.oid, o.name FROM organization AS o JOIN author AS a ON a.oid = o.oid GROUP BY o.oid, o.name HAVING COUNT(a.aid) > 5;"},{"question":"Quels organismes sont en Amérique du Nord ?","sql":"SELECT oid, name, homepage FROM organization WHERE continent = 'North America';"},{"question":"Combien d'organismes existe-t-il par continent ?","sql":"SELECT continent, COUNT(*) AS nombre_organismes FROM organization GROUP BY continent ORDER BY nombre_organismes DESC;"},{"question":"Quel continent compte le plus d'organismes ?","sql":"SELECT continent, COUNT(*) AS nombre_organismes FROM organization GROUP BY continent ORDER BY nombre_organismes DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels articles citent la publication 12 ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN cite AS c ON c.citing = p.pid WHERE c.cited = 12;"},{"question":"Quelles publications sont citées par l'article 15 ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN cite AS c ON c.cited = p.pid WHERE c.citing = 15;"},{"question":"Combien de citations reçues chaque publication possède-t-elle dans la table cite ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title, COUNT(c.citing) AS nombre_citations FROM publication AS p LEFT JOIN cite AS c ON c.cited = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont été citées au moins trois fois dans la table cite ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN cite AS c ON c.cited = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title HAVING COUNT(c.citing) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels articles ne citent aucune autre publication ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p LEFT JOIN cite AS c ON c.citing = p.pid WHERE c.cited IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels articles citent au moins une autre publication ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN cite AS c ON c.citing = p.pid;"},{"question":"Quelles paires de publications sont reliées par une citation ?","sql":"SELECT c.citing, c.cited FROM cite AS c ORDER BY c.citing, c.cited;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de relations de citation ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_citations FROM cite;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont plus de citations que de références ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, citation_num, reference_num FROM publication WHERE citation_num > reference_num;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont exactement autant de citations que de références ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE citation_num = reference_num;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un nombre de citations supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, citation_num FROM publication WHERE citation_num > (SELECT AVG(citation_num) FROM publication) ORDER BY citation_num DESC;"},{"question":"Quels articles sont plus récents que la publication moyenne en année ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, year FROM publication WHERE year > (SELECT AVG(year) FROM publication);"},{ "question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit au moins un article publié après 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.aid, a.name FROM author AS a JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid JOIN publication AS p ON p.pid = w.pid WHERE p.year > 2020;"},{"question":"Quels domaines contiennent à la fois des auteurs et des publications ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM domain_author AS da WHERE da.did = d.did) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM domain_publication AS dp WHERE dp.did = d.did);"},{"question":"Quels articles possèdent tous les mots-clés associés au domaine 1 ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM domain_keyword AS dk WHERE dk.did = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publication_keyword AS pk WHERE pk.pid = p.pid AND pk.kid = dk.kid));"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont collaboré avec l'auteur 1 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a2.aid, a2.name FROM writes AS w1 JOIN writes AS w2 ON w1.pid = w2.pid JOIN author AS a2 ON a2.aid = w2.aid WHERE w1.aid = 1 AND w2.aid <> 1;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont au moins un auteur appartenant au domaine 2 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.aid = w.aid WHERE da.did = 2;"},{"question":"Quels domaines ont des publications contenant le mot-clé « machine » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.did = d.did JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.pid = dp.pid JOIN keyword AS k ON k.kid = pk.kid WHERE k.keyword LIKE '%machine%';"},{"question":"Quels articles appartiennent à un domaine et sont publiés après 2018 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title, p.year FROM publication AS p JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.pid = p.pid WHERE p.year > 2018;"},{"question":"Quels journaux ont publié au moins un article de plus de 200 citations ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT j.jid, j.name FROM journal AS j JOIN publication AS p ON p.jid = j.jid WHERE p.citation_num > 200;"},{"question":"Quels organismes ont des auteurs ayant écrit plus d'une publication ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT o.oid, o.name FROM organization AS o JOIN author AS a ON a.oid = o.oid JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid GROUP BY o.oid, o.name, a.aid HAVING COUNT(w.pid) > 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque année, combien d'articles ont été publiés ?","sql":"SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles FROM publication GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quelles années comptent au moins cinq publications ?","sql":"SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles FROM publication GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne de citations par année de publication ?","sql":"SELECT year, AVG(citation_num) AS moyenne_citations FROM publication GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quelle année a produit le plus de publications ?","sql":"SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles FROM publication GROUP BY year ORDER BY nombre_articles DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels titres commencent par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE title LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont une page d'accueil renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT aid, name, homepage FROM author WHERE homepage IS NOT NULL AND homepage <> '';"},{"question":"Quelles conférences ont une page d'accueil manquante ?","sql":"SELECT cid, name FROM conference WHERE homepage IS NULL OR homepage = '';"},{"question":"Quels domaines ont un nom commençant par « Bio » ?","sql":"SELECT did, name FROM domain WHERE name LIKE 'Bio%';"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont écrits en minuscules ?","sql":"SELECT kid, keyword FROM keyword WHERE keyword = LOWER(keyword);"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un titre de plus de 50 caractères ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, LENGTH(title) AS longueur FROM publication WHERE LENGTH(title) > 50;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un résumé contenant le mot « algorithm » ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE abstract LIKE '%algorithm%';"},{"question":"Quels articles ont entre 5 et 20 références et au moins 50 citations ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE reference_num BETWEEN 5 AND 20 AND citation_num >= 50;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont été publiés dans un journal ou une conférence ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE jid IS NOT NULL OR cid IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels articles n'ont ni journal ni conférence ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE jid IS NULL AND cid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs appartiennent à plusieurs domaines ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name, COUNT(da.did) AS nombre_domaines FROM author AS a JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.aid = a.aid GROUP BY a.aid, a.name HAVING COUNT(da.did) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels articles utilisent plusieurs mots-clés distincts ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title, COUNT(DISTINCT pk.kid) AS nombre_mots_cles FROM publication AS p JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.pid = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pk.kid) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à plusieurs journaux et plusieurs conférences ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_journal AS dj ON dj.did = d.did JOIN domain_conference AS dc ON dc.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dj.jid) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT dc.cid) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit des publications dans au moins deux années différentes ?","sql":"SELECT a.aid, a.name FROM author AS a JOIN writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid JOIN publication AS p ON p.pid = w.pid GROUP BY a.aid, a.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.year) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quelle publication possède le plus grand nombre de références ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title, reference_num FROM publication WHERE reference_num = (SELECT MAX(reference_num) FROM publication);"},{"question":"Quels articles ont le même nombre de citations que la publication la plus citée ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE citation_num = (SELECT MAX(citation_num) FROM publication);"},{"question":"Quel domaine possède le plus d'auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(da.aid) AS nombre_auteurs FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did, d.name ORDER BY nombre_auteurs DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels noms d'auteurs sont aussi des noms de domaines ?","sql":"SELECT a.name FROM author AS a INNER JOIN domain AS d ON d.name = a.name;"},{"question":"Quels journaux ont le même nom qu'une conférence ?","sql":"SELECT j.name FROM journal AS j INNER JOIN conference AS c ON c.name = j.name;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont été écrites par un auteur dont le nom contient « Smith » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid JOIN author AS a ON a.aid = w.aid WHERE a.name LIKE '%Smith%';"},{"question":"Quels domaines sont associés à des publications sans résumé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d JOIN domain_publication AS dp ON dp.did = d.did JOIN publication AS p ON p.pid = dp.pid WHERE p.abstract IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque mot-clé, combien de publications l'utilisent ?","sql":"SELECT k.kid, k.keyword, COUNT(pk.pid) AS nombre_publications FROM keyword AS k LEFT JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.kid = k.kid GROUP BY k.kid, k.keyword ORDER BY nombre_publications DESC;"},{"question":"Quels mots-clés sont utilisés par plus de dix publications ?","sql":"SELECT k.kid, k.keyword, COUNT(pk.pid) AS nombre_publications FROM keyword AS k JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.kid = k.kid GROUP BY k.kid, k.keyword HAVING COUNT(pk.pid) > 10;"},{"question":"Quels articles citent une publication plus ancienne qu'eux ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p1.pid, p1.title FROM publication AS p1 JOIN cite AS c ON c.citing = p1.pid JOIN publication AS p2 ON p2.pid = c.cited WHERE p2.year < p1.year;"},{"question":"Quels articles sont cités par une publication plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p1.pid, p1.title FROM publication AS p1 JOIN cite AS c ON c.cited = p1.pid JOIN publication AS p2 ON p2.pid = c.citing WHERE p2.year > p1.year;"},{"question":"Quel est le ratio moyen entre citations et références ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(CAST(citation_num AS REAL) / NULLIF(reference_num, 0)) AS ratio_moyen FROM publication;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un ratio citations-références supérieur à 2 ?","sql":"SELECT pid, title FROM publication WHERE reference_num > 0 AND CAST(citation_num AS REAL) / reference_num > 2;"},{"question":"Quelles publications ont exactement deux auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid GROUP BY p.pid, p.title HAVING COUNT(w.aid) = 2;"},{"question":"Combien de collaborations distinctes entre auteurs sont enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_collaborations FROM (SELECT DISTINCT w1.aid, w2.aid FROM writes AS w1 JOIN writes AS w2 ON w1.pid = w2.pid WHERE w1.aid < w2.aid);"},{"question":"Quels organismes possèdent au moins un auteur dans le domaine 1 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT o.oid, o.name FROM organization AS o JOIN author AS a ON a.oid = o.oid JOIN domain_author AS da ON da.aid = a.aid WHERE da.did = 1;"},{"question":"Quels domaines n'ont aucun mot-clé associé ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d LEFT JOIN domain_keyword AS dk ON dk.did = d.did WHERE dk.kid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels domaines n'ont aucune conférence associée ?","sql":"SELECT d.did, d.name FROM domain AS d LEFT JOIN domain_conference AS dc ON dc.did = d.did WHERE dc.cid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels articles possèdent un mot-clé mais aucun auteur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title FROM publication AS p JOIN publication_keyword AS pk ON pk.pid = p.pid LEFT JOIN writes AS w ON w.pid = p.pid WHERE w.aid IS {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et nationalités de tous les architectes, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT name, nationality
FROM architect
ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Quels ponts sont plus longs que la longueur moyenne de l’ensemble des ponts ?","sql":"SELECT name, location, length_meters
FROM bridge
WHERE length_meters > (SELECT AVG(length_meters) FROM bridge)
ORDER BY length_meters DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de moulins correspondent à chaque type de moulin ?","sql":"SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_moulins
FROM mill
GROUP BY type
ORDER BY nombre_de_moulins DESC, type;"},{"question":"Quels architectes n’ont conçu aucun pont ?","sql":"SELECT a.id, a.name
FROM architect AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bridge AS b
    WHERE b.architect_id = a.id
)
ORDER BY a.name;"},{"question":"Affichez chaque pont avec le nom de son architecte et son lieu d’implantation.","sql":"SELECT b.name AS pont, a.name AS architecte, b.location
FROM bridge AS b
JOIN architect AS a ON a.id = b.architect_id
ORDER BY a.name, b.name;"},{"question":"Quel est le moulin construit le plus ancien, et en quelle année a-t-il été construit ?","sql":"SELECT name, location, built_year
FROM mill
WHERE built_year = (SELECT MIN(built_year) FROM mill)
ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque architecte ayant conçu au moins deux ponts, quelle est la longueur moyenne de ses ponts en mètres ?","sql":"SELECT a.name AS architecte, AVG(b.length_meters) AS longueur_moyenne
FROM architect AS a
JOIN bridge AS b ON b.architect_id = a.id
GROUP BY a.id, a.name
HAVING COUNT(b.id) >= 2
ORDER BY longueur_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels ponts ont une longueur indiquée en mètres mais pas en pieds ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, length_meters
FROM bridge
WHERE length_meters IS NOT NULL
  AND length_feet IS NULL
ORDER BY id;"},{"question":"Combien de moulins ont des notes renseignées pour chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS moulins_avec_notes
FROM mill
WHERE notes IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(notes) <> ''
GROUP BY type
ORDER BY type;"},{"question":"Quelles nationalités d’architectes sont représentées par au moins deux architectes ?","sql":"SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS nombre_architectes
FROM architect
GROUP BY nationality
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_architectes DESC, nationality;"},{"question":"Quels moulins ont été construits après l’année moyenne de construction de tous les moulins ?","sql":"SELECT name, location, built_year
FROM mill
WHERE built_year > (SELECT AVG(built_year) FROM mill)
ORDER BY built_year, name;"},{"question":"Quels architectes ont conçu au moins un pont et au moins un moulin ?","sql":"SELECT a.name
FROM architect AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bridge AS b
    WHERE b.architect_id = a.id
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mill AS m
    WHERE m.architect_id = a.id
)
ORDER BY a.name;"}]}

?","sql":"SELECT fl.fault_log_entry_id, fl.asset_id, fl.fault_log_entry_datetime, fl.fault_description FROM Fault_Log AS fl LEFT JOIN Engineer_Visits AS ev ON ev.fault_log_entry_id = ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id WHERE f.year = 2003 GROUP BY f.player_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN f.pos = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 moyenne de leur année ?","sql":"SELECT p.name_first, p.name_last, b.year, b.h * 1.0 / b.ab AS moyenne FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id WHERE b.ab > 0 AND b.h * 1.0 / b.ab > player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.votes_first > 0;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont joué dans le champ extérieur gauche, central et droit en 2015 ?","sql":"SELECT player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM player_award_vote pav WHERE pav.player_id = pa.player_id AND pav.year = pa.year AND pav.votes_first > {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les prénom, nom et adresse e-mail de tous les étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT first_name, last_name, email_address
FROM Students;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses se trouvent dans la ville de Paris ?","sql":"SELECT address_id, line_1, city, zip_postcode, country
FROM Addresses
WHERE city = 'Paris';"},{"question":"Quels incidents ont été enregistrés avec leur type descriptif ?","sql":"SELECT bi.incident_id, bi.student_id, rit.incident_type_description, bi.date_incident_start, bi.incident_summary
FROM Behavior_Incident AS bi
JOIN Ref_Incident_Type AS rit
  ON rit.incident_type_code = bi.incident_type_code;"},{"question":"Combien d'incidents chaque étudiant a-t-il eus, y compris ceux sans incident ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(bi.incident_id) AS nombre_incidents
FROM Students AS s
LEFT JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi
  ON bi.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;"},{"question":"Quelles retenues sont associées à un enseignant, avec le nom du type de retenue ?","sql":"SELECT d.detention_id, d.datetime_detention_start, t.first_name, t.last_name, rdt.detention_type_description
FROM Detention AS d
LEFT JOIN Teachers AS t
  ON t.teacher_id = d.teacher_id
JOIN Ref_Detention_Type AS rdt
  ON rdt.detention_type_code = d.detention_type_code;"},{"question":"Quelles notes d'évaluation ont été rédigées depuis le 1er janvier 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT notes_id, student_id, teacher_id, date_of_notes, text_of_notes
FROM Assessment_Notes
WHERE date_of_notes >= '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY date_of_notes;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une adresse actuellement enregistrée dans Student_Addresses ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, a.line_1, a.city
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Student_Addresses AS sa
  ON sa.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN Addresses AS a
  ON a.address_id = sa.address_id
WHERE sa.date_address_to IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le loyer mensuel moyen par ville ?","sql":"SELECT a.city, AVG(sa.monthly_rental) AS loyer_mensuel_moyen
FROM Student_Addresses AS sa
JOIN Addresses AS a
  ON a.address_id = sa.address_id
GROUP BY a.city
ORDER BY loyer_mensuel_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quels incidents ont commencé en 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT incident_id, student_id, incident_type_code, date_incident_start, incident_summary
FROM Behavior_Incident
WHERE date_incident_start >= '2024-01-01'
  AND date_incident_start < '2025-01-01';"},{"question":"Combien de retenues existe-t-il pour chaque type de retenue ?","sql":"SELECT rdt.detention_type_code, rdt.detention_type_description, COUNT(d.detention_id) AS nombre_retenues
FROM Ref_Detention_Type AS rdt
LEFT JOIN Detention AS d
  ON d.detention_type_code = rdt.detention_type_code
GROUP BY rdt.detention_type_code, rdt.detention_type_description;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants sont des femmes ?","sql":"SELECT teacher_id, first_name, last_name, email_address
FROM Teachers
WHERE gender = 'F';"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont jamais fait l'objet d'un incident ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Students AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Behavior_Incident AS bi
    WHERE bi.student_id = s.student_id
);"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne des incidents, en heures, lorsque les deux dates sont renseignées ?","sql":"SELECT AVG((julianday(date_incident_end) - julianday(date_incident_start)) * 24.0) AS duree_moyenne_heures
FROM Behavior_Incident
WHERE date_incident_start IS NOT NULL
  AND date_incident_end IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles notes affichent le nom de l'étudiant et celui de l'enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT an.notes_id, an.date_of_notes, s.first_name AS prenom_etudiant, s.last_name AS nom_etudiant, t.first_name AS prenom_enseignant, t.last_name AS nom_enseignant, an.text_of_notes
FROM Assessment_Notes AS an
LEFT JOIN Students AS s
  ON s.student_id = an.student_id
JOIN Teachers AS t
  ON t.teacher_id = an.teacher_id;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses sont utilisées à la fois comme adresse principale d'un étudiant et comme adresse d'historique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.address_id, a.line_1, a.city
FROM Addresses AS a
JOIN Students AS s
  ON s.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN Student_Addresses AS sa
  ON sa.address_id = a.address_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le loyer mensuel le plus élevé enregistré dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT a.city, MAX(sa.monthly_rental) AS loyer_maximal
FROM Student_Addresses AS sa
JOIN Addresses AS a
  ON a.address_id = sa.address_id
GROUP BY a.city;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont associés à une retenue et à l'incident correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, sid.detention_id, sid.incident_id, bi.incident_summary
FROM Students_in_Detention AS sid
JOIN Students AS s
  ON s.student_id = sid.student_id
JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi
  ON bi.incident_id = sid.incident_id;"},{"question":"Quels types d'incident n'ont encore aucun incident enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT rit.incident_type_code, rit.incident_type_description
FROM Ref_Incident_Type AS rit
LEFT JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi
  ON bi.incident_type_code = rit.incident_type_code
WHERE bi.incident_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant, quelle est la date de sa note d'évaluation la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, MAX(an.date_of_notes) AS derniere_note
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Assessment_Notes AS an
  ON an.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants n'ont dirigé aucune retenue ?","sql":"SELECT t.teacher_id, t.first_name, t.last_name
FROM Teachers AS t
LEFT JOIN Detention AS d
  ON d.teacher_id = t.teacher_id
WHERE d.detention_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les descriptions des types d'adresse disponibles ?","sql":"SELECT address_type_code, address_type_description
FROM Ref_Address_Types
ORDER BY address_type_description;"},{"question":"Comment afficher le nom complet de chaque étudiant en une seule colonne ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, TRIM(COALESCE(first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(middle_name || ' ', '') || COALESCE(last_name, '')) AS nom_complet
FROM Students;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre, le loyer minimal et le loyer maximal des locations par étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_locations, MIN(monthly_rental) AS loyer_minimal, MAX(monthly_rental) AS loyer_maximal
FROM Student_Addresses
GROUP BY student_id;"},{"question":"Quels incidents comportent des recommandations renseignées ?","sql":"SELECT incident_id, student_id, incident_summary, recommendations
FROM Behavior_Incident
WHERE recommendations IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(recommendations) <> '';"},{"question":"Combien d'incidents ont commencé chaque mois de chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', date_incident_start) AS annee, strftime('%m', date_incident_start) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_incidents
FROM Behavior_Incident
WHERE date_incident_start IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date_incident_start), strftime('%m', date_incident_start)
ORDER BY annee, mois;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont à la fois au moins un incident et au moins une note d'évaluation ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Students AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Behavior_Incident AS bi
    WHERE bi.student_id = s.student_id
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Assessment_Notes AS an
    WHERE an.student_id = s.student_id
);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont pas de date de départ de l'université ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, date_first_rental
FROM Students
WHERE date_left_university IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles retenues ont commencé après la fin d'une autre retenue ?","sql":"SELECT d1.detention_id AS retenue_1, d2.detention_id AS retenue_2, d1.datetime_detention_start AS debut_1, d2.datetime_detention_start AS debut_2
FROM Detention AS d1
JOIN Detention AS d2
  ON d1.detention_id < d2.detention_id
WHERE d1.datetime_detention_start IS NOT NULL
  AND d2.datetime_detention_start IS NOT NULL
  AND d1.datetime_detention_end IS NOT NULL
  AND d2.datetime_detention_start > d1.datetime_detention_end;"},{"question":"Pour chaque type d'incident, quel est le nombre d'incidents et le nombre d'étudiants concernés ?","sql":"SELECT rit.incident_type_code, rit.incident_type_description, COUNT(bi.incident_id) AS nombre_incidents, COUNT(DISTINCT bi.student_id) AS nombre_etudiants
FROM Ref_Incident_Type AS rit
LEFT JOIN Behavior_Incident AS bi
  ON bi.incident_type_code = rit.incident_type_code
GROUP BY rit.incident_type_code, rit.incident_type_description
ORDER BY nombre_incidents DESC;"}]}

date, mean_visibility_miles FROM weather WHERE mean_visibility_miles < 5 ORDER BY date;"},{"question":"Quelle est la pression moyenne au niveau de la mer par code postal ?","sql":"SELECT zip_code, ?","sql":"SELECT date, mean_temperature_f FROM weather WHERE mean_temperature_f > (SELECT AVG(mean_temperature_f) FROM weather) ORDER BY mean_temperature_f DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le jour où la différence entre températures maximale et minimale est la plus grande ?","sql":"SELECT date, max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f AS amplitude FROM weather ORDER BY amplitude DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien de jours sont associés à chaque direction du vent ?","sql":"SELECT wind_dir_degrees, COUNT(*) AS nombre_jours FROM weather GROUP BY wind_dir_degrees ORDER BY nombre_jours DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations n’ont jamais de relevé associé ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name FROM station AS s LEFT JOIN status AS st ON st.station_id = s.id WHERE st.station_id IS NULL ORDER BY s.name;"},{"question":"Combien de trajets commencent dans chaque ville de station ?","sql":"SELECT s.city, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets FROM trip AS t JOIN station AS s ON s.id = t.start_station_id GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY nombre_trajets DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des stations de départ ayant reçu au moins un trajet ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM station AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.start_station_id = s.id ORDER BY s.name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne des trajets par ville de départ ?","sql":"SELECT s.city, AVG(t.duration) AS duree_moyenne FROM trip AS t JOIN station AS s ON s.id = t.start_station_id GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY duree_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont plus de trajets entrants que sortants ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id = s.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS arrivees, SUM(CASE WHEN t.start_station_id = s.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS departs FROM station AS s LEFT JOIN trip AS t ON t.start_station_id = s.id OR t.end_station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING arrivees > departs;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de trajets pour chaque paire de stations de départ et d’arrivée ?","sql":"SELECT start_station_id, end_station_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets FROM trip GROUP BY start_station_id, end_station_id ORDER BY nombre_trajets DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont une capacité supérieure au nombre maximal de vélos observé ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name, s.dock_count, MAX(st.bikes_available) AS maximum_observe FROM station AS s JOIN status AS st ON st.station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.dock_count HAVING s.dock_count > MAX(st.bikes_available);"},{"question":"Quelle est la disponibilité moyenne des vélos pour chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT s.city, AVG(st.bikes_available) AS moyenne_velos FROM station AS s JOIN status AS st ON st.station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY moyenne_velos DESC;"},{"question":"Quels trajets ont commencé dans une station située à San Jose ?","sql":"SELECT t.id, t.duration, t.start_station_id FROM trip AS t JOIN station AS s ON s.id = t.start_station_id WHERE s.city = 'San Jose' ORDER BY t.start_date;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont été installées avant 2013 et disposent d’au moins 20 bornes ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, installation_date, dock_count FROM station WHERE installation_date < '2013-01-01' AND dock_count >= 20 ORDER BY installation_date;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de stations par année d’installation ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', installation_date) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_stations FROM station GROUP BY annee ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne des trajets selon que le trajet boucle ou non ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN start_station_id = end_station_id THEN 'Boucle' ELSE 'Trajet entre stations' END AS type_trajet, AVG(duration) AS duree_moyenne FROM trip GROUP BY type_trajet;"},{"question":"Quels codes postaux ont à la fois des trajets et des données météorologiques ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.zip_code FROM trip AS t JOIN weather AS w ON w.zip_code = t.zip_code WHERE t.zip_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.zip_code;"},{"question":"Pour chaque code postal partagé, combien de trajets et de jours météo sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT t.zip_code, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS nombre_trajets, COUNT(DISTINCT w.date) AS nombre_jours_meteo FROM trip AS t JOIN weather AS w ON w.zip_code = t.zip_code GROUP BY t.zip_code ORDER BY t.zip_code;"},{"question":"Quels jours pluvieux ont enregistré plus de 50 trajets commencés ?","sql":"SELECT w.date, w.precipitation_inches, COUNT(t.id) AS nombre_trajets FROM weather AS w JOIN trip AS t ON date(t.start_date) = w.date WHERE w.precipitation_inches > 0 GROUP BY w.date, w.precipitation_inches HAVING COUNT(t.id) > 50 ORDER BY w.date;"},{"question":"Quelle est la température moyenne les jours où des trajets ont commencé ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(w.mean_temperature_f) AS temperature_moyenne FROM weather AS w WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip AS t WHERE date(t.start_date) = w.date);"},{"question":"Quels jours ont eu la plus forte fréquentation et une température moyenne supérieure à 60 degrés ?","sql":"SELECT date(t.start_date) AS jour, COUNT(*) AS nombre_trajets, w.mean_temperature_f FROM trip AS t JOIN weather AS w ON w.date = date(t.start_date) WHERE w.mean_temperature_f > 60 GROUP BY jour, w.mean_temperature_f ORDER BY nombre_trajets DESC LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont un nombre de bornes supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les stations ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, dock_count FROM station WHERE dock_count > (SELECT AVG(dock_count) FROM station) ORDER BY dock_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels trajets sont plus longs que la durée moyenne de tous les trajets ?","sql":"SELECT id, duration, start_station_id, end_station_id FROM trip WHERE duration > (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM trip) ORDER BY duration DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ont une disponibilité moyenne de vélos supérieure à la moyenne globale des relevés ?","sql":"SELECT station_id, AVG(bikes_available) AS moyenne_station FROM status GROUP BY station_id HAVING AVG(bikes_available) > (SELECT AVG(bikes_available) FROM status) ORDER BY moyenne_station DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le pourcentage de trajets effectués par chaque type d’abonnement ?","sql":"SELECT subscription_type, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip) AS pourcentage FROM trip GROUP BY subscription_type ORDER BY pourcentage DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois stations les plus utilisées comme départ et leur capacité ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.name, s.dock_count, COUNT(t.id) AS nombre_departs FROM station AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.start_station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.dock_count ORDER BY nombre_departs DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quelle est la paire de stations correspondant au trajet moyen le plus long ?","sql":"SELECT start_station_id, end_station_id, AVG(duration) AS duree_moyenne FROM trip GROUP BY start_station_id, end_station_id ORDER BY duree_moyenne DESC LIMIT 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les lieux de naissance de toutes les personnes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Birth_Place\" FROM \"people\";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes mesurent plus de 180 cm ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Height\" FROM \"people\" WHERE \"Height\" > 180 ORDER BY \"Height\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les totaux obtenus par chaque athlète, avec son nom ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\", b.\"Total\" FROM \"people\" AS p JOIN \"body_builder\" AS b ON p.\"People_ID\" = b.\"People_ID\" ORDER BY b.\"Total\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nom de la personne ayant obtenu le meilleur total ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\", b.\"Total\" FROM \"people\" AS p JOIN \"body_builder\" AS b ON p.\"People_ID\" = b.\"People_ID\" WHERE b.\"Total\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Total\") FROM \"body_builder\");"},{"question":"Quel est le poids moyen des personnes pour chaque lieu de naissance ?","sql":"SELECT \"Birth_Place\", AVG(\"Weight\") AS \"Poids_Moyen\" FROM \"people\" GROUP BY \"Birth_Place\" ORDER BY \"Poids_Moyen\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de performances sont enregistrées et quel est leur total moyen ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_Performances\", AVG(\"Total\") AS \"Total_Moyen\" FROM \"body_builder\";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ne possèdent aucun résultat de performance enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\" FROM \"people\" AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"body_builder\" AS b WHERE b.\"People_ID\" = p.\"People_ID\");"},{"question":"Affiche toutes les performances, de la meilleure à la moins bonne selon le total.","sql":"SELECT \"Body_Builder_ID\", \"People_ID\", \"Snatch\", \"Clean_Jerk\", \"Total\" FROM \"body_builder\" ORDER BY \"Total\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le meilleur résultat à l'épaulé-jeté réalisé par une personne née en France ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\", MAX(b.\"Clean_Jerk\") AS \"Meilleur_Clean_Jerk\" FROM \"people\" AS p JOIN \"body_builder\" AS b ON p.\"People_ID\" = b.\"People_ID\" WHERE p.\"Birth_Place\" = 'France' GROUP BY p.\"People_ID\", p.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Meilleur_Clean_Jerk\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien de performances sont associées à chaque personne, y compris celles sans performance ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\", COUNT(b.\"Body_Builder_ID\") AS \"Nombre_Performances\" FROM \"people\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"body_builder\" AS b ON p.\"People_ID\" = b.\"People_ID\" GROUP BY p.\"People_ID\", p.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_Performances\" DESC, p.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quels athlètes ont obtenu un total compris entre 200 et 300 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\", b.\"Total\" FROM \"people\" AS p JOIN \"body_builder\" AS b ON p.\"People_ID\" = b.\"People_ID\" WHERE b.\"Total\" BETWEEN 200 AND 300 ORDER BY b.\"Total\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles performances ont un arraché supérieur à l'épaulé-jeté ?","sql":"SELECT \"Body_Builder_ID\", \"Snatch\", \"Clean_Jerk\", \"Total\" FROM \"body_builder\" WHERE \"Snatch\" > \"Clean_Jerk\";"},{"question":"Combien de personnes sont nées chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT substr(\"Birth_Date\", 1, 4) AS \"Annee_Naissance\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_Personnes\" FROM \"people\" GROUP BY substr(\"Birth_Date\", 1, 4) ORDER BY \"Annee_Naissance\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois meilleurs totaux avec le nom des athlètes correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\", b.\"Total\" FROM \"people\" AS p JOIN \"body_builder\" AS b ON p.\"People_ID\" = b.\"People_ID\" ORDER BY b.\"Total\" DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Pour chaque performance, quelle est la différence entre l'épaulé-jeté et l'arraché ?","sql":"SELECT \"Body_Builder_ID\", \"Clean_Jerk\" - \"Snatch\" AS \"Difference\" FROM \"body_builder\" ORDER BY \"Difference\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes pèsent plus que le poids moyen de toutes les personnes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Weight\" FROM \"people\" WHERE \"Weight\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Weight\") FROM \"people\") ORDER BY \"Weight\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque personne ayant au moins une performance, quel est son meilleur total ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Name\", MAX(b.\"Total\") AS \"Meilleur_Total\" FROM \"people\" AS p JOIN \"body_builder\" AS b ON p.\"People_ID\" = b.\"People_ID\" GROUP BY p.\"People_ID\", p.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Meilleur_Total\" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les titres des livres et leurs auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Writer\" FROM \"book\" ORDER BY \"Title\";"},{"question":"Quelles publications existent, avec leur éditeur, leur date et leur prix ?","sql":"SELECT \"Publication_ID\", \"Publisher\", \"Publication_Date\", \"Price\" FROM \"publication\" ORDER BY \"Publication_Date\";"},{"question":"Quels livres ont été publiés par chaque éditeur ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Publisher\", b.\"Title\" FROM \"publication\" AS p JOIN \"book\" AS b ON b.\"Book_ID\" = p.\"Book_ID\" ORDER BY p.\"Publisher\", b.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des publications pour chaque éditeur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Publisher\", AVG(\"Price\") AS \"Prix_moyen\" FROM \"publication\" GROUP BY \"Publisher\" ORDER BY \"Prix_moyen\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels livres n’ont encore aucune publication enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Book_ID\", b.\"Title\" FROM \"book\" AS b LEFT JOIN \"publication\" AS p ON p.\"Book_ID\" = b.\"Book_ID\" WHERE p.\"Publication_ID\" IS NULL ORDER BY b.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Combien de publications sont associées à chaque livre ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Book_ID\", b.\"Title\", COUNT(p.\"Publication_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_publications\" FROM \"book\" AS b LEFT JOIN \"publication\" AS p ON p.\"Book_ID\" = b.\"Book_ID\" GROUP BY b.\"Book_ID\", b.\"Title\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_publications\" DESC, b.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la publication la plus chère et à quel livre correspond-elle ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Publication_ID\", b.\"Title\", p.\"Publisher\", p.\"Price\" FROM \"publication\" AS p JOIN \"book\" AS b ON b.\"Book_ID\" = p.\"Book_ID\" WHERE p.\"Price\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Price\") FROM \"publication\");"},{"question":"Quels livres ont un nombre de numéros supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Book_ID\", \"Title\", \"Issues\" FROM \"book\" WHERE \"Issues\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Issues\") FROM \"book\") ORDER BY \"Issues\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque livre, quelle est la date de sa publication la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Book_ID\", b.\"Title\", MAX(p.\"Publication_Date\") AS \"Date_la_plus_récente\" FROM \"book\" AS b LEFT JOIN \"publication\" AS p ON p.\"Book_ID\" = b.\"Book_ID\" GROUP BY b.\"Book_ID\", b.\"Title\" ORDER BY \"Date_la_plus_récente\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont écrit plusieurs livres ?","sql":"SELECT \"Writer\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_livres\" FROM \"book\" GROUP BY \"Writer\" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_livres\" DESC, \"Writer\";"},{"question":"Quel est le prix total des publications pour chaque livre ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Title\", COALESCE(SUM(p.\"Price\"), 0) AS \"Prix_total\" FROM \"book\" AS b LEFT JOIN \"publication\" AS p ON p.\"Book_ID\" = b.\"Book_ID\" GROUP BY b.\"Book_ID\", b.\"Title\" ORDER BY \"Prix_total\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles publications coûtent entre 10 et 20 euros inclus ?","sql":"SELECT \"Publication_ID\", \"Publisher\", \"Price\" FROM \"publication\" WHERE \"Price\" BETWEEN 10 AND 20 ORDER BY \"Price\";"},{"question":"Quels livres ont été publiés en 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT b.\"Book_ID\", b.\"Title\" FROM \"book\" AS b JOIN \"publication\" AS p ON p.\"Book_ID\" = b.\"Book_ID\" WHERE p.\"Publication_Date\" LIKE '2023-%' ORDER BY b.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne du nombre de numéros par auteur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Writer\", AVG(\"Issues\") AS \"Moyenne_des_numéros\" FROM \"book\" GROUP BY \"Writer\" ORDER BY \"Moyenne_des_numéros\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque éditeur, quelle est sa publication la moins chère ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Publisher\", p.\"Publication_ID\", b.\"Title\", p.\"Price\" FROM \"publication\" AS p JOIN \"book\" AS b ON b.\"Book_ID\" = p.\"Book_ID\" WHERE p.\"Price\" = (SELECT MIN(p2.\"Price\") FROM \"publication\" AS p2 WHERE p2.\"Publisher\" = p.\"Publisher\") ORDER BY p.\"Publisher\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les accélérateurs Web, avec leur système d’exploitation, leur client et leur type de connexion, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, Operating_system, Client, Connection
FROM Web_client_accelerator
ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Quels navigateurs ont une part de marché supérieure à 10 %, du plus représenté au moins représenté ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, market_share
FROM browser
WHERE market_share > 10
ORDER BY market_share DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque compatibilité, quel est le nom de l’accélérateur, le nom du navigateur et l’année de début de compatibilité ?","sql":"SELECT w.name AS accelerator_name, b.name AS browser_name, c.compatible_since_year
FROM accelerator_compatible_browser AS c
JOIN Web_client_accelerator AS w ON w.id = c.accelerator_id
JOIN browser AS b ON b.id = c.browser_id
ORDER BY w.name, b.name;"},{"question":"Combien de navigateurs compatibles sont associés à chaque accélérateur, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT w.id, w.name, COUNT(c.browser_id) AS compatible_browser_count
FROM Web_client_accelerator AS w
LEFT JOIN accelerator_compatible_browser AS c ON c.accelerator_id = w.id
GROUP BY w.id, w.name
ORDER BY compatible_browser_count DESC, w.name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la part de marché moyenne des navigateurs compatibles avec chaque accélérateur ?","sql":"SELECT w.id, w.name, AVG(b.market_share) AS average_market_share
FROM Web_client_accelerator AS w
JOIN accelerator_compatible_browser AS c ON c.accelerator_id = w.id
JOIN browser AS b ON b.id = c.browser_id
GROUP BY w.id, w.name
ORDER BY average_market_share DESC;"},{"question":"Quels navigateurs sont compatibles avec au moins un accélérateur depuis 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.name
FROM browser AS b
JOIN accelerator_compatible_browser AS c ON c.browser_id = b.id
WHERE c.compatible_since_year >= 2020
ORDER BY b.name;"},{"question":"Quels accélérateurs ne disposent d’aucune compatibilité enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT w.id, w.name
FROM Web_client_accelerator AS w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM accelerator_compatible_browser AS c
    WHERE c.accelerator_id = w.id
)
ORDER BY w.name;"},{"question":"Combien d’accélérateurs utilisent chaque système d’exploitation ?","sql":"SELECT Operating_system, COUNT(*) AS accelerator_count
FROM Web_client_accelerator
GROUP BY Operating_system
ORDER BY accelerator_count DESC, Operating_system;"},{"question":"Quels navigateurs ont la plus grande part de marché parmi ceux compatibles avec l’accélérateur nommé « Web Accelerator » ?","sql":"SELECT b.id, b.name, b.market_share
FROM browser AS b
JOIN accelerator_compatible_browser AS c ON c.browser_id = b.id
JOIN Web_client_accelerator AS w ON w.id = c.accelerator_id
WHERE w.name = 'Web Accelerator'
ORDER BY b.market_share DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles compatibilités ont été introduites avant 2018 pour des navigateurs dont la part de marché est d’au moins 5 % ?","sql":"SELECT w.name AS accelerator_name, b.name AS browser_name, c.compatible_since_year, b.market_share
FROM accelerator_compatible_browser AS c
JOIN Web_client_accelerator AS w ON w.id = c.accelerator_id
JOIN browser AS b ON b.id = c.browser_id
WHERE c.compatible_since_year < 2018
  AND b.market_share >= 5
ORDER BY c.compatible_since_year, b.market_share DESC;"},{"question":"Quel navigateur possède la part de marché la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT id, name, market_share
FROM browser
WHERE market_share = (SELECT MAX(market_share) FROM browser);"},{"question":"Pour chaque type de connexion, combien d’accélérateurs sont recensés et combien de clients distincts utilisent-ils ?","sql":"SELECT Connection, COUNT(*) AS accelerator_count, COUNT(DISTINCT Client) AS distinct_client_count
FROM Web_client_accelerator
GROUP BY Connection
ORDER BY accelerator_count DESC, Connection;"},{"question":"Classez les navigateurs selon le nombre d’accélérateurs compatibles, en affichant aussi ceux qui ne sont associés à aucun accélérateur.","sql":"SELECT b.id, b.name, COUNT(c.accelerator_id) AS accelerator_count
FROM browser AS b
LEFT JOIN accelerator_compatible_browser AS c ON c.browser_id = b.id
GROUP BY b.id, b.name
ORDER BY accelerator_count DESC, b.name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des personnes candidates et leur taux de soutien, classés du plus élevé au plus faible ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", c."Support_rate"
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
ORDER BY c."Support_rate" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles candidatures ont un taux de soutien supérieur à leur taux de considération ?","sql":"SELECT c."Candidate_ID", p."Name", c."Support_rate", c."Consider_rate"
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
WHERE c."Support_rate" > c."Consider_rate";"},{"question":"Quel est le taux moyen de soutien pour chaque source de sondage ?","sql":"SELECT "Poll_Source", AVG("Support_rate") AS average_support_rate
FROM "candidate"
GROUP BY "Poll_Source"
ORDER BY average_support_rate DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de candidatures sont associées à chaque sexe ?","sql":"SELECT p."Sex", COUNT(c."Candidate_ID") AS candidate_count
FROM "people" AS p
LEFT JOIN "candidate" AS c ON c."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."Sex"
ORDER BY candidate_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle personne candidate possède le taux de soutien le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", c."Candidate_ID", c."Support_rate"
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
WHERE c."Support_rate" = (SELECT MAX("Support_rate") FROM "candidate");"},{"question":"Quelles candidatures ont un taux d'opposition inférieur à 20 % ?","sql":"SELECT c."Candidate_ID", p."Name", c."Oppose_rate"
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
WHERE c."Oppose_rate" < 20
ORDER BY c."Oppose_rate" ASC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes sont nées entre le 1er janvier 1970 et le 31 décembre 1979 ?","sql":"SELECT "People_ID", "Name", "Date_of_Birth"
FROM "people"
WHERE date("Date_of_Birth") BETWEEN date('1970-01-01') AND date('1979-12-31')
ORDER BY "Date_of_Birth";"},{"question":"Combien de candidatures proviennent de chaque source de sondage ?","sql":"SELECT "Poll_Source", COUNT(*) AS candidate_count
FROM "candidate"
GROUP BY "Poll_Source"
ORDER BY candidate_count DESC, "Poll_Source";"},{"question":"Quel est le taux moyen de soutien selon le sexe des personnes candidates ?","sql":"SELECT p."Sex", AVG(c."Support_rate") AS average_support_rate
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."Sex"
ORDER BY p."Sex";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes candidates ont un taux de soutien supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les candidatures ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", c."Support_rate"
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
WHERE c."Support_rate" > (SELECT AVG("Support_rate") FROM "candidate")
ORDER BY c."Support_rate" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque source de sondage, quelle est la candidature ayant le meilleur taux de soutien ?","sql":"WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c."Poll_Source" ORDER BY c."Support_rate" DESC) AS rn
    FROM "candidate" AS c
)
SELECT r."Poll_Source", p."Name", r."Support_rate"
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = r."People_ID"
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r."Poll_Source";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois candidatures ayant les taux de soutien les plus élevés ?","sql":"SELECT c."Candidate_ID", p."Name", c."Support_rate"
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
ORDER BY c."Support_rate" DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel est l'écart entre le soutien et l'opposition pour chaque candidature ?","sql":"SELECT c."Candidate_ID", p."Name", c."Support_rate" - c."Oppose_rate" AS support_opposition_gap
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
ORDER BY support_opposition_gap DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ne sont associées à aucune candidature ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name"
FROM "people" AS p
LEFT JOIN "candidate" AS c ON c."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE c."Candidate_ID" IS NULL
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles candidatures n'ont pas de taux d'incertitude renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT "Candidate_ID", "People_ID", "Poll_Source"
FROM "candidate"
WHERE "Unsure_rate" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de personnes candidates sont nées au cours de chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT substr(p."Date_of_Birth", 1, 4) AS birth_year, COUNT(c."Candidate_ID") AS candidate_count
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "candidate" AS c ON c."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY birth_year
ORDER BY birth_year;"},{"question":"Quel est le classement de chaque candidature selon son taux de soutien ?","sql":"SELECT c."Candidate_ID", p."Name", c."Support_rate",
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c."Support_rate" DESC) AS support_rank
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
ORDER BY support_rank, p."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles sources ont un taux moyen d'incertitude supérieur à 10 % ?","sql":"SELECT "Poll_Source", AVG("Unsure_rate") AS average_unsure_rate
FROM "candidate"
GROUP BY "Poll_Source"
HAVING AVG("Unsure_rate") > 10
ORDER BY average_unsure_rate DESC;"},{"question":"Affichez, pour chaque candidature, les quatre taux de sondage dans une même ligne.","sql":"SELECT "Candidate_ID", "Support_rate", "Consider_rate", "Oppose_rate", "Unsure_rate"
FROM "candidate"
ORDER BY "Candidate_ID";"},{"question":"Quelle candidature présente l'écart absolu le plus faible entre le soutien et l'opposition ?","sql":"SELECT c."Candidate_ID", p."Name", c."Support_rate", c."Oppose_rate",
       ABS(c."Support_rate" - c."Oppose_rate") AS absolute_gap
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
ORDER BY absolute_gap ASC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quel est l'âge approximatif de chaque personne candidate au 1er janvier 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", p."Date_of_Birth",
       CAST((julianday('2024-01-01') - julianday(p."Date_of_Birth")) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS approximate_age
FROM "candidate" AS c
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = c."People_ID"
ORDER BY approximate_age DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque source, combien de candidatures ont un taux de soutien d'au moins 50 % ?","sql":"SELECT "Poll_Source",
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Support_rate" >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS support_at_least_50_count,
       COUNT(*) AS total_candidate_count
FROM "candidate"
GROUP BY "Poll_Source"
ORDER BY "Poll_Source";"},{"question":"Quelle est la taille moyenne des personnes candidates pour chaque sexe ?","sql":"SELECT p."Sex", AVG(p."Height") AS average_height
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "candidate" AS c ON c."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."Sex"
ORDER BY p."Sex";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes candidates ont un poids supérieur au poids moyen des personnes candidates ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", p."Weight"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "candidate" AS c ON c."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE p."Weight" > (
    SELECT AVG(p2."Weight")
    FROM "people" AS p2
    JOIN "candidate" AS c2 ON c2."People_ID" = p2."People_ID"
)
ORDER BY p."Weight" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la candidature la plus proche de la moyenne de soutien de sa propre source de sondage ?","sql":"WITH source_averages AS (
    SELECT "Poll_Source", AVG("Support_rate") AS average_support
    FROM "candidate"
    GROUP BY "Poll_Source"
), differences AS (
    SELECT c.*, ABS(c."Support_rate" - s.average_support) AS distance_from_average
    FROM "candidate" AS c
    JOIN source_averages AS s ON s."Poll_Source" = c."Poll_Source"
)
SELECT d."Candidate_ID", p."Name", d."Poll_Source", d."Support_rate", d.distance_from_average
FROM differences AS d
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = d."People_ID"
ORDER BY d.distance_from_average ASC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes candidates ont un indice de masse corporelle supérieur à 25, en utilisant la taille en mètres ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", p."Height", p."Weight",
       p."Weight" / ((p."Height" / 100.0) * (p."Height" / 100.0)) AS bmi
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "candidate" AS c ON c."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE p."Height" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."Height" > 0
  AND p."Weight" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."Weight" / ((p."Height" / 100.0) * (p."Height" / 100.0)) > 25
ORDER BY bmi DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle source de sondage compte le plus de candidatures ?","sql":"SELECT "Poll_Source", COUNT(*) AS candidate_count
FROM "candidate"
GROUP BY "Poll_Source"
ORDER BY candidate_count DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le taux moyen de soutien des candidatures dont le taux d'opposition est supérieur à leur taux d'incertitude ?","sql":"SELECT AVG("Support_rate") AS average_support_rate
FROM "candidate"
WHERE "Oppose_rate" > "Unsure_rate";"},{"question":"Combien de candidatures ont simultanément un taux de soutien supérieur à 40 % et un taux d'opposition inférieur à 30 % ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_candidate_count
FROM "candidate"
WHERE "Support_rate" > 40
  AND "Oppose_rate" < 30;"},{"question":"Pour chaque personne, indiquez son nom et le nombre de sources de sondage distinctes qui lui sont associées.","sql":"SELECT p."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT c."Poll_Source") AS distinct_poll_source_count
FROM "people" AS p
LEFT JOIN "candidate" AS c ON c."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name"
ORDER BY distinct_poll_source_count DESC, p."Name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels cinémas ont une capacité supérieure à la capacité moyenne de tous les cinémas ?","sql":"SELECT \"Cinema_ID\", \"Name\", \"Capacity\" FROM \"cinema\" WHERE \"Capacity\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Capacity\") FROM \"cinema\");"},{"question":"Quels films sont réalisés par Christopher Nolan ?","sql":"SELECT \"Film_ID\", \"Title\", \"Original_air_date\" FROM \"film\" WHERE un cinéma situé à Paris ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\" FROM \"film\" AS f JOIN \"schedule\" AS s ON s.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\" JOIN \"cinema\" AS c ON c.\"Cinema_ID\" = f.\"Title\" FROM \"film\" AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"schedule\" AS s WHERE s.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\");"},{"question":"Quels cinémas ont un prix moyen de séance supérieur à 12 euros ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Cinema_ID\", c.\"Name\", AVG(s.\"Price\") AS \"average_price\" FROM \"cinema\" AS c JOIN \"schedule\" AS s ON s.\"Cinema_ID\" = c.\"Cinema_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"Cinema_ID\", ?","sql":"SELECT \"Cinema_ID\", \"Name\", \"Capacity\" FROM \"cinema\" WHERE \"Capacity\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Capacity\") FROM \"cinema\");"},{"question":"Pour chaque film, combien de cinémas différents le programment-ils ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\", COUNT(DISTINCT s.\"Cinema_ID\") AS \"cinema_count\" FROM \"film\" AS f LEFT JOIN \"schedule\" AS s ON s.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\" GROUP BY f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quels films ont un code de production commençant par « A » ?","sql":"SELECT \"Film_ID\", \"Title\", \"Production_code\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Production_code\" LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels cinémas proposent au moins une séance à moins de 8 euros ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.\"Cinema_ID\", c.\"Name\" FROM \"cinema\" AS c JOIN \"schedule\" AS s ON s.\"Cinema_ID\" = c.\"Cinema_ID\" WHERE s.\"Price\" < 8;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date de programmation la plus récente enregistrée pour chaque film ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\", MAX(s.\"Date\") AS \"latest_date\" FROM \"film\" AS f JOIN \"schedule\" AS s ON s.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\" GROUP BY f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\";"},{"question":"Quels films sont programmés dans tous les cinémas ?","sql":"SELECT f.\"Film_ID\", f.\"Title\" FROM \"film\" AS f WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.\"Cinema_ID\") FROM \"schedule\" AS s WHERE s.\"Film_ID\" = f.\"Film_ID\") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM \"cinema\");"},{"question":"Classe les programmations par prix décroissant et indique leur rang dans cette liste.","sql":"SELECT \"Cinema_ID\", \"Film_ID\", \"Film_ID\", \"Title\", \"Rank_in_series\", \"Number_in_season\" FROM \"film\" WHERE \"Number_in_season\" > \"Rank_in_series\";"},{"question":"Combien de films sont associés à chaque lieu de cinéma ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Location\", COUNT(DISTINCT f.\"Film_ID\") AS \"film_count\" FROM \"cinema\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"schedule\" AS s ON s.\"Cinema_ID\" = c.\"Cinema_ID\" LEFT JOIN \"film\" AS f ON f.\"Film_ID\" = s.\"Film_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"Location\" ORDER BY \"film_count\" DESC, c.\"Location\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles villes ont une population régionale supérieure à la population régionale moyenne de toutes les villes ?","sql":"SELECT City, Regional_Population FROM city WHERE Regional_Population > (SELECT AVG(Regional_Population) FROM city);"},{"question":"Quelles sont les cinq villes ayant le PIB le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT City, GDP FROM city ORDER BY GDP DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Combien de villes sont enregistrées dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_villes FROM city;"},{"question":"Quelle est la température moyenne du mois de janvier pour l'ensemble des villes ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(Jan) AS temperature_moyenne_janvier FROM temperature;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont une température de janvier supérieure à celle de juillet ?","sql":"SELECT c.City, t.Jan, t.Jul FROM city AS c JOIN temperature AS t ON t.City_ID = c.City_ID WHERE t.Jan > t.Jul;"},{"question":"Affichez les villes dont la température de janvier est la plus basse.","sql":"SELECT c.City, t.Jan FROM city AS c JOIN temperature AS t ON t.City_ID = c.City_ID WHERE t.Jan = (SELECT MIN(Jan) FROM temperature);"},{"question":"Pour chaque ville disposant de données climatiques, indiquez la population régionale et la température moyenne de janvier et février.","sql":"SELECT c.City, c.Regional_Population, (t.Jan + t.Feb) / 2.0 AS moyenne_janvier_fevrier FROM city AS c JOIN temperature AS t ON t.City_ID = c.City_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles compétitions apparaissent dans les matchs, et combien de matchs chacune contient-elle ?","sql":"SELECT Competition, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_matchs FROM \"match\" GROUP BY Competition ORDER BY nombre_de_matchs DESC, Competition;"},{"question":"Quels matchs se sont terminés par le résultat indiqué « Win » ?","sql":"SELECT Match_ID, Date, Venue, Score, Competition FROM \"match\" WHERE Result = 'Win';"},{"question":"Quels matchs ont été disputés dans un lieu contenant le mot « Stadium » ?","sql":"SELECT Match_ID, Date, Venue, Score FROM \"match\" WHERE Venue LIKE '%Stadium%';"},{"question":"Quels sont les matchs associés à une ville hôte connue, avec le nom de cette ville ?","sql":"SELECT m.Match_ID, m.Date, h.Year, c.City AS ville_hote, m.Competition FROM \"match\" AS m JOIN hosting_city AS h ON h.Match_ID = m.Match_ID JOIN city AS c ON c.City_ID = h.Host_City;"},{"question":"Pour quelles années une ville a-t-elle été enregistrée comme ville hôte ?","sql":"SELECT Year, Host_City FROM hosting_city ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont accueilli au moins un match selon la table des villes hôtes ?","sql":"SELECT c.City, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_annees_hotes FROM hosting_city AS h JOIN city AS c ON c.City_ID = h.Host_City GROUP BY c.City ORDER BY nombre_d_annees_hotes DESC, c.City;"},{"question":"Quelles villes n'apparaissent jamais comme villes hôtes ?","sql":"SELECT c.City FROM city AS c LEFT JOIN hosting_city AS h ON h.Host_City = c.City_ID WHERE h.Year IS NULL ORDER BY c.City;"},{"question":"Quel est le PIB par habitant régional pour chaque ville, en évitant les divisions par zéro ?","sql":"SELECT City, GDP, Regional_Population, GDP / NULLIF(Regional_Population, 0) AS PIB_par_habitant FROM city;"},{"question":"Quelle ou quelles villes ont le PIB maximal ?","sql":"SELECT City, GDP FROM city WHERE GDP = (SELECT MAX(GDP) FROM city);"},{"question":"Quelle ville possède la température moyenne la plus élevée entre janvier, juillet et décembre ?","sql":"SELECT c.City, (t.Jan + t.Jul + t.Dec) / 3.0 AS temperature_moyenne FROM city AS c JOIN temperature AS t ON t.City_ID = c.City_ID WHERE (t.Jan + t.Jul + t.Dec) / 3.0 = (SELECT MAX((Jan + Jul + Dec) / 3.0) FROM temperature);"},{"question":"Combien de matchs sont associés à chaque résultat ?","sql":"SELECT Result, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_matchs FROM \"match\" GROUP BY Result ORDER BY nombre_de_matchs DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles compétitions distinctes sont recensées ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT Competition FROM \"match\" WHERE Competition IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Competition;"},{"question":"Quels matchs ont un score renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT Match_ID, Date, Score, Result FROM \"match\" WHERE Score IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(Score) <> '';"},{"question":"Quelles villes possèdent un nom en pinyin renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT City, Hanyu_Pinyin FROM city WHERE Hanyu_Pinyin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(Hanyu_Pinyin) <> '' ORDER BY City;"},{"question":"Combien de villes appartiennent à chaque tranche de population : moins d'un million, de un à cinq millions, ou plus de cinq millions ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN Regional_Population < 1000000 THEN 'Moins d’un million' WHEN Regional_Population <= 5000000 THEN 'De un à cinq millions' ELSE 'Plus de cinq millions' END AS tranche_population, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_villes FROM city GROUP BY tranche_population ORDER BY tranche_population;"},{"question":"Pour chaque année enregistrée, quelle ville a été hôte et quel match lui est associé ?","sql":"SELECT h.Year, c.City, h.Match_ID FROM hosting_city AS h LEFT JOIN city AS c ON c.City_ID = h.Host_City ORDER BY h.Year;"},{"question":"Quelle est la température moyenne de chaque ville sur les mois disponibles de janvier à avril ?","sql":"SELECT c.City, (t.Jan + t.Feb + t.Mar + t.Apr) / 4.0 AS moyenne_janvier_avril FROM city AS c JOIN temperature AS t ON t.City_ID = c.City_ID ORDER BY moyenne_janvier_avril DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont accueilli au moins deux années distinctes ?","sql":"SELECT c.City, COUNT(DISTINCT h.Year) AS nombre_d_annees FROM city AS c JOIN hosting_city AS h ON h.Host_City = c.City_ID GROUP BY c.City HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.Year) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels matchs correspondent à une année de la table des villes hôtes ?","sql":"SELECT m.Match_ID, m.Date, h.Year, m.Competition FROM \"match\" AS m JOIN hosting_city AS h ON h.Match_ID = m.Match_ID ORDER BY h.Year;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont un PIB supérieur au PIB moyen des villes dont la population régionale dépasse un million d'habitants ?","sql":"SELECT City, GDP FROM city WHERE GDP > (SELECT AVG(GDP) FROM city WHERE Regional_Population > 1000000) ORDER BY GDP DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est l'amplitude thermique entre janvier et juillet pour chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT c.City, ABS(t.Jan - t.Jul) AS amplitude_janvier_juillet FROM city AS c JOIN temperature AS t ON t.City_ID = c.City_ID ORDER BY amplitude_janvier_juillet DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois résultats les plus fréquents dans les matchs ?","sql":"SELECT Result, COUNT(*) AS frequence FROM \"match\" GROUP BY Result ORDER BY frequence DESC, Result LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Classez les villes par PIB décroissant et indiquez leur rang.","sql":"SELECT City, GDP, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY GDP DESC) AS rang_pib FROM city ORDER BY rang_pib, City;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels magasins ont un score supérieur au score moyen de tous les magasins ?","sql":"SELECT "Shop_ID", "Address", "Score"

FROM "member"

ORDER BY "Nombre_de_happy_hours" DESC, "Month";"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total dépensé par chaque membre pendant les happy hours, y compris les membres sans dépense enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", COALESCE(SUM(hm."Total_amount"), 0) AS "Montant_total"
FROM "member" AS m
LEFT JOIN "happy_hour_member" AS hm
  ON hm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
GROUP BY m."Member_ID", m."Name"
ORDER BY "Montant_total" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le score moyen des magasins pour chaque année d’ouverture ?","sql":"SELECT "Open_Year", AVG("Score") AS "Score_moyen", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_magasins"

FROM "member" AS m

  ON hm."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
WHERE hm."Total_amount" > (SELECT AVG("Total_amount") FROM "happy_hour_member")
ORDER BY hm."Total_amount" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque magasin, combien de membres distincts ont participé à ses happy hours ?","sql":"SELECT h."Shop_ID", COUNT(DISTINCT hm."Member_ID") AS "Nombre_de_membres"

GROUP BY h."HH_ID", h."Shop_ID", h."Month"
ORDER BY "Montant_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les niveaux d’adhésion et le nombre de membres correspondant à chacun ?","sql":"SELECT "Level_of_membership", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_membres"

ORDER BY "Name";"}]}

bâtiment Taylor ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT st.ID, st.name FROM student st JOIN takes t ON t.ID = st.ID JOIN section s ON s.course_id = t.course_id AND s.sec_id = t.sec_id AND s.semester = t.semester nombre d'étudiants inscrits par année ?","sql":"SELECT year, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS student_count FROM takes GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quelle année compte le plus d'inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count FROM takes GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(enrollment_count) FROM (SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count FROM takes GROUP BY takes t JOIN section s ON s.course_id = t.course_id AND s.sec_id = t.sec_id AND s.semester = t.semester AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.building IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.building) enseignants du département d'histoire ?","sql":"SELECT ID, name, salary FROM instructor WHERE salary > (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM instructor WHERE dept_name = 'History');"},{"question":"Quels cours ont suivi au moins un cours pendant chaque semestre disponible ?","sql":"SELECT s.ID, s.name FROM student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT x.semester FROM takes x WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM takes t WHERE t.ID = s.ID AND t.semester = x.semester));"}]}
