e.StuID = s.StuID WHERE e.Grade = 'A';"},{"question":"Quels cours ont été suivis par l'étudiant numéro 1001 ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, e.Grade FROM Enrolled_in AS e JOIN Course AS c ON c.CID = e.CID WHERE e.StuID = 1001;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants sont membres du département numéro 10 ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, m.Appt_Type FROM Member_of AS m JOIN Faculty AS f ON f.FacID = m.FacID WHERE m.DNO = 10;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un département secondaire enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, d.DName AS departement_secondaire FROM Minor_in AS mi JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = mi.StuID JOIN Department AS d ON d.DNO = mi.DNO;"},{"question":"Combien de cours chaque département propose-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, COUNT(c.CID) AS nombre_cours FROM Department AS d LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.DNO = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName ORDER BY nombre_cours DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'étudiants inscrits à chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, COUNT(e.StuID) AS nombre_inscrits FROM Course AS c LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID GROUP BY c.CID, c.CName ORDER BY nombre_inscrits DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des crédits proposés par département ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, AVG(c.Credits) AS moyenne_credits FROM Department AS d JOIN Course AS c ON c.DNO = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName;"},{"question":"Quels départements comptent au moins deux enseignants membres ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, COUNT(m.FacID) AS nombre_enseignants FROM Department AS d JOIN Member_of AS m ON m.DNO = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName HAVING COUNT(m.FacID) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants donnent plus d'un cours ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(c.CID) AS nombre_cours FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Course AS c ON c.Instructor = f.FacID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname HAVING COUNT(c.CID) > 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de points associé aux notes disponibles ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(gradepoint) AS moyenne_points FROM Gradeconversion;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont obtenu une note dont la valeur est supérieure ou égale à 3 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Gradeconversion AS g ON g.lettergrade = e.Grade WHERE g.gradepoint >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont au moins un étudiant ayant obtenu la note A ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.CID, c.CName FROM Course AS c JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID WHERE e.Grade = 'A';"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ne donnent actuellement aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.Instructor = f.FacID WHERE c.CID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels départements n'ont encore aucun cours associé ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName FROM Department AS d LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.DNO = d.DNO WHERE c.CID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont aucun cursus secondaire déclaré ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Minor_in AS mi ON mi.StuID = s.StuID WHERE mi.DNO IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne sont inscrits à aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID WHERE e.CID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont lieu le mardi ou le jeudi ?","sql":"SELECT CID, CName, Days FROM Course WHERE Days LIKE '%T%' OR Days LIKE '%R%';"},{"question":"Quels étudiants dont le prénom commence par A ont-ils un âge supérieur à 18 ans ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, Age FROM Student WHERE Fname LIKE 'A%' AND Age > 18;"},{"question":"Quels noms de famille d'étudiants apparaissent plusieurs fois ?","sql":"SELECT LName, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM Student GROUP BY LName HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le cours ayant le plus grand nombre de crédits ?","sql":"SELECT CID, CName, Credits FROM Course WHERE Credits = (SELECT MAX(Credits) FROM Course);"},{"question":"Quels cours ont davantage de crédits que la moyenne de tous les cours ?","sql":"SELECT CID, CName, Credits FROM Course WHERE Credits > (SELECT AVG(Credits) FROM Course) ORDER BY Credits DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une note supérieure à la note moyenne de toutes les inscriptions, en valeur de points ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Gradeconversion AS g ON g.lettergrade = e.Grade WHERE g.gradepoint > (SELECT AVG(g2.gradepoint) FROM Enrolled_in AS e2 JOIN Gradeconversion AS g2 ON g2.lettergrade = e2.Grade);"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant inscrit, quels sont son nom et le nombre de cours suivis ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, COUNT(e.CID) AS nombre_cours FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName ORDER BY s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants appartiennent à un département situé dans le bâtiment « Main » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Member_of AS m ON m.FacID = f.FacID JOIN Department AS d ON d.DNO = m.DNO WHERE d.Building = 'Main';"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont pour majeure le même département que leur mineure ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Major FROM Student AS s JOIN Minor_in AS mi ON mi.StuID = s.StuID WHERE mi.DNO = s.Major;"},{"question":"Quels cours sont enseignés par un membre du département auquel le cours est rattaché ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.CID, c.CName, c.DNO, f.FacID, f.Lname FROM Course AS c JOIN Member_of AS m ON m.FacID = c.Instructor AND m.DNO = c.DNO JOIN Faculty AS f ON f.FacID = c.Instructor;"},{"question":"Quelle est la répartition des étudiants par sexe ?","sql":"SELECT Sex, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY Sex ORDER BY Sex;"},{"question":"Combien de cours sont proposés pour chaque nombre de crédits ?","sql":"SELECT Credits, COUNT(*) AS nombre_cours FROM Course GROUP BY Credits ORDER BY Credits;"},{"question":"Quelles lettres de note ne sont associées à aucune inscription ?","sql":"SELECT g.lettergrade FROM Gradeconversion AS g LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.Grade = g.lettergrade WHERE e.Grade IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits à tous les cours du département numéro 10 ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Course AS c WHERE c.DNO = 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Enrolled_in AS e WHERE e.StuID = s.StuID AND e.CID = c.CID));"},{"question":"Quels départements ont au moins un étudiant en majeure et au moins un cours ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName FROM Department AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Major = d.DNO) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Course AS c WHERE c.DNO = d.DNO);"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ont un numéro de téléphone renseigné mais aucun numéro de bureau ?","sql":"SELECT FacID, Fname, Lname, Phone FROM Faculty WHERE Phone IS NOT NULL AND Room IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants habitent dans les codes de ville commençant par 0 ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, city_code FROM Student WHERE city_code LIKE '0%';"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'inscriptions pour chaque lettre de note ?","sql":"SELECT g.lettergrade, COUNT(e.StuID) AS nombre_inscriptions FROM Gradeconversion AS g LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.Grade = g.lettergrade GROUP BY g.lettergrade ORDER BY g.lettergrade;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont lieu pendant une plage horaire contenant « 10 » ?","sql":"SELECT CID, CName, Hours FROM Course WHERE Hours LIKE '%10%';"},{"question":"Quels enseignants sont membres de plusieurs départements ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(DISTINCT m.DNO) AS nombre_departements FROM Faculty AS f JOIN Member_of AS m ON m.FacID = f.FacID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.DNO) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont le même conseiller qu'au moins un autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, s.Advisor FROM Student AS s WHERE s.Advisor IN (SELECT Advisor FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Advisor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY s.Advisor, s.LName;"},{"question":"Pour chaque enseignant, quel est le nombre d'étudiants inscrits à ses cours ?","sql":"SELECT f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname, COUNT(DISTINCT e.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Faculty AS f LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.Instructor = f.FacID LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID GROUP BY f.FacID, f.Fname, f.Lname ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC;"},{"question":"Quels départements ont une moyenne de crédits supérieure à 3 ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, AVG(c.Credits) AS moyenne_credits FROM Department AS d JOIN Course AS c ON c.DNO = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName HAVING AVG(c.Credits) > 3;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont suivi au moins un cours dans leur département de majeure ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Course AS c ON c.CID = e.CID WHERE c.DNO = s.Major;"},{"question":"Quels cours n'ont aucun étudiant inscrit et sont dispensés par un enseignant identifié ?","sql":"SELECT c.CID, c.CName, f.Fname, f.Lname FROM Course AS c JOIN Faculty AS f ON f.FacID = c.Instructor LEFT JOIN Enrolled_in AS e ON e.CID = c.CID WHERE e.StuID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels départements ont plus d'étudiants en majeure que de cours ?","sql":"SELECT d.DNO, d.DName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CID) AS nombre_cours FROM Department AS d LEFT JOIN Student AS s ON s.Major = d.DNO LEFT JOIN Course AS c ON c.DNO = d.DNO GROUP BY d.DNO, d.DName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.StuID) > COUNT(DISTINCT c.CID);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels employés gagnent un salaire supérieur à la moyenne de leur département ?","sql":"SELECT e.Fname, e.Lname, e.Salary, d.Dname
FROM employee AS e
JOIN department AS d ON d.Dnumber = e.Dno
WHERE e.Salary > (
    SELECT AVG(e2.Salary)
    FROM employee AS e2
    WHERE e2.Dno = e.Dno
)
ORDER BY e.Salary DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de sites possède chaque département, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT d.Dnumber, d.Dname, COUNT(dl.Dlocation) AS nombre_de_sites
FROM department AS d
LEFT JOIN dept_locations AS dl ON dl.Dnumber = d.Dnumber
GROUP BY d.Dnumber, d.Dname
ORDER BY nombre_de_sites DESC, d.Dnumber;"},{"question":"Pour chaque personne à charge, quel est le nom complet de l’employé auquel elle est rattachée et quelle est leur relation ?","sql":"SELECT e.Fname || ' ' || e.Lname AS employe,
       dep.Dependent_name AS personne_a_charge,
       dep.Relationship
FROM dependent AS dep
JOIN employee AS e ON e.Ssn = dep.Essn
ORDER BY e.Lname, e.Fname, dep.Dependent_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d’heures consacrées à chaque projet, en incluant les projets sans aucune heure enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT p.Pnumber,
       p.Pname,
       COALESCE(SUM(w.Hours), 0) AS total_heures
FROM project AS p
LEFT JOIN works_on AS w ON w.Pno = p.Pnumber
GROUP BY p.Pnumber, p.Pname
ORDER BY total_heures DESC, p.Pnumber;"},{"question":"Quels employés ne travaillent sur aucun projet ?","sql":"SELECT e.Ssn, e.Fname, e.Minit, e.Lname, e.Dno
FROM employee AS e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM works_on AS w
    WHERE w.Essn = e.Ssn
)
ORDER BY e.Lname, e.Fname;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels comtés ont une population supérieure à la population moyenne des comtés ?","sql":"SELECT "County_ID", "Name", "Population"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Population" > (SELECT AVG("Population") FROM "county_public_safety");"},{"question":"Quelles sont les villes et le nom du comté auquel chacune appartient ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Ville", co."Name" AS "Comté"

ORDER BY "Crime_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Combien de villes sont recensées dans chaque comté, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT co."County_ID", co."Name", COUNT(c."City_ID") AS "Nombre_de_villes"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co

FROM "city"
ORDER BY "Hispanic" DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels comtés comptent le moins de résidents par policier ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Residents_per_officer"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Residents_per_officer" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Residents_per_officer" ASC;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont une proportion de population blanche supérieure à celle de la population noire ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "White", "Black"
FROM "city"
WHERE "White" > "Black"
ORDER BY "White" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels comtés n'ont aucune ville associée dans la table des villes ?","sql":"SELECT co."County_ID", co."Name"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
LEFT JOIN "city" AS c ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
WHERE c."City_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont la plus grande charge de dossiers par policier ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Case_burden", "Police_officers", CAST("Case_burden" AS REAL) / NULLIF("Police_officers", 0) AS "Dossiers_par_policier"
FROM "county_public_safety"
ORDER BY "Dossiers_par_policier" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de villes chaque comté contient-il, classées de la plus grande à la plus petite quantité ?","sql":"SELECT "County_ID", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_villes"
FROM "city"
GROUP BY "County_ID"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_villes" DESC, "County_ID";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont un taux de criminalité supérieur à la moyenne de leur emplacement ?","sql":"SELECT co."Name", co."Location", co."Crime_rate"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
WHERE co."Crime_rate" > (
    SELECT AVG(co2."Crime_rate")
    FROM "county_public_safety" AS co2
    WHERE co2."Location" = co."Location"
);"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont un nom qui contient le mot « Lake » ?","sql":"SELECT "City_ID", "Name"
FROM "city"
WHERE "Name" LIKE '%Lake%'
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le rang de chaque comté selon sa population, de la plus élevée à la plus faible ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Population" DESC) AS "Rang_population"
FROM "county_public_safety"
ORDER BY "Rang_population", "Name";"},{"question":"Combien de policiers y a-t-il au total dans les comtés dont la population dépasse 100 000 habitants ?","sql":"SELECT SUM("Police_officers") AS "Total_policiers"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Population" > 100000;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont une proportion asiatique supérieure à la proportion amérindienne ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Asian", "Amerindian"
FROM "city"
WHERE "Asian" > "Amerindian";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont une population supérieure à 50 000 habitants et un taux de criminalité inférieur à 10 ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Population", "Crime_rate"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Population" > 50000
  AND "Crime_rate" < 10
ORDER BY "Population" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le taux moyen de population hispanique des villes de chaque comté ?","sql":"SELECT co."Name" AS "Comté", AVG(c."Hispanic") AS "Hispanic_moyen"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
JOIN "city" AS c ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
GROUP BY co."County_ID", co."Name"
ORDER BY "Hispanic_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel comté a la population la plus proche de la population moyenne de tous les comtés ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Population"
FROM "county_public_safety"
ORDER BY ABS("Population" - (SELECT AVG("Population") FROM "county_public_safety"))
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les villes situées dans les comtés de type « Urban » ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Ville", co."Name" AS "Comté"
FROM "city" AS c
JOIN "county_public_safety" AS co ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
WHERE co."Location" = 'Urban'
ORDER BY co."Name", c."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque force de police, quel est le nombre moyen de résidents par policier ?","sql":"SELECT "Police_force", AVG("Residents_per_officer") AS "Moyenne_residents_par_policier"
FROM "county_public_safety"
GROUP BY "Police_force"
ORDER BY "Moyenne_residents_par_policier" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont davantage de policiers que le nombre de villes qui leur sont rattachées ?","sql":"SELECT co."Name", co."Police_officers", COUNT(c."City_ID") AS "Nombre_de_villes"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
LEFT JOIN "city" AS c ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
GROUP BY co."County_ID", co."Name", co."Police_officers"
HAVING co."Police_officers" > COUNT(c."City_ID");"},{"question":"Pour chaque comté, comment classer la charge de dossiers par policier en faible, moyenne ou élevée ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Case_burden", "Police_officers",
       CASE
           WHEN CAST("Case_burden" AS REAL) / NULLIF("Police_officers", 0) < 10 THEN 'Faible'
           WHEN CAST("Case_burden" AS REAL) / NULLIF("Police_officers", 0) < 25 THEN 'Moyenne'
           ELSE 'Élevée'
       END AS "Categorie_charge"
FROM "county_public_safety";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois villes ayant la plus forte proportion de population multiraciale ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Multiracial"
FROM "city"
ORDER BY "Multiracial" DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de villes et la population moyenne des comtés pour chaque emplacement ?","sql":"SELECT co."Location", COUNT(DISTINCT c."City_ID") AS "Nombre_de_villes", AVG(co."Population") AS "Population_moyenne_des_comtes"
FROM "county_public_safety" AS co
LEFT JOIN "city" AS c ON c."County_ID" = co."County_ID"
GROUP BY co."Location";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont un taux de criminalité supérieur à celui du comté ayant la plus faible population ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Crime_rate"
FROM "county_public_safety"
WHERE "Crime_rate" > (
    SELECT "Crime_rate"
    FROM "county_public_safety"
    ORDER BY "Population" ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY "Crime_rate" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle ville a la plus forte proportion combinée de population asiatique et amérindienne ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Asian", "Amerindian", ("Asian" + "Amerindian") AS "Proportion_combinee"
FROM "city"
ORDER BY "Proportion_combinee" DESC
LIMIT 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les documents avec leur description de statut ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_id, d.document_status_code, s.document_status_description
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Ref_Document_Status AS s ON s.document_status_code = d.document_status_code;"},{"question":"Quels employés occupent chaque rôle, avec la description du rôle ?","sql":"SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.role_code, r.role_description
FROM Employees AS e
JOIN Roles AS r ON r.role_code = e.role_code
ORDER BY e.employee_name;"},{"question":"À quelles adresses les documents ont-ils été envoyés ?","sql":"SELECT dm.document_id, dm.mailing_date, a.address_id, a.address_details
FROM Documents_Mailed AS dm
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = dm.mailed_to_address_id
ORDER BY dm.document_id, dm.mailing_date;"},{"question":"Combien de copies existe-t-il pour chaque brouillon ?","sql":"SELECT dd.document_id, dd.draft_number, dd.draft_details, COUNT(dc.copy_number) AS nombre_de_copies
FROM Document_Drafts AS dd
LEFT JOIN Draft_Copies AS dc
  ON dc.document_id = dd.document_id
 AND dc.draft_number = dd.draft_number
GROUP BY dd.document_id, dd.draft_number, dd.draft_details
ORDER BY dd.document_id, dd.draft_number;"},{"question":"Quels documents ne possèdent encore aucun brouillon ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_id, d.document_status_code, d.document_type_code
FROM Documents AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Document_Drafts AS dd
    WHERE dd.document_id = d.document_id
);"},{"question":"Quels documents ont été reçus en 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, receipt_date, receipt_number
FROM Documents
WHERE strftime('%Y', receipt_date) = '2024'
ORDER BY receipt_date;"},{"question":"Combien de documents y a-t-il pour chaque statut, y compris les statuts sans document ?","sql":"SELECT s.document_status_code, s.document_status_description, COUNT(d.document_id) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Document_Status AS s
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.document_status_code = s.document_status_code
GROUP BY s.document_status_code, s.document_status_description
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC, s.document_status_code;"},{"question":"Combien de documents chaque agent d'expédition a-t-il traité ?","sql":"SELECT sa.shipping_agent_code, sa.shipping_agent_name, COUNT(d.document_id) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Shipping_Agents AS sa
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.shipping_agent_code = sa.shipping_agent_code
GROUP BY sa.shipping_agent_code, sa.shipping_agent_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC, sa.shipping_agent_name;"},{"question":"Quelles copies ont circulé, auprès de quels employés et pour quel document ?","sql":"SELECT ch.document_id, ch.draft_number, ch.copy_number, e.employee_name, e.employee_id
FROM Circulation_History AS ch
JOIN Employees AS e ON e.employee_id = ch.employee_id
ORDER BY ch.document_id, ch.draft_number, ch.copy_number, e.employee_name;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses n'ont jamais été utilisées pour un envoi ?","sql":"SELECT a.address_id, a.address_details
FROM Addresses AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Documents_Mailed AS dm
    WHERE dm.mailed_to_address_id = a.address_id
)
ORDER BY a.address_id;"},{"question":"Quel brouillon possède le plus grand nombre de copies ?","sql":"SELECT dd.document_id, dd.draft_number, COUNT(dc.copy_number) AS nombre_de_copies
FROM Document_Drafts AS dd
JOIN Draft_Copies AS dc
  ON dc.document_id = dd.document_id
 AND dc.draft_number = dd.draft_number
GROUP BY dd.document_id, dd.draft_number
ORDER BY nombre_de_copies DESC, dd.document_id, dd.draft_number
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien d'opérations de circulation sont associées à chaque employé ?","sql":"SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, COUNT(ch.document_id) AS nombre_de_circulations
FROM Employees AS e
LEFT JOIN Circulation_History AS ch ON ch.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name
ORDER BY nombre_de_circulations DESC, e.employee_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date d'envoi la plus récente pour chaque document envoyé ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, MAX(mailing_date) AS derniere_date_denvoi
FROM Documents_Mailed
GROUP BY document_id
ORDER BY document_id;"},{"question":"Combien de documents correspondent à chaque type de document ?","sql":"SELECT t.document_type_code, t.document_type_description, COUNT(d.document_id) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Ref_Document_Types AS t
LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.document_type_code = t.document_type_code
GROUP BY t.document_type_code, t.document_type_description
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC, t.document_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels brouillons ont au moins deux copies ?","sql":"SELECT dd.document_id, dd.draft_number, COUNT(dc.copy_number) AS nombre_de_copies
FROM Document_Drafts AS dd
JOIN Draft_Copies AS dc
  ON dc.document_id = dd.document_id
 AND dc.draft_number = dd.draft_number
GROUP BY dd.document_id, dd.draft_number
HAVING COUNT(dc.copy_number) >= 2
ORDER BY dd.document_id, dd.draft_number;"},{"question":"Quels documents n'ont pas encore de date de réception ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, document_status_code, document_type_code, receipt_number
FROM Documents
WHERE receipt_date IS NULL
ORDER BY document_id;"},{"question":"Quels statuts concernent plus de cinq documents ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_status_code, s.document_status_description, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_documents
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Ref_Document_Status AS s ON s.document_status_code = d.document_status_code
GROUP BY d.document_status_code, s.document_status_description
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY nombre_de_documents DESC;"},{"question":"Comment afficher l'identifiant et le nom de chaque employé sur une seule colonne ?","sql":"SELECT employee_id, employee_id || ' - ' || COALESCE(employee_name, '(nom inconnu)') AS identite
FROM Employees
ORDER BY employee_id;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont participé à la circulation d'au moins un document ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT e.employee_id, e.employee_name
FROM Employees AS e
JOIN Circulation_History AS ch ON ch.employee_id = e.employee_id
ORDER BY e.employee_name, e.employee_id;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont au moins une copie mais n'ont jamais été envoyés par courrier ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.document_id, d.document_status_code, d.document_type_code
FROM Documents AS d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Draft_Copies AS dc
    WHERE dc.document_id = d.document_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Documents_Mailed AS dm
    WHERE dm.document_id = d.document_id
)
ORDER BY d.document_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le numéro moyen de brouillon par document ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, AVG(draft_number) AS numero_moyen_de_brouillon
FROM Document_Drafts
GROUP BY document_id
ORDER BY document_id;"},{"question":"Combien de documents distincts ont circulé pour chaque employé ?","sql":"SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.document_id) AS documents_distincts
FROM Employees AS e
LEFT JOIN Circulation_History AS ch ON ch.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name
ORDER BY documents_distincts DESC, e.employee_id;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq documents reçus le plus récemment ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, receipt_date, receipt_number
FROM Documents
WHERE receipt_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY receipt_date DESC, document_id DESC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels agents d'expédition ont traité au moins un document reçu avant 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT sa.shipping_agent_code, sa.shipping_agent_name
FROM Ref_Shipping_Agents AS sa
JOIN Documents AS d ON d.shipping_agent_code = sa.shipping_agent_code
WHERE d.receipt_date < '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY sa.shipping_agent_name;"}]}

élément dont le produit n’est pas renseigné dans le catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT oi.Order_ID FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Product_ID = oi.Product_ID WHERE p.Product_ID IS magasin ?","sql":"SELECT Store_ID, MIN(Order_Date) AS Premiere_date_de_commande FROM Customer_Orders GROUP BY Store_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles factures contiennent un élément correspondant au même p JOIN Performers_in_Bookings AS pb ON pb.Performer_ID = p.Performer_ID GROUP BY p.Performer_ID, p.Customer_Name HAVING COUNT(pb.Order_ID) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels clients sont triés par nom décroissant, avec leur adresse complète ?","sql":"SELECT c.Customer_Name, a.Line_1, a.Line_2, a.City_Town, a.State_County FROM Clients AS c LEFT JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.Address_ID = c.Address_ID ORDER BY c.Customer_Name DESC;"},{"question":"Quels services sont plus chers que le prix moyen de tous les services ?","sql":"SELECT Service_ID, Product_Name, Product_Price FROM Services WHERE {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, lieux et comtés de tous les campus, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT Campus, Location, County FROM Campuses ORDER BY Campus;"},{"question":"Combien de campus sont enregistrés dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_campus FROM Campuses;"},{"question":"Quels campus se trouvent dans le comté de Los Angeles ?","sql":"SELECT Id, Campus, Location FROM Campuses WHERE County = 'Los Angeles';"},{"question":"Quelles années sont couvertes par la table des campus ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT Year FROM Campuses ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont été créés avant l’année 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT Campus, Year FROM Campuses WHERE Year < 2000 ORDER BY Year, Campus;"},{"question":"Quel est le campus associé à chaque enregistrement de frais ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, f.Year, f.CampusFee FROM csu_fees AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus ORDER BY f.Year, c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quels sont les frais de campus supérieurs à 5000 ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, f.Year, f.CampusFee FROM csu_fees AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus WHERE f.CampusFee > 5000 ORDER BY f.CampusFee DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des frais de campus par année ?","sql":"SELECT Year, AVG(CampusFee) AS frais_moyens FROM csu_fees GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quel campus possède les frais les plus élevés ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, f.Year, f.CampusFee FROM csu_fees AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus WHERE f.CampusFee = (SELECT MAX(CampusFee) FROM csu_fees);"},{"question":"Quels campus ont enregistré plus de 1000 diplômes en une année ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, d.Year, d.Degrees FROM degrees AS d JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = d.Campus WHERE d.Degrees > 1000 ORDER BY d.Degrees DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de diplômes ont été délivrés par année, tous campus confondus ?","sql":"SELECT Year, SUM(Degrees) AS total_diplomes FROM degrees GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de diplômes par campus ?","sql":"SELECT Campus, AVG(Degrees) AS moyenne_diplomes FROM degrees GROUP BY Campus ORDER BY moyenne_diplomes DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont délivré davantage de diplômes en 2020 qu’en 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, d2020.Degrees AS diplomes_2020, d2019.Degrees AS diplomes_2019 FROM degrees AS d2020 JOIN degrees AS d2019 ON d2020.Campus = d2019.Campus AND d2019.Year = 2019 JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = d2020.Campus WHERE d2020.Year = 2020 AND d2020.Degrees > d2019.Degrees;"},{"question":"Quel est le campus ayant délivré le plus grand nombre total de diplômes ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, SUM(d.Degrees) AS total_diplomes FROM degrees AS d JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = d.Campus GROUP BY d.Campus, c.Campus ORDER BY total_diplomes DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels sont les effectifs undergraduate et graduate par discipline et par campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, de.Discipline, de.Year, de.Undergraduate, de.Graduate FROM discipline_enrollments AS de JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = de.Campus ORDER BY c.Campus, de.Discipline;"},{"question":"Quelles disciplines comptent plus de 500 étudiants undergraduate ?","sql":"SELECT Discipline, Campus, Year, Undergraduate FROM discipline_enrollments WHERE Undergraduate > 500 ORDER BY Undergraduate DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le total des étudiants graduate par campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, SUM(de.Graduate) AS total_graduate FROM discipline_enrollments AS de JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = de.Campus GROUP BY de.Campus, c.Campus ORDER BY total_graduate DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle discipline a le plus grand effectif undergraduate ?","sql":"SELECT Discipline, Campus, Year, Undergraduate FROM discipline_enrollments WHERE Undergraduate = (SELECT MAX(Undergraduate) FROM discipline_enrollments);"},{"question":"Quels campus ont au moins une discipline avec plus d’étudiants graduate que undergraduate ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.Campus FROM discipline_enrollments AS de JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = de.Campus WHERE de.Graduate > de.Undergraduate ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quels sont les effectifs totaux et les équivalents temps plein par campus et par année ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, e.Year, e.TotalEnrollment_AY, e.FTE_AY FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus ORDER BY c.Campus, e.Year;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont plus de 20 000 inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, e.Year, e.TotalEnrollment_AY FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus WHERE e.TotalEnrollment_AY > 20000 ORDER BY e.TotalEnrollment_AY DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des inscriptions totales par année ?","sql":"SELECT Year, AVG(TotalEnrollment_AY) AS moyenne_inscriptions FROM enrollments GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quel est le total des inscriptions par campus, toutes années confondues ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, SUM(e.TotalEnrollment_AY) AS total_inscriptions FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus GROUP BY e.Campus, c.Campus ORDER BY total_inscriptions DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont un ratio FTE sur inscriptions supérieur à 0,5 ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, e.Year, e.FTE_AY * 1.0 / NULLIF(e.TotalEnrollment_AY, 0) AS ratio_fte FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus WHERE e.FTE_AY * 1.0 / NULLIF(e.TotalEnrollment_AY, 0) > 0.5 ORDER BY ratio_fte DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la valeur maximale des effectifs totaux enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(TotalEnrollment_AY) AS maximum_inscriptions FROM enrollments;"},{"question":"Quels campus disposent de données de personnel enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.Campus FROM faculty AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d’enseignants par année ?","sql":"SELECT Year, AVG(Faculty) AS moyenne_enseignants FROM faculty GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quels campus comptent plus de 100 enseignants ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, f.Year, f.Faculty FROM faculty AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus WHERE f.Faculty > 100 ORDER BY f.Faculty DESC;"},{"question":"Quel campus a la plus grande valeur de personnel enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, f.Year, f.Faculty FROM faculty AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus WHERE f.Faculty = (SELECT MAX(Faculty) FROM faculty);"},{"question":"Combien d’enregistrements de personnel enseignant existe-t-il pour chaque campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, COUNT(f.Year) AS nombre_enregistrements FROM Campuses AS c LEFT JOIN faculty AS f ON f.Campus = c.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.Campus ORDER BY nombre_enregistrements DESC, c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont à la fois des données d’inscriptions et de personnel enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.Campus FROM Campuses AS c JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.Campus = c.Id JOIN faculty AS f ON f.Campus = c.Id ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Pour chaque campus, affichez les inscriptions et les diplômes de la même année lorsqu’ils sont disponibles.","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, e.Year, e.TotalEnrollment_AY, d.Degrees FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus LEFT JOIN degrees AS d ON d.Campus = e.Campus AND d.Year = e.Year ORDER BY c.Campus, e.Year;"},{"question":"Quels campus avaient plus d’inscriptions que la moyenne de leur année ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, e.Year, e.TotalEnrollment_AY FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus WHERE e.TotalEnrollment_AY > (SELECT AVG(e2.TotalEnrollment_AY) FROM enrollments AS e2 WHERE e2.Year = e.Year) ORDER BY e.Year, e.TotalEnrollment_AY DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque année, quel campus avait le plus d’inscriptions ?","sql":"WITH classement AS (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Year ORDER BY TotalEnrollment_AY DESC) AS rang FROM enrollments AS e) SELECT c.Campus, classement.Year, classement.TotalEnrollment_AY FROM classement JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = classement.Campus WHERE rang = 1 ORDER BY classement.Year;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont des frais mais aucune donnée d’inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus FROM csu_fees AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollments AS e WHERE e.Campus = f.Campus) ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des frais par campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, SUM(f.CampusFee) AS total_frais FROM csu_fees AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus GROUP BY f.Campus, c.Campus ORDER BY total_frais DESC;"},{"question":"Quels comtés regroupent au moins deux campus ?","sql":"SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS nombre_campus FROM Campuses GROUP BY County HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_campus DESC, County;"},{"question":"Combien de campus sont situés dans chaque lieu ?","sql":"SELECT Location, COUNT(*) AS nombre_campus FROM Campuses GROUP BY Location ORDER BY nombre_campus DESC, Location;"},{"question":"Quel est le campus le plus ancien de chaque comté ?","sql":"WITH anciens AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY County ORDER BY Year, Id) AS rang FROM Campuses) SELECT Campus, County, Year FROM anciens WHERE rang = 1 ORDER BY County;"},{"question":"Quels campus n’ont jamais eu de frais enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus FROM Campuses AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM csu_fees AS f WHERE f.Campus = c.Id) ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quelle est la somme des inscriptions undergraduate et graduate par campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, SUM(de.Undergraduate) AS total_undergraduate, SUM(de.Graduate) AS total_graduate FROM discipline_enrollments AS de JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = de.Campus GROUP BY de.Campus, c.Campus ORDER BY total_undergraduate + total_graduate DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont un effectif graduate total supérieur à leur effectif undergraduate total ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, SUM(de.Undergraduate) AS total_undergraduate, SUM(de.Graduate) AS total_graduate FROM discipline_enrollments AS de JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = de.Campus GROUP BY de.Campus, c.Campus HAVING SUM(de.Graduate) > SUM(de.Undergraduate) ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Pour chaque année, combien de campus possèdent des données d’inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT Year, COUNT(DISTINCT Campus) AS nombre_campus FROM enrollments GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quelles années présentent des inscriptions maximales supérieures à 30 000 ?","sql":"SELECT Year, MAX(TotalEnrollment_AY) AS maximum_inscriptions FROM enrollments GROUP BY Year HAVING MAX(TotalEnrollment_AY) > 30000 ORDER BY Year;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de diplômes et d’inscriptions par campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, COALESCE(d.total_diplomes, 0) AS total_diplomes, COALESCE(e.total_inscriptions, 0) AS total_inscriptions FROM Campuses AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT Campus, SUM(Degrees) AS total_diplomes FROM degrees GROUP BY Campus) AS d ON d.Campus = c.Id LEFT JOIN (SELECT Campus, SUM(TotalEnrollment_AY) AS total_inscriptions FROM enrollments GROUP BY Campus) AS e ON e.Campus = c.Id ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont une moyenne de personnel enseignant supérieure à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, AVG(f.Faculty) AS moyenne_faculte FROM faculty AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus GROUP BY f.Campus, c.Campus HAVING AVG(f.Faculty) > (SELECT AVG(Faculty) FROM faculty) ORDER BY moyenne_faculte DESC;"},{"question":"Classez les campus par nombre total d’inscriptions décroissant.","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, SUM(e.TotalEnrollment_AY) AS total_inscriptions, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(e.TotalEnrollment_AY) DESC) AS classement FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus GROUP BY e.Campus, c.Campus ORDER BY classement, c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont connu une hausse des inscriptions entre leur première et leur dernière année disponibles ?","sql":"WITH bornes AS (SELECT Campus, MIN(Year) AS premiere_annee, MAX(Year) AS derniere_annee FROM enrollments GROUP BY Campus) SELECT c.Campus, e1.TotalEnrollment_AY AS inscriptions_premiere_annee, e2.TotalEnrollment_AY AS inscriptions_derniere_annee FROM bornes AS b JOIN enrollments AS e1 ON e1.Campus = b.Campus AND e1.Year = b.premiere_annee JOIN enrollments AS e2 ON e2.Campus = b.Campus AND e2.Year = b.derniere_annee JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = b.Campus WHERE e2.TotalEnrollment_AY > e1.TotalEnrollment_AY ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quelle est la différence entre le nombre maximal et minimal d’inscriptions pour chaque campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, MAX(e.TotalEnrollment_AY) - MIN(e.TotalEnrollment_AY) AS ecart_inscriptions FROM enrollments AS e JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = e.Campus GROUP BY e.Campus, c.Campus ORDER BY ecart_inscriptions DESC;"},{"question":"Quels campus ont des diplômes enregistrés sans inscription correspondante la même année ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.Campus, d.Year FROM degrees AS d JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = d.Campus WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollments AS e WHERE e.Campus = d.Campus AND e.Year = d.Year) ORDER BY c.Campus, d.Year;"},{"question":"Pour chaque comté, quel est le nombre moyen d’années de création des campus ?","sql":"SELECT County, AVG(Year) AS annee_moyenne FROM Campuses GROUP BY County ORDER BY annee_moyenne;"},{"question":"Quels enregistrements de frais correspondent à une année différente de celle du campus ?","sql":"SELECT c.Campus, c.Year AS annee_campus, f.Year AS annee_frais, f.CampusFee FROM csu_fees AS f JOIN Campuses AS c ON c.Id = f.Campus WHERE f.Year <> c.Year ORDER BY c.Campus;"},{"question":"Quel est le ratio moyen de diplômes par inscrit pour chaque année où les deux indicateurs existent ?","sql":"SELECT d.Year, SUM(d.Degrees) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(e.TotalEnrollment_AY), 0) AS ratio_diplomes_inscrits FROM degrees AS d JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.Campus = d.Campus AND e.Year = d.Year GROUP BY d.Year ORDER BY d.Year;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les titres, auteurs ou éditeurs et années des ouvrages du club de lecture, triés par année décroissante ?","sql":"SELECT \"Book_Title\", \"Author_or_Editor\", \"Year\" FROM \"book_club\" ORDER BY \"Year\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont un budget supérieur au budget moyen de tous les films ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Budget_million\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Budget_million\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Budget_million\") FROM \"movie\");"},{"question":"Combien d'entreprises appartiennent à chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT \"Type\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_entreprises\" FROM \"culture_company\" GROUP BY \"Type\" ORDER BY \"nombre_entreprises\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises sont associées à un film, avec le nom du film correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Company_name\", m.\"Title\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON c.\"movie_id\" = CAST(m.\"movie_id\" AS TEXT);"},{"question":"Quelles catégories distinctes sont présentes dans le club de lecture ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Category\" FROM \"book_club\" WHERE \"Category\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Category\";"},{"question":"Quel est le film qui a généré le plus de recettes mondiales ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Gross_worldwide\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Gross_worldwide\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Gross_worldwide\") FROM \"movie\");"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises ne sont associées à aucun film ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Company_name\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON c.\"movie_id\" = CAST(m.\"movie_id\" AS TEXT) WHERE m.\"movie_id\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels ouvrages ont été publiés entre 2000 et 2010 inclusivement ?","sql":"SELECT \"Book_Title\", \"Year\", \"Publisher\" FROM \"book_club\" WHERE \"Year\" BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 ORDER BY \"Year\", \"Book_Title\";"},{"question":"Quel est le budget moyen des films pour chaque réalisateur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Director\", AVG(\"Budget_million\") AS \"budget_moyen\" FROM \"movie\" GROUP BY \"Director\" ORDER BY \"budget_moyen\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'ouvrages sont associés à chaque éditeur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Publisher\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_ouvrages\" FROM \"book_club\" GROUP BY \"Publisher\" ORDER BY \"nombre_ouvrages\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises ont une participation du groupe supérieure à 50 % ?","sql":"SELECT \"Company_name\", \"Group_Equity_Shareholding\" FROM \"culture_company\" WHERE \"Group_Equity_Shareholding\" > 50 ORDER BY \"Group_Equity_Shareholding\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les titres des films liés à des entreprises de type « Studio » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"Title\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c JOIN \"movie\" AS m ON c.\"movie_id\" = CAST(m.\"movie_id\" AS TEXT) WHERE c.\"Type\" = 'Studio';"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois films aux recettes mondiales les plus élevées ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Gross_worldwide\" FROM \"movie\" ORDER BY \"Gross_worldwide\" DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels ouvrages n'ont pas de résultat renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT \"Book_Title\", \"Author_or_Editor\" FROM \"book_club\" WHERE \"Result\" IS NULL OR TRIM(\"Result\") = '';"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises sont liées à la fois à un ouvrage du club et à un film ?","sql":"SELECT \"Company_name\" FROM \"culture_company\" WHERE \"book_club_id\" IS NOT NULL AND \"movie_id\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque film, quel est le rapport entre ses recettes mondiales et son budget, lorsque le budget est positif ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Gross_worldwide\" * 1.0 / \"Budget_million\" AS \"rapport_recettes_budget\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Budget_million\" > 0 ORDER BY \"rapport_recettes_budget\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'ouvrages y a-t-il dans chaque catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT \"Category\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_ouvrages\" FROM \"book_club\" GROUP BY \"Category\" ORDER BY \"nombre_ouvrages\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises ont un nom contenant le mot « culture » sans tenir compte de la casse ?","sql":"SELECT \"Company_name\" FROM \"culture_company\" WHERE LOWER(\"Company_name\") LIKE '%culture%';"},{"question":"Quels films sont sortis avant 2000 avec un budget inférieur à 20 millions ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Year\", \"Budget_million\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Year\" < 2000 AND \"Budget_million\" < 20 ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ou éditeurs apparaissent pour plusieurs ouvrages ?","sql":"SELECT \"Author_or_Editor\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_ouvrages\" FROM \"book_club\" GROUP BY \"Author_or_Editor\" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY \"nombre_ouvrages\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la participation moyenne du groupe pour chaque type d'entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT \"Type\", AVG(\"Group_Equity_Shareholding\") AS \"participation_moyenne\" FROM \"culture_company\" GROUP BY \"Type\" ORDER BY \"participation_moyenne\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels ouvrages ne sont associés à aucune entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Book_Title\", b.\"book_club_id\" FROM \"book_club\" AS b LEFT JOIN \"culture_company\" AS c ON CAST(b.\"book_club_id\" AS TEXT) = c.\"book_club_id\" WHERE c.\"Company_name\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels films ont des recettes mondiales supérieures à la moyenne des films de leur réalisateur ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Title\", m.\"Director\", m.\"Gross_worldwide\" FROM \"movie\" AS m WHERE m.\"Gross_worldwide\" > (SELECT AVG(m2.\"Gross_worldwide\") FROM \"movie\" AS m2 WHERE m2.\"Director\" = m.\"Director\");"},{"question":"Quels films ont le budget maximal ?","sql":"SELECT \"Title\", \"Director\", \"Budget_million\" FROM \"movie\" WHERE \"Budget_million\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Budget_million\") FROM \"movie\");"},{"question":"Combien d'entreprises sont associées à un film, à un ouvrage, aux deux ou à aucun des deux ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN \"movie_id\" IS NOT NULL AND \"book_club_id\" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Les deux' WHEN \"movie_id\" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Film uniquement' WHEN \"book_club_id\" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Ouvrage uniquement' ELSE 'Aucun' END AS \"association\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_entreprises\" FROM \"culture_company\" GROUP BY \"association\" ORDER BY \"association\";"},{"question":"Pour quelles années y a-t-il au moins deux films, et quelles sont leurs recettes mondiales moyennes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_films\", AVG(\"Gross_worldwide\") AS \"recettes_moyennes\" FROM \"movie\" GROUP BY \"Year\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises sont associées à au moins un ouvrage ou à au moins un film ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Company_name\" FROM \"culture_company\" AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"book_club\" AS b WHERE CAST(b.\"book_club_id\" AS TEXT) = c.\"book_club_id\") OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"movie\" AS m WHERE CAST(m.\"movie_id\" AS TEXT) = c.\"movie_id\");"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles réclamations ont le statut « OPEN » ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, customer_id, product_id, complaint_status_code
FROM Complaints
WHERE complaint_status_code = 'OPEN';"},{"question":"Quels clients habitent à Paris ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, customer_type_code, email_address
FROM Customers
WHERE town_city = 'Paris';"},{"question":"Quels produits sont plus chers que le prix moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, product_price
FROM Products
WHERE product_price > (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products);"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms et adresses e-mail des membres du personnel ?","sql":"SELECT first_name, last_name, email_address
FROM Staff
ORDER BY last_name, first_name;"},{"question":"Affiche le nom du produit associé à chaque réclamation.","sql":"SELECT c.complaint_id, p.product_name, c.complaint_status_code
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
ORDER BY c.complaint_id;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations y a-t-il pour chaque statut ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_status_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
GROUP BY complaint_status_code
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations chaque client a-t-il déposées ?","sql":"SELECT cu.customer_id, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Customers AS cu
LEFT JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
GROUP BY cu.customer_id
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC, cu.customer_id;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations ont été ouvertes mais ne sont pas encore clôturées ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, customer_id, date_complaint_raised
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_closed IS NULL
ORDER BY date_complaint_raised;"},{"question":"Quels produits n'ont jamais fait l'objet d'une réclamation ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM Products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Complaints AS c
    WHERE c.product_id = p.product_id
)
ORDER BY p.product_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la réclamation la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, customer_id, product_id, date_complaint_raised
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised = (
    SELECT MAX(date_complaint_raised) FROM Complaints
);"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne, en jours, entre l'ouverture et la clôture des réclamations clôturées ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(date_complaint_closed) - julianday(date_complaint_raised)) AS duree_moyenne_jours
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
  AND date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations chaque membre du personnel a-t-il traitées, y compris ceux qui n'en ont traité aucune ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Staff AS s
LEFT JOIN Complaints AS c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des produits par catégorie ?","sql":"SELECT product_category_code, AVG(product_price) AS prix_moyen
FROM Products
GROUP BY product_category_code
ORDER BY product_category_code;"},{"question":"Quels types de clients sont représentés dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT customer_type_code
FROM Customers
ORDER BY customer_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont été retirés avant leur date de première disponibilité ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, date_product_first_available, date_product_discontinued
FROM Products
WHERE date_product_first_available IS NOT NULL
  AND date_product_discontinued IS NOT NULL
  AND date_product_discontinued < date_product_first_available;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations ont été déposées pendant l'année 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_id, customer_id, date_complaint_raised
FROM Complaints
WHERE date_complaint_raised >= '2023-01-01'
  AND date_complaint_raised < '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY date_complaint_raised;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq clients ayant déposé le plus de réclamations ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY nombre_reclamations DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Combien de réclamations correspondent à chaque résultat ?","sql":"SELECT complaint_outcome_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reclamations
FROM Complaints
GROUP BY complaint_outcome_code
ORDER BY complaint_outcome_code;"},{"question":"Quels clients disposent d'une adresse e-mail renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, email_address
FROM Customers
WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(email_address) <> ''
ORDER BY customer_id;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un produit parent, et quel est le nom de ce parent ?","sql":"SELECT enfant.product_id, enfant.product_name, parent.product_id AS parent_id, parent.product_name AS parent_name
FROM Products AS enfant
JOIN Products AS parent ON parent.product_id = enfant.parent_product_id
ORDER BY enfant.product_id;"},{"question":"Quelles réclamations concernent des clients situés dans l'État de Californie ?","sql":"SELECT c.complaint_id, c.customer_id, cu.town_city, cu.state
FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Customers AS cu ON cu.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE cu.state = 'California'

Customers_Cards AS cc LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id WHERE ft.transaction_id IS NULL ORDER BY cc.card_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la transaction la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, account_id, card_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_amount = (SELECT MAX(transaction_amount) FROM Financial_Transactions);"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont été effectuées entre le 1er janvier 2023 et le 31 décembre 2023 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount, transaction_type FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_date >= '2023-01-01' AND transaction_date < '2024-01-01' ORDER BY transaction_date;"},{"question":"Combien de cartes chaque type de carte représente-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT card_type_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_cartes FROM Customers_Cards GROUP BY card_type_code ORDER BY nombre_cartes DESC, card_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels comptes ont au moins cinq transactions ?","sql":"SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_transactions FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY nombre_transactions DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, quel est le montant cumulé de ses transactions ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS montant_cumule FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name ORDER BY montant_cumule DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions sont liées à une carte appartenant à un client nommé Martin ?","sql":"SELECT ft.transaction_id, ft.transaction_date, ft.transaction_amount, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id WHERE c.customer_last_name = 'Martin' ORDER BY ft.transaction_date;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de transactions par mois ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', transaction_date) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_transactions FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', transaction_date) ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont une adresse contenant le mot « Paris » ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_address FROM Customers WHERE customer_address LIKE '%Paris%' ORDER BY customer_last_name, customer_first_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions pour chaque type de carte ?","sql":"SELECT cc.card_type_code, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS montant_total FROM Customers_Cards AS cc LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id GROUP BY cc.card_type_code ORDER BY montant_total DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions n’ont pas de commentaire ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount, transaction_type FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_comment IS NULL OR TRIM(transaction_comment) = '' ORDER BY transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quels comptes ont un nom renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT account_id, customer_id, account_name FROM Accounts WHERE account_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(account_name) <> '' ORDER BY account_name;"},{"question":"Quel client possède le plus grand nombre de cartes ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COUNT(cc.card_id) AS nombre_cartes FROM Customers AS c JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name ORDER BY nombre_cartes DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Listez les transactions dont le montant est compris entre 50 et 100, bornes incluses.","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_amount BETWEEN 50 AND 100 ORDER BY transaction_amount, transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont à la fois un compte et une carte ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts AS a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Customers_Cards AS cc WHERE cc.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.customer_last_name, c.customer_first_name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque transaction, affichez aussi le nom du compte associé.","sql":"SELECT ft.transaction_id, ft.transaction_date, ft.transaction_amount, a.account_name FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id ORDER BY ft.transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quelles cartes expirent avant le 1er janvier 2025 ?","sql":"SELECT card_id, customer_id, card_type_code, date_valid_to FROM Customers_Cards WHERE date_valid_to < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY date_valid_to;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions positives et négatives séparément ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN transaction_amount >= 0 THEN 'positives' ELSE 'negatives' END AS categorie, SUM(transaction_amount) AS montant_total FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY CASE WHEN transaction_amount >= 0 THEN 'positives' ELSE 'negatives' END;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont dépensé plus de 5 000 au total ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS montant_total FROM Customers AS c JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name HAVING SUM(ft.transaction_amount) > 5000 ORDER BY montant_total DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la dernière transaction enregistrée pour chaque compte ?","sql":"SELECT ft.account_id, ft.transaction_id, ft.transaction_date, ft.transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft WHERE ft.transaction_date = (SELECT MAX(ft2.transaction_date) FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft2 WHERE ft2.account_id = ft.account_id) ORDER BY ft.account_id;"},{"question":"Combien de transactions chaque carte a-t-elle générées ?","sql":"SELECT cc.card_id, cc.card_type_code, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS nombre_transactions FROM Customers_Cards AS cc LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id GROUP BY cc.card_id, cc.card_type_code ORDER BY nombre_transactions DESC, cc.card_id;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont une adresse électronique renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_email FROM Customers WHERE customer_email IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(customer_email) <> '' ORDER BY customer_email;"},{"question":"Affichez les transactions qui ont une transaction précédente.","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, previous_transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE previous_transaction_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant maximal par type de transaction ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_type, MAX(transaction_amount) AS montant_maximal FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY transaction_type ORDER BY transaction_type;"},{"question":"Quels clients ne possèdent aucune carte ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE cc.card_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.customer_last_name, c.customer_first_name;"},{"question":"Combien de transactions ont été effectuées avec chaque carte ?","sql":"SELECT card_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_transactions FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY card_id ORDER BY card_id;"},{"question":"Quels comptes n’ont enregistré aucune transaction ?","sql":"SELECT a.account_id, a.customer_id, a.account_name FROM Accounts AS a LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE ft.transaction_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.account_id;"},{"question":"Donnez les trois transactions les plus anciennes.","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount, transaction_type FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY transaction_date ASC, transaction_id ASC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions par année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', transaction_date) AS annee, SUM(transaction_amount) AS montant_total FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY strftime('%Y', transaction_date) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels clients possèdent une carte de type VISA ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Customers AS c JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE UPPER(cc.card_type_code) = 'VISA' ORDER BY c.customer_last_name, c.customer_first_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de transactions par compte ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_transactions) AS moyenne_transactions_par_compte FROM (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS nombre_transactions FROM Accounts AS a LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id) AS comptes;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont le même compte et la même carte qu’une autre transaction ?","sql":"SELECT ft.transaction_id, ft.account_id, ft.card_id, ft.transaction_date, ft.transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Financial_Transactions AS autre WHERE autre.account_id = ft.account_id AND autre.card_id = ft.card_id AND autre.transaction_id <> ft.transaction_id) ORDER BY ft.account_id, ft.card_id, ft.transaction_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, comptez le nombre de cartes distinctes et de comptes distincts.","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.card_id) AS nombre_cartes, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS nombre_comptes FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;"},{"question":"Quels montants de transaction apparaissent plusieurs fois ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY transaction_amount HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY occurrences DESC, transaction_amount;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions effectuées après le 1er juin 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(SUM(transaction_amount), 0) AS montant_total FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_date > '2024-06-01';"},{"question":"Affichez chaque client avec le nombre de transactions réalisées par ses cartes.","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS nombre_transactions FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name ORDER BY nombre_transactions DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont un commentaire contenant le mot « abonnement » ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount, transaction_comment FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_comment LIKE '%abonnement%' ORDER BY transaction_date;"},{"question":"Quel est le premier et le dernier jour de transaction enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(transaction_date) AS premiere_date, MAX(transaction_date) AS derniere_date FROM Financial_Transactions;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont au moins deux comptes ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS nombre_comptes FROM Customers AS c JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name HAVING COUNT(a.account_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_comptes DESC;"},{"question":"Classez les transactions de chaque compte de la plus élevée à la plus faible.","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, account_id, transaction_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY transaction_amount DESC) AS rang_dans_le_compte FROM Financial_Transactions ORDER BY account_id, rang_dans_le_compte, transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quels numéros de carte sont renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT card_id, customer_id, card_number FROM Customers_Cards WHERE card_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(card_number) <> '' ORDER BY card_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions pour chaque client, en incluant ceux sans transaction ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_transactions FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions utilisent une carte dont la date de validité est inconnue ?","sql":"SELECT ft.transaction_id, ft.card_id, ft.transaction_date, ft.transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id WHERE cc.date_valid_from IS NULL OR cc.date_valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY ft.transaction_id;"},{"question":"Combien de transactions sont associées à chaque type de transaction et chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_type, strftime('%Y', transaction_date) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_transactions FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY transaction_type, strftime('%Y', transaction_date) ORDER BY annee, transaction_type;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un numéro de téléphone commençant par « 06 » ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_phone FROM Customers WHERE customer_phone LIKE '06%' ORDER BY customer_last_name, customer_first_name;"},{"question":"Quel compte possède le plus grand montant cumulé de transactions ?","sql":"SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS montant_total FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_name ORDER BY montant_total DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont un montant supérieur à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_amount > (SELECT AVG(transaction_amount) FROM Financial_Transactions) ORDER BY transaction_amount DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque carte, indiquez le nom et le prénom de son titulaire.","sql":"SELECT cc.card_id, cc.card_type_code, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Customers_Cards AS cc JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id ORDER BY cc.card_id;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont des comptes dont les détails supplémentaires mentionnent le mot « professionnel » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Customers AS c JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.other_account_details LIKE '%professionnel%' ORDER BY c.customer_last_name, c.customer_first_name;"},{"question":"Calculez le solde net par compte en additionnant les montants des transactions.","sql":"SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS solde_net FROM Accounts AS a LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_name ORDER BY solde_net DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont été réalisées le même jour que la transaction portant l’identifiant 100 ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id, transaction_date, transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE date(transaction_date) = (SELECT date(transaction_date) FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE transaction_id = 100) ORDER BY transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de clients par initiale de nom de famille ?","sql":"SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(customer_last_name, 1, 1)) AS initiale, COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients FROM Customers WHERE customer_last_name IS NOT NULL AND customer_last_name <> '' GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTR(customer_last_name, 1, 1)) ORDER BY initiale;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels débats ont attiré un nombre de spectateurs supérieur à la moyenne de tous les débats ?","sql":"SELECT "Debate_ID", "Date", "Venue", "Num_of_Audience"
FROM "debate"
WHERE "Num_of_Audience" > (
    SELECT AVG("Num_of_Audience")
    FROM "debate"
);"},{"question":"Combien de personnes de chaque district ont participé à au moins un débat ?","sql":"SELECT p."District", COUNT(DISTINCT p."People_ID") AS "Nombre_de_participants"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "debate_people" AS dp
  ON p."People_ID" = dp."Affirmative"
  OR p."People_ID" = dp."Negative"
GROUP BY p."District"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_participants" DESC, p."District";"},{"question":"Affichez la date, le lieu et les noms des deux intervenants pour chaque débat.","sql":"SELECT d."Date", d."Venue", pa."Name" AS "Affirmative", pn."Name" AS "Negative"
FROM "debate" AS d
JOIN "debate_people" AS dp ON d."Debate_ID" = dp."Debate_ID"
JOIN "people" AS pa ON dp."Affirmative" = pa."People_ID"
JOIN "people" AS pn ON dp."Negative" = pn."People_ID"
ORDER BY d."Date", d."Debate_ID";"},{"question":"Quels lieux ont accueilli au moins deux débats, et quelle a été leur audience moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "Venue", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_debats", AVG("Num_of_Audience") AS "Audience_moyenne"
FROM "debate"
GROUP BY "Venue"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_debats" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes n'ont participé à aucun débat, ni comme affirmative ni comme négative ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name", p."Party", p."District"
FROM "people" AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "debate_people" AS dp
    WHERE dp."Affirmative" = p."People_ID"
       OR dp."Negative" = p."People_ID"
)
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quels intervenants affirmatifs ont remporté leur débat ?","sql":"SELECT d."Debate_ID", d."Date", p."Name" AS "Vainqueur_affirmatif"
FROM "debate_people" AS dp
JOIN "debate" AS d ON d."Debate_ID" = dp."Debate_ID"
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = dp."Affirmative"
WHERE dp."If_Affirmative_Win" = 1
ORDER BY d."Date", d."Debate_ID";"},{"question":"Quel ou quels débats ont enregistré la plus forte audience ?","sql":"SELECT "Debate_ID", "Date", "Venue", "Num_of_Audience"
FROM "debate"
WHERE "Num_of_Audience" = (
    SELECT MAX("Num_of_Audience")
    FROM "debate"
);"},{"question":"Quelle est l'âge moyen des personnes dans chaque parti ?","sql":"SELECT "Party", AVG("Age") AS "Age_moyen", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_personnes"
FROM "people"
GROUP BY "Party"
ORDER BY "Age_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels duels ont opposé deux personnes du même parti ?","sql":"SELECT d."Debate_ID", d."Date", p1."Name" AS "Affirmative", p2."Name" AS "Negative", p1."Party"
FROM "debate_people" AS dp
JOIN "debate" AS d ON d."Debate_ID" = dp."Debate_ID"
JOIN "people" AS p1 ON p1."People_ID" = dp."Affirmative"
JOIN "people" AS p2 ON p2."People_ID" = dp."Negative"
WHERE p1."Party" = p2."Party"
ORDER BY d."Date";"},{"question":"Pour chaque date, combien de débats ont été organisés et quelle audience totale ont-ils réunie ?","sql":"SELECT "Date", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_debats", SUM("Num_of_Audience") AS "Audience_totale"
FROM "debate"
GROUP BY "Date"
ORDER BY "Date";"},{"question":"Quels débats opposaient un intervenant affirmatif plus âgé que l'intervenant négatif ?","sql":"SELECT d."Debate_ID", d."Date", pa."Name" AS "Affirmative", pa."Age" AS "Age_affirmative", pn."Name" AS "Negative", pn."Age" AS "Age_negative"
FROM "debate" AS d
JOIN "debate_people" AS dp ON d."Debate_ID" = dp."Debate_ID"
JOIN "people" AS pa ON dp."Affirmative" = pa."People_ID"
JOIN "people" AS pn ON dp."Negative" = pn."People_ID"
WHERE pa."Age" > pn."Age"
ORDER BY d."Date";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, les dirigeants et les localisations de tous les collèges, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Leader_Name", "College_Location"
FROM "college"
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Combien de membres sont enregistrés dans chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_membres"
FROM "member"
GROUP BY "Country"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_membres" DESC, "Country";"},{"question":"Quels membres ont obtenu le rang 1 dans au moins un tour, et sur quel thème ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name" AS "Membre", r."Decoration_Theme" AS "Thème", r."Round_ID" AS "Tour"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "round" AS r ON r."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
WHERE r."Rank_in_Round" = 1
ORDER BY m."Name", r."Round_ID";"},{"question":"Quels collèges ne comptent encore aucun membre ?","sql":"SELECT c."College_ID", c."Name"
FROM "college" AS c
LEFT JOIN "member" AS m ON m."College_ID" = c."College_ID"
WHERE m."Member_ID" IS NULL
ORDER BY c."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque membre ayant participé à plusieurs tours, quel est son rang moyen ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", AVG(r."Rank_in_Round") AS "Rang_moyen", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_tours"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "round" AS r ON r."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
GROUP BY m."Member_ID", m."Name"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY "Rang_moyen", m."Name";"},{"question":"Quels sont les thèmes associés à au moins deux membres distincts ?","sql":"SELECT "Decoration_Theme" AS "Thème", COUNT(DISTINCT "Member_ID") AS "Nombre_de_membres"
FROM "round"
GROUP BY "Decoration_Theme"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Member_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_membres" DESC, "Thème";"},{"question":"Quels membres ont obtenu un meilleur rang que la moyenne de leur tour ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name" AS "Membre", r."Round_ID" AS "Tour", r."Rank_in_Round" AS "Rang"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "round" AS r ON r."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
WHERE r."Rank_in_Round" < (
    SELECT AVG(r2."Rank_in_Round")
    FROM "round" AS r2
    WHERE r2."Round_ID" = r."Round_ID"
)
ORDER BY r."Round_ID", r."Rank_in_Round", m."Name";"},{"question":"Quel collège possède le plus grand nombre de membres ?","sql":"SELECT c."College_ID", c."Name", COUNT(m."Member_ID") AS "Nombre_de_membres"
FROM "college" AS c
LEFT JOIN "member" AS m ON m."College_ID" = c."College_ID"
GROUP BY c."College_ID", c."Name"
HAVING COUNT(m."Member_ID") = (
    SELECT MAX("Nombre_de_membres")
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(m2."Member_ID") AS "Nombre_de_membres"
        FROM "college" AS c2
        LEFT JOIN "member" AS m2 ON m2."College_ID" = c2."College_ID"
        GROUP BY c2."College_ID"
    )
);"},{"question":"Quels membres et collèges sont concernés par un classement dans les trois premiers ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name" AS "Membre", c."Name" AS "Collège", r."Round_ID" AS "Tour", r."Rank_in_Round" AS "Rang"
FROM "round" AS r
JOIN "member" AS m ON m."Member_ID" = r."Member_ID"
LEFT JOIN "college" AS c ON c."College_ID" = m."College_ID"
WHERE r."Rank_in_Round" <= 3
ORDER BY r."Round_ID", r."Rank_in_Round", m."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque collège, combien de membres et de participations à des tours sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Collège",
       COUNT(DISTINCT m."Member_ID") AS "Nombre_de_membres",
       COUNT(r."Round_ID") AS "Nombre_de_participations"
FROM "college" AS c
LEFT JOIN "member" AS m ON m."College_ID" = c."College_ID"
LEFT JOIN "round" AS r ON r."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
GROUP BY c."College_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_membres" DESC, "Nombre_de_participations" DESC, "Collège";"},{"question":"Quels pays comptent au moins un membre ayant participé à un tour ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m."Country"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "round" AS r ON r."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
ORDER BY m."Country";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les départements dont le budget dépasse 1,0 milliard, classés du budget le plus élevé au plus faible ?","sql":"SELECT "Department_ID", "Name", "Budget_in_Billions"
FROM "department"
WHERE "Budget_in_Billions" > 1.0
ORDER BY "Budget_in_Billions" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels responsables sont âgés d’au moins 50 ans, avec leur État de naissance ?","sql":"SELECT "head_ID", "name", "born_state", "age"
FROM "head"
WHERE "age" >= 50
ORDER BY "age" DESC, "name";"},{"question":"Quels départements sont associés à un responsable exerçant temporairement, selon la valeur « Yes » ?","sql":"SELECT d."Department_ID", d."Name", h."name" AS "responsable"
FROM "department" AS d
JOIN "management" AS m ON m."department_ID" = d."Department_ID"
JOIN "head" AS h ON h."head_ID" = m."head_ID"
WHERE m."temporary_acting" = 'Yes'
ORDER BY d."Name", h."name";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d’employés et le budget total de l’ensemble des départements ?","sql":"SELECT SUM("Num_Employees") AS "total_employes", SUM("Budget_in_Billions") AS "budget_total_en_milliards"
FROM "department";"},{"question":"Quels départements comptent plus d’employés que la moyenne de tous les départements ?","sql":"SELECT "Department_ID", "Name", "Num_Employees"
FROM "department"
WHERE "Num_Employees" > (SELECT AVG("Num_Employees") FROM "department")
