d.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS d JOIN Has_amenity AS h ON h.dormid = d.dormid GROUP BY d.dormid, d.dorm_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.amenid) = 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d’étudiants par majeure et par sexe ?","sql":"SELECT Major, Sex, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY Major, Sex ORDER BY Major, Sex;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants vivent dans une chambre dont le numéro est supérieur à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, l.room_number FROM Student AS s JOIN Lives_in AS l ON l.stuid = s.StuID WHERE l.room_number > (SELECT AVG(room_number) FROM Lives_in);"},{"question":"Quels dortoirs ont une capacité comprise entre 50 et 150 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT dormid, dorm_name, student_capacity FROM Dorm WHERE student_capacity BETWEEN 50 AND 150 ORDER BY student_capacity;"},{"question":"Combien d’étudiants vivent dans des dortoirs de chaque genre ?","sql":"SELECT d.gender, COUNT(l.stuid) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Dorm AS d LEFT JOIN Lives_in AS l ON l.dormid = d.dormid GROUP BY d.gender;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n’habitent pas dans le dortoir numéro 1 ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s WHERE s.StuID NOT IN (SELECT stuid FROM Lives_in WHERE dormid = 1);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de chambres distinctes utilisées dans chaque dortoir ?","sql":"SELECT d.dormid, d.dorm_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.room_number) AS nombre_chambres FROM Dorm AS d LEFT JOIN Lives_in AS l ON l.dormid = d.dormid GROUP BY d.dormid, d.dorm_name;"},{"question":"Quels noms d’équipements sont classés par ordre alphabétique inverse ?","sql":"SELECT amenity_name FROM Dorm_amenity ORDER BY amenity_name DESC;"},{"question":"Quels dortoirs ont davantage d’étudiants que la moyenne des effectifs par dortoir ?","sql":"WITH effectifs AS (SELECT d.dormid, d.dorm_name, COUNT(l.stuid) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Dorm AS d LEFT JOIN Lives_in AS l ON l.dormid = d.dormid GROUP BY d.dormid, d.dorm_name) SELECT dormid, dorm_name, nombre_etudiants FROM effectifs WHERE nombre_etudiants > (SELECT AVG(nombre_etudiants) FROM effectifs);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une majeure et un conseiller ayant le même identifiant numérique ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, Major, Advisor FROM Student WHERE Major = Advisor AND Major IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels dortoirs sont associés à un équipement dont le nom se termine par « room » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.dormid, d.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS d JOIN Has_amenity AS h ON h.dormid = d.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS a ON a.amenid = h.amenid WHERE a.amenity_name LIKE '%room';"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d’étudiants non logés par code de ville ?","sql":"SELECT s.city_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants_non_loges FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Lives_in AS l ON l.stuid = s.StuID WHERE l.stuid IS NULL GROUP BY s.city_code;"},{"question":"Quels dortoirs ont au moins un équipement mais aucun étudiant logé ?","sql":"SELECT d.dormid, d.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS d JOIN Has_amenity AS h ON h.dormid = d.dormid LEFT JOIN Lives_in AS l ON l.dormid = d.dormid WHERE l.dormid IS NULL GROUP BY d.dormid, d.dorm_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la capacité totale des dortoirs contenant au moins un équipement ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(d.student_capacity) AS capacite_totale FROM Dorm AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_amenity AS h WHERE h.dormid = d.dormid);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants vivent dans un dortoir qui possède plus d’équipements que la moyenne des dortoirs ?","sql":"WITH compteurs AS (SELECT d.dormid, COUNT(h.amenid) AS nombre_equipements FROM Dorm AS d LEFT JOIN Has_amenity AS h ON h.dormid = d.dormid GROUP BY d.dormid) SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Lives_in AS l ON l.stuid = s.StuID JOIN compteurs AS c ON c.dormid = l.dormid WHERE c.nombre_equipements > (SELECT AVG(nombre_equipements) FROM compteurs);"}]}

à un service dont le type est renseigné par la valeur « ADMIN » ?","sql":"SELECT f.form_id, f.form_name, s.service_name FROM Forms AS f JOIN Services AS s ON s.service_id = f.service_id WHERE s.service_type_code = 'ADMIN' ORDER BY f.form_name;"},{"question":"Quelle partie a effectué le plus grand nombre de réservations de services ?","sql":"SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reservations FROM Party_Services GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY nombre_reservations DESC, customer_id LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations n'ont pas de numéro de TVA renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT organization_id, organization_name FROM Organizations WHERE uk_vat_number IS NULL ORDER BY organization_name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque statut de formulaire, combien de formulaires sont concernés ?","sql":"SELECT form_status_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_formulaires FROM Party_Forms GROUP BY form_status_code ORDER BY form_status_code;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses ne sont liées à aucune partie ?","sql":"SELECT a.address_id, a.line_1_number_building, a.town_city, a.country FROM Addresses AS a LEFT JOIN Party_Addresses AS pa ON pa.address_id = a.address_id WHERE pa.address_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.address_id;"},{"question":"Quels individus ont été en contact avec plus d'une organisation ?","sql":"SELECT individual_id, COUNT(DISTINCT organization_id) AS nombre_organisations FROM Organization_Contact_Individuals GROUP BY individual_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT organization_id) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_organisations DESC, individual_id;"},{"question":"Quels services n'ont jamais été réservés ?","sql":"SELECT s.service_id, s.service_name FROM Services AS s LEFT JOIN Party_Services AS ps ON ps.service_id = s.service_id WHERE ps.service_id IS NULL ORDER BY s.service_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne, en jours, entre le début et la fin des contacts avec les organisations lorsque les deux dates sont disponibles ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(date_contact_to) - julianday(date_contact_from)) AS duree_moyenne_jours FROM Organization_Contact_Individuals WHERE date_contact_to IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles parties utilisent un moyen de paiement différent de « CARD » ?","sql":"SELECT party_id, payment_method_code, party_phone FROM Parties WHERE payment_method_code <> 'CARD' ORDER BY payment_method_code, party_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque service, indiquez le nombre de clients distincts l'ayant réservé.","sql":"SELECT s.service_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.customer_id) AS nombre_clients FROM Services AS s LEFT JOIN Party_Services AS ps ON ps.service_id = s.service_id GROUP BY s.service_id, s.service_name ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC, s.service_name;"},{"question":"Quels formulaires ont une description contenant le mot « permit », sans tenir compte de la casse ?","sql":"SELECT form_id, form_name, form_description FROM Forms WHERE LOWER(form_description) LIKE '%permit%' ORDER BY form_name;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations ont au moins un contact individuel dont le contact est toujours en cours ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT o.organization_id, o.organization_name FROM Organizations AS o JOIN Organization_Contact_Individuals AS oc ON oc.organization_id = o.organization_id WHERE oc.date_contact_to IS NULL ORDER BY o.organization_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de réservations par année de rendez-vous ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', service_datetime) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reservations FROM Party_Services GROUP BY strftime('%Y', service_datetime) ORDER BY annee;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms de tous les cours ?","sql":"SELECT course_name FROM Courses;"},{"question":"Liste les cours avec leur description.","sql":"SELECT course_name, course_description FROM Courses;"},{"question":"Quels sont les sujets disponibles, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT subject_id, subject_name FROM Subjects ORDER BY subject_name;"},{"question":"Combien de sujets sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_sujets FROM Subjects;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits depuis le 1er janvier 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, date_of_completion FROM Student_Course_Enrolment WHERE date_of_completion < '2024-01-01';"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits au cours numéro 5 ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.course_id = 5;"},{"question":"Quels cours comptent au moins deux inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions FROM Courses AS c JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name HAVING COUNT(e.registration_id) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date d'inscription la plus ancienne d'un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(date_of_registration) AS premiere_inscription FROM Students;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date de dernière connexion la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(date_of_latest_logon) AS derniere_connexion FROM Students;"},{"question":"Quels tests ont obtenu un résultat renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT registration_id, date_test_taken, test_result FROM Student_Tests_Taken WHERE test_result IS NOT NULL AND test_result <> '';"},{"question":"Combien de tests ont été passés pour chaque inscription ?","sql":"SELECT registration_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_tests FROM Student_Tests_Taken GROUP BY registration_id ORDER BY registration_id;"},{"question":"Affiche les inscriptions avec le nom du cours et le nom de l'étudiant.","sql":"SELECT e.registration_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, c.course_name, e.date_of_enrolment FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN Courses AS c ON c.course_id = e.course_id;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont terminé au moins un cours ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.date_of_completion IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ne sont inscrits à aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name FROM Students AS s LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.registration_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ou tuteurs n'ont créé aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.author_id = a.author_id WHERE c.course_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants distincts sont inscrits à au moins un cours ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS nombre_d_etudiants FROM Student_Course_Enrolment;"},{"question":"Combien de cours distincts sont suivis par les étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS nombre_de_cours_suivis FROM Student_Course_Enrolment;"},{"question":"Quels cours appartiennent à un sujet dont le nom contient « informatique » ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, s.subject_name FROM Courses AS c JOIN Subjects AS s ON s.subject_id = c.subject_id WHERE s.subject_name LIKE '%informatique%';"},{"question":"Quels cours ont un nom contenant le mot « avancé » ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, course_name FROM Courses WHERE course_name LIKE '%avancé%';"},{"question":"Quels étudiants se sont inscrits entre janvier et juin 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, personal_name, family_name, date_of_registration FROM Students WHERE date_of_registration >= '2023-01-01' AND date_of_registration < '2023-07-01' ORDER BY date_of_registration;"},{"question":"Combien d'inscriptions chaque étudiant possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions FROM Students AS s LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name ORDER BY nombre_d_inscriptions DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le cours le plus suivi ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions FROM Courses AS c JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY nombre_d_inscriptions DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels sujets ne possèdent aucun cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.subject_id, s.subject_name FROM Subjects AS s LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.subject_id = s.subject_id WHERE c.course_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'inscriptions par cours ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_d_inscriptions) AS moyenne_d_inscriptions FROM (SELECT c.course_id, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions FROM Courses AS c LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id);"},{ "question":"Quels auteurs ou tuteurs ont créé plus de trois cours ?","sql":"SELECT a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name, COUNT(c.course_id) AS nombre_de_cours FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a JOIN Courses AS c ON c.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name HAVING COUNT(c.course_id) > 3;"},{"question":"Quels résultats de test contiennent le mot « réussi » ?","sql":"SELECT registration_id, date_test_taken, test_result FROM Student_Tests_Taken WHERE test_result LIKE '%réussi%';"},{"question":"Affiche le dernier test passé pour chaque inscription.","sql":"SELECT registration_id, MAX(date_test_taken) AS dernier_test FROM Student_Tests_Taken GROUP BY registration_id;"},{"question":"Quelles inscriptions n'ont encore aucun test associé ?","sql":"SELECT e.registration_id, e.student_id, e.course_id FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e LEFT JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id WHERE t.registration_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont passé au moins deux tests ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, COUNT(t.registration_id) AS nombre_de_tests FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name HAVING COUNT(t.registration_id) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels cours sont suivis par plus de cinq étudiants distincts ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS nombre_d_etudiants FROM Courses AS c JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) > 5;"},{"question":"Pour chaque sujet, combien d'étudiants distincts suivent ses cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.subject_id, s.subject_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS nombre_d_etudiants FROM Subjects AS s LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.subject_id, s.subject_name ORDER BY nombre_d_etudiants DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits à des cours créés par l'auteur numéro 2 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN Courses AS c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE c.author_id = 2;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont été suivis par des étudiants inscrits avant 2022 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.course_id, c.course_name FROM Courses AS c JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE s.date_of_registration < '2022-01-01';"},{"question":"Quel étudiant a le plus grand nombre d'inscriptions ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, COUNT(e.registration_id) AS nombre_d_inscriptions FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name ORDER BY nombre_d_inscriptions DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ou tuteurs ont un nom de famille renseigné mais pas de prénom personnel ?","sql":"SELECT author_id, personal_name, family_name FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors WHERE family_name IS NOT NULL AND family_name <> '' AND (personal_name IS NULL OR personal_name = '');"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants ont une adresse de connexion datant de 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_etudiants FROM Students WHERE date_of_latest_logon >= '2024-01-01' AND date_of_latest_logon < '2025-01-01';"},{"question":"Liste les cours par sujet puis par ordre alphabétique.","sql":"SELECT s.subject_name, c.course_name FROM Subjects AS s JOIN Courses AS c ON c.subject_id = s.subject_id ORDER BY s.subject_name, c.course_name;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont été créés par un auteur ou tuteur dont le prénom contient « Jean » ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, a.personal_name, a.family_name FROM Courses AS c JOIN Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a ON a.author_id = c.author_id WHERE a.personal_name LIKE '%Jean%';"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée moyenne entre l'inscription et la fin des cours, en jours ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(date_of_completion) - julianday(date_of_enrolment)) AS duree_moyenne_en_jours FROM Student_Course_Enrolment;"},{"question":"Quelles inscriptions ont duré plus de trente jours ?","sql":"SELECT registration_id, student_id, course_id, date_of_enrolment, date_of_completion FROM Student_Course_Enrolment WHERE julianday(date_of_completion) - julianday(date_of_enrolment) > 30;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont terminé tous les cours auxquels ils se sont inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.date_of_completion IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0;"},{"question":"Pour chaque auteur, quel est le nombre de sujets différents de ses cours ?","sql":"SELECT a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.subject_id) AS nombre_de_sujets FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name;"},{"question":"Quels mois ont enregistré le plus d'inscriptions aux cours ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_of_enrolment) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_inscriptions FROM Student_Course_Enrolment GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_of_enrolment) ORDER BY nombre_d_inscriptions DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont passé un test le même jour que leur inscription au cours ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, e.registration_id FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id WHERE date(t.date_test_taken) = date(e.date_of_enrolment);"},{"question":"Quels cours ont au moins une inscription mais aucun test passé ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name FROM Courses AS c JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name HAVING COUNT(t.registration_id) = 0;"},{"question":"Quel est le taux d'inscriptions ayant au moins un test associé ?","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.registration_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.registration_id) AS taux_en_pourcentage FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e LEFT JOIN Student_Tests_Taken AS t ON t.registration_id = e.registration_id;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms complets des étudiants, avec leur identifiant de connexion ?","sql":"SELECT personal_name || ' ' || COALESCE(middle_name || ' ', '') || family_name AS nom_complet, login_name FROM Students ORDER BY family_name, personal_name;"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ou tuteurs portent le même nom de famille qu'un étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.author_id, a.personal_name, a.family_name FROM Course_Authors_and_Tutors AS a JOIN Students AS s ON s.family_name = a.family_name;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont une description de plus de 100 caractères ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, course_name, length(course_description) AS longueur_description FROM Courses WHERE length(course_description) > 100;"},{"question":"Quel sujet possède le plus de cours ?","sql":"SELECT s.subject_id, s.subject_name, COUNT(c.course_id) AS nombre_de_cours FROM Subjects AS s LEFT JOIN Courses AS c ON c.subject_id = s.subject_id GROUP BY s.subject_id, s.subject_name ORDER BY nombre_de_cours DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une inscription mais aucune date de dernière connexion ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.date_of_latest_logon IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque cours, affiche le dernier étudiant inscrit selon la date d'inscription.","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, e.date_of_enrolment FROM Courses AS c JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.date_of_enrolment = (SELECT MAX(e2.date_of_enrolment) FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS e2 WHERE e2.course_id = c.course_id);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants suivent à la fois plusieurs cours différents ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_id) AS nombre_de_cours FROM Students AS s JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.personal_name, s.family_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_id) > 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les populations de tous les comtés ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Population\" FROM \"county\";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont une population supérieure à la population moyenne de tous les comtés ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Population\" FROM \"county\" WHERE \"Population\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Population\") FROM \"county\");"},{"question":"Quels délégués sont associés à chaque district électoral ?","sql":"SELECT \"District\", \"Delegate\" FROM \"election\" ORDER BY \"District\";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les années et les gouverneurs répertoriés pour chaque parti ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", \"Year\", \"Governor\" FROM \"party\";"},{"question":"Combien de comtés sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_comtes\" FROM \"county\";"},{"question":"Quels comtés sont classés par ordre croissant de code postal ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Zip_code\" FROM \"county\" ORDER BY \"Zip_code\" ASC;"},{"question":"Quels partis sont associés aux élections, avec leur année et leur gouverneur ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Election_ID\", p.\"Party\", p.\"Year\", p.\"Governor\" FROM \"election\" AS e JOIN \"party\" AS p ON e.\"Party\" = p.\"Party_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ne sont associés à aucune élection ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"County_name\" FROM \"county\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"election\" AS e ON e.\"District\" = c.\"County_Id\" WHERE e.\"Election_ID\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le comté le plus peuplé ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Population\" FROM \"county\" WHERE \"Population\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Population\") FROM \"county\");"},{"question":"Quelle est l'année moyenne des partis ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"Year\") AS \"Annee_moyenne\" FROM \"party\";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les différentes commissions mentionnées dans les élections ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Committee\" FROM \"election\" WHERE \"Committee\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'élections sont enregistrées pour chaque district ?","sql":"SELECT \"District\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"election\" GROUP BY \"District\" ORDER BY \"District\";"},{"question":"Quels partis disposent d'un gouverneur renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", \"Governor\" FROM \"party\" WHERE \"Governor\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des comtés accompagnés de leur code postal sous forme de texte combiné ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\" || ' - ' || \"Zip_code\" AS \"Comte_et_code_postal\" FROM \"county\";"},{"question":"Combien d'élections chaque parti compte-t-il, y compris les partis sans élection ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Party\", COUNT(e.\"Election_ID\") AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"party\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"election\" AS e ON e.\"Party\" = p.\"Party_ID\" GROUP BY p.\"Party_ID\", p.\"Party\";"},{"question":"Quels districts comptent au moins deux élections ?","sql":"SELECT \"District\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"election\" GROUP BY \"District\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels partis ont un premier élu renseigné entre 2000 et 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"Party\", e.\"First_Elected\" FROM \"party\" AS p JOIN \"election\" AS e ON e.\"Party\" = p.\"Party_ID\" WHERE e.\"First_Elected\" BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020;"},{"question":"Quels partis ont le même nom de gouverneur et de lieutenant-gouverneur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", \"Governor\", \"Lieutenant_Governor\" FROM \"party\" WHERE \"Governor\" IS NOT NULL AND \"Governor\" = \"Lieutenant_Governor\";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont un code postal commençant par 9 ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Zip_code\" FROM \"county\" WHERE \"Zip_code\" LIKE '9%';"},{"question":"Quelles élections n'ont pas de commission renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT \"Election_ID\", \"Delegate\", \"District\" FROM \"election\" WHERE \"Committee\" IS NULL OR TRIM(\"Committee\") = '';"},{"question":"Quelles sont les dates de première élection minimale et maximale ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(\"First_Elected\") AS \"Premiere_minimale\", MAX(\"First_Elected\") AS \"Premiere_maximale\" FROM \"election\";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont une population comprise entre 10000 et 50000 habitants ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Population\" FROM \"county\" WHERE \"Population\" BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000 ORDER BY \"Population\";"},{"question":"Quel est le parti correspondant à l'année la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", \"Year\" FROM \"party\" WHERE \"Year\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Year\") FROM \"party\");"},{"question":"Combien de partis sont associés à chaque gouverneur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Governor\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_partis\" FROM \"party\" GROUP BY \"Governor\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_partis\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels délégués appartiennent à des districts dont la population dépasse 100000 habitants ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Delegate\", c.\"County_name\", c.\"Population\" FROM \"election\" AS e JOIN \"county\" AS c ON e.\"District\" = c.\"County_Id\" WHERE c.\"Population\" > 100000;"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont plus d'une élection dans leur district ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"County_name\", COUNT(e.\"Election_ID\") AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"county\" AS c JOIN \"election\" AS e ON e.\"District\" = c.\"County_Id\" GROUP BY c.\"County_Id\", c.\"County_name\" HAVING COUNT(e.\"Election_ID\") > 1;"},{"question":"Quels partis ne sont associés à aucune élection ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Party_ID\", p.\"Party\" FROM \"party\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"election\" AS e ON e.\"Party\" = p.\"Party_ID\" WHERE e.\"Election_ID\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel district possède le plus grand nombre d'élections ?","sql":"WITH comptes AS (SELECT \"District\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"election\" GROUP BY \"District\") SELECT \"District\", \"Nombre_elections\" FROM comptes WHERE \"Nombre_elections\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Nombre_elections\") FROM comptes);"},{"question":"Quels sont les délégués distincts enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Delegate\" FROM \"election\" WHERE \"Delegate\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Delegate\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la population totale des comtés associés à au moins une élection ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(c.\"Population\") AS \"Population_totale\" FROM \"county\" AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"election\" AS e WHERE e.\"District\" = c.\"County_Id\");"},{"question":"Quelles élections ont une date de première élection inconnue ?","sql":"SELECT \"Election_ID\", \"Delegate\", \"District\" FROM \"election\" WHERE \"First_Elected\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels partis ont au moins un responsable parmi le gouverneur, le lieutenant-gouverneur ou le procureur général ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\" FROM \"party\" WHERE \"Governor\" IS NOT NULL OR \"Lieutenant_Governor\" IS NOT NULL OR \"Attorney_General\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle est l'année moyenne des partis antérieurs à l'année moyenne globale ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", \"Year\" FROM \"party\" WHERE \"Year\" < (SELECT AVG(\"Year\") FROM \"party\") ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quelles commissions sont utilisées par au moins deux élections ?","sql":"SELECT \"Committee\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"election\" WHERE \"Committee\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"Committee\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants d'élection ont un délégué renseigné et sont triés par date de première élection ?","sql":"SELECT \"Election_ID\", \"Delegate\", \"First_Elected\" FROM \"election\" WHERE \"Delegate\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"First_Elected\" ASC;"},{"question":"Combien de partis sont enregistrés pour chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_partis\" FROM \"party\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Combien de comtés possèdent un nom renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(\"County_name\") AS \"Comtes_avec_nom\" FROM \"county\";"},{"question":"Combien d'élections ont un délégué mais aucune commission ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"election\" WHERE \"Delegate\" IS NOT NULL AND \"Committee\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels partis ont un procureur général et un sénateur américain renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", \"Attorney_General\", \"US_Senate\" FROM \"party\" WHERE \"Attorney_General\" IS NOT NULL AND \"US_Senate\" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle part de la population totale représentent les comtés les plus peuplés que la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN \"Population\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Population\") FROM \"county\") THEN \"Population\" ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(\"Population\"), 0) AS \"Pourcentage_population\" FROM \"county\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les comtés dont la population est supérieure à celle de tous les comtés ayant un code postal renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Population\" FROM \"county\" WHERE \"Population\" > (SELECT MAX(\"Population\") FROM \"county\" WHERE \"Zip_code\" IS NOT NULL);" },{"question":"Quels districts et noms de comté sont associés aux élections, même lorsque le district ne correspond pas à un comté ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"District\", c.\"County_name\", e.\"Election_ID\" FROM \"election\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"county\" AS c ON e.\"District\" = c.\"County_Id\";"},{"question":"Quels partis sont classés par nombre décroissant d'élections ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Party\", COUNT(e.\"Election_ID\") AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"party\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"election\" AS e ON e.\"Party\" = p.\"Party_ID\" GROUP BY p.\"Party_ID\", p.\"Party\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_elections\" DESC, p.\"Party\";"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont une population inférieure à la population moyenne de leur propre ensemble de comtés ?","sql":"SELECT \"County_name\", \"Population\" FROM \"county\" WHERE \"Population\" < (SELECT AVG(\"Population\") FROM \"county\");"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'élections par commission, en incluant les commissions inconnues ?","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(\"Committee\", '(inconnue)') AS \"Commission\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"election\" GROUP BY \"Committee\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_elections\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels partis ont une année comprise entre l'année minimale et l'année maximale des élections ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Party\", p.\"Year\" FROM \"party\" AS p WHERE p.\"Year\" BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(\"First_Elected\") FROM \"election\") AND (SELECT MAX(\"First_Elected\") FROM \"election\");"},{"question":"Quels comtés ont le même préfixe de code postal que le comté le plus peuplé ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"County_name\", c.\"Zip_code\" FROM \"county\" AS c WHERE SUBSTR(c.\"Zip_code\", 1, 1) = (SELECT SUBSTR(\"Zip_code\", 1, 1) FROM \"county\" ORDER BY \"Population\" DESC LIMIT 1);"},{"question":"Quels partis n'ont ni gouverneur ni lieutenant-gouverneur renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT \"Party\", \"Year\" FROM \"party\" WHERE \"Governor\" IS NULL AND \"Lieutenant_Governor\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'élections par district, avec le nom du comté correspondant lorsqu'il existe ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"County_name\", e.\"District\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"election\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"county\" AS c ON c.\"County_Id\" = e.\"District\" GROUP BY e.\"District\", c.\"County_name\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_elections\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les partis dont le nombre d'élections est supérieur au nombre moyen d'élections par parti ?","sql":"WITH comptes AS (SELECT p.\"Party_ID\", p.\"Party\", COUNT(e.\"Election_ID\") AS \"Nombre_elections\" FROM \"party\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"election\" AS e ON e.\"Party\" = p.\"Party_ID\" GROUP BY p.\"Party_ID\", p.\"Party\") SELECT \"Party\", \"Nombre_elections\" FROM comptes WHERE \"Nombre_elections\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Nombre_elections\") FROM comptes);"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les élections avec le nom du représentant, son parti, la date et le nombre de voix obtenues ?","sql":"SELECT e."Election_ID", r."Name", r."Party", e."Date", e."Votes"
FROM "election" AS e
JOIN "representative" AS r ON r."Representative_ID" = e."Representative_ID"
ORDER BY e."Date", r."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle ou quelles élections ont obtenu le plus grand nombre de voix ?","sql":"SELECT e."Election_ID", r."Name", e."Date", e."Votes"
FROM "election" AS e
JOIN "representative" AS r ON r."Representative_ID" = e."Representative_ID"
WHERE e."Votes" = (SELECT MAX("Votes") FROM "election")
ORDER BY e."Election_ID";"},{"question":"Quel est le pourcentage moyen de voix par parti ?","sql":"SELECT r."Party", ROUND(AVG(e."Vote_Percent"), 2) AS "pourcentage_moyen"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Party"
ORDER BY "pourcentage_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'élections sont enregistrées pour chaque État ?","sql":"SELECT r."State", COUNT(e."Election_ID") AS "nombre_elections"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."State"
ORDER BY "nombre_elections" DESC, r."State";"},{"question":"Quels représentants n'ont aucune élection enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT r."Representative_ID", r."Name", r."State", r."Party"
FROM "representative" AS r
LEFT JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
WHERE e."Election_ID" IS NULL
ORDER BY r."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le total des voix recueillies par parti sur l'ensemble des élections ?","sql":"SELECT r."Party", SUM(e."Votes") AS "total_voix"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Party"
ORDER BY "total_voix" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel représentant possède le meilleur pourcentage moyen de voix ?","sql":"SELECT r."Representative_ID", r."Name", ROUND(AVG(e."Vote_Percent"), 2) AS "moyenne_vote_percent"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Representative_ID", r."Name"
ORDER BY "moyenne_vote_percent" DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles élections ont obtenu plus de voix que la moyenne de toutes les élections ?","sql":"SELECT e."Election_ID", r."Name", e."Votes"
FROM "election" AS e
JOIN "representative" AS r ON r."Representative_ID" = e."Representative_ID"
WHERE e."Votes" > (SELECT AVG("Votes") FROM "election")
ORDER BY e."Votes" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque parti, quel est le nombre maximal de sièges attribué lors d'une élection ?","sql":"SELECT r."Party", MAX(e."Seats") AS "maximum_sieges"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Party"
ORDER BY "maximum_sieges" DESC;"},{"question":"Classez les représentants selon le nombre d'élections auxquelles ils ont participé.","sql":"SELECT r."Name", r."Party", COUNT(e."Election_ID") AS "nombre_elections",
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(e."Election_ID") DESC) AS "rang"
FROM "representative" AS r
LEFT JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Representative_ID", r."Name", r."Party"
ORDER BY "rang", r."Name";"},{"question":"Quels représentants ont participé à l'une des trois élections ayant obtenu le plus de voix ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT r."Representative_ID", r."Name", r."Party"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
WHERE e."Election_ID" IN (
    SELECT "Election_ID"
    FROM "election"
    ORDER BY "Votes" DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
ORDER BY r."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la dernière élection enregistrée pour chaque représentant ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Date", "Votes", "Vote_Percent"
FROM (
    SELECT r."Name", e."Date", e."Votes", e."Vote_Percent",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY r."Representative_ID"
               ORDER BY e."Date" DESC, e."Election_ID" DESC
           ) AS "rang"
    FROM "representative" AS r
    JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
)
WHERE "rang" = 1
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la place moyenne obtenue dans chaque État ?","sql":"SELECT r."State", ROUND(AVG(e."Place"), 2) AS "place_moyenne"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."State"
ORDER BY "place_moyenne" ASC;"},{"question":"Quels partis comptent au moins deux représentants distincts ayant participé à une élection ?","sql":"SELECT r."Party", COUNT(DISTINCT r."Representative_ID") AS "nombre_representants"
FROM "representative" AS r
JOIN "election" AS e ON e."Representative_ID" = r."Representative_ID"
GROUP BY r."Party"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r."Representative_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY "nombre_representants" DESC, r."Party";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les types de toutes les œuvres, classés par nom alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Type"
FROM artwork
ORDER BY "Name" ASC;"},{"question":"Quels festivals ont eu lieu à Paris, avec leur année et leur nombre de spectateurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Festival_Name", "Year", "Num_of_Audience"
FROM "festival_detail"
WHERE "Location" = 'Paris'
ORDER BY "Year" ASC;"},{"question":"Quelles œuvres ont été nominées à quels festivals, et quel a été leur résultat ?","sql":"SELECT a."Name", f."Festival_Name", n."Result"
FROM nomination AS n
JOIN artwork AS a ON a."Artwork_ID" = n."Artwork_ID"
JOIN "festival_detail" AS f ON f."Festival_ID" = n."Festival_ID"
ORDER BY f."Festival_Name", a."Name";"},{"question":"Quels festivals ont enregistré plus de 10 000 spectateurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Festival_Name", "Location", "Year", "Num_of_Audience"
FROM "festival_detail"
WHERE "Num_of_Audience" > 10000
ORDER BY "Num_of_Audience" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de festivals sont associés à chaque œuvre ?","sql":"SELECT a."Name", COUNT(n."Festival_ID") AS nombre_de_festivals
FROM artwork AS a
LEFT JOIN nomination AS n ON n."Artwork_ID" = a."Artwork_ID"
GROUP BY a."Artwork_ID", a."Name"
ORDER BY nombre_de_festivals DESC, a."Name";"},{"question":"Quels festivals n'ont aucune nomination enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT f."Festival_Name"
FROM "festival_detail" AS f
LEFT JOIN nomination AS n ON n."Festival_ID" = f."Festival_ID"
WHERE n."Festival_ID" IS NULL
ORDER BY f."Festival_Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est l'année du festival ayant accueilli le plus de spectateurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Festival_Name", "Year", "Num_of_Audience"
FROM "festival_detail"
WHERE "Num_of_Audience" = (
    SELECT MAX("Num_of_Audience")
    FROM "festival_detail"
);"},{"question":"Quelles œuvres n'ont jamais été nominées ?","sql":"SELECT a."Artwork_ID", a."Name", a."Type"
FROM artwork AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM nomination AS n
    WHERE n."Artwork_ID" = a."Artwork_ID"
)
ORDER BY a."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de spectateurs par festival ?","sql":"SELECT AVG("Num_of_Audience") AS moyenne_spectateurs
FROM "festival_detail";"},{"question":"Quels sont les résultats de nomination les plus fréquents ?","sql":"SELECT "Result", COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_nominations
FROM nomination
GROUP BY "Result"
ORDER BY nombre_de_nominations DESC, "Result";"},{"question":"Quelles œuvres de type « Film » portent un nom commençant par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT "Artwork_ID", "Name"
FROM artwork
WHERE "Type" = 'Film'
  AND "Name" LIKE 'A%'
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quels festivals ont eu lieu entre 2018 et 2022 inclusivement ?","sql":"SELECT "Festival_Name", "Year", "Location"
FROM "festival_detail"
WHERE "Year" BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022
ORDER BY "Year", "Festival_Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque lieu, combien de festivals ont été organisés et quelle a été leur audience totale ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_festivals, SUM("Num_of_Audience") AS audience_totale
FROM "festival_detail"
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY audience_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles œuvres ont été nominées dans au moins deux festivals différents ?","sql":"SELECT a."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT n."Festival_ID") AS nombre_de_festivals
FROM artwork AS a
JOIN nomination AS n ON n."Artwork_ID" = a."Artwork_ID"
GROUP BY a."Artwork_ID", a."Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n."Festival_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_de_festivals DESC, a."Name";"},{"question":"Quels festivals ont une audience supérieure à l'audience moyenne de tous les festivals ?","sql":"SELECT "Festival_Name", "Num_of_Audience"
FROM "festival_detail"
WHERE "Num_of_Audience" > (
    SELECT AVG("Num_of_Audience")
    FROM "festival_detail"
)
ORDER BY "Num_of_Audience" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de nominations par année de festival ?","sql":"SELECT f."Year", COUNT(n."Artwork_ID") AS nombre_de_nominations
FROM "festival_detail" AS f
LEFT JOIN nomination AS n ON n."Festival_ID" = f."Festival_ID"
GROUP BY f."Year"
ORDER BY f."Year" ASC;"}]}

investisseurs financent au moins deux entreprises ?","sql":"SELECT \"Investor\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_d_entreprises\" FROM \"entrepreneur\" WHERE \"Investor\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"Investor\" HAVING plus élevé au plus faible.","sql":"SELECT \"Company\", \"Money_Requested\", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY \"Money_Requested\" DESC) AS \"Rang\" FROM \"entrepreneur\" ORDER BY \"Rang\", WHERE \"Money_Requested\" BETWEEN 50000 AND 150000 ORDER BY \"Money_Requested\";"},{"question":"Quel est le ratio entre le poids et la taille de chaque personne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Weight\" / entreprise ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Company\", e.\"Money_Requested\" FROM \"entrepreneur\" AS e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"entrepreneur\" AS e2 WHERE e2.\"Money_Requested\" < e.\"Money_Requested\") ORDER BY e.\"Money_Requested\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'entrepreneurs par tranche de montant : moins de 50 000, de 50 000 à 100 000, et plus de 100 000 euros ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN \"Money_Requested\" < 50000 THEN 'Moins de 50 000' WHEN \"Money_Requested\" <= 100000 THEN 'De 50 000 à 100 000' ELSE 'Plus de 100 000' END AS \"Tranche\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre\" FROM \"entrepreneur\" GROUP BY \"Tranche\" ORDER BY MIN(\"Money_Requested\");"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ne sont liées à aucun entrepreneur ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"People_ID\", p.\"Name\" FROM \"people\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"entrepreneur\" AS e ON e.\"People_ID\" = p.\"People_ID\" WHERE e.\"Entrepreneur_ID\" IS NULL ORDER BY p.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelle entreprise a demandé le montant le plus proche du montant moyen ?","sql":"WITH moyenne AS (SELECT AVG(\"Money_Requested\") AS \"valeur\" FROM \"entrepreneur\") SELECT e.\"Company\", e.\"Money_Requested\" FROM \"entrepreneur\" AS e CROSS JOIN moyenne AS m ORDER BY ABS(e.\"Money_Requested\" - m.\"valeur\") LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des personnes dont la date de naissance est renseignée et qui sont associées à un entrepreneur ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.\"Name\" FROM \"people\" AS p JOIN \"entrepreneur\" AS e ON e.\"People_ID\" = p.\"People_ID\" WHERE p.\"Date_of_Birth\" IS NOT NULL AND {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les titres des articles dont le titre est renseigné, classés par ordre alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT title FROM item WHERE title IS NOT NULL ORDER BY title;"},{"question":"Combien de comptes utilisateurs sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_utilisateurs FROM useracct;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont donné une note supérieure ou égale à 4, avec le titre de l’article concerné ?","sql":"SELECT u.name, i.title, r.rating FROM review AS r JOIN useracct AS u ON u.u_id = r.u_id JOIN item AS i ON i.i_id = r.i_id WHERE r.rating >= 4 ORDER BY r.rating DESC, u.name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la note moyenne attribuée à chaque article, en ne gardant que les articles notés au moins deux fois ?","sql":"SELECT i.i_id, i.title, AVG(r.rating) AS note_moyenne, COUNT(*) AS nombre_avis FROM item AS i JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id GROUP BY i.i_id, i.title HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels avis ont la note maximale présente dans la table des avis ?","sql":"SELECT a_id, u_id, i_id, rating FROM review WHERE rating = (SELECT MAX(rating) FROM review);"},{"question":"Combien de relations de confiance sortantes chaque utilisateur a-t-il déclarées ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(t.target_u_id) AS nombre_de_relations FROM useracct AS u LEFT JOIN trust AS t ON t.source_u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name ORDER BY nombre_de_relations DESC, u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quelles relations de confiance sont réciproques ?","sql":"SELECT t.source_u_id, t.target_u_id, t.trust, retour.trust AS trust_retour FROM trust AS t JOIN trust AS retour ON retour.source_u_id = t.target_u_id AND retour.target_u_id = t.source_u_id WHERE t.source_u_id < t.target_u_id ORDER BY t.source_u_id, t.target_u_id;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs n’ont encore publié aucun avis ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name FROM useracct AS u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review AS r WHERE r.u_id = u.u_id) ORDER BY u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quel article possède le plus grand nombre d’avis ?","sql":"SELECT i.i_id, i.title, COUNT(r.a_id) AS nombre_avis FROM item AS i JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id GROUP BY i.i_id, i.title HAVING COUNT(r.a_id) = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM review GROUP BY i_id)) ORDER BY i.i_id;"},{"question":"Quels avis ont un rang renseigné et inférieur ou égal à 10 ?","sql":"SELECT a_id, u_id, i_id, rank FROM review WHERE rank IS NOT NULL AND rank <= 10 ORDER BY rank, a_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque utilisateur ayant publié au moins un avis, quelle est sa note moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, AVG(r.rating) AS note_moyenne FROM useracct AS u JOIN review AS r ON r.u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont fait confiance à au moins trois personnes différentes ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.target_u_id) AS cibles_distinctes FROM useracct AS u JOIN trust AS t ON t.source_u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.target_u_id) >= 3 ORDER BY cibles_distinctes DESC;"},{"question":"Quels articles n’ont reçu aucun avis ?","sql":"SELECT i.i_id, i.title FROM item AS i LEFT JOIN review AS r ON r.i_id = i.i_id WHERE r.a_id IS NULL ORDER BY i.i_id;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les notes disponibles et le nombre d’avis correspondant à chacune ?","sql":"SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS nombre_avis FROM review WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont à la fois écrit un avis et reçu au moins une relation de confiance ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name FROM useracct AS u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review AS r WHERE r.u_id = u.u_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trust AS t WHERE t.target_u_id = u.u_id) ORDER BY u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le titre de l’article associé à l’avis identifié par 100, s’il existe ?","sql":"SELECT i.title FROM review AS r JOIN item AS i ON i.i_id = r.i_id WHERE r.a_id = 100;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont donné une note inférieure à la note moyenne de l’ensemble des avis ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT u.u_id, u.name FROM useracct AS u JOIN review AS r ON r.u_id = u.u_id WHERE r.rating < (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM review WHERE rating IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY u.u_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque utilisateur, combien de personnes lui font confiance ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(t.source_u_id) AS nombre_de_soutiens FROM useracct AS u LEFT JOIN trust AS t ON t.target_u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name ORDER BY nombre_de_soutiens DESC, u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quels avis concernent des articles dont le titre contient le mot « guide » ?","sql":"SELECT r.a_id, r.u_id, i.title, r.rating FROM review AS r JOIN item AS i ON i.i_id = r.i_id WHERE i.title LIKE '%guide%' ORDER BY r.a_id;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont évalué plus d’articles distincts qu’ils n’ont reçu de relations de confiance ?","sql":"SELECT u.u_id, u.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.i_id) AS articles_evalues, COUNT(DISTINCT t.source_u_id) AS soutiens_recus FROM useracct AS u LEFT JOIN review AS r ON r.u_id = u.u_id LEFT JOIN trust AS t ON t.target_u_id = u.u_id GROUP BY u.u_id, u.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.i_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT t.source_u_id) ORDER BY u.u_id;"},{"question":"Quels sont les avis les plus récents selon l’identifiant d’avis pour chaque utilisateur ?","sql":"SELECT r.a_id, r.u_id, r.i_id, r.rating, r.rank FROM review AS r WHERE r.a_id = (SELECT MAX(r2.a_id) FROM review AS r2 WHERE r2.u_id = r.u_id) ORDER BY r.u_id;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les villes classées par population décroissante ?","sql":"SELECT \"City_ID\", \"Official_Name\", \"Population\" FROM \"city\" ORDER BY \"Population\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont une superficie supérieure à la superficie moyenne de toutes les villes ?","sql":"SELECT \"Official_Name\", \"Area_km_2\" FROM \"city\" WHERE \"Area_km_2\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Area_km_2\") FROM \"city\") ORDER BY \"Area_km_2\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de villes compte chaque statut ?","sql":"SELECT \"Status\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_villes\" FROM \"city\" GROUP BY \"Status\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_villes\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la ville la plus peuplée ?","sql":"SELECT \"Official_Name\", \"Population\" FROM \"city\" WHERE \"Population\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Population\") FROM \"city\");"},{"question":"Quels élevages possèdent plus de chevaux de travail que de bœufs ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", \"Working_Horses\", \"Oxen\" FROM \"farm\" WHERE \"Working_Horses\" > \"Oxen\" ORDER BY \"Farm_ID\";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de bovins par année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", AVG(\"Total_Cattle\") AS \"Moyenne_bovins\" FROM \"farm\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque élevage, quelle proportion des chevaux sont des chevaux de travail ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", \"Year\", \"Working_Horses\" / NULLIF(\"Total_Horses\", 0) AS \"Proportion_chevaux_travail\" FROM \"farm\" ORDER BY \"Farm_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels élevages ont davantage de bœufs que de taureaux ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", \"Oxen\", \"Bulls\" FROM \"farm\" WHERE \"Oxen\" > \"Bulls\";"},{"question":"Quelles compétitions indiquent le nom de leur ville hôte ?","sql":"SELECT fc.\"Competition_ID\", fc.\"Year\", fc.\"Theme\", c.\"Official_Name\" AS \"Ville_hôte\" FROM \"farm_competition\" AS fc JOIN \"city\" AS c ON c.\"City_ID\" = fc.\"Host_city_ID\" ORDER BY fc.\"Year\";"},{"question":"Combien de compétitions ont été accueillies par chaque ville, y compris celles qui n'en ont accueilli aucune ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"City_ID\", c.\"Official_Name\", COUNT(fc.\"Competition_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_competitions\" FROM \"city\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"farm_competition\" AS fc ON fc.\"Host_city_ID\" = c.\"City_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"City_ID\", c.\"Official_Name\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_competitions\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels élevages ont obtenu le rang 1 dans une compétition ?","sql":"SELECT \"Competition_ID\", \"Farm_ID\", \"Rank\" FROM \"competition_record\" WHERE \"Rank\" = 1 ORDER BY \"Competition_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels élevages ont participé à des compétitions ayant pour thème « agriculture » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.\"Farm_ID\", fc.\"Competition_ID\", fc.\"Theme\" FROM \"farm\" AS f JOIN \"competition_record\" AS cr ON cr.\"Farm_ID\" = f.\"Farm_ID\" JOIN \"farm_competition\" AS fc ON fc.\"Competition_ID\" = cr.\"Competition_ID\" WHERE LOWER(fc.\"Theme\") LIKE '%agriculture%' ORDER BY f.\"Farm_ID\";"},{"question":"Quel est le meilleur rang obtenu dans chaque compétition ?","sql":"SELECT \"Competition_ID\", MIN(\"Rank\") AS \"Meilleur_rang\" FROM \"competition_record\" GROUP BY \"Competition_ID\" ORDER BY \"Competition_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelles villes n'ont accueilli aucune compétition ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"City_ID\", c.\"Official_Name\" FROM \"city\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"farm_competition\" AS fc ON fc.\"Host_city_ID\" = c.\"City_ID\" WHERE fc.\"Competition_ID\" IS NULL ORDER BY c.\"Official_Name\";"},{"question":"Combien d'élevages sont recensés et quel est leur cheptel bovin total par année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_d_elevages\", SUM(\"Total_Cattle\") AS \"Bovins_total\" FROM \"farm\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels élevages ont plus de chevaux que de bovins ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", \"Total_Horses\", \"Total_Cattle\" FROM \"farm\" WHERE \"Total_Horses\" > \"Total_Cattle\" ORDER BY \"Total_Horses\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de participants figurent dans chaque compétition ?","sql":"SELECT fc.\"Competition_ID\", fc.\"Year\", fc.\"Theme\", COUNT(cr.\"Farm_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_participants\" FROM \"farm_competition\" AS fc LEFT JOIN \"competition_record\" AS cr ON cr.\"Competition_ID\" = fc.\"Competition_ID\" GROUP BY fc.\"Competition_ID\", fc.\"Year\", fc.\"Theme\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_participants\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque ville, quelle est la population et combien de compétitions y ont été organisées ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Official_Name\", c.\"Population\", COUNT(fc.\"Competition_ID\") AS \"Competitions_accueillies\" FROM \"city\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"farm_competition\" AS fc ON fc.\"Host_city_ID\" = c.\"City_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"City_ID\", c.\"Official_Name\", c.\"Population\" ORDER BY c.\"Population\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois élevages ayant le plus grand nombre total de moutons et chèvres ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", \"Sheep_and_Goats\" FROM \"farm\" ORDER BY \"Sheep_and_Goats\" DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel est le rang moyen des participants pour chaque compétition ?","sql":"SELECT \"Competition_ID\", AVG(\"Rank\") AS \"Rang_moyen\" FROM \"competition_record\" GROUP BY \"Competition_ID\" ORDER BY \"Rang_moyen\";"},{"question":"Quelle année présente le plus grand cheptel bovin cumulé ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", SUM(\"Total_Cattle\") AS \"Bovins_cumules\" FROM \"farm\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Bovins_cumules\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque élevage, quelle part du cheptel bovin est constituée de vaches ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", \"Cows\" / NULLIF(\"Total_Cattle\", 0) AS \"Part_de_vaches\" FROM \"farm\" ORDER BY \"Farm_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelles compétitions ont été accueillies dans une ville dont le statut est « capitale » ?","sql":"SELECT fc.\"Competition_ID\", fc.\"Year\", fc.\"Theme\", c.\"Official_Name\" FROM \"farm_competition\" AS fc JOIN \"city\" AS c ON c.\"City_ID\" = fc.\"Host_city_ID\" WHERE LOWER(c.\"Status\") = 'capitale' ORDER BY fc.\"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels élevages ont participé à une compétition organisée avant 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.\"Farm_ID\", f.\"Year\" FROM \"farm\" AS f JOIN \"competition_record\" AS cr ON cr.\"Farm_ID\" = f.\"Farm_ID\" JOIN \"farm_competition\" AS fc ON fc.\"Competition_ID\" = cr.\"Competition_ID\" WHERE fc.\"Year\" < 2000 ORDER BY f.\"Farm_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels élevages possèdent le plus de moutons et de chèvres, en affichant les cinq premiers ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", \"Year\", \"Sheep_and_Goats\" FROM \"farm\" ORDER BY \"Sheep_and_Goats\" DESC, \"Farm_ID\" LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Pour chaque statut de ville, quelle est la superficie moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Status\", AVG(\"Area_km_2\") AS \"Superficie_moyenne\" FROM \"city\" GROUP BY \"Status\" ORDER BY \"Superficie_moyenne\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles compétitions n'ont aucun résultat enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT fc.\"Competition_ID\", fc.\"Year\", fc.\"Theme\" FROM \"farm_competition\" AS fc LEFT JOIN \"competition_record\" AS cr ON cr.\"Competition_ID\" = fc.\"Competition_ID\" WHERE cr.\"Farm_ID\" IS NULL ORDER BY fc.\"Year\";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d'animaux recensés dans chaque élevage, toutes espèces confondues ?","sql":"SELECT \"Farm_ID\", COALESCE(\"Total_Horses\", 0) + COALESCE(\"Total_Cattle\", 0) + COALESCE(\"Pigs\", 0) + COALESCE(\"Sheep_and_Goats\", 0) AS \"Total_animaux\" FROM \"farm\" ORDER BY \"Total_animaux\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles villes plus peuplées que la moyenne ont accueilli au moins une compétition, et combien ?","sql":"WITH \"Population_moyenne\" AS (SELECT AVG(\"Population\") AS \"Valeur\" FROM \"city\") SELECT c.\"Official_Name\", c.\"Population\", COUNT(fc.\"Competition_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_competitions\" FROM \"city\" AS c JOIN \"Population_moyenne\" AS pm ON c.\"Population\" > pm.\"Valeur\" JOIN \"farm_competition\" AS fc ON fc.\"Host_city_ID\" = c.\"City_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"City_ID\", c.\"Official_Name\", c.\"Population\" ORDER BY c.\"Population\" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les titres, réalisateurs et studios des films classés par recettes décroissantes ?","sql":"SELECT "Title", "Director", "Studio", "Gross_in_dollar"
FROM "film"
ORDER BY "Gross_in_dollar" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont des recettes supérieures à la moyenne de tous les films ?","sql":"SELECT "Title", "Gross_in_dollar"
FROM "film"
WHERE "Gross_in_dollar" > (SELECT AVG("Gross_in_dollar") FROM "film");"},{"question":"Quelles sont les informations sur les marchés comptant plus de 100 villes ?","sql":"SELECT "Market_ID", "Country", "Number_cities"
FROM "market"
WHERE "Number_cities" > 100
ORDER BY "Number_cities" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films possèdent une estimation de marché en 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f."Title"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
WHERE e."Year" = 2020;"},{"question":"Pour chaque estimation, quelle est la différence entre l'estimation haute et l'estimation basse ?","sql":"SELECT "Estimation_ID", "Film_ID", "High_Estimate" - "Low_Estimate" AS "Difference"
FROM "film_market_estimation"
ORDER BY "Difference" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'estimations sont associées à chaque marché ?","sql":"SELECT m."Market_ID", m."Country", COUNT(e."Estimation_ID") AS "Nombre_estimations"
FROM "market" AS m
LEFT JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
GROUP BY m."Market_ID", m."Country"
ORDER BY "Nombre_estimations" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films n'ont aucune estimation de marché ?","sql":"SELECT f."Film_ID", f."Title"
FROM "film" AS f
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "film_market_estimation" AS e
    WHERE e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quel est le film ayant réalisé les recettes les plus élevées ?","sql":"SELECT "Film_ID", "Title", "Gross_in_dollar"
FROM "film"
WHERE "Gross_in_dollar" = (SELECT MAX("Gross_in_dollar") FROM "film");"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq films les plus rentables selon leurs recettes ?","sql":"SELECT "Title", "Gross_in_dollar"
FROM "film"
ORDER BY "Gross_in_dollar" DESC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Pour chaque studio, combien de films sont enregistrés et quelles sont leurs recettes moyennes ?","sql":"SELECT "Studio", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_films", AVG("Gross_in_dollar") AS "Recettes_moyennes"
FROM "film"
GROUP BY "Studio"
ORDER BY "Recettes_moyennes" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels marchés comptent davantage de villes que la moyenne des marchés ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", "Number_cities"
FROM "market"
WHERE "Number_cities" > (SELECT AVG("Number_cities") FROM "market")
ORDER BY "Number_cities" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les années couvertes par les estimations, avec la première et la dernière année ?","sql":"SELECT MIN("Year") AS "Premiere_annee", MAX("Year") AS "Derniere_annee", COUNT(DISTINCT "Year") AS "Nombre_annees"
FROM "film_market_estimation";"},{"question":"Quelles estimations ont une fourchette d'au moins 1 000 000 dollars ?","sql":"SELECT "Estimation_ID", "Film_ID", "Low_Estimate", "High_Estimate"
FROM "film_market_estimation"
WHERE "High_Estimate" - "Low_Estimate" >= 1000000
ORDER BY "High_Estimate" - "Low_Estimate" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels réalisateurs ont réalisé au moins deux films ?","sql":"SELECT "Director", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_films"
FROM "film"
GROUP BY "Director"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_films" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films sont estimés sur le marché de chaque pays, avec le nombre de villes correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title", m."Country", m."Number_cities", e."Type", e."Year"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
JOIN "market" AS m ON m."Market_ID" = e."Market_ID"
ORDER BY f."Title", m."Country";"},{"question":"Combien d'estimations chaque film possède-t-il, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title", COUNT(e."Estimation_ID") AS "Nombre_estimations"
FROM "film" AS f
LEFT JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
GROUP BY f."Film_ID", f."Title"
ORDER BY "Nombre_estimations" DESC, f."Title";"},{"question":"Quel est le total des recettes par studio ?","sql":"SELECT "Studio", SUM("Gross_in_dollar") AS "Total_recettes"
FROM "film"
GROUP BY "Studio"
ORDER BY "Total_recettes" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels marchés ont au moins dix estimations ?","sql":"SELECT m."Country", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_estimations"
FROM "market" AS m
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
GROUP BY m."Market_ID", m."Country"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY "Nombre_estimations" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque année, quelle est l'estimation haute maximale ?","sql":"SELECT "Year", MAX("High_Estimate") AS "Estimation_haute_maximale"
FROM "film_market_estimation"
GROUP BY "Year"
ORDER BY "Year";"},{"question":"Quels films ont des recettes comprises entre 50 et 100 millions de dollars ?","sql":"SELECT "Title", "Gross_in_dollar"
FROM "film"
WHERE "Gross_in_dollar" BETWEEN 50000000 AND 100000000
ORDER BY "Gross_in_dollar" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels marchés ne disposent d'aucune estimation ?","sql":"SELECT m."Market_ID", m."Country"
FROM "market" AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "film_market_estimation" AS e
    WHERE e."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels types d'estimation distincts sont utilisés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT "Type"
FROM "film_market_estimation"
ORDER BY "Type";"},{"question":"Quels films ont une estimation sur un marché situé en France ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f."Title", e."Type", e."Year"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
JOIN "market" AS m ON m."Market_ID" = e."Market_ID"
WHERE m."Country" = 'France'
ORDER BY f."Title";"},{"question":"Quelle est l'estimation basse moyenne pour chaque type d'estimation ?","sql":"SELECT "Type", AVG("Low_Estimate") AS "Estimation_basse_moyenne"
FROM "film_market_estimation"
GROUP BY "Type"
ORDER BY "Estimation_basse_moyenne" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont des recettes supérieures à la moyenne de leur studio ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title", f."Studio", f."Gross_in_dollar"
FROM "film" AS f
WHERE f."Gross_in_dollar" > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Gross_in_dollar")
    FROM "film" AS f2
    WHERE f2."Studio" = f."Studio"
)
ORDER BY f."Studio", f."Gross_in_dollar" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles estimations basses sont supérieures aux recettes du film correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title", e."Low_Estimate", f."Gross_in_dollar"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
WHERE e."Low_Estimate" > f."Gross_in_dollar"
ORDER BY e."Low_Estimate" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le classement des marchés selon leur nombre de villes ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", "Number_cities", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Number_cities" DESC) AS "Classement"
FROM "market"
ORDER BY "Classement", "Country";"},{"question":"Combien d'estimations ont été enregistrées pour chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT "Year", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_estimations"
FROM "film_market_estimation"
GROUP BY "Year"
ORDER BY "Year";"},{"question":"Pour chaque film, quelle est la plus haute estimation haute disponible ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title", MAX(e."High_Estimate") AS "Estimation_haute_maximale"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
GROUP BY f."Film_ID", f."Title"
ORDER BY "Estimation_haute_maximale" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel réalisateur a généré le plus de recettes cumulées ?","sql":"SELECT "Director", SUM("Gross_in_dollar") AS "Recettes_cumulees"
FROM "film"
GROUP BY "Director"
ORDER BY "Recettes_cumulees" DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque pays, combien de films différents ont-ils une estimation ?","sql":"SELECT m."Country", COUNT(DISTINCT e."Film_ID") AS "Nombre_films"
FROM "market" AS m
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
GROUP BY m."Market_ID", m."Country"
ORDER BY "Nombre_films" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels films ont plus d'une estimation de marché ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title", COUNT(e."Estimation_ID") AS "Nombre_estimations"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
GROUP BY f."Film_ID", f."Title"
HAVING COUNT(e."Estimation_ID") > 1
ORDER BY "Nombre_estimations" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel pays possède le plus grand nombre de villes ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", "Number_cities"
FROM "market"
WHERE "Number_cities" = (SELECT MAX("Number_cities") FROM "market");"},{"question":"Quels films ont uniquement des estimations de type « International » ?","sql":"SELECT f."Title"
FROM "film" AS f
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "film_market_estimation" AS e
    WHERE e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "film_market_estimation" AS e
    WHERE e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
      AND e."Type" <> 'International'
);"},{"question":"Quelle est, pour chaque année, la moyenne des estimations hautes et le nombre de films concernés ?","sql":"SELECT e."Year", AVG(e."High_Estimate") AS "Moyenne_estimation_haute", COUNT(DISTINCT e."Film_ID") AS "Nombre_films"
FROM "film_market_estimation" AS e
GROUP BY e."Year"
ORDER BY e."Year";"},{"question":"Quels films ont au moins une estimation dans un marché de plus de 500 villes ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f."Title"
FROM "film" AS f
JOIN "film_market_estimation" AS e ON e."Film_ID" = f."Film_ID"
JOIN "market" AS m ON m."Market_ID" = e."Market_ID"
WHERE m."Number_cities" > 500
ORDER BY f."Title";"}]}

pourcentage_codeshare DESC, a.name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien d’aéroports sont situés en France ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_aeroports
FROM "airport"
WHERE "Country" = 'France';"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms, villes et codes IATA des aéroports des États-Unis ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "City", "IATA"
FROM "airport"
WHERE "Country" = 'United States'
ORDER BY "City", "name";"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies ont été constituées en Allemagne ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Type", "Principal_activities"
FROM "operate_company"
WHERE "Incorporated_in" = 'Germany'
ORDER BY "name";"},{"question":"Quels vols ont une altitude supérieure à l’altitude moyenne de tous les vols ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "Vehicle_Flight_number", "Altitude"
FROM "flight"
WHERE "Altitude" > (SELECT AVG("Altitude") FROM "flight")
ORDER BY "Altitude" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de vols sont associés à chaque compagnie, y compris celles qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT oc."name" AS compagnie, COUNT(f."id") AS nombre_de_vols
FROM "operate_company" AS oc
LEFT JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."company_id" = oc."id"
GROUP BY oc."id", oc."name"
ORDER BY nombre_de_vols DESC, compagnie;"},{"question":"Quel aéroport possède le plus grand nombre de vols enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT a."name", a."City", COUNT(f."id") AS nombre_de_vols
FROM "airport" AS a
JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."airport_id" = a."id"
GROUP BY a."id", a."name", a."City"
ORDER BY nombre_de_vols DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque compagnie, combien de pilotes distincts sont associés à ses vols ?","sql":"SELECT oc."name" AS compagnie, COUNT(DISTINCT f."Pilot") AS nombre_de_pilotes
FROM "operate_company" AS oc
LEFT JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."company_id" = oc."id"
GROUP BY oc."id", oc."name"
ORDER BY nombre_de_pilotes DESC, compagnie;"},{"question":"Quels vols partent d’un aéroport situé au Canada, avec le nom de la compagnie qui les exploite ?","sql":"SELECT f."Vehicle_Flight_number" AS numero_de_vol, a."name" AS aeroport, oc."name" AS compagnie
FROM "flight" AS f
JOIN "airport" AS a ON a."id" = f."airport_id"
JOIN "operate_company" AS oc ON oc."id" = f."company_id"
WHERE a."Country" = 'Canada'
ORDER BY f."Vehicle_Flight_number";"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies ont une participation au capital supérieure à la moyenne de toutes les compagnies ?","sql":"SELECT "name", "Group_Equity_Shareholding"
FROM "operate_company"
WHERE "Group_Equity_Shareholding" > (
    SELECT AVG("Group_Equity_Shareholding")
    FROM "operate_company"
)
ORDER BY "Group_Equity_Shareholding" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels aéroports n’ont aucun vol associé ?","sql":"SELECT a."id", a."name", a."City", a."IATA"
FROM "airport" AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "flight" AS f
    WHERE f."airport_id" = a."id"
)
ORDER BY a."City", a."name";"},{"question":"Pour quelles compagnies la vitesse moyenne des vols dépasse-t-elle 500 km/h ?","sql":"SELECT oc."name" AS compagnie, AVG(f."Velocity") AS vitesse_moyenne
FROM "operate_company" AS oc
JOIN "flight" AS f ON f."company_id" = oc."id"
GROUP BY oc."id", oc."name"
HAVING AVG(f."Velocity") > 500
ORDER BY vitesse_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq vols les plus rapides, avec leur altitude et leur compagnie ?","sql":"SELECT f."Vehicle_Flight_number" AS numero_de_vol, f."Velocity", f."Altitude", oc."name" AS compagnie
FROM "flight" AS f
LEFT JOIN "operate_company" AS oc ON oc."id" = f."company_id"
ORDER BY f."Velocity" DESC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Combien d’aéroports y a-t-il dans chaque pays, et quels pays en comptent au moins deux ?","sql":"SELECT "Country" AS pays, COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_aeroports
FROM "airport"
GROUP BY "Country"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_d_aeroports DESC, pays;"},{"question":"Quels vols n’ont pas de pilote renseigné ou n’ont pas de vitesse indiquée ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "Vehicle_Flight_number", "Pilot", "Velocity"
FROM "flight"
WHERE "Pilot" IS NULL OR "Velocity" IS NULL
ORDER BY "id";"}]}

course associée ?","sql":"SELECT c.name, c.country FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.raceId IS NULL ORDER BY c.name;"},{"question":"Quels pilotes n'apparaissent un numéro renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT forename, surname, code, number FROM drivers WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY surname, forename;"},{"question":"Combien de résultats chaque courses ont eu lieu sur un circuit situé en Australie ?","sql":"SELECT r.name, r.date, c.name AS circuit FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Australia' ORDER constructeurs ont une moyenne de points par résultat supérieure à 5 ?","sql":"SELECT c.name, AVG(cr.points) AS moyenne_points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = une course ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE r.grid > 0 AND r.positionOrder < r.grid ORDER BY d.surname, par pays ?","sql":"SELECT country, MAX(lng) - MIN(lng) AS ecart_longitude FROM circuits WHERE lng IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY ecart_longitude DESC;"},{"question":"Quels pilotes ont eu au moins trois arrêts dans une même course ?","sql":"SELECT d.forename, d.surname, p.raceId, COUNT(*) AS nombre_arrets FROM pitStops p JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = p.driverId GROUP BY p.raceId, meilleur tour de leur course selon la colonne rank ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname, r.name AS course FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = res.driverId JOIN races r ON de famille qu'au moins un autre pilote ?","sql":"SELECT surname, COUNT(*) AS nombre_pilotes FROM drivers GROUP BY surname HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_pilotes DESC, surname;"},{"question":"Quelle est la somme des points des pilotes par nationalité ?","sql":"SELECT d.nationality, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId GROUP BY d.nationality ORDER BY total_points DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles courses ont un vainqueur dont le constructeur est Ferrari ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT ra.name, ra.year, d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId WHERE r.positionOrder = 1 AND c.name = d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 IS NULL ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename;"},{"question":"Pour chaque année, combien de constructeurs distincts ont participé aux courses ?","sql":"SELECT ra.year, COUNT(DISTINCT r.constructorId) AS nombre_constructeurs FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY ra.year ORDER BY ra.year;"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont une longitude négative et une latitude positive ?","sql":"SELECT name, location, country, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE lng < 0 AND lat > 0 ORDER BY country, name;"},{"question":"Quels pilotes ont obtenu leur meilleur classement de championnat à la position 1 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname FROM driverStandings ds JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = ds.driverId WHERE ds.position = 1 ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename;"}]}
