SportsInfo AS si ON si.StuID = s.StuID WHERE si.OnScholarship = 'Y';"},{"question":"Quels sports sont pratiqués par des étudiants boursiers ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT SportName FROM SportsInfo WHERE OnScholarship = 'Y' ORDER BY SportName;"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne d'heures de sport par semaine des étudiants boursiers ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(HoursPerWeek) AS moyenne_heures_par_semaine FROM SportsInfo WHERE OnScholarship = 'Y';"},{"question":"Quels jeux appartiennent à chaque type de jeu, avec le nom du type ?","sql":"SELECT GType, GName FROM Video_Games ORDER BY GType, GName;"},{"question":"Combien de jeux existe-t-il pour chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT GType, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_jeux FROM Video_Games GROUP BY GType;"},{"question":"Quel type de jeu contient le plus de jeux vidéo ?","sql":"SELECT GType, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_jeux FROM Video_Games GROUP BY GType ORDER BY nombre_de_jeux DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants jouent au jeu nommé « Chess » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Video_Games AS v ON v.GameID = p.GameID WHERE v.GName = 'Chess';"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant, quel est le nombre de jeux vidéo distincts auxquels il joue ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, COUNT(DISTINCT p.GameID) AS nombre_de_jeux FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants jouent à au moins deux jeux vidéo différents ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, COUNT(DISTINCT p.GameID) AS nombre_de_jeux FROM Student AS s JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.GameID) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'heures jouées par enregistrement ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(Hours_Played) AS moyenne_heures_jouees FROM Plays_Games;"},{"question":"Quelle est la plus grande durée de jeu enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(Hours_Played) AS maximum_heures_jouees FROM Plays_Games;"},{"question":"Quels enregistrements indiquent exactement cinq heures de jeu ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, GameID, Hours_Played FROM Plays_Games WHERE Hours_Played = 5;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants jouent au moins une heure à un jeu de type « Strategy » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Video_Games AS v ON v.GameID = p.GameID WHERE v.GType = 'Strategy' AND p.Hours_Played >= 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le total d'heures de sport déclaré par étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, SUM(si.HoursPerWeek) AS total_heures_sport FROM Student AS s JOIN SportsInfo AS si ON si.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants pratiquent plusieurs sports ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, COUNT(DISTINCT si.SportName) AS nombre_de_sports FROM Student AS s JOIN SportsInfo AS si ON si.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.SportName) > 1;"},{"question":"Quel sport compte le plus grand nombre total de parties jouées ?","sql":"SELECT SportName, SUM(GamesPlayed) AS total_parties FROM SportsInfo GROUP BY SportName ORDER BY total_parties DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont joué davantage d'heures de jeux vidéo que leur nombre d'heures de sport hebdomadaire ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID JOIN SportsInfo AS si ON si.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING SUM(p.Hours_Played) > SUM(si.HoursPerWeek);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un âge supérieur à l'âge moyen ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, Age FROM Student WHERE Age > (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM Student);"},{"question":"Quels jeux ont une durée totale de jeu supérieure à la moyenne des durées totales par jeu ?","sql":"WITH totaux AS (SELECT GameID, SUM(Hours_Played) AS total_heures FROM Plays_Games GROUP BY GameID) SELECT v.GameID, v.GName, t.total_heures FROM totaux AS t JOIN Video_Games AS v ON v.GameID = t.GameID WHERE t.total_heures > (SELECT AVG(total_heures) FROM totaux);"},{"question":"Quel étudiant a joué le plus grand nombre total d'heures ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, SUM(p.Hours_Played) AS total_heures FROM Student AS s JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName ORDER BY total_heures DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels types de jeux ont une durée totale jouée supérieure à 30 heures ?","sql":"SELECT v.GType, SUM(p.Hours_Played) AS total_heures FROM Video_Games AS v JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.GameID = v.GameID GROUP BY v.GType HAVING SUM(p.Hours_Played) > 30;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant, indiquez s'il joue à des jeux vidéo ou non.","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, CASE WHEN COUNT(p.GameID) > 0 THEN 'Oui' ELSE 'Non' END AS joue_aux_jeux FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont une activité sportive mais aucune activité de jeu vidéo ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN SportsInfo AS si ON si.StuID = s.StuID LEFT JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID WHERE p.StuID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle est la répartition des étudiants par tranche d'âge : moins de 20 ans, de 20 à 24 ans, ou 25 ans et plus ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN Age < 20 THEN 'Moins de 20 ans' WHEN Age BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '20-24 ans' ELSE '25 ans ou plus' END AS tranche_age, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY tranche_age ORDER BY tranche_age;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont consacré exactement autant d'heures à chaque jeu qu'ils pratiquent ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING MIN(p.Hours_Played) = MAX(p.Hours_Played);"},{"question":"Quels jeux sont pratiqués par des étudiants de moins de 20 ans ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT v.GameID, v.GName FROM Video_Games AS v JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.GameID = v.GameID JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = p.StuID WHERE s.Age < 20;"},{"question":"Pour chaque ville, quel est l'âge moyen de ses étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT city_code, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY city_code;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont un âge moyen supérieur à l'âge moyen global ?","sql":"SELECT city_code, AVG(Age) AS age_moyen FROM Student GROUP BY city_code HAVING AVG(Age) > (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM Student);"},{"question":"Quels étudiants pratiquent un sport et jouent au moins 15 heures au total ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, SUM(p.Hours_Played) AS total_heures_jeu FROM Student AS s JOIN SportsInfo AS si ON si.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName HAVING SUM(p.Hours_Played) >= 15;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'étudiants par code de ville et par sexe ?","sql":"SELECT city_code, Sex, COUNT(*) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student GROUP BY city_code, Sex ORDER BY city_code, Sex;"},{"question":"Quels jeux ont été joués par le plus grand nombre d'étudiants distincts ?","sql":"SELECT v.GameID, v.GName, COUNT(DISTINCT p.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Video_Games AS v JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.GameID = v.GameID GROUP BY v.GameID, v.GName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.StuID) = (SELECT MAX(nombre) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) AS nombre FROM Plays_Games GROUP BY GameID));"},{"question":"Quels étudiants jouent à tous les jeux de type « Puzzle » présents dans le catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Video_Games AS v WHERE v.GType = 'Puzzle' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Plays_Games AS p WHERE p.StuID = s.StuID AND p.GameID = v.GameID));"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de sports différents pratiqués par les étudiants de chaque sexe ?","sql":"SELECT s.Sex, COUNT(DISTINCT si.SportName) AS nombre_de_sports FROM Student AS s JOIN SportsInfo AS si ON si.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.Sex;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont le même code de ville qu'au moins un autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, city_code FROM Student WHERE city_code IN (SELECT city_code FROM Student GROUP BY city_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY city_code, LName;"},{"question":"Quels jeux n'ont été joués que par un seul étudiant distinct ?","sql":"SELECT v.GameID, v.GName FROM Video_Games AS v JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.GameID = v.GameID GROUP BY v.GameID, v.GName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.StuID) = 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le total de parties jouées pour les sports dont la moyenne hebdomadaire dépasse quatre heures ?","sql":"SELECT SportName, SUM(GamesPlayed) AS total_parties FROM SportsInfo GROUP BY SportName HAVING AVG(HoursPerWeek) > 4;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont joué à leur jeu préféré pendant la durée maximale enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName, v.GName, p.Hours_Played FROM Student AS s JOIN Plays_Games AS p ON p.StuID = s.StuID JOIN Video_Games AS v ON v.GameID = p.GameID WHERE p.Hours_Played = (SELECT MAX(Hours_Played) FROM Plays_Games);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de lignes dans chacune des tables principales, présenté par requête ?","sql":"SELECT 'Student' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM Student UNION ALL SELECT 'SportsInfo', COUNT(*) FROM SportsInfo UNION ALL SELECT 'Plays_Games', COUNT(*) FROM Plays_Games UNION ALL SELECT 'Video_Games', COUNT(*) FROM Video_Games;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels matchs ont été disputés pendant la saison 2020, classés par date croissante ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "Date", "Home_team", "Away_team", "Score"
FROM "game"
WHERE "Season" = 2020
ORDER BY "Date" ASC;"},{"question":"Quels stades ont une affluence moyenne supérieure à l'affluence moyenne de l'ensemble des stades ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "name", "Average_Attendance"
FROM "stadium"
WHERE "Average_Attendance" > (
    SELECT AVG("Average_Attendance")
    FROM "stadium"
)
ORDER BY "Average_Attendance" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque blessure, quels sont le joueur concerné, le match, les équipes et la compétition ?","sql":"SELECT ia."Player", ia."Injury", g."Date", g."Home_team", g."Away_team", g."Competition"
FROM "injury_accident" AS ia
JOIN "game" AS g ON g."id" = ia."game_id"
ORDER BY g."Date", ia."Player";"},{"question":"Combien de blessures ont été enregistrées pour chaque saison ?","sql":"SELECT g."Season", COUNT(ia."id") AS "nombre_de_blessures"
FROM "game" AS g
LEFT JOIN "injury_accident" AS ia ON ia."game_id" = g."id"
GROUP BY g."Season"
ORDER BY g."Season";"},{"question":"Quel est le stade ayant le plus fort pourcentage de capacité utilisé ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "name", "Capacity_Percentage"
FROM "stadium"
WHERE "Capacity_Percentage" = (
    SELECT MAX("Capacity_Percentage")
    FROM "stadium"
);"},{"question":"Quelles compétitions distinctes sont présentes dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT "Competition"
FROM "game"
WHERE "Competition" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Competition";"},{"question":"Quels matchs ont opposé deux équipes dont le nom contient « United » ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "Date", "Home_team", "Away_team", "Score"
FROM "game"
WHERE "Home_team" LIKE '%United%'
  AND "Away_team" LIKE '%United%'
ORDER BY "Date";"},{"question":"Quelles blessures correspondent au plus grand nombre de matchs d'absence indiqué ?","sql":"SELECT "Player", "Injury", "Number_of_matches", "Source"
FROM "injury_accident"
WHERE CAST("Number_of_matches" AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST("Number_of_matches" AS INTEGER))
    FROM "injury_accident"
    WHERE "Number_of_matches" IS NOT NULL
);"},{"question":"Pour chaque stade, quel est le nombre moyen de spectateurs par match à domicile selon les totaux fournis ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "name", "Total_Attendance", "Home_Games",
       "Total_Attendance" / NULLIF("Home_Games", 0) AS "spectateurs_moyens_par_match"
FROM "stadium"
WHERE "Home_Games" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "spectateurs_moyens_par_match" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels matchs ne possèdent aucune blessure enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT g."id", g."Date", g."Home_team", g."Away_team"
FROM "game" AS g
LEFT JOIN "injury_accident" AS ia ON ia."game_id" = g."id"
WHERE ia."id" IS NULL
ORDER BY g."Date";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois stades ayant la plus forte affluence moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "name", "Average_Attendance"
FROM "stadium"
ORDER BY "Average_Attendance" DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Pour chaque saison, combien de matchs ont été joués et quel a été le nombre moyen de matchs d'absence associés aux blessures ?","sql":"SELECT g."Season",
       COUNT(DISTINCT g."id") AS "nombre_de_matchs",
       AVG(CAST(ia."Number_of_matches" AS INTEGER)) AS "absence_moyenne"
FROM "game" AS g
LEFT JOIN "injury_accident" AS ia ON ia."game_id" = g."id"
GROUP BY g."Season"
ORDER BY g."Season";"},{"question":"Quelles sources ont rapporté au moins cinq blessures, et combien chacune en a rapporté ?","sql":"SELECT "Source", COUNT(*) AS "nombre_de_blessures"
FROM "injury_accident"
GROUP BY "Source"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY "nombre_de_blessures" DESC, "Source";"},{"question":"Quels stades ont accueilli davantage de matchs à domicile que la moyenne de tous les stades ?","sql":"SELECT "id", "name", "Home_Games"
FROM "stadium"
WHERE "Home_Games" > (
    SELECT AVG("Home_Games")
    FROM "stadium"
)
ORDER BY "Home_Games" DESC;"}]}

  AND julianday(Date_Claim_Settled) - julianday(Date_Claim_Made) > 30;"},{"question":"Donnez, pour chaque client, le nombre de demandes et le total des montants réclamés.","sql":"SELECT cu.Customer_ID,

       COUNT(cl.Claim_ID) AS Nombre_de_demandes,
       COALESCE(SUM(cl.Amount_Claimed), 0) AS Total_reclame

WHERE Start_Date <= '2024-01-01'

FROM Claims c
WHERE Amount_Claimed = (

    WHERE c2.Policy_ID = c.Policy_ID
)

FROM Customer_Policies cp
JOIN Claims c ON c.Policy_ID = cp.Policy_ID
JOIN Settlements s ON s.Claim_ID = c.Claim_ID
GROUP BY cp.Policy_Type_Code
ORDER BY cp.Policy_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quels paiements dépassent 10 000 unités monétaires ?","sql":"SELECT Payment_ID, Settlement_ID, Date_Payment_Made, Amount_Payment
FROM Payments
WHERE Amount_Payment > 10000
ORDER BY Amount_Payment DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est l’écart entre le montant réclamé et le montant réglé pour chaque règlement ?","sql":"SELECT Settlement_ID, Claim_ID,
       Amount_Claimed,
       Amount_Settled,
       Amount_Claimed - Amount_Settled AS Ecart
FROM Settlements
ORDER BY Ecart DESC;"},{"question":"Quels contrats appartiennent aux clients dont le nom ou les détails contiennent « Martin » ?","sql":"SELECT cp.Policy_ID, cp.Customer_ID, cp.Policy_Type_Code
FROM Customer_Policies cp
JOIN Customers c ON c.Customer_ID = cp.Customer_ID
WHERE c.Customer_Details LIKE '%Martin%';"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de demandes déclarées chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', Date_Claim_Made) AS Annee,
       COUNT(*) AS Nombre_de_demandes
FROM Claims
WHERE Date_Claim_Made IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date_Claim_Made)
ORDER BY Annee;"},{"question":"Quels règlements n’ont donné lieu à aucun paiement ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID, s.Claim_ID, s.Amount_Settled
FROM Settlements s
LEFT JOIN Payments p ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID
WHERE p.Payment_ID IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des paiements réalisés en 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Amount_Payment), 0) AS Total_paye_2024
FROM Payments
WHERE Date_Payment_Made >= '2024-01-01'
  AND Date_Payment_Made < '2025-01-01';"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, affichez la date de début de son contrat le plus ancien.","sql":"SELECT Customer_ID, MIN(Start_Date) AS Premier_debut_de_contrat
FROM Customer_Policies
GROUP BY Customer_ID
ORDER BY Customer_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles demandes ont un montant réglé supérieur à 90 % du montant réclamé ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_ID, Policy_ID, Amount_Claimed, Amount_Settled

WHERE Amount_Claimed > 0
  AND Amount_Settled > Amount_Claimed * 0.9;"},{"question":"Quel type de contrat compte le plus de contrats ?","sql":"SELECT Policy_Type_Code, COUNT(*) AS Nombre_de_contrats
FROM Customer_Policies
GROUP BY Policy_Type_Code
ORDER BY Nombre_de_contrats DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels règlements ont plusieurs paiements associés ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID, s.Claim_ID, COUNT(p.Payment_ID) AS Nombre_de_paiements
FROM Settlements s
JOIN Payments p ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID
GROUP BY s.Settlement_ID, s.Claim_ID
HAVING COUNT(p.Payment_ID) > 1;"},{"question":"Listez les demandes avec le nom du client et le type de contrat correspondant.","sql":"SELECT c.Claim_ID,
       cu.Customer_Details,
       cp.Policy_Type_Code,
       c.Date_Claim_Made,
       c.Amount_Claimed
FROM Claims c
JOIN Customer_Policies cp ON cp.Policy_ID = c.Policy_ID
JOIN Customers cu ON cu.Customer_ID = cp.Customer_ID
ORDER BY c.Claim_ID;"},{"question":"Quel est le délai moyen de règlement en jours pour les règlements ayant deux dates connues ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(Date_Claim_Settled) - julianday(Date_Claim_Made)) AS Delai_moyen_en_jours
FROM Settlements

FROM Customer_Policies cp
LEFT JOIN Claims c ON c.Policy_ID = cp.Policy_ID

       SUM(Amount_Settled) AS Total_regle
FROM Settlements
WHERE Date_Claim_Settled IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', Date_Claim_Settled)
ORDER BY Annee;"},{"question":"Quelles demandes ont été entièrement réglées, c’est-à-dire avec un montant réglé égal au montant réclamé ?","sql":"SELECT Claim_ID, Policy_ID, Amount_Claimed, Amount_Settled
FROM Claims
WHERE Amount_Settled = Amount_Claimed;"},{"question":"Pour chaque règlement, quel est le total des paiements enregistrés et la différence avec le montant réglé ?","sql":"SELECT s.Settlement_ID,
       s.Claim_ID,
       s.Amount_Settled,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.Amount_Payment), 0) AS Total_paiements,
       s.Amount_Settled - COALESCE(SUM(p.Amount_Payment), 0) AS Difference
FROM Settlements s

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les éditeurs âgés de plus de 40 ans, classés du plus âgé au plus jeune ?","sql":"SELECT "Editor_ID", "Name", "Age"
FROM "editor"
WHERE "Age" > 40
ORDER BY "Age" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq journaux ayant réalisé les meilleures ventes ?","sql":"SELECT "Journal_ID", "Date", "Theme", "Sales"
FROM "journal"

LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Pour chaque participation, quel est le nom de l’éditeur, le thème du journal et le type de travail ?","sql":"SELECT e."Name", j."Theme", jc."Work_Type"
FROM "journal_committee" AS jc
JOIN "editor" AS e ON e."Editor_ID" = jc."Editor_ID"
JOIN "journal" AS j ON j."Journal_ID" = jc."Journal_ID"
ORDER BY e."Name", j."Theme";"},{"question":"Combien de journaux chaque éditeur a-t-il intégrés au comité, y compris ceux qui ne participent à aucun journal ?","sql":"SELECT e."Editor_ID", e."Name", COUNT(jc."Journal_ID") AS "Nombre_de_journaux"

GROUP BY e."Editor_ID", e."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_journaux" DESC, e."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des ventes pour chaque thème de journal ?","sql":"SELECT "Theme", AVG("Sales") AS "Ventes_moyennes"
FROM "journal"

JOIN "journal" AS j ON j."Journal_ID" = jc."Journal_ID"

GROUP BY j."Journal_ID", j."Theme"
HAVING COUNT(jc."Editor_ID") >= 2

GROUP BY "Work_Type"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_participations" DESC, "Work_Type";"},{"question":"Quels sont les éditeurs plus âgés que l’âge moyen de tous les éditeurs ?","sql":"SELECT "Editor_ID", "Name", "Age"

WHERE "Sales" > (SELECT AVG("Sales") FROM "journal")
ORDER BY "Sales" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels éditeurs ne figurent dans aucun comité de journal ?","sql":"SELECT e."Editor_ID", e."Name"

    FROM "journal_committee" AS jc
    WHERE jc."Editor_ID" = e."Editor_ID"

FROM "journal" AS j
LEFT JOIN "journal_committee" AS jc ON jc."Journal_ID" = j."Journal_ID"
GROUP BY j."Journal_ID", j."Theme", j."Sales"
ORDER BY j."Journal_ID";"},{"question":"Quels thèmes regroupent au moins deux journaux, et quel est le total de leurs ventes ?","sql":"SELECT "Theme", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_journaux", SUM("Sales") AS "Ventes_totales"

state;"},{"question":"Quelles agences possèdent au moins un client dont le score de crédit est inférieur à 500 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT b.branch_ID, b.bname FROM bank AS b JOIN customer AS c ON c.branch_ID = b.branch_ID WHERE c.credit_score < 500;"},{"question":"Pour chaque type de prêt, combien de clients distincts sont concernés ?","sql":"SELECT loan_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_ID) AS nombre_clients FROM loan GROUP BY loan_type;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un solde négatif ou nul ?","sql":"SELECT cust_ID, cust_name, acc_bal FROM customer WHERE acc_bal <= 0;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total et le nombre de prêts enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_prets, SUM(amount) AS montant_total FROM loan;"},{"question":"Quelles banques ont plus de clients calculés que la banque dont l'identifiant est 1 ?","sql":"SELECT b.branch_ID, b.bname, COUNT(c.cust_ID) AS nombre_clients FROM bank AS b LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.branch_ID = b.branch_ID GROUP BY b.branch_ID, b.bname HAVING COUNT(c.cust_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE branch_ID = 1);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont contracté plusieurs types de prêts différents ?","sql":"SELECT c.cust_ID, c.cust_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_type) AS nombre_types FROM customer AS c JOIN loan AS l ON l.cust_ID = c.cust_ID GROUP BY c.cust_ID, c.cust_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_type) > 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les adresses des propriétés, avec leur type et leurs autres informations ?","sql":"SELECT property_address, property_type_code, other_details
FROM Properties;"},{"question":"Combien de propriétés existe-t-il pour chaque type de propriété ?","sql":"SELECT property_type_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_proprietes
FROM Properties
GROUP BY property_type_code
ORDER BY nombre_proprietes DESC;"},{"question":"Quels résidents sont encore enregistrés dans leur logement aujourd’hui ?","sql":"SELECT resident_id, property_id, date_moved_in, date_moved_out
FROM Residents
WHERE date_moved_out >= date('now')
ORDER BY date_moved_out;"},{"question":"Quels services ont été demandés mais ne sont pas encore fournis ?","sql":"SELECT resident_id, service_id, date_requested, other_details
FROM Residents_Services
WHERE date_requested IS NOT NULL
  AND date_provided IS NULL
ORDER BY date_requested;"},{"question":"Pour chaque organisation, quels services propose-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT o.organization_id, o.organization_details, s.service_id, s.service_type_code, s.service_details
FROM Organizations AS o
JOIN Services AS s ON s.organization_id = o.organization_id
ORDER BY o.organization_id, s.service_id;"},{"question":"Combien d’événements sont associés à chaque client, y compris les clients sans événement ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_details, COUNT(e.Customer_Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Customer_Events AS e ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_details
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, c.customer_id;"},{"question":"Quels événements disposent d’une note correspondante et quel type de service y est indiqué ?","sql":"SELECT e.Customer_Event_ID, n.Customer_Event_Note_ID, n.service_type_code, n.resident_id, n.property_id
FROM Customer_Events AS e
JOIN Customer_Event_Notes AS n ON n.Customer_Event_ID = e.Customer_Event_ID
ORDER BY e.Customer_Event_ID, n.Customer_Event_Note_ID;"},{"question":"Quelle est la dernière localisation connue de chaque objet ?","sql":"SELECT t.thing_id, t.Type_of_Thing_Code, l.Location_Code, l.Date_and_Time
FROM Things AS t
JOIN Timed_Locations_of_Things AS l ON l.thing_id = t.thing_id
WHERE l.Date_and_Time = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date_and_Time)
    FROM Timed_Locations_of_Things AS l2
    WHERE l2.thing_id = l.thing_id
)
ORDER BY t.thing_id;"},{"question":"Quels objets ont déjà possédé au moins deux statuts différents ?","sql":"SELECT thing_id, COUNT(DISTINCT Status_of_Thing_Code) AS nombre_statuts
FROM Timed_Status_of_Things
GROUP BY thing_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Status_of_Thing_Code) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_statuts DESC, thing_id;"},{"question":"Quels sont les organismes et, lorsqu’elle existe, leur organisation parente ?","sql":"SELECT o.organization_id, o.organization_details,
       p.organization_id AS parent_organization_id,
       p.organization_details AS parent_organization_details
FROM Organizations AS o
LEFT JOIN Organizations AS p
  ON p.organization_id = o.parent_organization_id
ORDER BY o.organization_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque propriété, combien de périodes de résidence sont enregistrées et quelle est la date d’entrée la plus ancienne ?","sql":"SELECT p.property_id, p.property_address,
       COUNT(r.resident_id) AS nombre_periodes_residence,
       MIN(r.date_moved_in) AS premiere_date_entree
FROM Properties AS p
LEFT JOIN Residents AS r ON r.property_id = p.property_id
GROUP BY p.property_id, p.property_address
ORDER BY p.property_id;"},{"question":"Quels services ont été fournis après leur date de demande, et combien de jours les séparent ?","sql":"SELECT resident_id, service_id, date_requested, date_provided,
       julianday(date_provided) - julianday(date_requested) AS delai_en_jours
FROM Residents_Services
WHERE date_requested IS NOT NULL
  AND date_provided IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(date_provided) > julianday(date_requested)
ORDER BY delai_en_jours DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les événements avec leur identifiant, leurs détails et le code du service associé ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details, s.Service_Type_Code
FROM Events AS e
JOIN Services AS s ON s.Service_ID = e.Service_ID
ORDER BY e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Combien d’événements sont associés à chaque service, y compris les services sans événement ?","sql":"SELECT s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code, COUNT(e.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Services AS s
LEFT JOIN Events AS e ON e.Service_ID = s.Service_ID
GROUP BY s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, s.Service_ID;"},{"question":"Quels participants ont pris part à au moins un événement, avec le nombre d’événements auxquels chacun a participé ?","sql":"SELECT p.Participant_ID, p.Participant_Type_Code, p.Participant_Details, COUNT(pe.Event_ID) AS nombre_evenements
FROM Participants AS p
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Participant_ID = p.Participant_ID
GROUP BY p.Participant_ID, p.Participant_Type_Code, p.Participant_Details
ORDER BY nombre_evenements DESC, p.Participant_ID;"},{"question":"Quels événements réunissent au moins deux participants ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details, COUNT(pe.Participant_ID) AS nombre_participants
FROM Events AS e
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
GROUP BY e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details
HAVING COUNT(pe.Participant_ID) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_participants DESC, e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Quels participants ne sont associés à aucun événement ?","sql":"SELECT p.Participant_ID, p.Participant_Type_Code, p.Participant_Details
FROM Participants AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Participants_in_Events AS pe
    WHERE pe.Participant_ID = p.Participant_ID
)
ORDER BY p.Participant_ID;"},{"question":"Quels événements n’ont encore aucun participant ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details, e.Service_ID
FROM Events AS e
LEFT JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
WHERE pe.Event_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Quels codes de type de participant apparaissent dans les inscriptions aux événements ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.Participant_Type_Code
FROM Participants AS p
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Participant_ID = p.Participant_ID
ORDER BY p.Participant_Type_Code;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total d’événements, de participants et d’associations entre participants et événements ?","sql":"SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Events) AS total_evenements,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Participants) AS total_participants,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Participants_in_Events) AS total_associations;"},{"question":"Pour chaque événement, indiquez s’il possède ou non des participants.","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Participants_in_Events AS pe
           WHERE pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
       ) THEN 'Oui' ELSE 'Non' END AS a_des_participants
FROM Events AS e
ORDER BY e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Quels services sont associés à au moins un événement comptant un participant de type donné par les données ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.Service_ID, s.Service_Type_Code
FROM Services AS s
JOIN Events AS e ON e.Service_ID = s.Service_ID
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
JOIN Participants AS p ON p.Participant_ID = pe.Participant_ID
WHERE p.Participant_Type_Code IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.Service_ID;"},{"question":"Quel événement compte le plus grand nombre de participants ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details, COUNT(pe.Participant_ID) AS nombre_participants
FROM Events AS e
JOIN Participants_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
GROUP BY e.Event_ID, e.Event_Details
ORDER BY nombre_participants DESC, e.Event_ID
LIMIT 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de clients figurent dans l’index central des clients ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients
FROM Customer_Master_Index;"},{"question":"Quels sont les codes des systèmes sources enregistrés, avec le nombre de références correspondant à chacun ?","sql":"SELECT source_system_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_references
FROM CMI_Cross_References
GROUP BY source_system_code
ORDER BY source_system_code;"},{"question":"Quels clients sont associés à au moins une référence de taxe d’habitation ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details
FROM Customer_Master_Index AS c
JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r
  ON r.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
JOIN Council_Tax AS t
  ON t.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id
ORDER BY c.master_customer_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, combien de références croisées lui sont rattachées ?","sql":"SELECT c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details, COUNT(r.cmi_cross_ref_id) AS nombre_references
FROM Customer_Master_Index AS c
LEFT JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r
  ON r.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
GROUP BY c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details
ORDER BY nombre_references DESC, c.master_customer_id;"},{"question":"Quelles références croisées sont présentes à la fois dans les dossiers de taxe d’habitation et dans les amendes de stationnement ?","sql":"SELECT r.cmi_cross_ref_id, r.master_customer_id, r.source_system_code
FROM CMI_Cross_References AS r
JOIN Council_Tax AS t
  ON t.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id
JOIN Parking_Fines AS p
  ON p.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id
ORDER BY r.cmi_cross_ref_id;"},{"question":"Quels clients n’ont aucune référence dans les tables de taxe d’habitation, de prestations indûment versées, de tarifs professionnels, d’inscription électorale, d’amendes de stationnement ou d’arriérés de loyer ?","sql":"SELECT c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details
FROM Customer_Master_Index AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CMI_Cross_References AS r
    WHERE r.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
      AND (
          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Council_Tax AS t WHERE t.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id)
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Benefits_Overpayments AS b WHERE b.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id)
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Business_Rates AS br WHERE br.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id)
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Electoral_Register AS e WHERE e.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id)
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Parking_Fines AS p WHERE p.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id)
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Rent_Arrears AS a WHERE a.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id)
      )
)
ORDER BY c.master_customer_id;"},{"question":"Quels identifiants de taxe d’habitation correspondent à des prestations indûment versées, avec le client concerné ?","sql":"SELECT b.council_tax_id, b.cmi_cross_ref_id, r.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details
FROM Benefits_Overpayments AS b
JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r
  ON r.cmi_cross_ref_id = b.cmi_cross_ref_id
JOIN Customer_Master_Index AS c
  ON c.master_customer_id = r.master_customer_id
ORDER BY b.council_tax_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de dossiers dans chaque domaine administratif ?","sql":"SELECT 'Benefits_Overpayments' AS domaine, COUNT(*) AS nombre_dossiers FROM Benefits_Overpayments
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Business_Rates', COUNT(*) FROM Business_Rates
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Council_Tax', COUNT(*) FROM Council_Tax
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Electoral_Register', COUNT(*) FROM Electoral_Register
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Parking_Fines', COUNT(*) FROM Parking_Fines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rent_Arrears', COUNT(*) FROM Rent_Arrears;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont des références croisées rattachées à au moins trois domaines administratifs distincts ?","sql":"WITH domaines AS (
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id, 'Benefits_Overpayments' AS domaine FROM Benefits_Overpayments
    UNION
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id, 'Business_Rates' FROM Business_Rates
    UNION
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id, 'Council_Tax' FROM Council_Tax
    UNION
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id, 'Electoral_Register' FROM Electoral_Register
    UNION
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id, 'Parking_Fines' FROM Parking_Fines
    UNION
    SELECT cmi_cross_ref_id, 'Rent_Arrears' FROM Rent_Arrears
)
SELECT c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details, COUNT(DISTINCT d.domaine) AS nombre_domaines
FROM Customer_Master_Index AS c
JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r
  ON r.master_customer_id = c.master_customer_id
JOIN domaines AS d
  ON d.cmi_cross_ref_id = r.cmi_cross_ref_id
GROUP BY c.master_customer_id, c.cmi_details
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.domaine) >= 3
ORDER BY nombre_domaines DESC, c.master_customer_id;"},{"question":"Quelles références croisées sont inscrites au registre électoral mais ne possèdent aucun dossier d’arriérés de loyer ?","sql":"SELECT e.electoral_register_id, e.cmi_cross_ref_id, r.master_customer_id, r.source_system_code
FROM Electoral_Register AS e
JOIN CMI_Cross_References AS r
  ON r.cmi_cross_ref_id = e.cmi_cross_ref_id
LEFT JOIN Rent_Arrears AS a
  ON a.cmi_cross_ref_id = e.cmi_cross_ref_id
WHERE a.cmi_cross_ref_id IS NULL
ORDER BY e.electoral_register_id;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles machines ont été fabriquées à partir de 2015, classées de la plus récente à la plus ancienne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Machine_ID\", \"Making_Year\", \"Class\", \"Machine_series\" FROM \"machine\" WHERE \"Making_Year\" >= 2015 ORDER BY \"Making_Year\" DESC, \"Machine_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la valeur moyenne des machines pour chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT \"Class\", AVG(\"value_points\") AS valeur_moyenne FROM \"machine\" GROUP BY \"Class\" ORDER BY valeur_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels techniciens sont affectés à quelles machines et à quelles réparations ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"Name\" AS technicien, r.\"name\" AS reparation, m.\"Machine_ID\" AS machine_id FROM \"repair_assignment\" ra JOIN \"technician\" t ON t.\"technician_id\" = ra.\"technician_id\" JOIN \"repair\" r ON r.\"repair_ID\" = ra.\"repair_ID\" JOIN \"machine\" m ON m.\"Machine_ID\" = ra.\"Machine_ID\" ORDER BY technicien, machine_id, reparation;"},{"question":"Quels techniciens ne sont affectés à aucune réparation ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"technician_id\", t.\"Name\", t.\"Team\" FROM \"technician\" t LEFT JOIN \"repair_assignment\" ra ON ra.\"technician_id\" = t.\"technician_id\" WHERE ra.\"technician_id\" IS NULL ORDER BY t.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Combien de réparations sont affectées à chaque machine, y compris celles sans BY m.\"Machine_ID\" ORDER BY nombre_reparations DESC, m.\"Machine_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la machine ayant le meilleur rang de qualité ?","sql":"SELECT \"Machine_ID\", \"Making_Year\", \"Class\", \"Machine_series\", \"quality_rank\" FROM \"machine\" WHERE \"quality_rank\" = (SELECT MIN(\"quality_rank\") FROM \"machine\");"},{"question":"Quelles réparations ont été lancées depuis le 1er janvier 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT \"repair_ID\", \"name\", \"Launch_Date\", \"Notes\" FROM \"repair\" WHERE date(\"Launch_Date\") >= date('2020-01-01') ORDER BY date(\"Launch_Date\");"},{"question":"Quel est l'âge moyen des techniciens dans chaque équipe ?","sql":"SELECT \"Team\", AVG(\"Age\") AS age_moyen, COUNT(*) AS nombre_techniciens FROM \"technician\" GROUP BY \"Team\" ORDER BY age_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque série de machines, combien d'exemplaires existe-t-il et quelle est leur valeur maximale ?","sql":"SELECT \"Machine_series\", COUNT(*) AS nombre_machines, MAX(\"value_points\") AS valeur_maximale FROM \"machine\" GROUP BY \"Machine_series\" ORDER BY nombre_machines DESC, \"Machine_series\";"},{"question":"Quels techniciens ont commencé entre 2010 et 2015 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT \"technician_id\", \"Name\", \"Starting_Year\", \"Age\", \"Team\" FROM \"technician\" WHERE \"Starting_Year\" BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015 ORDER BY \"Starting_Year\", \"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelles réparations ne sont affectées à aucune machine ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"repair_ID\", r.\"name\", r.\"Launch_Date\" FROM \"repair\" r LEFT JOIN \"repair_assignment\" ra ON ra.\"repair_ID\" = r.\"repair_ID\" WHERE ra.\"repair_ID\" IS NULL ORDER BY r.\"Launch_Date\", r.\"repair_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelles machines ont au moins deux techniciens distincts affectés ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Machine_ID\", COUNT(DISTINCT ra.\"technician_id\") AS nombre_techniciens FROM \"machine\" m JOIN \"repair_assignment\" ra ON ra.\"Machine_ID\" = m.\"Machine_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Machine_ID\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.\"technician_id\") >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_techniciens DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les machines dont la valeur dépasse la valeur moyenne de leur classe ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Machine_ID\", m.\"Class\", m.\"value_points\" FROM \"machine\" m WHERE m.\"value_points\" > (SELECT AVG(m2.\"value_points\") FROM \"machine\" m2 WHERE m2.\"Class\" = m.\"Class\") ORDER BY m.\"Class\", m.\"value_points\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque affectation, quels sont les noms du technicien et de la réparation concernés ?","sql":"SELECT ra.\"technician_id\", t.\"Name\" AS nom_technicien, ra.\"repair_ID\", r.\"name\" AS nom_reparation, ra.\"Machine_ID\" FROM \"repair_assignment\" ra JOIN \"technician\" t ON t.\"technician_id\" = ra.\"technician_id\" JOIN \"repair\" r ON r.\"repair_ID\" = ra.\"repair_ID\" ORDER BY ra.\"technician_id\", ra.\"repair_ID\", ra.\"Machine_ID\";"},{"question":"Combien de réparations ont été lancées chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', \"Launch_Date\") AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reparations FROM \"repair\" GROUP BY strftime('%Y', \"Launch_Date\") ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quelles classes comptent au moins trois machines et ont un rang de qualité moyen inférieur à 50 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Class\", COUNT(*) AS nombre_machines, AVG(\"quality_rank\") AS rang_moyen FROM \"machine\" GROUP BY \"Class\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND AVG(\"quality_rank\") < 50 ORDER BY rang_moyen;"},{"question":"Quels techniciens ont été affectés à au moins une machine fabriquée avant 2010 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.\"technician_id\", t.\"Name\", t.\"Team\" FROM \"technician\" t JOIN \"repair_assignment\" ra ON ra.\"technician_id\" = t.\"technician_id\" JOIN \"machine\" m ON m.\"Machine_ID\" = ra.\"Machine_ID\" WHERE m.\"Making_Year\" < 2010 ORDER BY t.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque machine, quelles réparations lui sont associées, réunies dans une seule chaîne ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Machine_ID\", COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.\"name\"), '') AS reparations FROM \"machine\" m LEFT JOIN \"repair_assignment\" ra ON ra.\"Machine_ID\" = m.\"Machine_ID\" LEFT JOIN \"repair\" r ON r.\"repair_ID\" = ra.\"repair_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Machine_ID\" ORDER BY m.\"Machine_ID\";"},{"question":"Quel est le classement des machines par valeur au sein de chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT \"Machine_ID\", \"Class\", \"value_points\", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY \"Class\" ORDER BY \"value_points\" DESC) AS rang_dans_la_classe FROM \"machine\" ORDER BY \"Class\", rang_dans_la_classe, \"Machine_ID\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque équipe, combien de techniciens compte-t-elle et quelle est l'année de début la plus ancienne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Team\", COUNT(*) AS nombre_techniciens, MIN(\"Starting_Year\") AS debut_le_plus_ancien FROM \"technician\" GROUP BY \"Team\" ORDER BY debut_le_plus_ancien, \"Team\";"},{"question":"Quelles affectations associent un technicien et une machine appartenant à la même équipe ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"Name\" AS technicien, t.\"Team\", m.\"Machine_ID\", m.\"Class\", ra.\"repair_ID\" FROM \"repair_assignment\" ra JOIN \"technician\" t ON t.\"technician_id\" = ra.\"technician_id\" JOIN \"machine\" m ON m.\"Machine_ID\" = ra.\"Machine_ID\" WHERE t.\"Team\" = m.\"Team\" ORDER BY t.\"Team\", technicien, m.\"Machine_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelles machines ont une valeur supérieure à la valeur moyenne de toutes les machines ?","sql":"SELECT \"Machine_ID\", \"Machine_series\", \"Class\", \"value_points\" FROM \"machine\" WHERE \"value_points\" > (SELECT AVG(\"value_points\") FROM \"machine\") ORDER BY \"value_points\" DESC;"}]}

5000;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ne fabriquent aucun produit ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name FROM Manufacturers AS m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Products AS p WHERE p.Manufacturer = m.Code);"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont au moins deux produits ?","sql":"SELECT m.Name, COUNT(p.Code) AS nombre_produits FROM Manufacturers AS m JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name HAVING COUNT(p.Code) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq produits les plus chers ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price FROM Products ORDER BY Price DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Combien de produits sont enregistrés au total ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_total_produits FROM Products;"},{"question":"Quel est le chiffre d’affaires total renseigné des fabricants ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(Revenue) AS chiffre_affaires_total FROM Manufacturers;"},{"question":"Combien de fabricants ont leur siège dans chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT Headquarter, COUNT(*) AS nombre_fabricants FROM Manufacturers GROUP BY Headquarter ORDER BY nombre_fabricants DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits appartiennent au fabricant dont le code vaut 10 ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price FROM Products WHERE Manufacturer = 10;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont fabriqués par des entreprises dont le siège est à Paris ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS produit, m.Name AS fabricant FROM Products AS p JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE m.Headquarter = 'Paris';"},{"question":"Pour chaque fabricant ayant des produits, quel est le produit le plus cher ?","sql":"SELECT m.Name AS fabricant, p.Name AS produit, p.Price FROM Products AS p JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE p.Price = (SELECT MAX(p2.Price) FROM Products AS p2 WHERE p2.Manufacturer = p.Manufacturer);"},{"question":"Quels produits ont exactement le deuxième prix le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price FROM Products WHERE Price = (SELECT MAX(Price) FROM Products WHERE Price < (SELECT MAX(Price) FROM Products));"},{"question":"Quel est le prix de chaque produit arrondi à l’unité ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Price, ROUND(Price) AS prix_arrondi FROM Products;"},{"question":"Affichez le chiffre d’affaires de chaque fabricant, en remplaçant les valeurs absentes par zéro.","sql":"SELECT Name, COALESCE(Revenue, 0) AS chiffre_affaires FROM Manufacturers;"},{"question":"Quels sont les dix fabricants classés par ordre alphabétique ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name FROM Manufacturers ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un code compris entre 100 et 200 ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price FROM Products WHERE Code BETWEEN 100 AND 200 ORDER BY Code;"},{"question":"Pour chaque fabricant, combien de produits coûtent plus de 50 ?","sql":"SELECT m.Name, COUNT(p.Code) AS produits_de_plus_de_50 FROM Manufacturers AS m LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code AND p.Price > 50 GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont un prix moyen de produit supérieur au prix moyen global ?","sql":"SELECT m.Name, AVG(p.Price) AS prix_moyen_fabricant FROM Manufacturers AS m JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name HAVING AVG(p.Price) > (SELECT AVG(Price) FROM Products);"},{"question":"Pour chaque produit, quelle est la différence entre son prix et le prix moyen global ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Price, Price - (SELECT AVG(Price) FROM Products) AS ecart_au_prix_moyen FROM Products;"},{"question":"Quel fabricant possède le chiffre d’affaires renseigné le plus faible ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Revenue FROM Manufacturers WHERE Revenue = (SELECT MIN(Revenue) FROM Manufacturers WHERE Revenue IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un fabricant existant dont le chiffre d’affaires est inconnu ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS produit, m.Name AS fabricant FROM Products AS p JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE m.Revenue IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de produits portent chaque première lettre de nom ?","sql":"SELECT SUBSTR(Name, 1, 1) AS initiale, COUNT(*) AS nombre_produits FROM Products GROUP BY SUBSTR(Name, 1, 1) ORDER BY initiale;"},{"question":"Quelles villes accueillent plusieurs sièges sociaux de fabricants ?","sql":"SELECT Headquarter, COUNT(*) AS nombre_fabricants FROM Manufacturers GROUP BY Headquarter HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;"},{"question":"Classez les fabricants par chiffre d’affaires décroissant, en plaçant les valeurs absentes à la fin.","sql":"SELECT Name, Revenue FROM Manufacturers ORDER BY Revenue IS NULL, Revenue DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits sont fabriqués par une entreprise fondée par « Jean Dupont » ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS produit, m.Name AS fabricant FROM Products AS p JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE m.Founder = 'Jean Dupont';"},{"question":"Quel fabricant a le chiffre d’affaires renseigné le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Revenue FROM Manufacturers WHERE Revenue = (SELECT MAX(Revenue) FROM Manufacturers WHERE Revenue IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Quels produits appartiennent à un fabricant dont le chiffre d’affaires dépasse 10000 ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS produit, p.Price, m.Name AS fabricant FROM Products AS p JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE m.Revenue > 10000;"},{"question":"Quel pourcentage des produits coûte plus de 100 ?","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Price > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pourcentage FROM Products;"},{"question":"Répartissez les produits en catégories selon leur prix : moins de 50, de 50 à 100, ou plus de 100.","sql":"SELECT Name, Price, CASE WHEN Price < 50 THEN 'moins de 50' WHEN Price <= 100 THEN 'de 50 à 100' ELSE 'plus de 100' END AS categorie_prix FROM Products;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont le même prix qu’au moins un autre produit ?","sql":"SELECT p1.Code, p1.Name, p1.Price FROM Products AS p1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Products AS p2 WHERE p2.Price = p1.Price AND p2.Code <> p1.Code) ORDER BY p1.Price;"},{"question":"Quel fabricant propose le plus grand nombre de produits ?","sql":"WITH comptes AS (SELECT m.Code, m.Name, COUNT(p.Code) AS nombre_produits FROM Manufacturers AS m LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name) SELECT Code, Name, nombre_produits FROM comptes WHERE nombre_produits = (SELECT MAX(nombre_produits) FROM comptes);"},{"question":"Pour chaque fabricant, affichez le nombre de produits et leur prix moyen, y compris sans produit.","sql":"SELECT m.Name, COUNT(p.Code) AS nombre_produits, AVG(p.Price) AS prix_moyen FROM Manufacturers AS m LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ne partagent leur siège avec aucun autre fabricant ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name, m.Headquarter FROM Manufacturers AS m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Manufacturers AS m2 WHERE m2.Headquarter = m.Headquarter AND m2.Code <> m.Code);"},{"question":"Quels produits ont exactement le prix maximal de leur fabricant ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS produit, p.Price, m.Name AS fabricant FROM Products AS p JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE p.Price = (SELECT MAX(p2.Price) FROM Products AS p2 WHERE p2.Manufacturer = p.Manufacturer);"},{"question":"Pour chaque fabricant, comparez son chiffre d’affaires à la valeur totale de ses produits.","sql":"SELECT m.Name, m.Revenue, SUM(p.Price) AS valeur_totale_produits FROM Manufacturers AS m LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name, m.Revenue;"},{"question":"Quels produits représentent plus de 20 % de la somme des prix de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Price FROM Products WHERE Price > 0.2 * (SELECT SUM(Price) FROM Products);"},{"question":"Quels codes de produits sont pairs ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name FROM Products WHERE Code % 2 = 0 ORDER BY Code;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix supérieur au prix moyen de leur propre fabricant ?","sql":"SELECT p.Name AS produit, p.Price, m.Name AS fabricant FROM Products AS p JOIN Manufacturers AS m ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE p.Price > (SELECT AVG(p2.Price) FROM Products AS p2 WHERE p2.Manufacturer = p.Manufacturer);"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont au moins un produit dont le prix est inférieur à 10 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.Code, m.Name FROM Manufacturers AS m JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code WHERE p.Price < 10;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de produits par fabricant, en comptant aussi ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_produits) AS moyenne_produits_par_fabricant FROM (SELECT m.Code, COUNT(p.Code) AS nombre_produits FROM Manufacturers AS m LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code GROUP BY m.Code);"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ont un nom contenant la lettre « a » et un siège renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Headquarter FROM Manufacturers WHERE Name LIKE '%a%' AND Headquarter IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les produits dont le prix est supérieur à tous les produits du fabricant de code 1 ?","sql":"SELECT Code, Name, Price FROM Products WHERE Price > ALL (SELECT Price FROM Products WHERE Manufacturer = 1);"},{"question":"Pour chaque siège social, quel est le chiffre d’affaires maximal des fabricants qui y sont établis ?","sql":"SELECT Headquarter, MAX(Revenue) AS chiffre_affaires_maximal FROM Manufacturers GROUP BY Headquarter;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants possèdent exactement un seul produit ?","sql":"SELECT m.Code, m.Name FROM Manufacturers AS m JOIN Products AS p ON p.Manufacturer = m.Code GROUP BY m.Code, m.Name HAVING COUNT(p.Code) = 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels meubles ont un tarif de marché supérieur à la moyenne de tous les meubles ?","sql":"SELECT "Furniture_ID", "Name", "Market_Rate"
FROM "furniture"
WHERE "Market_Rate" > (SELECT AVG("Market_Rate") FROM "furniture");"},{"question":"Quels fabricants possèdent plus de magasins que d’usines ?","sql":"SELECT "Manufacturer_ID", "Name", "Num_of_Factories", "Num_of_Shops"
FROM "manufacturer"
WHERE "Num_of_Shops" > "Num_of_Factories";"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen proposé par chaque fabricant, en incluant uniquement ceux qui fabriquent au moins un meuble ?","sql":"SELECT m."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name", AVG(fm."Price_in_Dollar") AS "Prix_moyen"
FROM "manufacturer" AS m
JOIN "furniture_manufacte" AS fm ON fm."Manufacturer_ID" = m."Manufacturer_ID"
GROUP BY m."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois meubles comportant le plus de composants ?","sql":"SELECT "Furniture_ID", "Name", "Num_of_Component"
FROM "furniture"
ORDER BY "Num_of_Component" DESC, "Furniture_ID"
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels fabricants ne fabriquent actuellement aucun meuble ?","sql":"SELECT m."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name"
FROM "manufacturer" AS m
LEFT JOIN "furniture_manufacte" AS fm ON fm."Manufacturer_ID" = m."Manufacturer_ID"
WHERE fm."Manufacturer_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque meuble fabriqué par au moins deux fabricants, combien de fabricants le produisent-ils et quel est leur prix moyen ?","sql":"SELECT f."Furniture_ID", f."Name", COUNT(fm."Manufacturer_ID") AS "Nombre_de_fabricants", AVG(fm."Price_in_Dollar") AS "Prix_moyen"
FROM "furniture" AS f
JOIN "furniture_manufacte" AS fm ON fm."Furniture_ID" = f."Furniture_ID"
GROUP BY f."Furniture_ID", f."Name"
HAVING COUNT(fm."Manufacturer_ID") >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels meubles sont vendus par un fabricant dont l’année d’ouverture est antérieure à 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f."Furniture_ID", f."Name"
FROM "furniture" AS f
JOIN "furniture_manufacte" AS fm ON fm."Furniture_ID" = f."Furniture_ID"
JOIN "manufacturer" AS m ON m."Manufacturer_ID" = fm."Manufacturer_ID"
WHERE m."Open_Year" < 2000;"},{"question":"Quel fabricant a ouvert le plus tôt ?","sql":"SELECT "Manufacturer_ID", "Name", "Open_Year"
FROM "manufacturer"
WHERE "Open_Year" = (SELECT MIN("Open_Year") FROM "manufacturer");"},{"question":"Quels liens de fabrication ont un prix supérieur au tarif de marché du meuble concerné ?","sql":"SELECT fm."Manufacturer_ID", fm."Furniture_ID", fm."Price_in_Dollar", f."Market_Rate"
FROM "furniture_manufacte" AS fm
JOIN "furniture" AS f ON f."Furniture_ID" = fm."Furniture_ID"
WHERE fm."Price_in_Dollar" > f."Market_Rate";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de meubles distincts fabriqués par chaque fabricant, y compris ceux qui n’en fabriquent aucun ?","sql":"SELECT m."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT fm."Furniture_ID") AS "Nombre_de_meubles"
FROM "manufacturer" AS m
LEFT JOIN "furniture_manufacte" AS fm ON fm."Manufacturer_ID" = m."Manufacturer_ID"
GROUP BY m."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name";"},{"question":"Quels fabricants proposent uniquement des meubles dont le prix est au moins égal à 100 dollars ?","sql":"SELECT m."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name"
FROM "manufacturer" AS m
JOIN "furniture_manufacte" AS fm ON fm."Manufacturer_ID" = m."Manufacturer_ID"
GROUP BY m."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name"
HAVING MIN(fm."Price_in_Dollar") >= 100;"},{"question":"Pour chaque fabricant, quel est le meuble le plus cher qu’il fabrique ?","sql":"SELECT fm."Manufacturer_ID", m."Name" AS "Nom_du_fabricant", fm."Furniture_ID", f."Name" AS "Nom_du_meuble", fm."Price_in_Dollar"
FROM "furniture_manufacte" AS fm
JOIN "manufacturer" AS m ON m."Manufacturer_ID" = fm."Manufacturer_ID"
JOIN "furniture" AS f ON f."Furniture_ID" = fm."Furniture_ID"
WHERE fm."Price_in_Dollar" = (
    SELECT MAX(fm2."Price_in_Dollar")
    FROM "furniture_manufacte" AS fm2
    WHERE fm2."Manufacturer_ID" = fm."Manufacturer_ID"
);"}]}

\"music_festival\".\"Volume\" = \"volume\".\"Volume_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont l’âge maximal dans leur groupe d’âge ?","sql":"SELECT \"Artist\", \"Age\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Age\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Age\") FROM \"artist\");"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de semaines au sommet de tous les volumes ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"Weeks_on_Top\") AS \"moyenne_generale\" FROM \"volume\".\"Song\" ORDER BY \"artist\".\"Artist\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, âges, villes et professions de toutes les personnes ?","sql":"SELECT name, age, city, job FROM Person;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont plus de 30 ans ?","sql":"SELECT name, age FROM Person WHERE age > 30;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes habitent à Paris ?","sql":"SELECT name, age, job FROM Person WHERE city = 'Paris';"},{"question":"Quels sont vivent à Paris ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT pf.friend FROM PersonFriend AS pf JOIN Person AS p ON p.name = pf.name WHERE p.city = 'Paris' ORDER BY pf.friend;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes sont accessibles en deux relations d'amitié depuis Alice ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT second.friend FROM PersonFriend AS first JOIN PersonFriend AS second ON second.name = first.friend WHERE first.name = 'Alice' AND second.friend <> 'Alice' ORDER BY second.friend;"},{"question":"Quelles paires de personnes ont la même profession ?","sql":"SELECT p1.name AS personne_1, p2.name AS personne_2, p1.job FROM Person AS p1 JOIN Person AS p2 ON p1.job = p2.job AND p1.name < p2.name WHERE p1.job IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p1.job, personne_1, personne_2;"},{"question":"Quels métiers sont exercés par des personnes âgées de plus de 40 ans ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT job FROM Person WHERE age > 40 AND job IS NOT NULL ORDER BY job;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de personnes par couple ville-profession ?","sql":"SELECT city, job, COUNT(*) AS effectif FROM Person GROUP BY city, job ORDER BY city, job;"},{"question":"Quelles villes comptent plus de trois personnes ?","sql":"SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS effectif FROM Person GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY effectif DESC, city;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont l'âge maximal ?","sql":"SELECT name, age FROM Person WHERE age = (SELECT MAX(age) FROM Person) ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les personnes les plus jeunes de leur ville ?","sql":"SELECT p.name, p.city, p.age FROM Person AS p WHERE p.age = (SELECT MIN(p2.age) FROM Person AS p2 WHERE p2.city = p.city) ORDER BY p.city, p.name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'amis déclarés par personne ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_amis) AS moyenne_amis FROM (SELECT p.name, COUNT(pf.friend) AS nombre_amis FROM Person AS p LEFT JOIN PersonFriend AS pf ON pf.name = p.name GROUP BY p.name);"},{"question":"Combien de relations d'amitié y a-t-il pour chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS nombre_relations FROM PersonFriend GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quelles années distinctes apparaissent dans les relations d'amitié ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT year FROM PersonFriend WHERE year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont exactement deux amis déclarés ?","sql":"SELECT p.name FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS pf ON pf.name = p.name GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(pf.friend) = 2 ORDER BY p.name;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont exactement deux personnes qui les ont déclarées comme amies ?","sql":"SELECT p.name FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS pf ON pf.friend = p.name GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(pf.name) = 2 ORDER BY p.name;"},{"question":"Quelles relations concernent des personnes ayant au moins dix ans d'écart ?","sql":"SELECT pf.name, pf.friend, ABS(p1.age - p2.age) AS ecart_age FROM PersonFriend AS pf JOIN Person AS p1 ON p1.name = pf.name JOIN Person AS p2 ON p2.name = pf.friend WHERE ABS(p1.age - p2.age) >= 10 ORDER BY ecart_age DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles professions sont exercées par des personnes ayant au moins un ami ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.job FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS pf ON pf.name = p.name WHERE p.job IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.job;"},{"question":"Combien de relations d'amitié partent de chaque ville ?","sql":"SELECT p.city, COUNT(*) AS nombre_relations FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS pf ON pf.name = p.name GROUP BY p.city ORDER BY nombre_relations DESC, p.city;"},{"question":"Quelle personne a déclaré le plus grand nombre d'amis ?","sql":"SELECT p.name, COUNT(pf.friend) AS nombre_amis FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS pf ON pf.name = p.name GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(pf.friend) = (SELECT MAX(nombre_amis) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_amis FROM PersonFriend GROUP BY name)) ORDER BY p.name;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes n'ont aucune relation d'amitié, entrante ou sortante ?","sql":"SELECT p.name FROM Person AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PersonFriend AS pf WHERE pf.name = p.name OR pf.friend = p.name) ORDER BY p.name;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont uniquement des amis de leur propre ville ?","sql":"SELECT p.name FROM Person AS p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PersonFriend AS pf WHERE pf.name = p.name) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PersonFriend AS pf JOIN Person AS ami ON ami.name = pf.friend WHERE pf.name = p.name AND ami.city <> p.city) ORDER BY p.name;"},{"question":"Quel est l'âge moyen des amis de chaque personne ?","sql":"SELECT p.name, AVG(ami.age) AS age_moyen_des_amis FROM Person AS p JOIN PersonFriend AS pf ON pf.name = p.name JOIN Person AS ami ON ami.name = pf.friend GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de personnes par genre et par ville ?","sql":"SELECT gender, city, COUNT(*) AS effectif FROM Person GROUP BY gender, city ORDER BY gender, city;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont un âge supérieur à l'âge moyen général ?","sql":"SELECT name, age FROM Person WHERE age > (SELECT AVG(age) FROM Person) ORDER BY age DESC, name;"},{"question":"Quelles villes ont un âge moyen supérieur à 35 ans ?","sql":"SELECT city, AVG(age) AS age_moyen FROM Person GROUP BY city HAVING AVG(age) > 35 ORDER BY age_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le classement des personnes par âge décroissant ?","sql":"SELECT name, age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS classement FROM Person ORDER BY classement, name;"},{"question":"Quelles relations impliquent une personne nommée Alice, comme émettrice ou comme amie ?","sql":"SELECT name, friend, year FROM PersonFriend WHERE name = 'Alice' OR friend = 'Alice' ORDER BY year, name, friend;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont déclaré un ami dont le nom contient la lettre e ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT pf.name FROM PersonFriend AS pf WHERE pf.friend LIKE '%e%' ORDER BY pf.name;"},{"question":"Quelles paires de villes sont reliées par des relations d'amitié ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p1.city AS ville_depart, p2.city AS ville_arrivee FROM PersonFriend AS pf JOIN Person AS p1 ON p1.name = pf.name JOIN Person AS p2 ON p2.name = pf.friend ORDER BY ville_depart, ville_arrivee;"},{"question":"Quelles relations ont été créées après l'année moyenne des relations ?","sql":"SELECT name, friend, year FROM PersonFriend WHERE year > (SELECT AVG(year) FROM PersonFriend) ORDER BY year, name, friend;"},{"question":"Pour chaque personne, quels sont ses amis et leurs professions ?","sql":"SELECT pf.name AS personne, pf.friend AS ami, p.job AS profession_de_l_ami FROM PersonFriend AS pf JOIN Person AS p ON p.name = pf.friend ORDER BY pf.name, pf.friend;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont le même âge qu'au moins une autre personne ?","sql":"SELECT name, age FROM Person WHERE age IN (SELECT age FROM Person GROUP BY age HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY age, name;"},{"question":"Quels noms ont une longueur supérieure à 10 caractères ?","sql":"SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS longueur FROM Person WHERE LENGTH(name) > 10 ORDER BY longueur DESC, name;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les événements classés par nombre de participants décroissant ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Date", "Event_Attendance"
FROM "event"
ORDER BY "Event_Attendance" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel événement a accueilli le plus grand nombre de participants ?","sql":"SELECT "Event_ID", "Name", "Venue", "Event_Attendance"
FROM "event"
WHERE "Event_Attendance" = (SELECT MAX("Event_Attendance") FROM "event");"},{"question":"Combien de reportages chaque journaliste a-t-il réalisés, y compris ceux qui n'en ont réalisé aucun ?","sql":"SELECT j."journalist_ID", j."Name", COUNT(n."Event_ID") AS "Nombre_de_reportages"
FROM "journalist" AS j
LEFT JOIN "news_report" AS n ON n."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
GROUP BY j."journalist_ID", j."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_reportages" DESC, j."Name";"},{"question":"Quels événements n'ont fait l'objet d'aucun reportage ?","sql":"SELECT e."Event_ID", e."Name", e."Date"
FROM "event" AS e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "news_report" AS n
    WHERE n."Event_ID" = e."Event_ID"
)
ORDER BY e."Date";"},{"question":"Quels journalistes ayant au moins dix ans d'expérience ont couvert quels événements ?","sql":"SELECT j."Name" AS "Journaliste", e."Name" AS "Événement", j."Years_working"
FROM "journalist" AS j
JOIN "news_report" AS n ON n."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."Event_ID" = n."Event_ID"
WHERE j."Years_working" >= 10
ORDER BY j."Years_working" DESC, j."Name", e."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est l'âge moyen des journalistes pour chaque nationalité ?","sql":"SELECT "Nationality", AVG(CAST("Age" AS INTEGER)) AS "Age_moyen"
FROM "journalist"
GROUP BY "Nationality"
ORDER BY "Age_moyen" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels événements ont attiré plus de participants que la moyenne de tous les événements ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Event_Attendance"
FROM "event"
WHERE "Event_Attendance" > (SELECT AVG("Event_Attendance") FROM "event")
ORDER BY "Event_Attendance" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'événements ont été organisés dans chaque lieu, et quels lieux en ont accueilli au moins deux ?","sql":"SELECT "Venue", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_evenements"
FROM "event"
GROUP BY "Venue"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_evenements" DESC, "Venue";"},{"question":"Quels journalistes ont travaillé sur au moins deux événements différents ?","sql":"SELECT j."journalist_ID", j."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT n."Event_ID") AS "Nombre_evenements"
FROM "journalist" AS j
JOIN "news_report" AS n ON n."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
GROUP BY j."journalist_ID", j."Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n."Event_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_evenements" DESC, j."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque événement, combien de journalistes distincts ont produit un reportage ?","sql":"SELECT e."Event_ID", e."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT n."journalist_ID") AS "Journalistes_distincts"
FROM "event" AS e
LEFT JOIN "news_report" AS n ON n."Event_ID" = e."Event_ID"
GROUP BY e."Event_ID", e."Name"
ORDER BY "Journalistes_distincts" DESC, e."Name";"},{"question":"Quels journalistes ont couvert un événement dont le nom contient la lettre « a » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT j."journalist_ID", j."Name"
FROM "journalist" AS j
JOIN "news_report" AS n ON n."journalist_ID" = j."journalist_ID"
JOIN "event" AS e ON e."Event_ID" = n."Event_ID"
WHERE e."Name" LIKE '%a%'
ORDER BY j."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle part de l'ensemble des reportages chaque événement représente-t-il ?","sql":"WITH "Total" AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_total"
    FROM "news_report"
)
SELECT e."Name",
       COUNT(n."journalist_ID") AS "Nombre_reportages",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(n."journalist_ID") / NULLIF((SELECT "Nombre_total" FROM "Total"), 0), 2) AS "Pourcentage"
FROM "event" AS e
LEFT JOIN "news_report" AS n ON n."Event_ID" = e."Event_ID"
GROUP BY e."Event_ID", e."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_reportages" DESC, e."Name";"},{"question":"Quels journalistes sont plus âgés que l'âge moyen de l'ensemble des journalistes ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Nationality", "Age"
FROM "journalist"
WHERE CAST("Age" AS INTEGER) > (
    SELECT AVG(CAST("Age" AS INTEGER))
    FROM "journalist"
)
ORDER BY CAST("Age" AS INTEGER) DESC, "Name";"}]}
