{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les lieux ayant accueilli au moins deux performances, avec le nombre de performances correspondantes ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_performances
FROM "performance"
GROUP BY "Location"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_de_performances DESC, "Location";"},{"question":"Quels membres sont de nationalité française ?","sql":"SELECT "Member_ID", "Name", "Role"
FROM "member"
WHERE "Nationality" = 'French'
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Combien de pièces chaque membre a-t-il interprétées au total ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", COALESCE(SUM(ma."Num_of_Pieces"), 0) AS total_pieces
FROM "member" AS m
LEFT JOIN "member_attendance" AS ma
  ON ma."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
GROUP BY m."Member_ID", m."Name"
ORDER BY total_pieces DESC, m."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la performance qui a enregistré la plus forte fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT "Performance_ID", "Date", "Host", "Location", "Attendance"
FROM "performance"
WHERE "Attendance" = (SELECT MAX("Attendance") FROM "performance");"},{"question":"Quelles performances sont classées de la plus ancienne à la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT "Performance_ID", "Date", "Host", "Location"
FROM "performance"
ORDER BY "Date" ASC, "Performance_ID" ASC;"},{"question":"Quels membres n'ont participé à aucune performance ?","sql":"SELECT m."Member_ID", m."Name", m."Nationality", m."Role"
FROM "member" AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "member_attendance" AS ma
    WHERE ma."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
)
ORDER BY m."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque performance, combien de pièces ont été interprétées au total par les membres présents ?","sql":"SELECT p."Performance_ID", p."Date", COALESCE(SUM(ma."Num_of_Pieces"), 0) AS total_pieces
FROM "performance" AS p
LEFT JOIN "member_attendance" AS ma
  ON ma."Performance_ID" = p."Performance_ID"
GROUP BY p."Performance_ID", p."Date"
ORDER BY p."Date", p."Performance_ID";"},{"question":"Combien de membres y a-t-il dans chaque rôle ?","sql":"SELECT "Role", COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_membres
FROM "member"
GROUP BY "Role"
ORDER BY nombre_de_membres DESC, "Role";"},{"question":"Quelles performances ont accueilli au moins cinq membres différents ?","sql":"SELECT p."Performance_ID", p."Date", COUNT(DISTINCT ma."Member_ID") AS nombre_de_membres
FROM "performance" AS p
JOIN "member_attendance" AS ma
  ON ma."Performance_ID" = p."Performance_ID"
GROUP BY p."Performance_ID", p."Date"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ma."Member_ID") >= 5
ORDER BY nombre_de_membres DESC, p."Date";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de spectateurs par lieu ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", AVG("Attendance") AS frequentation_moyenne
FROM "performance"
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY frequentation_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque membre, quelles sont les dates des performances auxquelles il a participé ?","sql":"SELECT m."Name", p."Date", p."Performance_ID"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "member_attendance" AS ma
  ON ma."Member_ID" = m."Member_ID"
JOIN "performance" AS p
  ON p."Performance_ID" = ma."Performance_ID"
ORDER BY m."Name", p."Date", p."Performance_ID";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des personnes associées à chaque auteur, avec le lieu et le pays correspondants ?","sql":"SELECT p."Name", x."Location", x."Country"
FROM "perpetrator" AS x
JOIN "people" AS p ON p."People_ID" = x."People_ID";"},{"question":"Combien d'auteurs sont recensés dans chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_auteurs"
FROM "perpetrator"
GROUP BY "Country"
ORDER BY "Nombre_auteurs" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la taille moyenne des personnes apparaissant dans la table des auteurs ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(p."Height") AS "Taille_moyenne"
FROM "people" AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "perpetrator" AS x
    WHERE x."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont provoqué le plus grand nombre de victimes tuées ?","sql":"SELECT "Perpetrator_ID", "People_ID", "Killed"
FROM "perpetrator"
WHERE "Killed" = (SELECT MAX("Killed") FROM "perpetrator");"},{"question":"Quels événements ont eu lieu à partir de l'année 2000, avec leur date et leur localisation ?","sql":"SELECT "Perpetrator_ID", "Date", "Year", "Location"
FROM "perpetrator"
WHERE "Year" >= 2000
ORDER BY "Year", "Date";"},{"question":"Quels pays comptent plus de cinq auteurs recensés ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_auteurs"
FROM "perpetrator"
GROUP BY "Country"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY "Nombre_auteurs" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ne sont associées à aucun auteur ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name"
FROM "people" AS p
LEFT JOIN "perpetrator" AS x ON x."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE x."Perpetrator_ID" IS NULL
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quel est le total des personnes tuées et blessées pour chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT "Year", SUM("Killed") AS "Total_tues", SUM("Injured") AS "Total_blesses"
FROM "perpetrator"
GROUP BY "Year"
ORDER BY "Year";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois lieux où le plus grand nombre d'événements est recensé ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_evenements"
FROM "perpetrator"
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY "Nombre_evenements" DESC, "Location"
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Pour chaque personne associée à au moins un auteur, quel est le nombre total de victimes tuées qui lui est attribué ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name", SUM(x."Killed") AS "Total_tues"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "perpetrator" AS x ON x."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name"
ORDER BY "Total_tues" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels enregistrements indiquent davantage de blessés que de tués ?","sql":"SELECT "Perpetrator_ID", "Date", "Killed", "Injured"
FROM "perpetrator"
WHERE "Injured" > "Killed"
ORDER BY "Injured" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de blessés par pays, uniquement pour les pays dont la moyenne dépasse deux ?","sql":"SELECT "Country", AVG("Injured") AS "Moyenne_blesses"
FROM "perpetrator"
GROUP BY "Country"
HAVING AVG("Injured") > 2
ORDER BY "Moyenne_blesses" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes mesurent plus de 1,80 mètre et sont associées à un événement ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p."People_ID", p."Name", p."Height"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "perpetrator" AS x ON x."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE p."Height" > 1.80
ORDER BY p."Height" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est l'événement le plus ancien enregistré pour chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT x."Country", x."Perpetrator_ID", x."Date", x."Year"
FROM "perpetrator" AS x
WHERE x."Year" = (
    SELECT MIN(y."Year")
    FROM "perpetrator" AS y
    WHERE y."Country" = x."Country"
)
ORDER BY x."Country";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont été associées à au moins deux événements dans des lieux différents ?","sql":"SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT x."Location") AS "Nombre_lieux"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "perpetrator" AS x ON x."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT x."Location") >= 2
ORDER BY "Nombre_lieux" DESC, p."Name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms des modèles de puces et leur année de lancement ?","sql":"SELECT \"Model_name\", \"Launch_year\" FROM \"chip_model\";"},{"question":"Quels téléphones sont fabriqués par chaque entreprise, avec leur modèle matériel ?","sql":"SELECT \"Company_name\", \"Hardware_Model_name\" FROM \"phone\" ORDER BY \"Company_name\", \"Hardware_Model_name\";"},{"question":"Quels modes graphiques utilisent plus de 100 Ko de mémoire ?","sql":"SELECT \"Graphics_mode\", \"used_kb\" FROM \"screen_mode\" WHERE \"used_kb\" > 100 ORDER BY \"used_kb\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces disposent d'au moins 1024 MiB de RAM ?","sql":"SELECT \"Model_name\", \"RAM_MiB\" FROM \"chip_model\" WHERE \"RAM_MiB\" >= 1024 ORDER BY \"RAM_MiB\" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de téléphones sont associés à chaque type d'accréditation ?","sql":"SELECT \"Accreditation_type\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_telephones\" FROM \"phone\" GROUP BY \"Accreditation_type\" ORDER BY \"nombre_telephones\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels téléphones utilisent une puce lancée après 2015 ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Hardware_Model_name\", p.\"Company_name\", c.\"Model_name\", c.\"Launch_year\" FROM \"phone\" AS p JOIN \"chip_model\" AS c ON p.\"chip_model\" = c.\"Model_name\" WHERE c.\"Launch_year\" > 2015 ORDER BY c.\"Launch_year\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de MiB de ROM des modèles de puces ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"ROM_MiB\") AS \"rom_moyenne_mib\" FROM \"chip_model\";"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces ont plus de ROM que de RAM ?","sql":"SELECT \"Model_name\", \"RAM_MiB\", \"ROM_MiB\" FROM \"chip_model\" WHERE \"ROM_MiB\" > \"RAM_MiB\";"},{"question":"Listez les téléphones et le nombre de pixels de leur mode d'écran.","sql":"SELECT p.\"Hardware_Model_name\", s.\"Pixels\" FROM \"phone\" AS p JOIN \"screen_mode\" AS s ON p.\"screen_mode\" = s.\"Graphics_mode\" ORDER BY p.\"Hardware_Model_name\";"},{"question":"Quelles entreprises ont au moins deux téléphones enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT \"Company_name\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_telephones\" FROM \"phone\" GROUP BY \"Company_name\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY \"Company_name\";"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces prennent en charge le WiFi indiqué comme « yes » ?","sql":"SELECT \"Model_name\", \"WiFi\" FROM \"chip_model\" WHERE LOWER(\"WiFi\") = 'yes';"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois modèles de puces les plus récents ?","sql":"SELECT \"Model_name\", \"Launch_year\" FROM \"chip_model\" WHERE \"Launch_year\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Launch_year\" DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Pour chaque téléphone, affichez son entreprise et son niveau d'accréditation, y compris les niveaux absents.","sql":"SELECT \"Hardware_Model_name\", \"Company_name\", \"Accreditation_level\" FROM \"phone\" ORDER BY \"Accreditation_level\" IS NULL, \"Accreditation_level\";"},{"question":"Quels modes d'écran ont plus de 16 couleurs matérielles et utilisent au plus 64 Ko ?","sql":"SELECT \"Graphics_mode\", \"Hardware_colours\", \"used_kb\" FROM \"screen_mode\" WHERE \"Hardware_colours\" > 16 AND \"used_kb\" <= 64;"},{"question":"Combien de modèles de puces sont disponibles pour chaque valeur de Bluetooth ?","sql":"SELECT \"Bluetooth\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_modeles\" FROM \"chip_model\" GROUP BY \"Bluetooth\" ORDER BY \"nombre_modeles\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels téléphones utilisent une puce compatible avec le Bluetooth indiqué comme « no » ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Hardware_Model_name\", p.\"Company_name\" FROM \"phone\" AS p WHERE p.\"chip_model\" IN (SELECT c.\"Model_name\" FROM \"chip_model\" AS c WHERE LOWER(c.\"Bluetooth\") = 'no');"},{"question":"Quelle est la RAM maximale parmi les modèles de puces lancés avant 2020 ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(\"RAM_MiB\") AS \"ram_maximale_mib\" FROM \"chip_model\" WHERE \"Launch_year\" < 2020;"},{"question":"Quels modes graphiques correspondent à un type contenant le mot « color » ?","sql":"SELECT \"Graphics_mode\", \"Type\", \"Hardware_colours\" FROM \"screen_mode\" WHERE LOWER(\"Type\") LIKE '%color%';"},{"question":"Quels téléphones ont une date d'enregistrement comprise entre 2010 et 2019 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Hardware_Model_name\", \"Company_name\", \"Date\" FROM \"phone\" WHERE \"Date\" >= '2010-01-01' AND \"Date\" < '2020-01-01' ORDER BY \"Date\";"},{"question":"Quelle entreprise possède le plus grand nombre de téléphones ?","sql":"SELECT \"Company_name\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_telephones\" FROM \"phone\" GROUP BY \"Company_name\" ORDER BY \"nombre_telephones\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels modèles de puces ont simultanément des emplacements renseignés et une ROM supérieure à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT \"Model_name\", \"Slots\", \"ROM_MiB\" FROM \"chip_model\" WHERE \"Slots\" IS NOT NULL AND \"ROM_MiB\" > (SELECT AVG(\"ROM_MiB\") FROM \"chip_model\") ORDER BY \"ROM_MiB\" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels marchés comptent plus de 10 boutiques et ont un classement inférieur ou égal à 5 ?","sql":"SELECT "Market_ID", "District", "Num_of_shops", "Ranking"
FROM "market"
WHERE "Num_of_shops" > 10
  AND "Ranking" <= 5;"},{"question":"Quels téléphones sont plus chers que le prix moyen de tous les téléphones ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Phone_ID", "Price"
FROM "phone"
WHERE "Price" > (SELECT AVG("Price") FROM "phone")
ORDER BY "Price" DESC;"},{"question":"Dans quels marchés le téléphone appelé « Galaxy S21 » est-il disponible, et en quelle quantité ?","sql":"SELECT m."Market_ID", m."District", pm."Num_of_stock"
FROM "market" AS m
JOIN "phone_market" AS pm ON pm."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
JOIN "phone" AS p ON p."Phone_ID" = pm."Phone_ID"
WHERE p."Name" = 'Galaxy S21';"},{"question":"Pour chaque marché, quelle est la quantité totale de téléphones en stock ?","sql":"SELECT m."Market_ID", m."District", COALESCE(SUM(pm."Num_of_stock"), 0) AS "total_stock"
FROM "market" AS m
LEFT JOIN "phone_market" AS pm ON pm."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
GROUP BY m."Market_ID", m."District"
ORDER BY "total_stock" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les téléphones les plus chers de chaque opérateur ?","sql":"SELECT p."Carrier", p."Name", p."Phone_ID", p."Price"
FROM "phone" AS p
WHERE p."Price" = (
    SELECT MAX(p2."Price")
    FROM "phone" AS p2
    WHERE p2."Carrier" = p."Carrier"
)
ORDER BY p."Carrier", p."Price" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels marchés ne proposent actuellement aucun téléphone en stock ?","sql":"SELECT m."Market_ID", m."District"
FROM "market" AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "phone_market" AS pm
    WHERE pm."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
      AND pm."Num_of_stock" > 0
);"},{"question":"Combien de marchés se trouvent dans chaque district ?","sql":"SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS "nombre_de_marches"
FROM "market"
GROUP BY "District"
ORDER BY "nombre_de_marches" DESC, "District";"},{"question":"Quels marchés ont une valeur totale de stock supérieure à 100000, en valorisant chaque téléphone à son prix ?","sql":"SELECT m."Market_ID", m."District", SUM(pm."Num_of_stock" * p."Price") AS "valeur_du_stock"
FROM "market" AS m
JOIN "phone_market" AS pm ON pm."Market_ID" = m."Market_ID"
JOIN "phone" AS p ON p."Phone_ID" = pm."Phone_ID"
GROUP BY m."Market_ID", m."District"
HAVING SUM(pm."Num_of_stock" * p."Price") > 100000
ORDER BY "valeur_du_stock" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois téléphones ayant la plus grande capacité mémoire ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Memory_in_G", "Price", "Carrier"
FROM "phone"
ORDER BY "Memory_in_G" DESC, "Price" DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels marchés ont le plus grand nombre d'employés dans leur district ?","sql":"SELECT m."Market_ID", m."District", m."Num_of_employees"
FROM "market" AS m
WHERE m."Num_of_employees" = (
    SELECT MAX(m2."Num_of_employees")
    FROM "market" AS m2
    WHERE m2."District" = m."District"
)
ORDER BY m."District", m."Market_ID";"},{"question":"Quels téléphones sont disponibles dans au moins deux marchés distincts ?","sql":"SELECT p."Phone_ID", p."Name", COUNT(DISTINCT pm."Market_ID") AS "nombre_de_marches"
FROM "phone" AS p
JOIN "phone_market" AS pm ON pm."Phone_ID" = p."Phone_ID"
GROUP BY p."Phone_ID", p."Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pm."Market_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY "nombre_de_marches" DESC, p."Name";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les fabricants et modèles des aéronefs commandés en 2020 ou après ?","sql":"SELECT \"Manufacturer\", \"Model\", \"Order_Year\" FROM \"aircraft\" WHERE \"Order_Year\" >= 2020 ORDER BY \"Order_Year\", \"Manufacturer\", \"Model\";"},{"question":"Quels pilotes sont de nationalité française, avec leur nom, leur âge et leur équipe ?","sql":"SELECT \"Pilot_name\", \"Age\", \"Team\" FROM \"pilot\" WHERE \"Nationality\" = 'Française' ORDER BY \"Pilot_name\";"},{"question":"Quels enregistrements indiquent le pilote, le modèle de l’aéronef et la date correspondante ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Pilot_name\", a.\"Model\", pr.\"Date\" FROM \"pilot_record\" AS pr JOIN \"pilot\" AS p ON p.\"Pilot_ID\" = pr.\"Pilot_ID\" JOIN \"aircraft\" AS a ON a.\"Aircraft_ID\" = pr.\"Aircraft_ID\" ORDER BY pr.\"Date\", p.\"Pilot_name\";"},{"question":"Quels pilotes n’ont encore aucun enregistrement de vol ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"Pilot_ID\", p.\"Pilot_name\" FROM \"pilot\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"pilot_record\" AS pr ON pr.\"Pilot_ID\" = p.\"Pilot_ID\" WHERE pr.\"Pilot_ID\" IS NULL ORDER BY p.\"Pilot_name\";"},{"question":"Quelles équipes ont un âge moyen des pilotes supérieur à 35 ans, et quel est cet âge moyen ?","sql":"SELECT \"Team\", ROUND(AVG(\"Age\"), 2) AS \"Age_moyen\" FROM \"pilot\" GROUP BY \"Team\" HAVING AVG(\"Age\") > 35 ORDER BY \"Age_moyen\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque aéronef, combien d’enregistrements lui sont associés, y compris ceux qui n’en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Aircraft_ID\", a.\"Manufacturer\", a.\"Model\", COUNT(pr.\"Record_ID\") AS \"Nombre_enregistrements\" FROM \"aircraft\" AS a LEFT JOIN \"pilot_record\" AS pr ON pr.\"Aircraft_ID\" = a.\"Aircraft_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Aircraft_ID\", a.\"Manufacturer\", a.\"Model\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_enregistrements\" DESC, a.\"Aircraft_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels pilotes ont un rang inférieur ou égal à 3 et ont rejoint l’organisation avant 2015 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Pilot_name\", \"Rank\", \"Join_Year\" FROM \"pilot\" WHERE \"Rank\" <= 3 AND \"Join_Year\" < 2015 ORDER BY \"Rank\", \"Join_Year\", \"Pilot_name\";"},{"question":"Quels fabricants possèdent au moins un aéronef équipé d’une propulsion électrique ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Manufacturer\" FROM \"aircraft\" WHERE \"Powertrain\" = 'Electric' ORDER BY \"Manufacturer\";"},{"question":"Quel ou quels pilotes ont enregistré le plus grand nombre d’aéronefs différents ?","sql":"WITH pilot_counts AS (SELECT p.\"Pilot_ID\", p.\"Pilot_name\", COUNT(DISTINCT pr.\"Aircraft_ID\") AS \"Nombre_aeronefs\" FROM \"pilot\" AS p LEFT JOIN \"pilot_record\" AS pr ON pr.\"Pilot_ID\" = p.\"Pilot_ID\" GROUP BY p.\"Pilot_ID\", p.\"Pilot_name\") SELECT \"Pilot_ID\", \"Pilot_name\", \"Nombre_aeronefs\" FROM pilot_counts WHERE \"Nombre_aeronefs\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Nombre_aeronefs\") FROM pilot_counts);"},{"question":"Combien d’enregistrements existent pour chaque année de la date d’enregistrement ?","sql":"SELECT substr(\"Date\", 1, 4) AS \"Annee\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_enregistrements\" FROM \"pilot_record\" GROUP BY substr(\"Date\", 1, 4) ORDER BY \"Annee\";"},{"question":"Quels aéronefs n’ont été associés qu’à un seul pilote distinct, en affichant leur constructeur et leur modèle ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Aircraft_ID\", a.\"Manufacturer\", a.\"Model\", COUNT(DISTINCT pr.\"Pilot_ID\") AS \"Nombre_pilotes\" FROM \"aircraft\" AS a JOIN \"pilot_record\" AS pr ON pr.\"Aircraft_ID\" = a.\"Aircraft_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Aircraft_ID\", a.\"Manufacturer\", a.\"Model\" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr.\"Pilot_ID\") = 1 ORDER BY a.\"Manufacturer\", a.\"Model\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les catalogues avec leur nom, leur éditeur et leur date de publication ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_name, catalog_publisher, date_of_publication
FROM Catalogs;"},{"question":"Combien de niveaux contient chaque catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT c.catalog_id, c.catalog_name, COUNT(s.catalog_level_number) AS nombre_de_niveaux
FROM Catalogs AS c
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Structure AS s ON s.catalog_id = c.catalog_id
GROUP BY c.catalog_id, c.catalog_name;"},{"question":"Quels catalogues ont été révisés après leur date de publication ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_id, catalog_name, date_of_publication, date_of_latest_revision
FROM Catalogs
WHERE date_of_latest_revision > date_of_publication;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms et types de toutes les définitions d’attributs, triés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT attribute_name, attribute_data_type
FROM Attribute_Definitions
ORDER BY attribute_name;"},{"question":"Combien de définitions d’attributs existent pour chaque type de données ?","sql":"SELECT attribute_data_type, COUNT(*) AS nombre_attributs
FROM Attribute_Definitions
GROUP BY attribute_data_type
ORDER BY nombre_attributs DESC;"},{"question":"Quels niveaux de catalogue appartiennent à un catalogue publié en premier ?","sql":"SELECT s.catalog_level_number, s.catalog_level_name, c.catalog_name, c.date_of_publication
FROM Catalog_Structure AS s
JOIN Catalogs AS c ON c.catalog_id = s.catalog_id
WHERE c.date_of_publication = (SELECT MIN(date_of_publication) FROM Catalogs);"},{"question":"Quels articles possèdent un prix en dollars supérieur à 100 ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, price_in_dollars
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE price_in_dollars > 100
ORDER BY price_in_dollars DESC;"},{"question":"Quels articles n’ont aucun prix renseigné dans les trois devises ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE price_in_dollars IS NULL
  AND price_in_euros IS NULL
  AND price_in_pounds IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen en euros des articles qui en disposent ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(price_in_euros) AS prix_moyen_en_euros
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE price_in_euros IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque niveau, quel est le nombre d’articles et le prix moyen en dollars ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_level_number,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles,
       AVG(price_in_dollars) AS prix_moyen_en_dollars
FROM Catalog_Contents
GROUP BY catalog_level_number
ORDER BY catalog_level_number;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont une capacité renseignée et une largeur non renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, capacity, width
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL
  AND width IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels articles sont reliés à un article précédent et à un article suivant ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, previous_entry_id, next_entry_id
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE previous_entry_id IS NOT NULL
  AND next_entry_id IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les articles dont le nom commence par « Pro » ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, product_stock_number
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE catalog_entry_name LIKE 'Pro%';"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un numéro de stock renseigné, triés par numéro de stock ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, product_stock_number
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE product_stock_number IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY product_stock_number;"},{"question":"Quel est l’article le plus cher en dollars ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, price_in_dollars
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE price_in_dollars = (SELECT MAX(price_in_dollars) FROM Catalog_Contents);"},{"question":"Quels articles ont un prix en dollars supérieur au prix moyen en dollars ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, price_in_dollars
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE price_in_dollars > (SELECT AVG(price_in_dollars) FROM Catalog_Contents)
ORDER BY price_in_dollars DESC;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont une capacité contenant le texte « Go » ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, capacity
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE capacity LIKE '%Go%';"},{"question":"Quels attributs supplémentaires sont associés à chaque article ?","sql":"SELECT ca.catalog_entry_id,
       c.catalog_entry_name,
       ad.attribute_name,
       ca.attribute_value
FROM Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes AS ca
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS c ON c.catalog_entry_id = ca.catalog_entry_id
JOIN Attribute_Definitions AS ad ON ad.attribute_id = ca.attribute_id
ORDER BY ca.catalog_entry_id, ad.attribute_name;"},{"question":"Quels articles possèdent au moins deux attributs supplémentaires ?","sql":"SELECT ca.catalog_entry_id,
       c.catalog_entry_name,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_attributs
FROM Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes AS ca
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS c ON c.catalog_entry_id = ca.catalog_entry_id
GROUP BY ca.catalog_entry_id, c.catalog_entry_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quelles valeurs ont été enregistrées pour l’attribut nommé « Couleur » ?","sql":"SELECT ca.catalog_entry_id, c.catalog_entry_name, ca.attribute_value
FROM Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes AS ca
JOIN Attribute_Definitions AS ad ON ad.attribute_id = ca.attribute_id
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS c ON c.catalog_entry_id = ca.catalog_entry_id
WHERE ad.attribute_name = 'Couleur';"},{"question":"Combien de valeurs supplémentaires sont enregistrées pour chaque définition d’attribut ?","sql":"SELECT ad.attribute_id,
       ad.attribute_name,
       COUNT(ca.catalog_entry_id) AS nombre_de_valeurs
FROM Attribute_Definitions AS ad
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes AS ca
  ON ca.attribute_id = ad.attribute_id
GROUP BY ad.attribute_id, ad.attribute_name
ORDER BY ad.attribute_name;"},{"question":"Quels niveaux de catalogue ne contiennent aucun article ?","sql":"SELECT s.catalog_level_number, s.catalog_level_name
FROM Catalog_Structure AS s
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Contents AS c
  ON c.catalog_level_number = s.catalog_level_number
WHERE c.catalog_entry_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels catalogues contiennent au moins un article dont le prix en euros dépasse 500 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT cat.catalog_id, cat.catalog_name
FROM Catalogs AS cat
JOIN Catalog_Structure AS s ON s.catalog_id = cat.catalog_id
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS c ON c.catalog_level_number = s.catalog_level_number
WHERE c.price_in_euros > 500;"},{"question":"Pour chaque catalogue, quel est le nombre total d’articles présents dans ses niveaux ?","sql":"SELECT cat.catalog_id,
       cat.catalog_name,
       COUNT(cc.catalog_entry_id) AS nombre_total_articles
FROM Catalogs AS cat
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Structure AS s ON s.catalog_id = cat.catalog_id
LEFT JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_level_number = s.catalog_level_number
GROUP BY cat.catalog_id, cat.catalog_name;"},{"question":"Quels articles appartiennent à un niveau dont le nom contient « produit » ?","sql":"SELECT cc.catalog_entry_id,
       cc.catalog_entry_name,
       s.catalog_level_name
FROM Catalog_Contents AS cc
JOIN Catalog_Structure AS s
  ON s.catalog_level_number = cc.catalog_level_number
WHERE LOWER(s.catalog_level_name) LIKE '%produit%';"},{"question":"Quel est le prix minimal, maximal et moyen en livres sterling par catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT cat.catalog_id,
       cat.catalog_name,
       MIN(cc.price_in_pounds) AS prix_minimal,
       MAX(cc.price_in_pounds) AS prix_maximal,
       AVG(cc.price_in_pounds) AS prix_moyen
FROM Catalogs AS cat
JOIN Catalog_Structure AS s ON s.catalog_id = cat.catalog_id
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_level_number = s.catalog_level_number
GROUP BY cat.catalog_id, cat.catalog_name;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont des dimensions complètes, c’est-à-dire une longueur, une hauteur et une largeur renseignées ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, length, height, width
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  AND height IS NOT NULL
  AND width IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont le même prix en dollars et en euros ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, price_in_dollars, price_in_euros
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE price_in_dollars IS NOT NULL
  AND price_in_euros IS NOT NULL
  AND price_in_dollars = price_in_euros;"},{"question":"Pour chaque niveau, quel article possède le prix en dollars le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT cc.catalog_level_number,
       cc.catalog_entry_id,
       cc.catalog_entry_name,
       cc.price_in_dollars
FROM Catalog_Contents AS cc
WHERE cc.price_in_dollars = (
    SELECT MAX(cc2.price_in_dollars)
    FROM Catalog_Contents AS cc2
    WHERE cc2.catalog_level_number = cc.catalog_level_number
);"},{"question":"Quels articles n’ont ni article précédent ni article suivant ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE previous_entry_id IS NULL
  AND next_entry_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels niveaux sont ordonnés par un article précédent mais n’ont pas d’article suivant ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_level_number, catalog_entry_id, catalog_entry_name, previous_entry_id, next_entry_id
FROM Catalog_Contents
WHERE previous_entry_id IS NOT NULL
  AND next_entry_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d’articles par année de publication du catalogue ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', cat.date_of_publication) AS annee_publication,
       COUNT(cc.catalog_entry_id) AS nombre_articles
FROM Catalogs AS cat
JOIN Catalog_Structure AS s ON s.catalog_id = cat.catalog_id
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_level_number = s.catalog_level_number
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', cat.date_of_publication)
ORDER BY annee_publication;"},{"question":"Quels éditeurs publient plusieurs catalogues ?","sql":"SELECT catalog_publisher, COUNT(*) AS nombre_catalogues
FROM Catalogs
GROUP BY catalog_publisher
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont une valeur d’attribut supplémentaire contenant le mot « noir » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT cc.catalog_entry_id,
       cc.catalog_entry_name,
       ca.attribute_value
FROM Catalog_Contents_Additional_Attributes AS ca
JOIN Catalog_Contents AS cc ON cc.catalog_entry_id = ca.catalog_entry_id
WHERE LOWER(ca.attribute_value) LIKE '%noir%';"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels produits ont un coût de location quotidien supérieur au coût quotidien moyen de tous les produits ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, daily_hire_cost
FROM Products_for_Hire
WHERE daily_hire_cost > (SELECT AVG(daily_hire_cost) FROM Products_for_Hire)
ORDER BY daily_hire_cost DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont au moins une réservation avec un montant restant dû supérieur à zéro ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Bookings AS b ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE b.amount_outstanding > 0
ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"},{"question":"Combien de réservations ont été commencées au cours de chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', booking_start_date) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_reservations
FROM Bookings
WHERE booking_start_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', booking_start_date)
ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels coupons n'ont encore été associés à aucun client ?","sql":"SELECT dc.coupon_id, dc.date_issued, dc.coupon_amount
FROM Discount_Coupons AS dc
LEFT JOIN Customers AS c ON c.coupon_id = dc.coupon_id
WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
ORDER BY dc.date_issued;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client, quel est le montant total de ses paiements enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_paid), 0) AS total_paye
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Payments AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY total_paye DESC;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont été retournés en retard au moins cinq fois ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_retours_en_retard
FROM Products_for_Hire AS p
JOIN Products_Booked AS pb ON pb.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE pb.returned_late_yn = 'Y'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY nombre_retours_en_retard DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque produit, quelle est la date la plus récente à laquelle sa disponibilité a été enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, MAX(status_date) AS derniere_date_de_statut
FROM View_Product_Availability
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations ont duré plus de sept jours entre leur début et leur fin ?","sql":"SELECT booking_id, customer_id, booking_start_date, booking_end_date,
       julianday(booking_end_date) - julianday(booking_start_date) AS duree_en_jours
FROM Bookings
WHERE booking_start_date IS NOT NULL
  AND booking_end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(booking_end_date) - julianday(booking_start_date) > 7
ORDER BY duree_en_jours DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont effectué au moins trois réservations, avec le nombre de réservations et leur montant moyen payable ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name,
       COUNT(b.booking_id) AS nombre_reservations,
       AVG(b.amount_payable) AS montant_moyen_payable
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Bookings AS b ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING COUNT(b.booking_id) >= 3
ORDER BY nombre_reservations DESC, c.last_name;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions présentent un montant payé différent du montant dû ?","sql":"SELECT payment_id, booking_id, customer_id, amount_due, amount_paid,
       amount_paid - amount_due AS ecart
FROM Payments
WHERE amount_due IS NOT NULL
  AND amount_paid IS NOT NULL
  AND amount_paid <> amount_due
ORDER BY ABS(amount_paid - amount_due) DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq produits ayant généré les montants réservés cumulés les plus élevés ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name,
       SUM(pb.booked_amount) AS montant_total_reserve
FROM Products_for_Hire AS p
JOIN Products_Booked AS pb ON pb.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY montant_total_reserve DESC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quelles réservations comportaient au moins un produit retourné endommagé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT b.booking_id, b.customer_id, b.booking_start_date,
       b.booking_end_date
FROM Bookings AS b
JOIN Products_Booked AS pb ON pb.booking_id = b.booking_id
WHERE b.returned_damaged_yn = 'Y'
ORDER BY b.booking_start_date;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont aucune réservation enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.date_became_customer
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Bookings AS b ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;"}]}

?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre) AS moyenne_de_caracteristiques FROM (SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(pc.characteristic_id) AS nombre FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id Ref_Characteristic_Types AS t JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_type_code = t.characteristic_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix d’achat non numérique ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_buying_price FROM Products WHERE typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(typical_buying_price) <> '' AND CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL) = 0 AND typical_buying_price NOT LIKE '0%';"},{"question":"Combien de produits chaque catégorie contient-elle, y compris les catégories vides ?","sql":"SELECT c.product_category_code, c.product_category_description, COUNT(p.product_id) AS nombre_de_produits FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS c LEFT JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_category_code = c.product_category_code GROUP BY c.product_category_code, c.product_category_description;"},{"question":"Quelles caractéristiques sont utilisées par plus d’un produit ?","sql":"SELECT c.characteristic_id, c.characteristic_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.product_id) AS nombre_de_produits FROM Characteristics AS c JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.characteristic_id = c.characteristic_id GROUP BY c.characteristic_id, c.characteristic_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.product_id) > 1;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une valeur de caractéristique contenant le mot « oui » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id WHERE LOWER(pc.product_characteristic_value) LIKE '%oui%';"},{"question":"Quelle est la longueur moyenne des descriptions de produits ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(LENGTH(product_description)) AS longueur_moyenne FROM Products WHERE product_description IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont le même code de catégorie que le produit d’identifiant minimal ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, product_category_code FROM Products WHERE product_category_code = (SELECT product_category_code FROM Products ORDER BY product_id LIMIT 1);"},{"question":"Quelles couleurs sont utilisées par des produits dont le prix de vente dépasse 100 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.color_code, c.color_description FROM Ref_Colors AS c JOIN Products AS p ON p.color_code = c.color_code WHERE CAST(p.typical_selling_price AS REAL) > 100;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une caractéristique dont le nom contient « taille » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_id = pc.characteristic_id WHERE LOWER(c.characteristic_name) LIKE '%taille%';"},{"question":"Combien de valeurs de caractéristiques distinctes sont enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_characteristic_value) AS nombre_de_valeurs_distinctes FROM Product_Characteristics WHERE product_characteristic_value IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont des détails complémentaires renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, other_product_details FROM Products WHERE other_product_details IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(other_product_details) <> NULL;"},{"question":"Quel produit possède le plus grand nombre de caractéristiques ?","sql":"WITH comptes AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(pc.characteristic_id) AS n FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name) SELECT product_id, product_name, n AS nombre_de_caracteristiques FROM comptes WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM comptes);"},{"question":"Quels produits appartiennent à une catégorie dont l’unité de mesure est renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.unit_of_measure FROM Products AS p JOIN Ref_Product_Categories AS c ON c.product_category_code = p.product_category_code WHERE c.unit_of_measure IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.unit_of_measure) <> '';"},{"question":"Quels codes de catégorie sont utilisés par plusieurs produits ?","sql":"SELECT product_category_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_produits FROM Products GROUP BY product_category_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;"},{"question":"Quelles caractéristiques n’ont jamais de valeur renseignée dans les associations ?","sql":"SELECT c.characteristic_id, c.characteristic_name FROM Characteristics AS c LEFT JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.characteristic_id = c.characteristic_id AND pc.product_characteristic_value IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pc.product_characteristic_value) <> '' WHERE pc.characteristic_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un écart de prix vente-achat supérieur à 50 ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) - CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL) AS ecart FROM Products WHERE typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL AND typical_selling_price IS NOT NULL AND CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL) - CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL) > 50;"},{"question":"Combien de produits sont associés à chaque type de caractéristique ?","sql":"SELECT t.characteristic_type_code, t.characteristic_type_description, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.product_id) AS nombre_de_produits FROM Ref_Characteristic_Types AS t JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_type_code = t.characteristic_type_code JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.characteristic_id = c.characteristic_id GROUP BY t.characteristic_type_code, t.characteristic_type_description;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont exactement une association de caractéristique ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Quelles descriptions de catégories contiennent le mot « maison » ?","sql":"SELECT product_category_code, product_category_description FROM Ref_Product_Categories WHERE LOWER(product_category_description) LIKE '%maison%';"},{"question":"Quels produits n’ont pas de couleur correspondante dans le référentiel ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.color_code FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Ref_Colors AS c ON c.color_code = p.color_code WHERE c.color_code IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels codes de type de caractéristique sont utilisés par plusieurs caractéristiques ?","sql":"SELECT characteristic_type_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_caracteristiques FROM Characteristics GROUP BY characteristic_type_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;"},{"question":"Affichez les produits dont le nom contient au moins huit caractères.","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products WHERE LENGTH(product_name) >= 8;"},{"question":"Quelle est la plus petite valeur de prix d’achat numérique renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL)) AS prix_d_achat_minimal FROM Products WHERE typical_buying_price IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une caractéristique et appartiennent à la catégorie la plus représentée ?","sql":"WITH categorie_majoritaire AS (SELECT product_category_code FROM Products GROUP BY product_category_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, product_category_code LIMIT 1) SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p JOIN categorie_majoritaire AS cm ON cm.product_category_code = p.product_category_code JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id;"},{"question":"Quelles associations relient un produit à une caractéristique de type booléen ?","sql":"SELECT pc.product_id, pc.characteristic_id, pc.product_characteristic_value FROM Product_Characteristics AS pc JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_id = pc.characteristic_id WHERE LOWER(c.characteristic_data_type) IN ('boolean', 'bool');"},{"question":"Combien de produits ont une description non vide ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_produits FROM Products WHERE product_description IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(product_description) <> '';"},{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix de vente égal à leur prix d’achat ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name, typical_buying_price, typical_selling_price FROM Products WHERE CAST(typical_buying_price AS REAL) = CAST(typical_selling_price AS REAL);"},{"question":"Quelles couleurs ne sont utilisées que par un seul produit ?","sql":"SELECT color_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_produits FROM Products GROUP BY color_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Quels types de caractéristiques ont au moins une caractéristique sans détail complémentaire ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.characteristic_type_code, t.characteristic_type_description FROM Ref_Characteristic_Types AS t JOIN Characteristics AS c ON c.characteristic_type_code = t.characteristic_type_code WHERE c.other_characteristic_details IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq derniers produits selon leur identifiant ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products ORDER BY product_id DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quel est le total des associations produit-caractéristique ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_d_associations FROM Product_Characteristics;"},{"question":"Quelles catégories ont au moins un produit sans prix de vente ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.product_category_code, c.product_category_description FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS c JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_category_code = c.product_category_code WHERE p.typical_selling_price IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels produits ont une caractéristique dont la valeur est exactement « rouge » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Characteristics AS pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id WHERE LOWER(pc.product_characteristic_value) = 'rouge';"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les propriétaires des chaînes, classés par nom ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Owner"
FROM "channel"
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Quels programmes ont été lancés après le lancement moyen de tous les programmes ?","sql":"SELECT "Program_ID", "Name", "Launch"
FROM "program"
WHERE "Launch" > (SELECT AVG("Launch") FROM "program")
ORDER BY "Launch";"},{"question":"Quels programmes sont diffusés sur quelles chaînes, et à quel moment de la journée ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Channel_Name", p."Name" AS "Program_Name", b."Time_of_day"
FROM "broadcast" AS b
JOIN "channel" AS c ON c."Channel_ID" = b."Channel_ID"
JOIN "program" AS p ON p."Program_ID" = b."Program_ID"
ORDER BY c."Name", p."Name";"},{"question":"Combien de programmes appartiennent à chaque origine ?","sql":"SELECT "Origin", COUNT(*) AS "Program_Count"
FROM "program"
GROUP BY "Origin"
ORDER BY "Program_Count" DESC, "Origin";"},{"question":"Quelle chaîne possède la meilleure note d'audience ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Rating_in_percent"
FROM "channel"
WHERE "Rating_in_percent" = (SELECT MAX("Rating_in_percent") FROM "channel");"},{"question":"Quelles diffusions ont une part d'audience supérieure à 20 % ?","sql":"SELECT "Channel_ID", "Program_ID", "Date", "Share_in_percent"
FROM "broadcast_share"
WHERE "Share_in_percent" > 20
ORDER BY "Share_in_percent" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels programmes ne sont associés à aucune diffusion ?","sql":"SELECT p."Program_ID", p."Name"
FROM "program" AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "broadcast" AS b
    WHERE b."Program_ID" = p."Program_ID"
)
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles chaînes ont une note d'audience supérieure à leur part de marché ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Share_in_percent", "Rating_in_percent"
FROM "channel"
WHERE "Rating_in_percent" > "Share_in_percent"
ORDER BY "Rating_in_percent" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le lancement moyen des programmes pour chaque propriétaire ?","sql":"SELECT "Owner", AVG("Launch") AS "Average_Launch"
FROM "program"
GROUP BY "Owner"
ORDER BY "Average_Launch";"},{"question":"Quel est le programme lancé le plus récemment ?","sql":"SELECT "Program_ID", "Name", "Launch"
FROM "program"
WHERE "Launch" = (SELECT MAX("Launch") FROM "program");"},{"question":"Quelle chaîne diffuse le plus de programmes ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name", COUNT(*) AS "Broadcast_Count"
FROM "channel" AS c
JOIN "broadcast" AS b ON b."Channel_ID" = c."Channel_ID"
GROUP BY c."Channel_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Broadcast_Count" DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque diffusion ayant une part d'audience mesurée, quels sont la chaîne, le programme et cette part ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Channel_Name", p."Name" AS "Program_Name", bs."Share_in_percent"
FROM "broadcast_share" AS bs
JOIN "channel" AS c ON c."Channel_ID" = bs."Channel_ID"
JOIN "program" AS p ON p."Program_ID" = bs."Program_ID"
ORDER BY bs."Share_in_percent" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles diffusions ont un moment de la journée renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT "Channel_ID", "Program_ID", "Time_of_day"
FROM "broadcast"
WHERE "Time_of_day" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Time_of_day";"},{"question":"Quels propriétaires apparaissent à la fois parmi les chaînes et parmi les programmes ?","sql":"SELECT "Owner"
FROM "channel"
INTERSECT
SELECT "Owner"
FROM "program"
ORDER BY "Owner";"},{"question":"Quelle est la part d'audience moyenne des programmes pour chaque chaîne ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name", AVG(bs."Share_in_percent") AS "Average_Program_Share"
FROM "channel" AS c
JOIN "broadcast_share" AS bs ON bs."Channel_ID" = c."Channel_ID"
GROUP BY c."Channel_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Average_Program_Share" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels programmes sont diffusés par une chaîne dont le propriétaire est le même que celui du programme ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p."Name" AS "Program_Name", c."Name" AS "Channel_Name", p."Owner"
FROM "broadcast" AS b
JOIN "program" AS p ON p."Program_ID" = b."Program_ID"
JOIN "channel" AS c ON c."Channel_ID" = b."Channel_ID"
WHERE p."Owner" = c."Owner"
ORDER BY p."Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque origine, quels sont les lancements le plus ancien et le plus récent ?","sql":"SELECT "Origin", MIN("Launch") AS "Earliest_Launch", MAX("Launch") AS "Latest_Launch"
FROM "program"
GROUP BY "Origin"
ORDER BY "Origin";"},{"question":"Quelles chaînes ne diffusent aucun programme ?","sql":"SELECT c."Channel_ID", c."Name"
FROM "channel" AS c
LEFT JOIN "broadcast" AS b ON b."Channel_ID" = c."Channel_ID"
WHERE b."Channel_ID" IS NULL
ORDER BY c."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois chaînes ayant les meilleures notes d'audience ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Rating_in_percent"
FROM "channel"
ORDER BY "Rating_in_percent" DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels programmes ont été lancés après 2010 et quel est leur propriétaire ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Launch", "Owner"
FROM "program"
WHERE "Launch" > 2010
ORDER BY "Launch", "Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la date la plus récente enregistrée pour chaque chaîne dans les données de part d'audience ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name", MAX(bs."Date") AS "Latest_Date"
FROM "broadcast_share" AS bs
JOIN "channel" AS c ON c."Channel_ID" = bs."Channel_ID"
GROUP BY c."Channel_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Latest_Date" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de diffusions sont prévues pour chaque moment de la journée ?","sql":"SELECT "Time_of_day", COUNT(*) AS "Broadcast_Count"
FROM "broadcast"
GROUP BY "Time_of_day"
ORDER BY "Broadcast_Count" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles chaînes ont une part de marché supérieure à la part de marché moyenne de toutes les chaînes ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Share_in_percent"
FROM "channel"
WHERE "Share_in_percent" > (SELECT AVG("Share_in_percent") FROM "channel")
ORDER BY "Share_in_percent" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels programmes ont un nom contenant le mot « news », sans tenir compte de la casse ?","sql":"SELECT "Program_ID", "Name"
FROM "program"
WHERE LOWER("Name") LIKE '%news%'
ORDER BY "Name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque chaîne, combien de programmes sont diffusés, y compris celles qui n'en diffusent aucun ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name", COUNT(b."Program_ID") AS "Program_Count"
FROM "channel" AS c
LEFT JOIN "broadcast" AS b ON b."Channel_ID" = c."Channel_ID"
GROUP BY c."Channel_ID", c."Name"
ORDER BY "Program_Count" DESC, c."Name";"},{"question":"Quels propriétaires gèrent au moins deux programmes ?","sql":"SELECT "Owner", COUNT(*) AS "Program_Count"
FROM "program"
GROUP BY "Owner"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Program_Count" DESC, "Owner";"},{"question":"Quels programmes originaires d'une origine donnée sont diffusés sur une chaîne ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p."Name", p."Origin", c."Name" AS "Channel_Name"
FROM "program" AS p
JOIN "broadcast" AS b ON b."Program_ID" = p."Program_ID"
JOIN "channel" AS c ON c."Channel_ID" = b."Channel_ID"
WHERE p."Origin" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p."Origin", p."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la différence entre la meilleure et la moins bonne note d'audience des chaînes ?","sql":"SELECT MAX("Rating_in_percent") - MIN("Rating_in_percent") AS "Rating_Range"
FROM "channel";"},{"question":"Quels couples chaîne-programme ont une part d'audience supérieure à la moyenne de toutes les parts enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT c."Name" AS "Channel_Name", p."Name" AS "Program_Name", bs."Share_in_percent"
FROM "broadcast_share" AS bs
JOIN "channel" AS c ON c."Channel_ID" = bs."Channel_ID"
JOIN "program" AS p ON p."Program_ID" = bs."Program_ID"
WHERE bs."Share_in_percent" > (SELECT AVG("Share_in_percent") FROM "broadcast_share")
ORDER BY bs."Share_in_percent" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles protéines ont une longueur de séquence supérieure à la longueur moyenne de toutes les protéines ?","sql":"SELECT "common_name", "protein_name", "sequence_length"
FROM "protein"
WHERE "sequence_length" > (SELECT AVG("sequence_length") FROM "protein");"},{"question":"Quelles institutions ont été fondées après 1900 et comptent plus de 10 000 étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT "Institution", "Founded", "Enrollment"
FROM "Institution"
WHERE "Founded" > 1900
  AND "Enrollment" > 10000;"},{"question":"Quel est le bâtiment qui possède le plus grand nombre d'étages ?","sql":"SELECT "building_id", "Name", "Floors"
FROM "building"
WHERE "Floors" = (SELECT MAX("Floors") FROM "building");"},{"question":"Pour chaque protéine, quelle institution lui est associée et dans quelle ville se trouve cette institution ?","sql":"SELECT p."common_name", p."protein_name", i."Institution", i."Location"
FROM "protein" AS p
JOIN "Institution" AS i ON p."Institution_id" = i."Institution_id";"},{"question":"Combien de protéines sont associées à chaque institution, y compris les institutions sans protéine ?","sql":"SELECT i."Institution_id", i."Institution", COUNT(p."common_name") AS "protein_count"
FROM "Institution" AS i
LEFT JOIN "protein" AS p ON p."Institution_id" = i."Institution_id"
GROUP BY i."Institution_id", i."Institution";"},{"question":"Quelles institutions ont une équipe et une conférence principale renseignées ?","sql":"SELECT "Institution", "Team", "Primary_Conference"
FROM "Institution"
WHERE "Team" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Primary_Conference" IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les cinq protéines dont la séquence est la plus longue ?","sql":"SELECT "common_name", "protein_name", "sequence_length"
FROM "protein"
ORDER BY "sequence_length" DESC
LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quelles institutions ne sont associées à aucune protéine ?","sql":"SELECT i."Institution_id", i."Institution"
FROM "Institution" AS i
LEFT JOIN "protein" AS p ON p."Institution_id" = i."Institution_id"
WHERE p."common_name" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle est l'institution la plus ancienne parmi celles dont l'année de fondation est connue ?","sql":"SELECT "Institution", "Founded"
FROM "Institution"
WHERE "Founded" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Founded" ASC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels bâtiments mesurent au moins 500 pieds et comportent au moins 30 étages ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Height_feet", "Floors"
FROM "building"
WHERE "Height_feet" >= 500
  AND "Floors" >= 30;"},{"question":"Combien d'institutions appartiennent à chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT "Type", COUNT(*) AS "institution_count"
FROM "Institution"
GROUP BY "Type"
ORDER BY "institution_count" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque conférence principale, quel est le nombre total d'étudiants inscrits dans les institutions correspondantes ?","sql":"SELECT "Primary_Conference", SUM("Enrollment") AS "total_enrollment"
FROM "Institution"
WHERE "Primary_Conference" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "Primary_Conference";"},{"question":"Quelles protéines ont une divergence de lignée supérieure à la divergence moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT "common_name", "protein_name", "divergence_from_human_lineage"
FROM "protein"
WHERE "divergence_from_human_lineage" > (
    SELECT AVG("divergence_from_human_lineage")
    FROM "protein"
);"},{"question":"Quels bâtiments sont liés à des institutions situées à la même adresse que le bâtiment ?","sql":"SELECT i."Institution", b."Name", i."Location", b."Street_address"
FROM "Institution" AS i
JOIN "building" AS b ON i."building_id" = b."building_id"
WHERE i."Location" = b."Street_address";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les dates de toutes les courses, avec le nom du circuit associé ?","sql":"SELECT r."Name" AS race_name, r."Date", t."Name" AS track_name
FROM "race" AS r
LEFT JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID";"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont une capacité d'accueil supérieure à 50 000 places ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Location", "Seating"
FROM "track"
WHERE "Seating" > 50000;"},{"question":"Combien de courses sont associées à chaque circuit, y compris les circuits sans course ?","sql":"SELECT t."Name" AS track_name, COUNT(r."Race_ID") AS race_count
FROM "track" AS t
LEFT JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name";"},{"question":"Quelle est la capacité moyenne des circuits pour chaque lieu ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", AVG("Seating") AS average_seating
FROM "track"
GROUP BY "Location";"},{"question":"Pour chaque circuit, quelle est la date de sa première course connue ?","sql":"SELECT t."Name" AS track_name, MIN(r."Date") AS first_race_date
FROM "track" AS t
JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les différentes classes de course présentes dans la base ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT "Class"
FROM "race"
ORDER BY "Class";"},{"question":"Quels circuits n'ont encore aucune course associée ?","sql":"SELECT t."Name", t."Location"
FROM "track" AS t
LEFT JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
WHERE r."Race_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le circuit ayant la plus grande capacité d'accueil ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Location", "Seating"
FROM "track"
WHERE "Seating" = (SELECT MAX("Seating") FROM "track");"},{"question":"Quelles courses ont eu lieu entre le 1er janvier 2020 et le 31 décembre 2020, dates incluses ?","sql":"SELECT "Race_ID", "Name", "Class", "Date"
FROM "race"
WHERE "Date" BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
ORDER BY "Date";"},{"question":"Quel circuit a accueilli le plus grand nombre de courses ?","sql":"SELECT t."Name" AS track_name, COUNT(r."Race_ID") AS race_count
FROM "track" AS t
JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name"
ORDER BY race_count DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Affichez chaque course avec son lieu et l'année d'ouverture de son circuit.","sql":"SELECT r."Name" AS race_name, t."Location", t."Year_Opened"
FROM "race" AS r
JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID";"},{"question":"Combien de courses existe-t-il dans chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT "Class", COUNT(*) AS race_count
FROM "race"
GROUP BY "Class"
ORDER BY race_count DESC;"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont une capacité supérieure à la capacité moyenne de tous les circuits ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Seating"
FROM "track"
WHERE "Seating" > (SELECT AVG("Seating") FROM "track")
ORDER BY "Seating" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles courses se sont déroulées sur des circuits ouverts avant l'an 2000 ?","sql":"SELECT r."Name" AS race_name, r."Date", t."Name" AS track_name, t."Year_Opened"
FROM "race" AS r
JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID"
WHERE t."Year_Opened" < 2000;"},{"question":"Combien de courses sont enregistrées pour chaque année de date ?","sql":"SELECT substr("Date", 1, 4) AS race_year, COUNT(*) AS race_count
FROM "race"
GROUP BY substr("Date", 1, 4)
ORDER BY race_year;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date de la course la plus récente et quel est son nom ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Date"
FROM "race"
WHERE "Date" = (SELECT MAX("Date") FROM "race");"},{"question":"Quels circuits sont situés dans un lieu contenant le mot « Park » ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Location"
FROM "track"
WHERE "Location" LIKE '%Park%';"},{"question":"Quelles courses ont lieu sur le circuit dont la capacité est maximale ?","sql":"SELECT r."Name" AS race_name, r."Date", t."Name" AS track_name
FROM "race" AS r
JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID"
WHERE t."Seating" = (SELECT MAX("Seating") FROM "track");"},{"question":"Pour chaque circuit utilisé, quelle est la date la plus récente de course et combien de courses y sont disputées ?","sql":"SELECT t."Name" AS track_name, MAX(r."Date") AS latest_race_date, COUNT(*) AS race_count
FROM "track" AS t
JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name";"},{"question":"Quelles courses ont un identifiant de circuit qui ne correspond à aucun circuit enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT r."Race_ID", r."Name", r."Track_ID"
FROM "race" AS r
LEFT JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID"
WHERE t."Track_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les capacités minimale et maximale des circuits ?","sql":"SELECT MIN("Seating") AS minimum_seating, MAX("Seating") AS maximum_seating
FROM "track";"},{"question":"Quelles classes comptent au moins deux courses ?","sql":"SELECT "Class", COUNT(*) AS race_count
FROM "race"
GROUP BY "Class"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont accueilli au moins une course après le 1er janvier 2021 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t."Name", t."Location"
FROM "track" AS t
JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
WHERE r."Date" > '2021-01-01';"},{"question":"Classez les circuits par nombre de courses accueillies, du plus fréquenté au moins fréquenté, en incluant ceux sans course.","sql":"SELECT t."Name" AS track_name, COUNT(r."Race_ID") AS race_count
FROM "track" AS t
LEFT JOIN "race" AS r ON r."Track_ID" = t."Track_ID"
GROUP BY t."Track_ID", t."Name"
ORDER BY race_count DESC, track_name;"},{"question":"Quelles courses appartiennent à la même classe qu'au moins une autre course ?","sql":"SELECT "Race_ID", "Name", "Class"
FROM "race" AS r
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "race" AS r2
    WHERE r2."Class" = r."Class"
      AND r2."Race_ID" <> r."Race_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quels circuits ont ouvert entre 1990 et 1999 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Location", "Year_Opened"
FROM "track"
WHERE "Year_Opened" BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999
ORDER BY "Year_Opened";"},{"question":"Quelle course possède l'identifiant le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT "Race_ID", "Name", "Class", "Date"
FROM "race"
ORDER BY "Race_ID" DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque lieu, combien de circuits et quelle capacité moyenne sont enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS track_count, AVG("Seating") AS average_seating
FROM "track"
GROUP BY "Location";"},{"question":"Quelles courses ont lieu sur un circuit ayant une capacité inférieure à 20 000 places ?","sql":"SELECT r."Name" AS race_name, r."Date", t."Name" AS track_name, t."Seating"
FROM "race" AS r
JOIN "track" AS t ON t."Track_ID" = r."Track_ID"
WHERE t."Seating" < 20000;"},{"question":"Donnez, pour chaque classe, la date de la première course et celle de la dernière course.","sql":"SELECT "Class", MIN("Date") AS first_date, MAX("Date") AS last_date
FROM "race"
GROUP BY "Class";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois circuits les plus anciens ?","sql":"SELECT "Name", "Location", "Year_Opened"
FROM "track"
ORDER BY "Year_Opened" ASC
LIMIT 3;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les managers qui travaillent en France ?","sql":"SELECT \"Manager_ID\", \"Name\", \"Country\" FROM \"manager\" WHERE \"Country\" = 'France';"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies ferroviaires ont été construites après 1900 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Railway_ID\", \"Railway\", \"Built\" FROM \"railway\" WHERE CAST(\"Built\" AS INTEGER) > 1900 ORDER BY CAST(\"Built\" AS INTEGER);"},{"question":"Quels trains circulent sur chaque compagnie ferroviaire ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"Train_Num\", t.\"Name\", r.\"Railway\" FROM \"train\" AS t JOIN \"railway\" AS r ON r.\"Railway_ID\" = t.\"Railway_ID\" ORDER BY r.\"Railway\", t.\"Train_Num\";"},{"question":"Combien de trains sont associés à chaque compagnie ferroviaire, y compris celles sans train ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Railway_ID\", r.\"Railway\", COUNT(t.\"Train_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_trains\" FROM \"railway\" AS r LEFT JOIN \"train\" AS t ON t.\"Railway_ID\" = r.\"Railway_ID\" GROUP BY r.\"Railway_ID\", r.\"Railway\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_trains\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels managers sont associés à quelles compagnies et depuis quelle année ?","sql":"SELECT m.\"Name\", r.\"Railway\", rm.\"From_Year\" FROM \"railway_manage\" AS rm JOIN \"manager\" AS m ON m.\"Manager_ID\" = rm.\"Manager_ID\" JOIN \"railway\" AS r ON r.\"Railway_ID\" = rm.\"Railway_ID\" ORDER BY m.\"Name\", rm.\"From_Year\";"},{"question":"Quel est le manager le plus âgé ?","sql":"SELECT \"Manager_ID\", \"Name\", \"Age\" FROM \"manager\" WHERE \"Age\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Age\") FROM \"manager\");"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies utilisent des roues dont la description contient « acier » ?","sql":"SELECT \"Railway_ID\", \"Railway\", \"Wheels\" FROM \"railway\" WHERE \"Wheels\" LIKE '%acier%';"},{"question":"Quels trains ont une gare de départ différente de leur gare d'arrivée ?","sql":"SELECT \"Train_ID\", \"Train_Num\", \"Name\", \"From\", \"Arrival\" FROM \"train\" WHERE COUNT(rm.\"Railway_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_compagnies\" FROM \"manager\" AS m LEFT JOIN \"railway_manage\" AS rm ON rm.\"Manager_ID\" = m.\"Manager_ID\" GROUP BY m.\"Manager_ID\", m.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_compagnies\" DESC, m.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies sont gérées par un manager nommé Martin ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT r.\"Railway_ID\", r.\"Railway\" FROM \"railway\" AS r JOIN \"railway_manage\" AS rm ON rm.\"Railway_ID\" = r.\"Railway_ID\" JOIN \"manager\" AS m ON m.\"Manager_ID\" = rm.\"Manager_ID\" WHERE m.\"Name\" = 'Martin';"},{"question":"Quelles compagnies ferroviaires ne sont associées à aucun manager ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Railway_ID\", r.\"Railway\" FROM \"railway\" AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"railway_manage\" AS rm WHERE rm.\"Railway_ID\" = r.\"Railway_ID\");"},{"question":"Combien de trains arrivent dans chaque lieu d'implantation des compagnies ferroviaires ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Location\", COUNT(t.\"Train_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_trains\" FROM \"railway\" AS r JOIN \"train\" AS t ON t.\"Railway_ID\" = r.\"Railway_ID\" GROUP BY r.\"Location\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_trains\" DESC, r.\"Location\";"},{"question":"Quels managers ont commencé à travailler entre 2000 et 2010 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT \"Manager_ID\", \"Name\", \"Working_year_starts\" FROM \"manager\" WHERE CAST(\"Working_year_starts\" AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 ORDER BY CAST(\"Working_year_starts\" AS INTEGER);"},{"question":"Quelle compagnie ferroviaire possède le plus grand nombre de trains ?","sql":"WITH train_counts AS (SELECT r.\"Railway_ID\", r.\"Railway\", COUNT(t.\"Train_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_trains\" FROM \"railway\" AS r LEFT JOIN \"train\" AS t ON t.\"Railway_ID\" = r.\"Railway_ID\" GROUP BY r.\"Railway_ID\", r.\"Railway\") SELECT \"Railway_ID\", \"Railway\", \"Nombre_de_trains\" FROM train_counts WHERE \"Nombre_de_trains\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Nombre_de_trains\") FROM train_counts);"},{"question":"Quels managers gèrent au moins une compagnie construite après 1950 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT m.\"Manager_ID\", m.\"Name\" FROM \"manager\" AS m JOIN \"railway_manage\" AS rm ON rm.\"Manager_ID\" = m.\"Manager_ID\" JOIN \"railway\" AS r ON {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les restaurants ayant une note d’au moins 4, triés par note décroissante puis par nom ?","sql":"SELECT ResID, ResName, Rating
FROM Restaurant
WHERE Rating >= 4
ORDER BY Rating DESC, ResName ASC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont au moins 21 ans et habitent dans une ville dont le code est « PAR » ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Fname, LName, Age, city_code
FROM Student
WHERE Age >= 21
  AND city_code = 'PAR'
ORDER BY LName, Fname;"},{"question":"Combien de restaurants appartiennent à chaque type, y compris les types sans restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT rt.ResTypeID,
       rt.ResTypeName,
       COUNT(tor.ResID) AS nombre_restaurants
FROM Restaurant_Type AS rt
LEFT JOIN Type_Of_Restaurant AS tor
  ON tor.ResTypeID = rt.ResTypeID
GROUP BY rt.ResTypeID, rt.ResTypeName
ORDER BY nombre_restaurants DESC, rt.ResTypeName;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont reçu au moins trois visites et quelle est la dépense moyenne par visite pour chacun ?","sql":"SELECT r.ResID,
       r.ResName,
       COUNT(v.StuID) AS nombre_visites,
       AVG(v.Spent) AS depense_moyenne
FROM Restaurant AS r
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v
  ON v.ResID = r.ResID
GROUP BY r.ResID, r.ResName
HAVING COUNT(v.StuID) >= 3
ORDER BY depense_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total dépensé par chaque étudiant dans les restaurants visités ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID,
       s.Fname,
       s.LName,
       COALESCE(SUM(v.Spent), 0) AS depense_totale
FROM Student AS s
LEFT JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v
  ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
ORDER BY depense_totale DESC, s.LName;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant, quelle est la date de sa dernière visite connue ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID,
       s.Fname,
       s.LName,
       MAX(v.Time) AS derniere_visite
FROM Student AS s
LEFT JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v
  ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
ORDER BY derniere_visite DESC;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants n’ont encore jamais été visités ?","sql":"SELECT r.ResID, r.ResName, r.Address
FROM Restaurant AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Visits_Restaurant AS v
    WHERE v.ResID = r.ResID
)
ORDER BY r.ResName;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n’ont effectué aucune visite dans un restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
FROM Student AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Visits_Restaurant AS v
    WHERE v.StuID = s.StuID
)
ORDER BY s.LName, s.Fname;"},{"question":"Pour chaque étudiant ayant effectué une visite, quelle est sa dépense la plus élevée en une seule visite ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID,
       s.Fname,
       s.LName,
       MAX(v.Spent) AS depense_maximale
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v
  ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
ORDER BY depense_maximale DESC;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont dépensé plus que la dépense moyenne de l’ensemble des visites ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID,
       s.Fname,
       s.LName,
       SUM(v.Spent) AS depense_totale
FROM Student AS s
JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v
  ON v.StuID = s.StuID
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname, s.LName
HAVING SUM(v.Spent) > (
    SELECT AVG(Spent)
    FROM Visits_Restaurant
)
ORDER BY depense_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la dépense totale enregistrée pour chaque type de restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT rt.ResTypeID,
       rt.ResTypeName,
       COALESCE(SUM(v.Spent), 0) AS depense_totale
FROM Restaurant_Type AS rt
LEFT JOIN Type_Of_Restaurant AS tor
  ON tor.ResTypeID = rt.ResTypeID
LEFT JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v
  ON v.ResID = tor.ResID
GROUP BY rt.ResTypeID, rt.ResTypeName
ORDER BY depense_totale DESC;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants ont une note supérieure à la note moyenne de tous les restaurants ?","sql":"SELECT ResID, ResName, Rating
FROM Restaurant
WHERE Rating > (
    SELECT AVG(Rating)
    FROM Restaurant
)
ORDER BY Rating DESC, ResName;"},{"question":"Combien de visites et combien d’étudiants distincts chaque restaurant a-t-il eus ?","sql":"SELECT r.ResID,
       r.ResName,
       COUNT(v.StuID) AS nombre_visites,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants
FROM Restaurant AS r
LEFT JOIN Visits_Restaurant AS v
  ON v.ResID = r.ResID
GROUP BY r.ResID, r.ResName
ORDER BY nombre_visites DESC, r.ResName;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les dépenses mensuelles totales, classées chronologiquement ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Time) AS mois,
       SUM(Spent) AS depense_totale,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_visites
FROM Visits_Restaurant
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Time)
ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quels restaurants sont associés à au moins deux types différents ?","sql":"SELECT r.ResID,
       r.ResName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT tor.ResTypeID) AS nombre_types
FROM Restaurant AS r
JOIN Type_Of_Restaurant AS tor
  ON tor.ResID = r.ResID
GROUP BY r.ResID, r.ResName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tor.ResTypeID) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_types DESC, r.ResName;"},{"question":"Pour chaque type de restaurant, quelle est la note moyenne de ses restaurants, en excluant les types sans restaurant ?","sql":"SELECT rt.ResTypeID,
       rt.ResTypeName,
       AVG(r.Rating) AS note_moyenne,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.ResID) AS nombre_restaurants
FROM Restaurant_Type AS rt
JOIN Type_Of_Restaurant AS tor
  ON tor.ResTypeID = rt.ResTypeID
JOIN Restaurant AS r
  ON r.ResID = tor.ResID
GROUP BY rt.ResTypeID, rt.ResTypeName
ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC, rt.ResTypeName;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les clubs de la région « Bretagne » fondés depuis 2000, classés du plus récent au plus ancien ?","sql":"SELECT "Club_name", "Start_year"

JOIN "club" AS c ON c."Club_ID" = co."Club_ID"
ORDER BY c."Club_name", co."Rank";"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont obtenu au moins 10 points dans les résultats de match ?","sql":"SELECT c."Club_name", mr."Points"

WHERE mr."Points" >= 10
ORDER BY mr."Points" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels joueurs ont reçu plus de 100 votes et quelle est leur profession ?","sql":"SELECT "Player_name", "Occupation", "Votes"
FROM "player"
WHERE "Votes" > 100
ORDER BY "Votes" DESC, "Player_name";"},{"question":"Quels joueurs sont suivis par un entraîneur, avec l’année de début de leur collaboration ?","sql":"SELECT p."Player_name", co."Coach_name", pc."Starting_year"
FROM "player_coach" AS pc
JOIN "player" AS p ON p."Player_ID" = pc."Player_ID"
JOIN "coach" AS co ON co."Coach_ID" = pc."Coach_ID"
ORDER BY pc."Starting_year", p."Player_name";"},{"question":"Quels clubs n’ont encore aucun entraîneur enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT c."Club_ID", c."Club_name"
FROM "club" AS c
LEFT JOIN "coach" AS co ON co."Club_ID" = c."Club_ID"
WHERE co."Coach_ID" IS NULL
ORDER BY c."Club_name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque région, quel est le total de points obtenus par les clubs qui y sont situés ?","sql":"SELECT c."Region", SUM(mr."Points") AS total_points
FROM "club" AS c
JOIN "match_result" AS mr ON mr."Club_ID" = c."Club_ID"
GROUP BY c."Region"
ORDER BY total_points DESC;"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont obtenu le plus grand nombre de points dans l’ensemble des résultats de match ?","sql":"SELECT c."Club_name", SUM(mr."Points") AS total_points
FROM "club" AS c
JOIN "match_result" AS mr ON mr."Club_ID" = c."Club_ID"
GROUP BY c."Club_ID", c."Club_name"
HAVING SUM(mr."Points") = (
    SELECT MAX(club_points)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM("Points") AS club_points
        FROM "match_result"
        GROUP BY "Club_ID"
    )
)
ORDER BY c."Club_name";"},{"question":"Quels joueurs sont associés à au moins deux entraîneurs différents ?","sql":"SELECT p."Player_name", COUNT(DISTINCT pc."Coach_ID") AS nombre_entraineurs
FROM "player" AS p
JOIN "player_coach" AS pc ON pc."Player_ID" = p."Player_ID"
GROUP BY p."Player_ID", p."Player_name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc."Coach_ID") >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_entraineurs DESC, p."Player_name";"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de votes par genre de joueur ?","sql":"SELECT "Gender", AVG("Votes") AS moyenne_votes
FROM "player"
GROUP BY "Gender"
ORDER BY "Gender";"},{"question":"Quels clubs ont un résultat classé premier et combien de médailles d’or y sont associées ?","sql":"SELECT c."Club_name", mr."Gold"

WHERE mr."Rank" = 1
ORDER BY mr."Gold" DESC, c."Club_name";"},{"question":"Pour chaque club, combien d’entraîneurs possède-t-il et quel est leur classement moyen ?","sql":"SELECT c."Club_name", COUNT(co."Coach_ID") AS nombre_entraineurs, AVG(co."Rank") AS classement_moyen
FROM "club" AS c
LEFT JOIN "coach" AS co ON co."Club_ID" = c."Club_ID"
GROUP BY c."Club_ID", c."Club_name"
ORDER BY nombre_entraineurs DESC, c."Club_name";"}]}

FROM "driver" AS d
JOIN "school_bus" AS sb ON sb."Driver_ID" = d."Driver_ID"
GROUP BY d."Driver_ID", d."Name"
HAVING AVG(sb."Years_Working") > (SELECT AVG("Years_Working") FROM "school_bus")
ORDER BY "Moyenne_annees" DESC;"}]}

scientifique, quelle est la charge totale des projets auxquels il est affecté ?","sql":"SELECT s.SSN, s.Name, COALESCE(SUM(p.Hours), 0) AS TotalHours FROM Scientists s LEFT JOIN AssignedTo a ON des projets ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Scientist) AS AssignedScientistCount FROM AssignedTo;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de projets distincts auxquels des scientifiques sont affectés ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Project) AS AssignedProjectCount FROM AssignedTo;"},{"question":"Quels couples scientifique-projet correspondent à un projet de moins de 50 heures ?","sql":"SELECT {"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms, nationalités et tonnages de tous les navires ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Nationality\", \"Tonnage\" FROM \"ship\";"},{"question":"Quelles missions ont ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Name\", MAX(m.\"Launched_Year\") AS \"Derniere_annee\" FROM \"ship\" AS s JOIN \"mission\" AS m ON m.\"Ship_ID\" = s.\"Ship_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Ship_ID\", s.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Derniere_annee\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels navires ont une vitesse moyenne de mission supérieure à la vitesse moyenne de toutes les missions ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Name\", AVG(m.\"Speed_knots\") AS BY s.\"Type\" ORDER BY \"Nombre_de_missions\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles missions ont un code commençant par la lettre M ?","sql":"SELECT \"Mission_ID\", \"Code\", \"Ship_ID\", \"Launched_Year\" FROM \"mission\" WHERE \"Code\" LIKE 'M%' ORDER BY \"Code\";"},{"question":"Affichez les missions réussies avec le nom du navire et sa nationalité.","sql":"SELECT m.\"Mission_ID\", m.\"Code\", \"Vitesse_minimale\", MAX(m.\"Speed_knots\") AS \"Vitesse_maximale\" FROM \"ship\" AS s JOIN \"mission\" AS m ON m.\"Ship_ID\" = s.\"Ship_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Ship_ID\", s.\"Name\" ORDER BY s.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quels navires n’ont jamais été associés à une mission ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Ship_ID\", s.\"Name\", s.\"Type\" FROM \"ship\" AS s LEFT JOIN \"mission\" AS m ON m.\"Ship_ID\" = s.\"Ship_ID\" WHERE m.\"Mission_ID\" IS NULL ORDER BY s.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quelle nationalité possède le tonnage moyen le plus élevé parmi ses navires ?","sql":"SELECT \"Nationality\", AVG(\"Tonnage\") AS \"Tonnage_moyen\" FROM \"ship\" GROUP BY \"Nationality\" ORDER BY \"Tonnage_moyen\" DESC LIMIT 1;"}]}

succursale compte le plus de membres inscrits ?","sql":"SELECT b.\"Branch_ID\", b.\"Name\", COUNT(r.\"Member_ID\") AS \"Member_Count\" FROM \"branch\" AS b JOIN \"membership_register_branch\" AS r ON \"Member_ID\", \"Branch_ID\", \"Year\", \"Total_pounds\" FROM \"purchase\" WHERE \"Total_pounds\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Total_pounds\") FROM \"purchase\") ORDER BY \"Total_pounds\"
