{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les identifiants et les noms de tous les clients ?","sql":"SELECT custid, name FROM ACCOUNTS;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un solde sur leur compte courant supérieur à 1 000 ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance > 1000;"},{"question":"Affiche les comptes d'épargne du plus petit au plus grand solde.","sql":"SELECT a.name, s.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid ORDER BY s.balance ASC;"},{"question":"Quels clients possèdent à la fois un compte courant et un compte d'épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid;"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont pas de compte d'épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a LEFT JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE s.custid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque client ayant les deux types de comptes, quelle est la différence entre son épargne et son compte courant ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, s.balance - c.balance AS difference FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid;"},{"question":"Quel client a le solde courant le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid ORDER BY c.balance DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le solde moyen des comptes d'épargne ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(balance) AS solde_moyen FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Combien de clients ont un compte courant ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_comptes_courants FROM CHECKING;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois clients dont le total des soldes est le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, COALESCE(c.balance, 0) + COALESCE(s.balance, 0) AS total_balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid LEFT JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid ORDER BY total_balance DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total détenu sur les comptes courants ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(balance) AS total_checking FROM CHECKING;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un nom commençant par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT custid, name FROM ACCOUNTS WHERE name LIKE 'A%';"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un solde courant supérieur à leur solde d'épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance AS checking_balance, s.balance AS savings_balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance > s.balance;"},{"question":"Quels comptes courants ont un solde supérieur à la moyenne des comptes courants ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance > (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM CHECKING);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont le solde d'épargne maximal, y compris en cas d'égalité ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, s.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE s.balance = (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM SAVINGS);"},{"question":"Quels clients n'ont pas de compte courant ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name FROM ACCOUNTS AS a LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid WHERE c.custid IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le total des soldes de chaque client, en incluant les clients sans compte dans l'une des deux tables ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, COALESCE(c.balance, 0) + COALESCE(s.balance, 0) AS total_balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid LEFT JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid ORDER BY a.custid;"},{"question":"Combien de clients possèdent au moins un compte, courant ou d'épargne ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_clients FROM (SELECT custid FROM CHECKING UNION SELECT custid FROM SAVINGS) AS comptes;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont exactement le même solde sur leur compte courant et leur compte d'épargne ?","sql":"SELECT a.custid, a.name, c.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid WHERE c.balance = s.balance;"},{"question":"Quel est le solde minimal et le solde maximal des comptes d'épargne ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(balance) AS solde_minimal, MAX(balance) AS solde_maximal FROM SAVINGS;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un total de soldes supérieur au total moyen des clients ?","sql":"WITH totaux AS (SELECT a.custid, a.name, COALESCE(c.balance, 0) + COALESCE(s.balance, 0) AS total_balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS a LEFT JOIN CHECKING AS c ON c.custid = a.custid LEFT JOIN SAVINGS AS s ON s.custid = a.custid) SELECT custid, name, total_balance FROM totaux WHERE total_balance > (SELECT AVG(total_balance) FROM totaux);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont la lettre « a » dans leur nom ?","sql":"SELECT custid, name FROM ACCOUNTS WHERE name LIKE '%a%';"},{"question":"Pour quels c.balance > 500) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS AS s WHERE s.custid = a.custid AND s.balance > 500);"},{"question":"Quels clients ont un écart absolu d'au moins 1 000 entre leurs deux soldes {"examples":[{"question":"Quels produits ont un prix supérieur au prix moyen de l’ensemble des produits ?","sql":"SELECT Product_ID, Product_Name, Product_Price
FROM Products
WHERE Product_Price > (SELECT AVG(Product_Price) FROM Products)
ORDER BY Product_Price DESC;"},{"question":"Quels événements disposent d’une adresse, et quels sont les détails de cette adresse ainsi que ceux de leur canal ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Type_Code, a.address_details, c.Other_Details AS channel_details
FROM Events AS e
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.Address_ID = e.Address_ID
JOIN Channels AS c ON c.Channel_ID = e.Channel_ID
ORDER BY e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Combien de parties sont associées à chaque événement, y compris les événements sans partie ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.Party_ID) AS party_count
FROM Events AS e
LEFT JOIN Parties_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
GROUP BY e.Event_ID
ORDER BY e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Pour quels événements la valeur totale des produits associés est-elle supérieure à zéro ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, SUM(p.Product_Price) AS total_product_value
FROM Events AS e
JOIN Products_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
JOIN Products AS p ON p.Product_ID = pe.Product_ID
GROUP BY e.Event_ID
HAVING SUM(p.Product_Price) > 0
ORDER BY total_product_value DESC;"},{"question":"Quels accords sont liés à chaque type d’événement ?","sql":"SELECT ag.Document_ID, ag.Event_ID, e.Event_Type_Code
FROM Agreements AS ag
JOIN Events AS e ON e.Event_ID = ag.Event_ID
ORDER BY ag.Document_ID;"},{"question":"Quels actifs sont associés à plusieurs événements, et à combien d’événements chacun est-il associé ?","sql":"SELECT a.Asset_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.Event_ID) AS event_count
FROM Assets AS a
JOIN Assets_in_Events AS ae ON ae.Asset_ID = a.Asset_ID
GROUP BY a.Asset_ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ae.Event_ID) > 1
ORDER BY event_count DESC, a.Asset_ID;"},{"question":"Quelles parties ont au moins une association avec un rôle renseigné, et quels rôles leur sont attribués ?","sql":"SELECT p.Party_ID, p.Party_Details, pe.Role_Code, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.Event_ID) AS event_count
FROM Parties AS p
JOIN Parties_in_Events AS pe ON pe.Party_ID = p.Party_ID
WHERE pe.Role_Code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Party_ID, p.Party_Details, pe.Role_Code
ORDER BY p.Party_ID, pe.Role_Code;"},{"question":"Quelles localisations comptent le plus d’événements, en incluant celles qui n’en comptent aucun ?","sql":"SELECT l.Location_ID, l.Other_Details, COUNT(e.Event_ID) AS event_count

GROUP BY l.Location_ID, l.Other_Details
ORDER BY event_count DESC, l.Location_ID;"},{"question":"Quels financements ne sont associés à aucun événement ?","sql":"SELECT f.Finance_ID, f.Other_Details
FROM Finances AS f
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Events AS e
    WHERE e.Finance_ID = f.Finance_ID
)
ORDER BY f.Finance_ID;"},{"question":"Quels événements ont au moins un produit associé mais aucun actif associé ?","sql":"SELECT e.Event_ID, e.Event_Type_Code
FROM Events AS e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Products_in_Events AS pe
    WHERE pe.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Assets_in_Events AS ae
    WHERE ae.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
)
ORDER BY e.Event_ID;"},{"question":"Quels événements possèdent le plus grand nombre d’accords ?","sql":"WITH agreement_counts AS (
    SELECT e.Event_ID, COUNT(ag.Document_ID) AS agreement_count
    FROM Events AS e
    LEFT JOIN Agreements AS ag ON ag.Event_ID = e.Event_ID
    GROUP BY e.Event_ID
)
SELECT Event_ID, agreement_count
FROM agreement_counts
WHERE agreement_count = (SELECT MAX(agreement_count) FROM agreement_counts)
ORDER BY Event_ID;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Combien de stations sont rattachées à chaque autorité locale ?","sql":"SELECT local_authority, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_stations
FROM station
GROUP BY local_authority
ORDER BY nombre_de_stations DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trains dont l'origine est « Paris » et qui desservent une destination différente ?","sql":"SELECT id, train_number, name, origin, destination, time
FROM train
WHERE origin = 'Paris'
  AND destination <> origin
ORDER BY time;"},{"question":"Quelle est la température maximale moyenne prévue pour chaque station ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name, AVG(w.high_temperature) AS temperature_maximale_moyenne
FROM station AS s
JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.network_name
ORDER BY temperature_maximale_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations sont desservies par plus de trois trains ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name, COUNT(r.train_id) AS nombre_de_trains
FROM station AS s
JOIN route AS r ON r.station_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.network_name
HAVING COUNT(r.train_id) > 3
ORDER BY nombre_de_trains DESC;"},{"question":"Quel jour et dans quelle station les précipitations prévues sont-elles les plus importantes ?","sql":"SELECT w.station_id, s.network_name, w.day_of_week, w.precipitation
FROM weekly_weather AS w
JOIN station AS s ON s.id = w.station_id
WHERE w.precipitation = (SELECT MAX(precipitation) FROM weekly_weather);"},{"question":"Quels jours présentent à la fois plus de 20 mph de vent et des précipitations ?","sql":"SELECT station_id, day_of_week, wind_speed_mph, precipitation
FROM weekly_weather
WHERE wind_speed_mph > 20
  AND precipitation > 0
ORDER BY wind_speed_mph DESC, precipitation DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations proposent un service contenant le terme « wifi », sans tenir compte de la casse ?","sql":"SELECT id, network_name, services
FROM station
WHERE LOWER(services) LIKE '%wifi%'
ORDER BY network_name;"},{"question":"Quels trains desservent des stations appartenant à un réseau dont le nom contient « Metro » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.train_number, t.name, t.origin, t.destination
FROM train AS t
JOIN route AS r ON r.train_id = t.id
JOIN station AS s ON s.id = r.station_id
WHERE s.network_name LIKE '%Metro%'
ORDER BY t.train_number;"},{"question":"Pour chaque jour de la semaine, quelle est l'amplitude moyenne entre la température maximale et la température minimale ?","sql":"SELECT day_of_week,
       AVG(high_temperature - low_temperature) AS amplitude_moyenne
FROM weekly_weather
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY amplitude_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles stations ne disposent d'aucune prévision météorologique enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT s.id, s.network_name, s.local_authority
FROM station AS s
LEFT JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = s.id
WHERE w.station_id IS NULL
ORDER BY s.id;"},{"question":"Quels trains desservent au moins deux stations ?","sql":"SELECT t.id, t.train_number, t.name, COUNT(r.station_id) AS nombre_de_stations
FROM train AS t
JOIN route AS r ON r.train_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.train_number, t.name
HAVING COUNT(r.station_id) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_de_stations DESC, t.train_number;"},{"question":"Classez les stations selon leur température maximale moyenne, de la plus élevée à la plus basse.","sql":"WITH moyennes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.network_name, AVG(w.high_temperature) AS temperature_moyenne
    FROM station AS s
    JOIN weekly_weather AS w ON w.station_id = s.id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.network_name
)
SELECT id, network_name, temperature_moyenne,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY temperature_moyenne DESC) AS rang
FROM moyennes
ORDER BY rang, network_name;"}]}

DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles factures dépassent 20 ?","sql":"SELECT id, customer_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoices WHERE total > 20 ORDER BY total DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des factures ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(total) AS montant_moyen FROM invoices;"},{"question":"Quel est le total facturé par pays de facturation ?","sql":"SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) AS total_facture FROM invoices GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY total_facture DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de factures ont été émises chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', invoice_date) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_factures FROM invoices GROUP BY strftime('%Y', invoice_date) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quelles factures ont été émises en 2012 ?","sql":"SELECT id, customer_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', invoice_date) = '2012' ORDER BY invoice_date;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont au moins une facture supérieure à 15 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT customers.first_name, customers.last_name FROM customers JOIN invoices ON invoices.customer_id = customers.id WHERE invoices.total > 15 ORDER BY customers.last_name, customers.first_name;"},{"question":"Quelle est la facture la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT id, customer_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoices ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de lignes sur chaque facture ?","sql":"SELECT invoices.id, COUNT(invoice_lines.id) AS nombre_lignes FROM invoices LEFT JOIN invoice_lines ON invoice_lines.invoice_id = invoices.id GROUP BY invoices.id ORDER BY nombre_lignes DESC, invoices.id;"},{"question":"Quel est le chiffre d'affaires par titre, calculé avec le prix unitaire et la quantité ?","sql":"SELECT tracks.name, SUM(invoice_lines.unit_price * invoice_lines.quantity) AS chiffre_affaires FROM tracks JOIN invoice_lines ON invoice_lines.track_id = tracks.id GROUP BY tracks.id, tracks.name ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC;"},{"question":"Quels titres ont été vendus au moins dix fois ?","sql":"SELECT tracks.name, SUM(invoice_lines.quantity) AS quantite_vendue FROM tracks JOIN invoice_lines ON invoice_lines.track_id = tracks.id GROUP BY tracks.id, tracks.name HAVING SUM(invoice_lines.quantity) >= 10 ORDER BY quantite_vendue DESC, tracks.name;"},{"question":"Quelle quantité totale a été vendue pour chaque genre ?","sql":"SELECT genres.name, SUM(invoice_lines.quantity) AS quantite_vendue FROM genres JOIN tracks ON tracks.genre_id = genres.id JOIN invoice_lines ON invoice_lines.track_id = tracks.id GROUP BY genres.id, genres.name ORDER BY quantite_vendue DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles lignes de facture ont une quantité supérieure à 1 ?","sql":"SELECT id, invoice_id, track_id, quantity, unit_price FROM invoice_lines WHERE quantity > 1 ORDER BY quantity DESC, id;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix unitaire moyen pratiqué dans les lignes de facture ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS prix_moyen FROM invoice_lines;"},{"question":"Quels titres n'ont jamais été vendus ?","sql":"SELECT tracks.name FROM tracks LEFT JOIN invoice_lines ON invoice_lines.track_id = tracks.id WHERE invoice_lines.id IS NULL ORDER BY tracks.name;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des ventes par année de facture ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', invoices.invoice_date) AS annee, SUM(invoice_lines.unit_price * invoice_lines.quantity) AS total_ventes FROM invoices JOIN invoice_lines ON invoice_lines.invoice_id = invoices.id GROUP BY strftime('%Y', invoices.invoice_date) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quelles playlists existent ?","sql":"SELECT id, name FROM playlists ORDER BY name;"},{"question":"Combien de playlists sont enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_playlists FROM playlists;"},{"question":"Combien de titres contient chaque playlist ?","sql":"SELECT playlists.name, COUNT(playlist_tracks.track_id) AS nombre_titres FROM playlists LEFT JOIN playlist_tracks ON playlist_tracks.playlist_id = playlists.id GROUP BY playlists.id, playlists.name ORDER BY nombre_titres DESC, playlists.name;"},{"question":"Quelles playlists sont vides ?","sql":"SELECT playlists.name FROM playlists LEFT JOIN playlist_tracks ON playlist_tracks.playlist_id = playlists.id WHERE playlist_tracks.track_id IS NULL ORDER BY playlists.name;"},{"question":"Quels titres figurent dans la playlist identifiée par 1 ?","sql":"SELECT tracks.name FROM playlist_tracks JOIN tracks ON tracks.id = playlist_tracks.track_id WHERE playlist_tracks.playlist_id = 1 ORDER BY tracks.name;"},{"question":"Dans combien de playlists chaque titre apparaît-il ?","sql":"SELECT tracks.name, COUNT(playlist_tracks.playlist_id) AS nombre_playlists FROM tracks LEFT JOIN playlist_tracks ON playlist_tracks.track_id = tracks.id GROUP BY tracks.id, tracks.name ORDER BY nombre_playlists DESC, tracks.name;"},{"question":"Quels titres apparaissent dans au moins trois playlists ?","sql":"SELECT tracks.name, COUNT(playlist_tracks.playlist_id) AS nombre_playlists FROM tracks JOIN playlist_tracks ON playlist_tracks.track_id = tracks.id GROUP BY tracks.id, tracks.name HAVING COUNT(playlist_tracks.playlist_id) >= 3 ORDER BY nombre_playlists DESC, tracks.name;"},{"question":"Quels titres sont présents dans la playlist « Music » ?","sql":"SELECT tracks.name FROM playlists JOIN playlist_tracks ON playlist_tracks.playlist_id = playlists.id JOIN tracks ON tracks.id = playlist_tracks.track_id WHERE playlists.name = 'Music' ORDER BY tracks.name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de titres par album pour les albums ayant au moins dix titres ?","sql":"SELECT albums.title, COUNT(tracks.id) AS nombre_titres FROM albums JOIN tracks ON tracks.album_id = albums.id GROUP BY albums.id, albums.title HAVING COUNT(tracks.id) >= 10 ORDER BY nombre_titres DESC, albums.title;"},{"question":"Quels albums n'ont aucun titre associé ?","sql":"SELECT albums.title FROM albums LEFT JOIN tracks ON tracks.album_id = albums.id WHERE tracks.id IS NULL ORDER BY albums.title;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée totale des titres de chaque album ?","sql":"SELECT albums.title, SUM(tracks.milliseconds) AS duree_totale_millisecondes FROM albums JOIN tracks ON tracks.album_id = albums.id GROUP BY albums.id, albums.title ORDER BY duree_totale_millisecondes DESC;"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont des titres dont la durée moyenne dépasse quatre minutes ?","sql":"SELECT artists.name, AVG(tracks.milliseconds) AS duree_moyenne FROM artists JOIN albums ON albums.artist_id = artists.id JOIN tracks ON tracks.album_id = albums.id GROUP BY artists.id, artists.name HAVING AVG(tracks.milliseconds) > 240000 ORDER BY duree_moyenne DESC;"},{"question":"Quels titres ont un prix supérieur au prix moyen de tous les titres ?","sql":"SELECT name, unit_price FROM tracks WHERE unit_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM tracks) ORDER BY unit_price DESC, name;"},{"question":"Quels clients ont dépensé davantage que la moyenne des dépenses par client ?","sql":"WITH depenses AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS montant FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customers.first_name, customers.last_name, depenses.montant FROM depenses JOIN customers ON customers.id = depenses.customer_id WHERE depenses.montant > (SELECT AVG(montant) FROM depenses) ORDER BY depenses.montant DESC;"},{"question":"Quels genres sont associés à au moins un titre coûtant 1,99 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT genres.name FROM genres JOIN tracks ON tracks.genre_id = genres.id WHERE tracks.unit_price = 1.99 ORDER BY genres.name;"},{"question":"Quel est le classement des cinq clients ayant généré le plus de chiffre d'affaires ?","sql":"SELECT customers.first_name, customers.last_name, SUM(invoices.total) AS chiffre_affaires FROM customers JOIN invoices ON invoices.customer_id = customers.id GROUP BY customers.id, customers.first_name, customers.last_name ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont été embauchés le plus récemment ?","sql":"SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE hire_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hire_date DESC LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quel artiste possède le plus grand nombre de titres ?","sql":"SELECT artists.name, COUNT(tracks.id) AS nombre_titres FROM artists JOIN albums ON albums.artist_id = artists.id JOIN tracks ON tracks.album_id = albums.id GROUP BY artists.id, artists.name ORDER BY nombre_titres DESC, artists.name LIMIT 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les dates d’activité de toutes les tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Dates_active

FROM storm;"},{"question":"Quelle est la vitesse maximale atteinte par une tempête ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(Max_speed) AS vitesse_maximale

JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.Region_id = r.Region_id

GROUP BY s.Storm_ID, s.Name;"},{"question":"Quels couples tempête-région indiquent plus de 10 villes affectées ?","sql":"SELECT s.Name AS tempete, r.Region_name AS region, ar.Number_city_affected
FROM affected_region AS ar
JOIN storm AS s ON s.Storm_ID = ar.Storm_ID
JOIN region AS r ON r.Region_id = ar.Region_id
WHERE ar.Number_city_affected > 10;"},{"question":"Quelle tempête a causé le plus de dégâts ?","sql":"SELECT Storm_ID, Name, Damage_millions_USD
FROM storm
WHERE Damage_millions_USD = (SELECT MAX(Damage_millions_USD) FROM storm);"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont la vitesse maximale la plus élevée ?","sql":"SELECT Storm_ID, Name, Max_speed
FROM storm
WHERE Max_speed = (SELECT MAX(Max_speed) FROM storm);"},{"question":"Quelles régions n’ont été affectées par aucune tempête ?","sql":"SELECT r.Region_id, r.Region_name
FROM region AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM affected_region AS ar
    WHERE ar.Region_id = r.Region_id
);"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes n’ont affecté aucune région ?","sql":"SELECT s.Storm_ID, s.Name
FROM storm AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM affected_region AS ar
    WHERE ar.Storm_ID = s.Storm_ID
);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de villes affectées par enregistrement de région et de tempête ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(Number_city_affected) AS moyenne_villes_affectees
FROM affected_region;"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont affecté au moins deux régions ?","sql":"SELECT s.Storm_ID, s.Name, COUNT(ar.Region_id) AS nombre_regions
FROM storm AS s
JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.Storm_ID = s.Storm_ID
GROUP BY s.Storm_ID, s.Name
HAVING COUNT(ar.Region_id) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quelles régions ont été touchées par au moins deux tempêtes distinctes ?","sql":"SELECT r.Region_id, r.Region_name, COUNT(ar.Storm_ID) AS nombre_tempetes
FROM region AS r
JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.Region_id = r.Region_id
GROUP BY r.Region_id, r.Region_name
HAVING COUNT(ar.Storm_ID) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quel est le total des dégâts des tempêtes dont la vitesse maximale dépasse 120 ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(Damage_millions_USD) AS total_degats
FROM storm
WHERE Max_speed > 120;"},{"question":"Quelles tempêtes ont à la fois causé plus de 50 décès et dépassé 100 de vitesse maximale ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Max_speed, Number_Deaths

WHERE Number_Deaths > 50
  AND Max_speed > 100;"},{"question":"Affichez les tempêtes par ordre décroissant de dégâts, puis par nom.","sql":"SELECT Storm_ID, Name, Damage_millions_USD
FROM storm
ORDER BY Damage_millions_USD DESC, Name ASC;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les trois tempêtes ayant enregistré le plus grand nombre de décès ?","sql":"SELECT Storm_ID, Name, Number_Deaths
FROM storm
ORDER BY Number_Deaths DESC
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Pour chaque région, quel est le plus grand nombre de villes affectées lors d’une tempête ?","sql":"SELECT r.Region_name, MAX(ar.Number_city_affected) AS maximum_villes_affectees

JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.Region_id = r.Region_id
GROUP BY r.Region_id, r.Region_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de villes affectées par les tempêtes dont le nom contient la lettre « a » ?","sql":"SELECT SUM(ar.Number_city_affected) AS total_villes_affectees
FROM affected_region AS ar
JOIN storm AS s ON s.Storm_ID = ar.Storm_ID
WHERE LOWER(s.Name) LIKE '%a%';"},{"question":"Quels noms de tempêtes sont associés à des dégâts supérieurs à la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT Name, Damage_millions_USD

WHERE Damage_millions_USD > (
    SELECT AVG(Damage_millions_USD)
    FROM storm
);"},{"question":"Quelle est la différence entre la vitesse maximale et la vitesse minimale enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(Max_speed) - MIN(Max_speed) AS ecart_vitesse
FROM storm;"},{"question":"Pour chaque tempête, affichez son nom et le nombre total de villes affectées, y compris celles sans région associée.","sql":"SELECT s.Name, COALESCE(SUM(ar.Number_city_affected), 0) AS total_villes_affectees
FROM storm AS s
LEFT JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.Storm_ID = s.Storm_ID
GROUP BY s.Storm_ID, s.Name;"},{"question":"Quelles régions ont un total de villes affectées supérieur à 20 ?","sql":"SELECT r.Region_name, SUM(ar.Number_city_affected) AS total_villes_affectees
FROM region AS r
JOIN affected_region AS ar ON ar.Region_id = r.Region_id
GROUP BY r.Region_id, r.Region_name
HAVING SUM(ar.Number_city_affected) > 20;"},{"question":"Quel est le ratio entre le total des décès et le nombre de tempêtes ?","sql":"SELECT CAST(SUM(Number_Deaths) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS deces_moyens_par_tempete
FROM storm;"},{"question":"Quels enregistrements indiquent le plus grand nombre de villes affectées parmi toutes les associations région-tempête ?","sql":"SELECT ar.Region_id, r.Region_name, ar.Storm_ID, s.Name, ar.Number_city_affected

JOIN region AS r ON r.Region_id = ar.Region_id

WHERE ar.Number_city_affected = (
    SELECT MAX(Number_city_affected)
    FROM affected_region
);"},{"question":"Combien de régions différentes sont référencées dans la table des zones affectées ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Region_id) AS nombre_regions

DESC;"},{"question":"Quels élèves sont dans la classe 101 ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Classroom\" = 101 ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les enseignants et leurs salles de classe ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Combien y a-t-il d'élèves au total ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEleves\" FROM \"list\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne générale des notes ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(\"Grade\") AS \"MoyenneGenerale\" FROM \"list\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la meilleure note obtenue ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(\"Grade\") AS \"MeilleureNote\" FROM \"list\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la plus mauvaise note obtenue ?","sql":"SELECT MIN(\"Grade\") AS \"NoteLaPlusBasse\" FROM \"list\";"},{"question":"Combien d'élèves ont chaque note ?","sql":"SELECT \"Grade\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEleves\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Grade\" ORDER BY \"Grade\";"},{"question":"Combien d'élèves y a-t-il dans chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEleves\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves n'ont pas encore de note ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Classroom\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" IS NULL ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quelles salles sont occupées par au moins un enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" WHERE \"Classroom\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves sont dans une salle où enseigne au moins un professeur ?","sql":"SELECT l.\"LastName\", l.\"FirstName\", l.\"Classroom\" FROM \"list\" AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"teachers\" AS t WHERE t.\"Classroom\" = l.\"Classroom\") ORDER BY l.\"Classroom\", l.\"LastName\", l.\"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves sont dans une salle sans enseignant référencé ?","sql":"SELECT l.\"LastName\", l.\"FirstName\", l.\"Classroom\" FROM \"list\" AS l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"teachers\" AS t WHERE t.\"Classroom\" = l.\"Classroom\") ORDER BY l.\"Classroom\", l.\"LastName\";"},{"question":"Quels enseignants n'ont aucun élève dans leur salle ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\", t.\"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"list\" AS l WHERE l.\"Classroom\" = t.\"Classroom\") ORDER BY t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque enseignant, combien d'élèves sont dans sa salle ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\", t.\"Classroom\", COUNT(l.\"FirstName\") AS \"NombreEleves\" FROM \"teachers\" AS t LEFT JOIN \"list\" AS l ON l.\"Classroom\" = t.\"Classroom\" GROUP BY t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\", t.\"Classroom\" ORDER BY t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont une note supérieure à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Grade\") FROM \"list\") ORDER BY \"Grade\" DESC, \"LastName\";"},{"question":"Qui a obtenu la note maximale ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Grade\") FROM \"list\") ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la moyenne des notes dans chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", AVG(\"Grade\") AS \"Moyenne\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quelles classes ont une moyenne au moins égale à 12 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", AVG(\"Grade\") AS \"Moyenne\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" HAVING AVG(\"Grade\") >= 12 ORDER BY \"Moyenne\" DESC;"},{"question":"Existe-t-il des élèves portant le même nom de famille ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"LastName\" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY \"LastName\";"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ont le même nom et prénom qu'un élève ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\" FROM \"teachers\" AS t INNER JOIN \"list\" AS l ON l.\"LastName\" = t.\"LastName\" AND l.\"FirstName\" = t.\"FirstName\" ORDER BY t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quels enseignants partagent leur salle avec au moins un élève portant le même nom de famille ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\", t.\"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" AS t JOIN \"list\" AS l ON l.\"Classroom\" = t.\"Classroom\" AND l.\"LastName\" = t.\"LastName\" ORDER BY t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quelles salles apparaissent dans les deux tables ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" INTERSECT SELECT \"Classroom\" FROM \"list\" ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quelles salles apparaissent chez les élèves mais pas chez les enseignants ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Classroom\" FROM \"list\" EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT \"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Combien d'enseignants sont affectés à chaque salle ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEnseignants\" FROM \"teachers\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quelles classes comptent au moins trois élèves ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEleves\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY \"NombreEleves\" DESC, \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont une note comprise entre 10 et 14 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" BETWEEN 10 AND 14 ORDER BY \"Grade\", \"LastName\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois élèves les mieux notés ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Grade\" DESC, \"LastName\", \"FirstName\" LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont une note supérieure à 10 et appartiennent à la classe 202 ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" > 10 AND \"Classroom\" = 202 ORDER BY \"Grade\" DESC;"},{"question":"Affiche le nom complet de chaque élève avec sa note.","sql":"SELECT \"FirstName\" || ' ' || \"LastName\" AS \"NomComplet\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quelles sont les classes dont la note moyenne est supérieure à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", AVG(\"Grade\") AS \"MoyenneClasse\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" HAVING AVG(\"Grade\") > (SELECT AVG(\"Grade\") FROM \"list\") ORDER BY \"MoyenneClasse\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ont un prénom commençant par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" WHERE \"FirstName\" LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont un nom de famille se terminant par « son » ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"LastName\" LIKE '%son' ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Répartis les élèves selon trois catégories de notes : insuffisante, moyenne ou bonne.","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Grade\", CASE WHEN \"Grade\" < 10 THEN 'Insuffisante' WHEN \"Grade\" < 15 THEN 'Moyenne' ELSE 'Bonne' END AS \"Categorie\" FROM \"list\" ORDER BY \"Grade\", \"LastName\";"},{"question":"Quel pourcentage d'élèves a une note d'au moins 10 ?","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN \"Grade\" >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS \"PourcentageReussite\" FROM \"list\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la deuxième meilleure note distincte ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(\"Grade\") AS \"DeuxiemeMeilleureNote\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" < (SELECT MAX(\"Grade\") FROM \"list\");"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont obtenu la meilleure note de leur classe ?","sql":"SELECT l.\"LastName\", l.\"FirstName\", l.\"Classroom\", l.\"Grade\" FROM \"list\" AS l WHERE l.\"Grade\" = (SELECT MAX(x.\"Grade\") FROM \"list\" AS x WHERE x.\"Classroom\" = l.\"Classroom\") ORDER BY l.\"Classroom\", l.\"LastName\";"},{"question":"Quelles classes ont exclusivement des notes supérieures ou égales à 10 ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" HAVING MIN(\"Grade\") >= 10 ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quelle classe compte le plus grand nombre d'élèves ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEleves\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" ORDER BY \"NombreEleves\" DESC, \"Classroom\" LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels enseignants sont les seuls enseignants de leur salle ?","sql":"SELECT \"LastName\", \"FirstName\", \"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" WHERE \"Classroom\" IN (SELECT \"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) ORDER BY \"Classroom\", \"LastName\";"},{"question":"Combien y a-t-il d'enseignants au total ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEnseignants\" FROM \"teachers\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves ont le même prénom qu'au moins un enseignant ?","sql":"SELECT l.\"LastName\", l.\"FirstName\", l.\"Grade\" FROM \"list\" AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"teachers\" AS t WHERE t.\"FirstName\" = l.\"FirstName\") ORDER BY l.\"FirstName\", l.\"LastName\";"},{"question":"Quelles paires élève-enseignant ont le même prénom ?","sql":"SELECT l.\"FirstName\" AS \"Prenom\", l.\"LastName\" AS \"NomEleve\", t.\"LastName\" AS \"NomEnseignant\" FROM \"list\" AS l JOIN \"teachers\" AS t ON t.\"FirstName\" = l.\"FirstName\" ORDER BY l.\"FirstName\", l.\"LastName\", t.\"LastName\";"},{"question":"Quels noms complets apparaissent dans au moins une des deux tables ?","sql":"SELECT \"FirstName\", \"LastName\" FROM \"list\" UNION SELECT \"FirstName\", \"LastName\" FROM \"teachers\" ORDER BY \"LastName\", \"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Quels enseignants ne partagent leur salle avec aucun élève ayant une note ?","sql":"SELECT t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\", t.\"Classroom\" FROM \"teachers\" AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"list\" AS l WHERE l.\"Classroom\" = t.\"Classroom\" AND l.\"Grade\" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t.\"LastName\", t.\"FirstName\";"},{"question":"Combien d'élèves notés et non notés y a-t-il dans chaque classe ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", SUM(CASE WHEN \"Grade\" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS \"ElevesNotes\", SUM(CASE WHEN \"Grade\" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS \"ElevesNonNotes\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quelles notes ont été obtenues par au moins deux élèves ?","sql":"SELECT \"Grade\", COUNT(*) AS \"NombreEleves\" FROM \"list\" WHERE \"Grade\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"Grade\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY \"Grade\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque classe, quelles sont les notes minimale et maximale ?","sql":"SELECT \"Classroom\", MIN(\"Grade\") AS \"NoteMinimale\", MAX(\"Grade\") AS \"NoteMaximale\" FROM \"list\" GROUP BY \"Classroom\" ORDER BY \"Classroom\";"},{"question":"Quels élèves sont dans une salle avec un enseignant et ont une note au-dessus de la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT l.\"LastName\", l.\"FirstName\", l.\"Classroom\", l.\"Grade\" FROM \"list\" AS l WHERE l.\"Grade\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Grade\") FROM \"list\") AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"teachers\" AS t WHERE t.\"Classroom\" = l.\"Classroom\") ORDER BY l.\"Grade\" DESC, l.\"LastName\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque salle occupée par des élèves, indique le nombre d'élèves et le nombre d'enseignants.","sql":"SELECT x.\"Classroom\", COUNT(DISTINCT x.\"StudentLastName\" || CHAR(0) || x.\"StudentFirstName\") AS \"NombreEleves\", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM \"teachers\" AS t WHERE t.\"Classroom\" = x.\"Classroom\") AS \"NombreEnseignants\" FROM (SELECT \"Classroom\", \"LastName\" AS \"StudentLastName\", \"FirstName\" AS \"StudentFirstName\" FROM \"list\") AS x GROUP BY x.\"Classroom\" ORDER BY x.\"Classroom\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et adresses e-mail de toutes les personnes, triés par nom de famille puis prénom ?","sql":"SELECT first_name, last_name, email_address
FROM People
ORDER BY last_name, first_name;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont enregistrés dans la table des personnes ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM Students AS s
JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id
ORDER BY s.student_id;"},{"question":"Quels candidats possèdent un identifiant supérieur à 100 ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, candidate_details
FROM Candidates
WHERE candidate_id > 100
ORDER BY candidate_id;"},{"question":"Quelles villes apparaissent dans les adresses, sans doublons ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT city
FROM Addresses
WHERE city IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY city;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes sont associées à chacune des adresses enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT pa.person_id, pa.address_id, a.line_1, a.city, a.country
FROM People_Addresses AS pa
JOIN Addresses AS a ON a.address_id = pa.address_id
ORDER BY pa.person_id, pa.address_id;"},{"question":"Quelles associations de personnes et d’adresses sont encore en cours ?","sql":"SELECT person_id, address_id, date_from
FROM People_Addresses
WHERE date_to IS NULL
ORDER BY person_id, date_from;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont une description renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, course_name, course_description
FROM Courses
WHERE course_description IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY course_name;"},{"question":"Quelles inscriptions ont été enregistrées depuis le 1er janvier 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, course_id, registration_date
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
WHERE registration_date >= '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY registration_date;"},{"question":"Quelles présences ont été enregistrées pour chaque étudiant et chaque cours ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, course_id, date_of_attendance
FROM Student_Course_Attendance
ORDER BY student_id, date_of_attendance;"},{"question":"Combien d’inscriptions chaque étudiant possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_inscriptions
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
GROUP BY student_id
ORDER BY nombre_inscriptions DESC, student_id;"},{"question":"Quels cours ne comptent encore aucune inscription ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name
FROM Courses AS c
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS r ON r.course_id = c.course_id
WHERE r.course_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.course_id;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants suivent au moins un cours, avec le nom de ce cours ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, c.course_name
FROM Students AS s
JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS r ON r.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN Courses AS c ON c.course_id = r.course_id
ORDER BY s.student_id, c.course_name;"},{"question":"Quelles évaluations ont obtenu le résultat « réussi » ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, qualification, assessment_date, asessment_outcome_code
FROM Candidate_Assessments
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(asessment_outcome_code)) = 'réussi'
ORDER BY assessment_date;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont passé une évaluation, avec leur nom complet ?","sql":"SELECT ca.candidate_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, ca.qualification, ca.assessment_date, ca.asessment_outcome_code
FROM Candidate_Assessments AS ca
JOIN Candidates AS c ON c.candidate_id = ca.candidate_id
JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = c.candidate_id
ORDER BY ca.candidate_id, ca.assessment_date;"},{"question":"Combien d’évaluations existe-t-il pour chaque résultat ?","sql":"SELECT asessment_outcome_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_evaluations
FROM Candidate_Assessments
GROUP BY asessment_outcome_code
ORDER BY nombre_evaluations DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date d’évaluation la plus récente de chaque candidat ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, MAX(assessment_date) AS derniere_evaluation
FROM Candidate_Assessments
GROUP BY candidate_id
ORDER BY candidate_id;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes n’ont aucune adresse associée ?","sql":"SELECT p.person_id, p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM People AS p
LEFT JOIN People_Addresses AS pa ON pa.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE pa.person_address_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.person_id;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n’ont enregistré aucune présence ?","sql":"SELECT s.student_id, p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM Students AS s
JOIN People AS p ON p.person_id = s.student_id
LEFT JOIN Student_Course_Attendance AS a ON a.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE a.student_id IS NULL
ORDER BY s.student_id;"},{"question":"Combien de jours séparent l’inscription et la première présence pour chaque inscription ayant une présence ?","sql":"SELECT r.student_id, r.course_id, CAST(julianday(a.date_of_attendance) - julianday(r.registration_date) AS INTEGER) AS jours_avant_presence
FROM Student_Course_Registrations AS r
JOIN Student_Course_Attendance AS a
  ON a.student_id = r.student_id AND a.course_id = r.course_id
ORDER BY r.student_id, r.course_id;"},{"question":"Quelles inscriptions concernent des étudiants inscrits avant le 1er juin 2022 ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, course_id, registration_date
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
WHERE registration_date < '2022-06-01'
ORDER BY registration_date;"},{"question":"Dans quels pays des adresses sont-elles enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS nombre_adresses
FROM Addresses
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY nombre_adresses DESC, country;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms complets des personnes dont le prénom commence par la lettre A ?","sql":"SELECT TRIM(first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(middle_name || ' ', '') || last_name) AS nom_complet
FROM People
WHERE first_name LIKE 'A%'
ORDER BY nom_complet;"},{"question":"Quelles présences correspondent bien à une inscription existante ?","sql":"SELECT a.student_id, a.course_id, a.date_of_attendance
FROM Student_Course_Attendance AS a
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS r
  ON r.student_id = a.student_id AND r.course_id = a.course_id
ORDER BY a.date_of_attendance;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont une qualification contenant le terme « SQL » ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, qualification, assessment_date
FROM Candidate_Assessments
WHERE qualification LIKE '%SQL%'
ORDER BY candidate_id, assessment_date;"},{"question":"Combien d’adresses sont associées à chaque pays, en ne gardant que les pays ayant au moins deux adresses ?","sql":"SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS nombre_adresses
FROM Addresses
GROUP BY country
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_adresses DESC, country;"},{"question":"Quels candidats n’ont encore aucune évaluation ?","sql":"SELECT c.candidate_id, c.candidate_details
FROM Candidates AS c
LEFT JOIN Candidate_Assessments AS ca ON ca.candidate_id = c.candidate_id
WHERE ca.candidate_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.candidate_id;"},{"question":"Quels cours n’ont pas encore de nom renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, course_description
FROM Courses
WHERE course_name IS NULL
ORDER BY course_id;"},{"question":"Quelles présences ont eu lieu le même jour ou après la date d’inscription correspondante ?","sql":"SELECT a.student_id, a.course_id, r.registration_date, a.date_of_attendance
FROM Student_Course_Attendance AS a
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS r
  ON r.student_id = a.student_id AND r.course_id = a.course_id
WHERE a.date_of_attendance >= r.registration_date
ORDER BY a.date_of_attendance;"},{"question":"Quelles personnes ont plusieurs adresses associées ?","sql":"SELECT person_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_adresses
FROM People_Addresses
GROUP BY person_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY nombre_adresses DESC, person_id;"},{"question":"Combien de présences chaque cours a-t-il enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_presences
FROM Student_Course_Attendance
GROUP BY course_id
ORDER BY nombre_presences DESC, course_id;"},{"question":"Quelle est la première date d’inscription de chaque étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, MIN(registration_date) AS premiere_inscription
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
GROUP BY student_id
ORDER BY premiere_inscription;"},{"question":"Quelles évaluations ont eu lieu pendant l’année 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, qualification, assessment_date, asessment_outcome_code
FROM Candidate_Assessments
WHERE assessment_date >= '2024-01-01'
  AND assessment_date < '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY assessment_date;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont des détails renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, candidate_details
FROM Candidates
WHERE candidate_details IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY candidate_id;"},{"question":"Quelles adresses possèdent un code postal commençant par 75 ?","sql":"SELECT address_id, line_1, city, zip_postcode
FROM Addresses
WHERE zip_postcode LIKE '75%'
ORDER BY address_id;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont inscrits à au moins deux cours ?","sql":"SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_cours
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
GROUP BY student_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY nombre_cours DESC, student_id;"},{"question":"Combien de qualifications distinctes chaque candidat a-t-il passées ?","sql":"SELECT candidate_id, COUNT(DISTINCT qualification) AS nombre_qualifications
FROM Candidate_Assessments
GROUP BY candidate_id
ORDER BY nombre_qualifications DESC, candidate_id;"},{"question":"Quels cours ont au moins une inscription et au moins une présence ?","sql":"SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.student_id) AS nombre_etudiants, COUNT(a.student_id) AS nombre_presences
FROM Courses AS c
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations AS r ON r.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN Student_Course_Attendance AS a
  ON a.student_id = r.student_id AND a.course_id = r.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
ORDER BY c.course_id;"}]}

enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"ID\", s.\"name\", s.\"Nationality\" FROM \"swimmer\" AS s LEFT JOIN \"record\" AS r ON r.\"Swimmer_ID\" = s.\"ID\" WHERE r.\"Swimmer_ID\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le stade de plus grande capacité dans chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Country\", s.\"name\", s.\"Capacity\" FROM \"stadium\" AS s WHERE s.\"Capacity\" = (SELECT MAX(s2.\"Capacity\") FROM FROM \"swimmer\" WHERE \"meter_200\" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(\"meter_200\") <> '';"},{"question":"Quels événements se déroulent dans des stades de plus de 50 000 places ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Name\" AS \"evenement\", e.\"Year\", s.\"name\" AS \"stade\", s.\"Capacity\" FROM \"event\" AS e JOIN \"stadium\" AS s ON s.\"ID\" = e.\"Stadium_ID\" WHERE s.\"Capacity\" > 50000;"},{"question":"Quel nageur possède le meilleur temps au 100 mètres ?","sql":"SELECT \"name\", \"Nationality\", \"meter_100\" FROM \"swimmer\" WHERE \"meter_100\" = (SELECT MIN(\"meter_100\") FROM \"swimmer\" WHERE \"meter_100\" IS NOT NULL);"},{"question":"Combien de résultats sont associés à chaque nationalité ?","sql":"SELECT s.\"Nationality\", COUNT(*) AS \"nombre_resultats\" FROM \"record\" AS r JOIN \"swimmer\" AS s ON s.\"ID\" = r.\"Swimmer_ID\" GROUP BY s.\"Nationality\" ORDER BY \"nombre_resultats\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel événement compte le plus de résultats enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Name\", e.\"Year\", COUNT(r.\"Swimmer_ID\") AS \"nombre_resultats\" FROM \"event\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"record\" AS r ON r.\"Event_ID\" = e.\"ID\" GROUP BY e.\"ID\", e.\"Name\", e.\"Year\" ORDER BY \"nombre_resultats\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quels pays ont une capacité moyenne de stade supérieure à 30 000 places ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\", AVG(\"Capacity\") AS \"capacite_moyenne\" FROM \"stadium\" GROUP BY \"Country\" HAVING AVG(\"Capacity\") > 30000 ORDER BY \"capacite_moyenne\" DESC;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les artistes originaires de France ?","sql":"SELECT \"Artist_ID\", \"Name\", \"Country\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Country\" = 'France';"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont eu lieu à partir de 2020, avec leur thème et leur prix d’entrée ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", \"Year\", \"Theme\", \"Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" WHERE \"Year\" >= 2020 ORDER BY \"Year\", \"Exhibition_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la fréquentation totale de chaque exposition ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", COALESCE(SUM(r.\"Attendance\"), 0) AS \"Total_Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" ORDER BY \"Total_Attendance\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels artistes n’ont encore participé à aucune exposition ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\" FROM \"artist\" AS a LEFT JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" WHERE e.\"Exhibition_ID\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le prix moyen des billets par pays d’origine des artistes ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Country\", AVG(e.\"Ticket_Price\") AS \"Average_Ticket_Price\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Country\" ORDER BY \"Average_Ticket_Price\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel enregistrement présente la plus forte fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", \"Date\", \"Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" ORDER BY \"Attendance\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ne possèdent aucun relevé de fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" WHERE r.\"Exhibition_ID\" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont organisé au moins une exposition dont le prix est supérieur au prix moyen de toutes les expositions ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" WHERE e.\"Ticket_Price\" > (SELECT AVG(\"Ticket_Price\") FROM \"exhibition\");"},{"question":"Quelle fréquentation totale a été enregistrée pour chaque année d’exposition ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Year\", COALESCE(SUM(r.\"Attendance\"), 0) AS \"Total_Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Year\" ORDER BY e.\"Year\";"},{"question":"Quels thèmes ont une fréquentation moyenne par relevé supérieure à 500 visiteurs ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Theme\", AVG(r.\"Attendance\") AS \"Average_Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Theme\" HAVING AVG(r.\"Attendance\") > 500 ORDER BY \"Average_Attendance\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont entre 30 et 50 ans inclus ?","sql":"SELECT \"Artist_ID\", \"Name\", \"Age\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Age\" BETWEEN 30 AND 50 ORDER BY \"Age\", \"Name\";"},{"question":"Quels relevés de fréquentation ont été effectués en janvier, quelle que soit l’année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", \"Date\", \"Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" WHERE substr(\"Date\", 6, 2) = '01' ORDER BY \"Date\";"},{"question":"Quelles expositions indiquent le nom de leur artiste et leur prix d’entrée ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", a.\"Name\" AS \"Artist_Name\", e.\"Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"artist\" AS a ON a.\"Artist_ID\" = e.\"Artist_ID\" ORDER BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les pays représentés par les artistes, sans doublon ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Country\" FROM \"artist\" WHERE \"Country\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Country\";"},{"question":"Combien d’artistes appartiennent à chaque pays ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\", COUNT(*) AS \"Artist_Count\" FROM \"artist\" GROUP BY \"Country\" ORDER BY \"Artist_Count\" DESC, \"Country\";"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont enregistré au moins un relevé dépassant 1 000 visiteurs ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" WHERE r.\"Attendance\" > 1000 ORDER BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque exposition, quelle est la date la plus récente de relevé disponible ?","sql":"SELECT \"Exhibition_ID\", MAX(\"Date\") AS \"Latest_Date\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" GROUP BY \"Exhibition_ID\" ORDER BY \"Exhibition_ID\";"},{"question":"Quels artistes ont rejoint la galerie avant 2000 et possèdent au moins une exposition ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\", a.\"Year_Join\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" WHERE a.\"Year_Join\" < 2000 ORDER BY a.\"Year_Join\";"},{"question":"Quels thèmes comptent le plus d’expositions, avec leur prix moyen ?","sql":"SELECT \"Theme\", COUNT(*) AS \"Exhibition_Count\", AVG(\"Ticket_Price\") AS \"Average_Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" GROUP BY \"Theme\" ORDER BY \"Exhibition_Count\" DESC, \"Theme\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la fréquentation totale cumulée par artiste, y compris pour ceux sans exposition ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\", COALESCE(SUM(r.\"Attendance\"), 0) AS \"Total_Attendance\" FROM \"artist\" AS a LEFT JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" LEFT JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Total_Attendance\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont un relevé de fréquentation supérieur à 500 visiteurs à chacune de leurs dates enregistrées ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" HAVING MIN(r.\"Attendance\") > 500;"},{"question":"Quel artiste a présenté le plus grand nombre d’expositions ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\", COUNT(e.\"Exhibition_ID\") AS \"Exhibition_Count\" FROM \"artist\" AS a JOIN \"exhibition\" AS e ON e.\"Artist_ID\" = a.\"Artist_ID\" GROUP BY a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\" ORDER BY \"Exhibition_Count\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelle année d’exposition a généré la plus forte fréquentation cumulée ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Year\", SUM(r.\"Attendance\") AS \"Total_Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Year\" ORDER BY \"Total_Attendance\" DESC LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien de relevés de fréquentation existe-t-il pour chaque exposition ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", COUNT(r.\"Date\") AS \"Record_Count\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" ORDER BY \"Record_Count\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont un prix supérieur au prix moyen des expositions de leur artiste ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", e.\"Artist_ID\", e.\"Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e WHERE e.\"Ticket_Price\" > (SELECT AVG(e2.\"Ticket_Price\") FROM \"exhibition\" AS e2 WHERE e2.\"Artist_ID\" = e.\"Artist_ID\") ORDER BY e.\"Artist_ID\", e.\"Ticket_Price\" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque exposition ayant des relevés, quels sont le pays de l’artiste et la fréquentation totale ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", a.\"Country\", SUM(r.\"Attendance\") AS \"Total_Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"artist\" AS a ON a.\"Artist_ID\" = e.\"Artist_ID\" JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", a.\"Country\" ORDER BY \"Total_Attendance\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont une fréquentation totale nulle ou aucun relevé ?","sql":"SELECT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e LEFT JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" GROUP BY e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\" HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.\"Attendance\"), 0) = 0;"},{"question":"Quels artistes sont plus âgés que la moyenne d’âge des artistes de leur pays ?","sql":"SELECT a.\"Artist_ID\", a.\"Name\", a.\"Country\", a.\"Age\" FROM \"artist\" AS a WHERE a.\"Age\" > (SELECT AVG(a2.\"Age\") FROM \"artist\" AS a2 WHERE a2.\"Country\" = a.\"Country\") ORDER BY a.\"Country\", a.\"Age\" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels relevés correspondent à la date la plus récente de chaque exposition ?","sql":"SELECT r.\"Exhibition_ID\", r.\"Date\", r.\"Attendance\" FROM \"exhibition_record\" AS r WHERE r.\"Date\" = (SELECT MAX(r2.\"Date\") FROM \"exhibition_record\" AS r2 WHERE r2.\"Exhibition_ID\" = r.\"Exhibition_ID\") ORDER BY r.\"Exhibition_ID\";"},{"question":"Quelles expositions ont un prix d’entrée compris entre 10 et 25 inclus et au moins un relevé de fréquentation ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT e.\"Exhibition_ID\", e.\"Theme\", e.\"Ticket_Price\" FROM \"exhibition\" AS e JOIN \"exhibition_record\" AS r ON r.\"Exhibition_ID\" = e.\"Exhibition_ID\" WHERE e.\"Ticket_Price\" BETWEEN 10 AND 25 ORDER BY e.\"Ticket_Price\", e.\"Exhibition_ID\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les détails de toutes les organisations ?","sql":"SELECT organisation_id, organisation_type, organisation_details FROM Organisations;"},{"question":"Quelles descriptions correspondent aux types d’organisation enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT organisation_type, organisation_type_description FROM Organisation_Types;"},{"question":"Quels sont les codes et descriptions des types de documents ?","sql":"SELECT document_type_code, document_description FROM Document_Types;"},{"question":"Quels projets appartiennent à l’organisation 10 ?","sql":"SELECT project_id, project_details FROM Projects WHERE organisation_id = 10;"},{"question":"Quels financements dépassent 100000 ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, organisation_id, grant_amount FROM Grants WHERE grant_amount > 100000 ORDER BY grant_amount DESC;"},{"question":"Quels financements sont classés par montant croissant ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, grant_amount FROM Grants ORDER BY grant_amount ASC;"},{"question":"Combien de projets chaque organisation possède-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT organisation_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_projets FROM Projects GROUP BY organisation_id ORDER BY nombre_projets DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des financements par organisation ?","sql":"SELECT organisation_id, SUM(grant_amount) AS montant_total FROM Grants GROUP BY organisation_id;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont au moins une tâche ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id, p.project_details FROM Projects AS p JOIN Tasks AS t ON t.project_id = p.project_id;"},{"question":"Quelles tâches sont associées au projet 3 ?","sql":"SELECT task_id, task_details, \"eg Agree Objectives\" FROM Tasks WHERE project_id = 3;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel travaillent pour chaque organisation ?","sql":"SELECT rs.staff_id, rs.staff_details, o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details FROM Research_Staff AS rs JOIN Organisations AS o ON o.organisation_id = rs.employer_organisation_id;"},{"question":"Quels rôles sont définis pour le personnel de projet ?","sql":"SELECT role_code, role_description FROM Staff_Roles ORDER BY role_description;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel sont affectés au projet 5 ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, role_code, date_from, date_to, other_details FROM Project_Staff WHERE project_id = 5;"},{"question":"Quels résultats de recherche sont associés aux projets ?","sql":"SELECT po.project_id, po.outcome_code, ro.outcome_description, po.outcome_details FROM Project_Outcomes AS po JOIN Research_Outcomes AS ro ON ro.outcome_code = po.outcome_code;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont reçu une réponse après le 1er janvier 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, grant_id, response_received_date FROM Documents WHERE response_received_date > '2023-01-01' ORDER BY response_received_date;"},{"question":"Pour chaque document, quel est le type correspondant ?","sql":"SELECT d.document_id, d.grant_id, dt.document_description FROM Documents AS d LEFT JOIN Document_Types AS dt ON dt.document_type_code = d.document_type_code;"},{"question":"Quels financements sont encore valides au 31 décembre 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, organisation_id, grant_start_date, grant_end_date FROM Grants WHERE grant_start_date <= '2024-12-31' AND grant_end_date >= '2024-12-31';"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de documents par type ?","sql":"SELECT document_type_code, COUNT(*) AS nombre_documents FROM Documents GROUP BY document_type_code;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations sont liées à des projets et à des financements ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details FROM Organisations AS o JOIN Projects AS p ON p.organisation_id = o.organisation_id JOIN Grants AS g ON g.organisation_id = o.organisation_id;"},{"question":"Quels projets n’ont encore aucune tâche ?","sql":"SELECT p.project_id, p.project_details FROM Projects AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Tasks AS t WHERE t.project_id = p.project_id);"},{"question":"Quel est le financement maximal accordé à chaque organisation ?","sql":"SELECT organisation_id, MAX(grant_amount) AS financement_maximal FROM Grants GROUP BY organisation_id;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont plus de deux tâches ?","sql":"SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_taches FROM Tasks GROUP BY project_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont été envoyés avant leur date de réponse ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, grant_id, sent_date, response_received_date FROM Documents WHERE sent_date < response_received_date;"},{"question":"Combien de membres de recherche chaque organisation emploie-t-elle ?","sql":"SELECT o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details, COUNT(rs.staff_id) AS nombre_membres FROM Organisations AS o LEFT JOIN Research_Staff AS rs ON rs.employer_organisation_id = o.organisation_id GROUP BY o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details;"},{"question":"Quels projets sont dirigés par des organisations de type « UNIVERSITY » ?","sql":"SELECT p.project_id, p.project_details, o.organisation_details FROM Projects AS p JOIN Organisations AS o ON o.organisation_id = p.organisation_id WHERE o.organisation_type = 'UNIVERSITY';"},{"question":"Quels financements ont une durée supérieure à un an ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, grant_start_date, grant_end_date FROM Grants WHERE julianday(grant_end_date) - julianday(grant_start_date) > 365;"},{"question":"Quels codes de résultats ne sont associés à aucun projet ?","sql":"SELECT ro.outcome_code, ro.outcome_description FROM Research_Outcomes AS ro LEFT JOIN Project_Outcomes AS po ON po.outcome_code = ro.outcome_code WHERE po.project_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel de projet ont un rôle défini comme responsable ?","sql":"SELECT ps.staff_id, ps.project_id, sr.role_description FROM Project_Staff AS ps JOIN Staff_Roles AS sr ON sr.role_code = ps.role_code WHERE LOWER(sr.role_description) LIKE '%respons%';"},{"question":"Quel montant moyen de financement reçoit chaque type d’organisation ?","sql":"SELECT ot.organisation_type, ot.organisation_type_description, AVG(g.grant_amount) AS montant_moyen FROM Organisation_Types AS ot JOIN Organisations AS o ON o.organisation_type = ot.organisation_type JOIN Grants AS g ON g.organisation_id = o.organisation_id GROUP BY ot.organisation_type, ot.organisation_type_description;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont obtenu le résultat de code « SUCCESS » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id, p.project_details FROM Projects AS p JOIN Project_Outcomes AS po ON po.project_id = p.project_id WHERE po.outcome_code = 'SUCCESS';"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre total de tâches par organisation ?","sql":"SELECT o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details, COUNT(t.task_id) AS nombre_taches FROM Organisations AS o JOIN Projects AS p ON p.organisation_id = o.organisation_id LEFT JOIN Tasks AS t ON t.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details;"},{"question":"Quels financements n’ont aucun document associé ?","sql":"SELECT g.grant_id, g.organisation_id, g.grant_amount FROM Grants AS g LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.grant_id = g.grant_id WHERE d.document_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont au moins un résultat et au moins une tâche ?","sql":"SELECT p.project_id, p.project_details FROM Projects AS p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Project_Outcomes AS po WHERE po.project_id = p.project_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Tasks AS t WHERE t.project_id = p.project_id);"},{"question":"Quelle est la plus ancienne date d’envoi de document pour chaque financement ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, MIN(sent_date) AS premier_envoi FROM Documents GROUP BY grant_id;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel sont actuellement affectés, sans date de fin ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, project_id, role_code, date_from FROM Project_Staff WHERE date_to IS NULL;"},{"question":"Combien de projets chaque type d’organisation regroupe-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT o.organisation_type, COUNT(p.project_id) AS nombre_projets FROM Organisations AS o LEFT JOIN Projects AS p ON p.organisation_id = o.organisation_id GROUP BY o.organisation_type;"},{"question":"Quels financements sont supérieurs à la moyenne de tous les financements ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, organisation_id, grant_amount FROM Grants WHERE grant_amount > (SELECT AVG(grant_amount) FROM Grants) ORDER BY grant_amount DESC;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont exactement un résultat enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_resultats FROM Project_Outcomes GROUP BY project_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations n’emploient aucun membre de recherche ?","sql":"SELECT o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details FROM Organisations AS o LEFT JOIN Research_Staff AS rs ON rs.employer_organisation_id = o.organisation_id WHERE rs.staff_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le délai moyen de réponse aux documents, en jours ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(julianday(response_received_date) - julianday(sent_date)) AS delai_moyen_jours FROM Documents;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont une tâche contenant le mot « objectifs » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id, p.project_details FROM Projects AS p JOIN Tasks AS t ON t.project_id = p.project_id WHERE LOWER(t.task_details) LIKE '%objectifs%';"},{"question":"Quels financements ont été accordés à des organisations ayant au moins deux projets ?","sql":"SELECT g.grant_id, g.organisation_id, g.grant_amount FROM Grants AS g WHERE g.organisation_id IN (SELECT organisation_id FROM Projects GROUP BY organisation_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2);"},{"question":"Quels rôles ne sont utilisés par aucun membre de projet ?","sql":"SELECT sr.role_code, sr.role_description FROM Staff_Roles AS sr LEFT JOIN Project_Staff AS ps ON ps.role_code = sr.role_code WHERE ps.staff_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Pour chaque projet, combien de membres du personnel lui sont affectés ?","sql":"SELECT p.project_id, p.project_details, COUNT(ps.staff_id) AS nombre_membres FROM Projects AS p LEFT JOIN Project_Staff AS ps ON ps.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_details ORDER BY p.project_id;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont été envoyés en 2022 ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, grant_id, sent_date, document_type_code FROM Documents WHERE sent_date >= '2022-01-01' AND sent_date < '2023-01-01';"},{"question":"Quelle organisation possède le financement le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details, g.grant_id, g.grant_amount FROM Grants AS g JOIN Organisations AS o ON o.organisation_id = g.organisation_id WHERE g.grant_amount = (SELECT MAX(grant_amount) FROM Grants);"},{"question":"Quels projets sont associés à la description contenant « environnement » ?","sql":"SELECT project_id, project_details FROM Projects WHERE LOWER(project_details) LIKE '%environnement%';"},{"question":"Combien de résultats différents chaque projet possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT outcome_code) AS nombre_resultats_distincts FROM Project_Outcomes GROUP BY project_id;"},{"question":"Quels financements commencent après le 1er janvier 2025 et sont triés par date ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, organisation_id, grant_start_date, grant_amount FROM Grants WHERE grant_start_date > '2025-01-01' ORDER BY grant_start_date ASC;"},{"question":"Quelles organisations ont à la fois un membre de recherche et un projet ?","sql":"SELECT o.organisation_id, o.organisation_details FROM Organisations AS o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Research_Staff AS rs WHERE rs.employer_organisation_id = o.organisation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Projects AS p WHERE p.organisation_id = o.organisation_id);"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de documents envoyés pour chaque financement, y compris ceux sans document ?","sql":"SELECT g.grant_id, COUNT(d.document_id) AS nombre_documents FROM Grants AS g LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.grant_id = g.grant_id GROUP BY g.grant_id;"},{"question":"Quels membres du personnel de projet ont commencé leur affectation en 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT staff_id, project_id, role_code, date_from FROM Project_Staff WHERE date_from >= '2023-01-01' AND date_from < '2024-01-01';"},{"question":"Quels types de documents n’ont jamais été utilisés ?","sql":"SELECT dt.document_type_code, dt.document_description FROM Document_Types AS dt LEFT JOIN Documents AS d ON d.document_type_code = dt.document_type_code WHERE d.document_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des financements par année de début ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', grant_start_date) AS annee_debut, SUM(grant_amount) AS montant_total FROM Grants GROUP BY strftime('%Y', grant_start_date) ORDER BY annee_debut;"},{"question":"Quels projets ont plus de membres affectés que la moyenne ?","sql":"SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_membres FROM Project_Staff GROUP BY project_id HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(nombre_membres) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_membres FROM Project_Staff GROUP BY project_id));"},{"question":"Quels financements sont liés à des organisations dont le détail contient « institut » ?","sql":"SELECT g.grant_id, g.grant_amount, o.organisation_details FROM Grants AS g JOIN Organisations AS o ON o.organisation_id = g.organisation_id WHERE LOWER(o.organisation_details) LIKE '%institut%';"},{"question":"Pour chaque code de résultat, combien de projets le déclarent ?","sql":"SELECT outcome_code, COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) AS nombre_projets FROM Project_Outcomes GROUP BY outcome_code ORDER BY nombre_projets DESC;"},{"question":"Quels projets n’ont aucun résultat de recherche enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT p.project_id, p.project_details FROM Projects AS p LEFT JOIN Project_Outcomes AS po ON po.project_id = p.project_id WHERE po.project_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels documents ont un délai de réponse supérieur à 30 jours ?","sql":"SELECT document_id, grant_id, sent_date, response_received_date FROM Documents WHERE julianday(response_received_date) - julianday(sent_date) > 30 ORDER BY response_received_date;"},{"question":"Quel est le financement moyen des organisations qui ont au moins un projet ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(g.grant_amount) AS financement_moyen FROM Grants AS g WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Projects AS p WHERE p.organisation_id = g.organisation_id);"},{"question":"Quels détails de tâches sont associés à des projets financés ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.task_id, t.task_details, t.project_id FROM Tasks AS t JOIN Projects AS p ON p.project_id = t.project_id JOIN Grants AS g ON g.organisation_id = p.organisation_id;"},{"question":"Quels employeurs comptent au moins trois chercheurs ?","sql":"SELECT employer_organisation_id, COUNT(*) AS nombre_chercheurs FROM Research_Staff GROUP BY employer_organisation_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;"},{"question":"Quels financements ont le même montant qu’au moins un autre financement ?","sql":"SELECT grant_id, organisation_id, grant_amount FROM Grants WHERE grant_amount IN (SELECT grant_amount FROM Grants GROUP BY grant_amount HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY grant_amount;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée maximale des financements en jours ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(julianday(grant_end_date) - julianday(grant_start_date)) AS duree_maximale_jours FROM Grants;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les détails de tous les clients ?","sql":"SELECT customer_name, customer_details FROM Customers;"},{"question":"Quels produits contiennent le mot « câble » dans leur nom ?","sql":"SELECT product_id, product_name FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%câble%';"},{"question":"Quelles commandes ont le statut « expédiée » ?","sql":"SELECT order_id, s.order_id = o.order_id;"},{"question":"Quelles commandes n'ont encore aucun envoi ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.date_order_placed FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Shipments AS s ON Shipments AS s WHERE s.shipment_date = (SELECT MAX(s2.shipment_date) FROM Shipments AS s2 WHERE s2.order_id = s.order_id);"},{"question":"Affichez les clients dont la commande la plus récente a été
