oi.order_item_id, p.product_name, o.order_id, oi.order_item_status FROM Order_Items AS oi JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id;"},{"question":"Combien d'envois sont associés à chaque client ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id) AS nombre_envois FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen d'articles par commande ?","sql":"SELECT AVG(nombre_articles) AS moyenne_articles_par_commande FROM (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS nombre_articles FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id);"},{"question":"Quelles commandes non expédiées ont été passées avant le 1er janvier 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.date_order_placed FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.shipment_id IS NULL AND o.date_order_placed < '2024-01-01';"},{"question":"Quelles factures ne sont associées à aucun envoi ?","sql":"SELECT i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Shipments AS s ON s.invoice_number = i.invoice_number WHERE s.shipment_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels articles sont inclus dans chaque envoi, avec leur statut ?","sql":"SELECT si.shipment_id, si.order_item_id, oi.order_item_status FROM Shipment_Items AS si JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = si.order_item_id ORDER BY si.shipment_id, si.order_item_id;"},{"question":"Pour combien de commandes distinctes chaque produit a-t-il été utilisé ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS nombre_commandes FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name;"},{"question":"Quelles commandes appartiennent au même client qu'une commande passée après le 1er décembre 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.date_order_placed FROM Orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Orders WHERE date_order_placed > '2024-12-01') ORDER BY o.customer_id, o.date_order_placed;"},{"question":"Combien de commandes ont été passées chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', date_order_placed) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes FROM Orders GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date_order_placed) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels articles ont le même statut que leur commande ?","sql":"SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.order_id, oi.order_item_status FROM Order_Items AS oi JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.order_item_status = o.order_status;"},{"question":"Quels clients sont classés par nombre décroissant de commandes ?","sql":"SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS nombre_commandes FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY nombre_commandes DESC, c.customer_name;"},{"question":"Quels envois ont une date d'expédition manquante ?","sql":"SELECT shipment_id, order_id, shipment_tracking_number FROM Shipments WHERE shipment_date IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quelle commande contient le plus grand nombre d'articles ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS nombre_articles FROM Orders AS o JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) = (SELECT MAX(nombre_articles) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id));"},{"question":"Quels clients ont au moins une commande et au moins un envoi associé ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.order_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le délai en jours entre la commande et l'expédition pour chaque envoi ?","sql":"SELECT s.shipment_id, s.order_id, CAST(julianday(s.shipment_date) - julianday(o.date_order_placed) AS INTEGER) AS delai_jours FROM Shipments AS s JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.shipment_date IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels noms de clients apparaissent dans les détails des commandes ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_name FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_details LIKE '%' || c.customer_name || '%';"},{"question":"Combien de produits distincts sont présents dans chaque commande ?","sql":"SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS nombre_produits_distincts FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id;"},{"question":"Quels envois utilisent une facture créée avant leur date d'expédition ?","sql":"SELECT s.shipment_id, s.shipment_date, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date FROM Shipments AS s JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = s.invoice_number WHERE s.shipment_date IS NOT NULL AND i.invoice_date IS NOT NULL AND i.invoice_date < s.shipment_date;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les identifiants et les informations de tous les investisseurs ?","sql":"SELECT investor_id, Investor_details
FROM Investors
ORDER BY investor_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque lot, quel est son identifiant et quel investisseur le détient ?","sql":"SELECT l.lot_id, l.lot_details, i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
FROM Lots AS l
JOIN Investors AS i ON i.investor_id = l.investor_id
ORDER BY l.lot_id;"},{"question":"Combien de transactions correspondent à chaque type de transaction, y compris les types sans transaction ?","sql":"SELECT r.transaction_type_code,
       r.transaction_type_description,
       COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS nombre_transactions
FROM Ref_Transaction_Types AS r
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON t.transaction_type_code = r.transaction_type_code
GROUP BY r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description
ORDER BY nombre_transactions DESC, r.transaction_type_code;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les informations détaillées des achats avec leur date et leur montant ?","sql":"SELECT p.purchase_transaction_id,
       p.purchase_details,
       t.date_of_transaction,
       t.amount_of_transaction
FROM Purchases AS p
JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON t.transaction_id = p.purchase_transaction_id
ORDER BY t.date_of_transaction;"},{"question":"Quelles ventes sont associées à chaque transaction, avec le nombre de parts indiqué ?","sql":"SELECT s.sales_transaction_id,
       s.sales_details,
       t.share_count
FROM Sales AS s
JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON t.transaction_id = s.sales_transaction_id
ORDER BY s.sales_transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont été effectuées pendant l'année 2024 ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id,
       investor_id,
       transaction_type_code,
       date_of_transaction,
       amount_of_transaction
FROM Transactions
WHERE date_of_transaction >= '2024-01-01'
  AND date_of_transaction < '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY date_of_transaction;"},{"question":"Quelle est la transaction dont le montant est le plus élevé ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id,
       investor_id,
       date_of_transaction,
       amount_of_transaction
FROM Transactions
WHERE amount_of_transaction = (
    SELECT MAX(amount_of_transaction)
    FROM Transactions
);"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des transactions pour chaque investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id,
       i.Investor_details,
       AVG(t.amount_of_transaction) AS montant_moyen
FROM Investors AS i
JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
ORDER BY montant_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de lots chaque investisseur possède-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id,
       i.Investor_details,
       COUNT(l.lot_id) AS nombre_lots
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Lots AS l ON l.investor_id = i.investor_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
ORDER BY nombre_lots DESC, i.investor_id;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ne sont liées à aucun lot ?","sql":"SELECT t.transaction_id,
       t.investor_id,
       t.date_of_transaction,
       t.amount_of_transaction
FROM Transactions AS t
LEFT JOIN Transactions_Lots AS tl
  ON tl.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
WHERE tl.transaction_id IS NULL
ORDER BY t.transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quels lots sont associés à chaque transaction ?","sql":"SELECT tl.transaction_id,
       tl.lot_id,
       l.lot_details
FROM Transactions_Lots AS tl
JOIN Lots AS l ON l.lot_id = tl.lot_id
ORDER BY tl.transaction_id, tl.lot_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des ventes pour chaque investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id,
       i.Investor_details,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount_of_transaction), 0) AS total_ventes
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id
LEFT JOIN Sales AS s ON s.sales_transaction_id = t.transaction_id
WHERE s.sales_transaction_id IS NOT NULL
   OR t.transaction_id IS NULL
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
ORDER BY total_ventes DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'achats chaque investisseur a-t-il enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id,
       i.Investor_details,
       COUNT(p.purchase_transaction_id) AS nombre_achats
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id
LEFT JOIN Purchases AS p ON p.purchase_transaction_id = t.transaction_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
ORDER BY nombre_achats DESC, i.investor_id;"},{"question":"Combien de transactions ont eu lieu chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', date_of_transaction) AS annee,
       COUNT(*) AS nombre_transactions
FROM Transactions
WHERE date_of_transaction IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date_of_transaction)
ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions possèdent une valeur de parts renseignée et non vide ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id,
       investor_id,
       share_count,
       date_of_transaction
FROM Transactions
WHERE share_count IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(share_count) <> ''
ORDER BY date_of_transaction, transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quels investisseurs ne possèdent aucun lot ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id,
       i.Investor_details
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Lots AS l ON l.investor_id = i.investor_id
WHERE l.lot_id IS NULL
ORDER BY i.investor_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant moyen des transactions pour chaque type, avec sa description ?","sql":"SELECT r.transaction_type_code,
       r.transaction_type_description,
       AVG(t.amount_of_transaction) AS montant_moyen
FROM Ref_Transaction_Types AS r
JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON t.transaction_type_code = r.transaction_type_code
GROUP BY r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description
ORDER BY montant_moyen DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de transactions sont associées à chaque lot ?","sql":"SELECT l.lot_id,
       l.lot_details,
       COUNT(tl.transaction_id) AS nombre_transactions
FROM Lots AS l
LEFT JOIN Transactions_Lots AS tl ON tl.lot_id = l.lot_id
GROUP BY l.lot_id, l.lot_details
ORDER BY nombre_transactions DESC, l.lot_id;"},{"question":"Quel investisseur a enregistré le plus grand nombre de transactions ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id,
       i.Investor_details,
       COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS nombre_transactions
FROM Investors AS i
JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
ORDER BY nombre_transactions DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles informations d'achat contiennent le mot « fonds » ?","sql":"SELECT purchase_transaction_id, purchase_details
FROM Purchases
WHERE purchase_details LIKE '%fonds%'
ORDER BY purchase_transaction_id;"},{"question":"Quelles ventes ont un montant compris entre 1 000 et 10 000 inclus ?","sql":"SELECT s.sales_transaction_id,
       s.sales_details,
       t.amount_of_transaction
FROM Sales AS s
JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON t.transaction_id = s.sales_transaction_id
WHERE t.amount_of_transaction BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000
ORDER BY t.amount_of_transaction;"},{"question":"Quelle est la dernière transaction de chaque investisseur ?","sql":"SELECT t.transaction_id,
       t.investor_id,
       t.date_of_transaction,
       t.amount_of_transaction
FROM Transactions AS t
WHERE t.date_of_transaction = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.date_of_transaction)
    FROM Transactions AS t2
    WHERE t2.investor_id = t.investor_id
)
ORDER BY t.investor_id;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions ont un montant supérieur à la moyenne de toutes les transactions ?","sql":"SELECT transaction_id,
       investor_id,
       amount_of_transaction,
       date_of_transaction
FROM Transactions
WHERE amount_of_transaction > (
    SELECT AVG(amount_of_transaction)
    FROM Transactions
)
ORDER BY amount_of_transaction DESC;"},{"question":"Quelle est la première date de transaction enregistrée pour chaque type ?","sql":"SELECT r.transaction_type_code,
       r.transaction_type_description,
       MIN(t.date_of_transaction) AS premiere_date
FROM Ref_Transaction_Types AS r
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON t.transaction_type_code = r.transaction_type_code
GROUP BY r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description
ORDER BY premiere_date;"},{"question":"Combien d'investisseurs distincts ont effectué chaque type de transaction ?","sql":"SELECT r.transaction_type_code,
       r.transaction_type_description,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.investor_id) AS nombre_investisseurs
FROM Ref_Transaction_Types AS r
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON t.transaction_type_code = r.transaction_type_code
GROUP BY r.transaction_type_code, r.transaction_type_description
ORDER BY nombre_investisseurs DESC, r.transaction_type_code;"},{"question":"Quel est le montant total des transactions par mois de l'année 2023 ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_of_transaction) AS mois,
       SUM(amount_of_transaction) AS montant_total
FROM Transactions
WHERE date_of_transaction >= '2023-01-01'
  AND date_of_transaction < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_of_transaction)
ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quels lots ne sont associés à aucune transaction ?","sql":"SELECT l.lot_id,
       l.investor_id,
       l.lot_details
FROM Lots AS l
LEFT JOIN Transactions_Lots AS tl ON tl.lot_id = l.lot_id
WHERE tl.lot_id IS NULL
ORDER BY l.lot_id;"},{"question":"Quelle transaction est associée au plus grand nombre de lots ?","sql":"SELECT t.transaction_id,
       t.investor_id,
       COUNT(tl.lot_id) AS nombre_lots
FROM Transactions AS t
JOIN Transactions_Lots AS tl
  ON tl.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
GROUP BY t.transaction_id, t.investor_id
ORDER BY nombre_lots DESC, t.transaction_id
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Pour chaque investisseur, quels sont le nombre de transactions et leur montant total ?","sql":"SELECT i.investor_id,
       i.Investor_details,
       COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS nombre_transactions,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount_of_transaction), 0) AS montant_total
FROM Investors AS i
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t ON t.investor_id = i.investor_id
GROUP BY i.investor_id, i.Investor_details
ORDER BY montant_total DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles transactions sont liées à des lots appartenant à un autre investisseur que celui de la transaction ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT t.transaction_id,
       t.investor_id AS investisseur_transaction,
       l.lot_id,
       l.investor_id AS investisseur_lot
FROM Transactions AS t
JOIN Transactions_Lots AS tl ON tl.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
JOIN Lots AS l ON l.lot_id = tl.lot_id
WHERE t.investor_id <> l.investor_id
ORDER BY t.transaction_id, l.lot_id;"}]}

problèmes ont été clôturés avant leur date de signalement ?","sql":"SELECT problem_id, date_problem_reported, date_problem_closed FROM Problems WHERE date_problem_closed IS NOT NULL AND JOIN Product AS p ON p.product_id = pr.product_id ORDER BY pr.problem_id;"},{"question":"Quels journaux de problèmes mentionnent une correction ?","sql":"SELECT problem_log_id, problem_id, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_journaux FROM Problem_Status_Codes AS s LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_status_code = s.problem_status_code GROUP BY s.problem_status_code, s.problem_status_description ORDER BY nombre_journaux DESC;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de jours entre le signalement et la clôture des problèmes clôturés ?","sql":"SELECT moins un journal de problème ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name FROM Staff AS s JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.assigned_to_staff_id = s.staff_id ORDER BY s.staff_last_name, s.staff_first_name;"},{"question":"Combien de problèmes chaque employé a-t-il signalés ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name, COUNT(p.problem_id) AS nombre_problemes_signales FROM Staff AS s LEFT JOIN Problems AS p ON p.reported_by_staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name ORDER BY nombre_problemes_signales DESC;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont autorisé la clôture d'au moins un problème ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name FROM Staff AS s JOIN Problems AS p ON problem_id;"},{"question":"Quels codes de catégorie ne sont utilisés dans aucun journal ?","sql":"SELECT c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description FROM Problem_Category_Codes AS c LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_category_code = c.problem_category_code WHERE l.problem_log_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels codes de statut ne sont associés à aucun journal ?","sql":"SELECT s.problem_status_code, s.problem_status_description FROM Problem_Status_Codes AS s LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_status_code = s.problem_status_code WHERE l.problem_log_id IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quel produit a le plus grand nombre de problèmes ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(pr.problem_id) AS nombre_problemes FROM Product AS p JOIN Problems AS pr ON p.product_id;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes ont au moins deux entrées dans le journal ?","sql":"SELECT pr.problem_id, pr.problem_description, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_entrees FROM Problems AS pr JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_id = pr.problem_id GROUP BY pr.problem_id, pr.problem_description HAVING COUNT(l.problem_log_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_entrees DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque entrée du journal, affichez le problème, sa catégorie et son statut.","sql":"SELECT l.problem_log_id, l.problem_id, c.problem_category_description, s.problem_status_description, l.log_entry_date FROM Problem_Log AS l JOIN Problem_Category_Codes AS c ON c.problem_category_code = l.problem_category_code JOIN Problem_Status_Codes AS s ON s.problem_status_code = l.problem_status_code ORDER BY l.log_entry_date;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes n'ont aucune entrée dans le journal ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, p.problem_description FROM Problems AS p LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_id = p.problem_id WHERE l.problem_log_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.problem_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le dernier journal enregistré pour chaque problème ?","sql":"SELECT l.problem_id, l.problem_log_id, l.log_entry_date, l.log_entry_description FROM Problem_Log AS l WHERE l.log_entry_date = (SELECT MAX(l2.log_entry_date) FROM Problem_Log AS l2 WHERE l2.problem_id = l.problem_id) ORDER BY l.problem_id;"},{"question":"Combien de problèmes ont été signalés chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y', date_problem_reported) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_problemes FROM Problems GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date_problem_reported) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels produits n'ont encore aucun problème enregistré ?","sql":"SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Product AS p LEFT JOIN Problems AS pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id WHERE pr.problem_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.product_name;"},{"question":"Affichez les cinq problèmes les plus récemment signalés.","sql":"SELECT problem_id, product_id, date_problem_reported, problem_description FROM Problems ORDER BY date_problem_reported DESC LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Quelle est la durée maximale, en jours, avant clôture d'un problème ?","sql":"SELECT MAX(julianday(date_problem_closed) - julianday(date_problem_reported)) AS duree_maximale_jours FROM Problems WHERE date_problem_closed IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Quels employés ont traité plus de trois entrées de journal ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_entrees FROM Staff AS s JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.assigned_to_staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name HAVING COUNT(l.problem_log_id) > 3 ORDER BY nombre_entrees DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque catégorie, combien de problèmes distincts sont concernés ?","sql":"SELECT c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description, COUNT(DISTINCT l.problem_id) AS nombre_problemes FROM Problem_Category_Codes AS c LEFT JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.problem_category_code = c.problem_category_code GROUP BY c.problem_category_code, c.problem_category_description ORDER BY nombre_problemes DESC;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes ont été signalés par un employé qui a aussi autorisé leur clôture ?","sql":"SELECT p.problem_id, p.reported_by_staff_id, p.closure_authorised_by_staff_id, p.date_problem_reported FROM Problems AS p WHERE p.reported_by_staff_id = p.closure_authorised_by_staff_id;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre de problèmes ouverts et clôturés ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN date_problem_closed IS NULL THEN 'Ouverts' ELSE 'Clôturés' END AS etat, COUNT(*) AS nombre_problemes FROM Problems GROUP BY CASE WHEN date_problem_closed IS NULL THEN 'Ouverts' ELSE 'Clôturés' END;"},{"question":"Quels journaux ont été saisis par un employé dont le prénom commence par « A » ?","sql":"SELECT l.problem_log_id, l.problem_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name, l.log_entry_date FROM Problem_Log AS l JOIN Staff AS s ON s.staff_id = l.assigned_to_staff_id WHERE s.staff_first_name LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY l.log_entry_date;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes concernent un produit dont le nom contient « Pro » ?","sql":"SELECT pr.problem_id, p.product_name, pr.problem_description FROM Problems AS pr JOIN Product AS p ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%Pro%' ORDER BY p.product_name, pr.problem_id;"},{"question":"Pour chaque mois de signalement, combien de problèmes ont été enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_problem_reported) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nombre_problemes FROM Problems GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date_problem_reported) ORDER BY mois;"},{"question":"Quels problèmes possèdent à la fois des détails supplémentaires et une description ?","sql":"SELECT problem_id, problem_description, other_problem_details FROM Problems WHERE problem_description IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(problem_description) <> '' AND other_problem_details IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(other_problem_details) <> '' ORDER BY problem_id;"},{"question":"Quel employé est associé au plus grand nombre d'entrées de journal ?","sql":"SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name, COUNT(l.problem_log_id) AS nombre_entrees FROM Staff AS s JOIN Problem_Log AS l ON l.assigned_to_staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.staff_first_name, s.staff_last_name ORDER BY nombre_entrees DESC LIMIT 1;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quels sont les noms et le nombre d’abonnés des utilisateurs, classés du plus grand au plus petit nombre d’abonnés ?","sql":"SELECT name, followers FROM user_profiles ORDER BY followers DESC;"},{"question":"Quels tweets ont été publiés depuis le 1er janvier 2024, avec leur auteur et leur date de création ?","sql":"SELECT t.id, u.name, t.createdate, t.text FROM tweets AS t JOIN user_profiles AS u ON u.uid = t.uid WHERE t.createdate >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY t.createdate;"},{"question":"Combien de tweets chaque utilisateur a-t-il publiés, y compris ceux qui n’en ont publié aucun ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name, COUNT(t.id) AS nombre_tweets FROM user_profiles AS u LEFT JOIN tweets AS t ON t.uid = u.uid GROUP BY u.uid, u.name ORDER BY nombre_tweets DESC, u.uid;"},{"question":"Quel utilisateur possède le plus grand nombre d’abonnés indiqué dans son profil ?","sql":"SELECT uid, name, followers FROM user_profiles WHERE followers = (SELECT MAX(followers) FROM user_profiles);"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs suivent quels autres utilisateurs ?","sql":"SELECT u1.name AS utilisateur, u2.name AS utilisateur_suivi FROM follows AS f JOIN user_profiles AS u1 ON u1.uid = f.f1 JOIN user_profiles AS u2 ON u2.uid = f.f2 ORDER BY u1.name, u2.name;"},{"question":"Combien de tweets ont été publiés chaque jour ?","sql":"SELECT DATE(createdate) AS jour, COUNT(*) AS nombre_tweets FROM tweets GROUP BY DATE(createdate) ORDER BY jour;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs n’ont encore publié aucun tweet ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name FROM user_profiles AS u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tweets AS t WHERE t.uid = u.uid) ORDER BY u.name;"},{"question":"Quels tweets contiennent le mot « vacances » sans tenir compte de la casse ?","sql":"SELECT id, uid, text, createdate FROM tweets WHERE LOWER(text) LIKE '%vacances%' ORDER BY createdate;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs suivent au moins trois autres utilisateurs ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name, COUNT(f.f2) AS nombre_suivis FROM user_profiles AS u JOIN follows AS f ON f.f1 = u.uid GROUP BY u.uid, u.name HAVING COUNT(f.f2) >= 3 ORDER BY nombre_suivis DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque utilisateur ayant publié au moins un tweet, quel est son tweet le plus récent ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name, t.id, t.text, t.createdate FROM user_profiles AS u JOIN tweets AS t ON t.uid = u.uid WHERE t.createdate = (SELECT MAX(t2.createdate) FROM tweets AS t2 WHERE t2.uid = u.uid) ORDER BY u.uid;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont un nombre d’abonnés supérieur à la moyenne de tous les profils ?","sql":"SELECT uid, name, followers FROM user_profiles WHERE followers > (SELECT AVG(followers) FROM user_profiles) ORDER BY followers DESC;"},{"question":"Quelles paires d’utilisateurs se suivent mutuellement ?","sql":"SELECT u1.name AS utilisateur_1, u2.name AS utilisateur_2 FROM follows AS f1 JOIN follows AS f2 ON f1.f1 = f2.f2 AND f1.f2 = f2.f1 JOIN user_profiles AS u1 ON u1.uid = f1.f1 JOIN user_profiles AS u2 ON u2.uid = f1.f2 WHERE f1.f1 < f1.f2 ORDER BY utilisateur_1, utilisateur_2;"},{"question":"Quels sont les cinq utilisateurs ayant publié le plus de tweets ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name, COUNT(t.id) AS nombre_tweets FROM user_profiles AS u JOIN tweets AS t ON t.uid = u.uid GROUP BY u.uid, u.name ORDER BY nombre_tweets DESC, u.uid LIMIT 5;"},{"question":"Combien de tweets ont été publiés au cours de chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', createdate) AS annee, COUNT(*) AS nombre_tweets FROM tweets GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', createdate) ORDER BY annee;"},{"question":"Quels profils n’ont pas d’adresse e-mail renseignée ?","sql":"SELECT uid, name FROM user_profiles WHERE email IS NULL OR TRIM(email) = '' ORDER BY uid;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs ont publié au moins un tweet contenant le caractère « ? » ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT u.uid, u.name FROM user_profiles AS u JOIN tweets AS t ON t.uid = u.uid WHERE t.text LIKE '%?%' ORDER BY u.name;"},{"question":"Pour chaque utilisateur, combien de personnes le suivent d’après la table des relations ?","sql":"SELECT u.uid, u.name, COUNT(f.f1) AS nombre_de_suiveurs FROM user_profiles AS u LEFT JOIN follows AS f ON f.f2 = u.uid GROUP BY u.uid, u.name ORDER BY nombre_de_suiveurs DESC, u.uid;"},{"question":"Quels tweets sont plus longs que la longueur moyenne des tweets ?","sql":"SELECT id, uid, LENGTH(text) AS longueur, text FROM tweets WHERE LENGTH(text) > (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(text)) FROM tweets) ORDER BY longueur DESC;"},{"question":"Quels utilisateurs suivent au moins une personne dont le nombre d’abonnés est supérieur à 1 000 ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT u.uid, u.name FROM user_profiles AS u JOIN follows AS f ON f.f1 = u.uid JOIN user_profiles AS suivi ON suivi.uid = f.f2 WHERE suivi.followers > 1000 ORDER BY u.name;"}]}

préférence enregistrée ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Registration_Date, Election_Cycle FROM Voting_record WHERE President_Vote IS NULL AND Vice_President_Vote IS NULL AND Secretary_Vote IS NULL AND Treasurer_Vote IS NULL AND Class_President_Vote IS NULL AND Class_Senator_Vote IS NULL ORDER BY StuID;"},{"question":"Quels bulletins contiennent six votes renseignés ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Election_Cycle FROM Voting_record WHERE President_Vote IS NOT NULL AND Vice_President_Vote IS NOT NULL AND Secretary_Vote IS NOT NULL AND Treasurer_Vote IS NOT NULL AND Class_President_Vote IS NOT NULL AND Class_Senator_Vote IS NOT NULL ORDER BY StuID;"},{"question":"Quels électeurs ont voté pour le même étudiant à la présidence et à la vice-présidence ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Election_Cycle, President_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE President_Vote IS NOT NULL AND President_Vote = Vice_President_Vote ORDER BY StuID;"},{"question":"Quels bulletins désignent des candidats différents pour la présidence et la vice-présidence ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, Election_Cycle, President_Vote, Vice_President_Vote FROM Voting_record WHERE President_Vote IS NOT NULL AND Vice_President_Vote IS NOT NULL AND President_Vote <> Vice_President_Vote ORDER BY StuID;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre moyen de fonctions renseignées par bulletin ?","sql":"SELECT AVG((President_Vote IS NOT NULL) + (Vice_President_Vote IS NOT NULL) + (Secretary_Vote IS NOT NULL) + (Treasurer_Vote IS NOT NULL) + (Class_President_Vote IS NOT NULL) + (Class_Senator_Vote IS NOT NULL)) AS moyenne_fonctions_renseignees FROM Voting_record;"},{"question":"Combien de bulletins chaque étudiant a-t-il enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, COUNT(v.StuID) AS nombre_de_bulletins FROM Student AS s LEFT JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname ORDER BY nombre_de_bulletins DESC, s.StuID;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont enregistré plus d'un bulletin ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_bulletins FROM Student AS s JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY nombre_de_bulletins DESC;"},{"question":"Combien d'électeurs distincts ont participé à chaque cycle ?","sql":"SELECT Election_Cycle, COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) AS electeurs_distincts FROM Voting_record GROUP BY Election_Cycle ORDER BY Election_Cycle;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont voté dans au moins deux cycles électoraux différents ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, COUNT(DISTINCT v.Election_Cycle) AS nombre_de_cycles FROM Student AS s JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.Election_Cycle) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_de_cycles DESC, s.StuID;"},{"question":"Quel est le premier cycle électoral enregistré pour chaque étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, MIN(Election_Cycle) AS premier_cycle FROM Voting_record GROUP BY StuID ORDER BY StuID;"},{"question":"Quelle est la date d'inscription la plus ancienne pour chaque cycle ?","sql":"SELECT Election_Cycle, MIN(Registration_Date) AS premiere_date FROM Voting_record GROUP BY Election_Cycle ORDER BY Election_Cycle;"},{"question":"Quelles dates d'inscription comptent au moins deux bulletins ?","sql":"SELECT Registration_Date, COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_bulletins FROM Voting_record GROUP BY Registration_Date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY Registration_Date;"},{"question":"Quel est le nombre d'étudiants par tranche d'âge : moins de 20 ans, de 20 à 24 ans, ou 25 ans et plus ?","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN Age < 20 THEN 'moins de 20 ans' WHEN Age BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN '20-24 ans' ELSE '25 ans et plus' END AS tranche_age, COUNT(*) AS nombre FROM Student GROUP BY tranche_age ORDER BY tranche_age;"},{"question":"Qui sont les trois étudiants les plus âgés ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname, Age FROM Student ORDER BY Age DESC, StuID LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont exactement le même âge qu'au moins un autre étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT StuID, LName, Fname, Age FROM Student WHERE Age IN (SELECT Age FROM Student GROUP BY Age HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY Age, StuID;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont un conseiller de la même ville qu'eux ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, s.city_code, a.StuID AS advisor_id FROM Student AS s JOIN Student AS a ON a.StuID = s.Advisor WHERE s.city_code = a.city_code ORDER BY s.StuID;"},{"question":"Combien de conseillers différents sont référencés par les étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Advisor) AS nombre_de_conseillers FROM Student WHERE Advisor IS NOT NULL;"},{"question":"Combien d'étudiants chaque conseiller encadre-t-il ?","sql":"SELECT a.StuID, a.LName, a.Fname, COUNT(s.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student AS a JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = a.StuID GROUP BY a.StuID, a.LName, a.Fname ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC, a.StuID;"},{"question":"Quels conseillers encadrent au moins deux étudiants ?","sql":"SELECT a.StuID, a.LName, a.Fname, COUNT(s.StuID) AS nombre_etudiants FROM Student AS a JOIN Student AS s ON s.Advisor = a.StuID GROUP BY a.StuID, a.LName, a.Fname HAVING COUNT(s.StuID) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_etudiants DESC;"},{"question":"Quels codes de ville ne sont associés à aucun étudiant ?","sql":"SELECT city_code FROM Student WHERE city_code IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels électeurs ont choisi comme président un étudiant plus âgé qu'eux ?","sql":"SELECT v.StuID AS electeur_id, e.LName AS electeur_nom, e.Fname AS electeur_prenom, c.StuID AS candidat_id, c.LName AS candidat_nom, c.Age AS age_candidat FROM Voting_record AS v JOIN Student AS e ON e.StuID = v.StuID JOIN Student AS c ON c.StuID = v.President_Vote WHERE c.Age > e.Age ORDER BY v.StuID;"},{"question":"Pour chaque filière, combien de bulletins présidentiels ont été enregistrés ?","sql":"SELECT s.Major, COUNT(v.President_Vote) AS nombre_de_votes_presidentiels FROM Student AS s JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.StuID = s.StuID WHERE v.President_Vote IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.Major ORDER BY s.Major;"},{"question":"Quels sont les votes présidentiels exprimés par des étudiants de la ville 'PAR' ?","sql":"SELECT v.StuID, v.Election_Cycle, v.President_Vote FROM Voting_record AS v JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = v.StuID WHERE s.city_code = 'PAR' ORDER BY v.StuID;"},{"question":"Quel candidat a reçu le plus de votes en cumulant les six fonctions ?","sql":"WITH tous_les_votes AS (SELECT President_Vote AS candidat FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT Vice_President_Vote FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT Secretary_Vote FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT Treasurer_Vote FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT Class_President_Vote FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT Class_Senator_Vote FROM Voting_record) SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname, COUNT(*) AS total_votes FROM tous_les_votes AS t JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = t.candidat WHERE t.candidat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname ORDER BY total_votes DESC, s.StuID LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Combien de votes ont été exprimés pour chaque fonction élective ?","sql":"SELECT 'President' AS fonction, COUNT(President_Vote) AS nombre_de_votes FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT 'Vice_President', COUNT(Vice_President_Vote) FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT 'Secretary', COUNT(Secretary_Vote) FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT 'Treasurer', COUNT(Treasurer_Vote) FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT 'Class_President', COUNT(Class_President_Vote) FROM Voting_record UNION ALL SELECT 'Class_Senator', COUNT(Class_Senator_Vote) FROM Voting_record;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants ont voté pour un candidat de leur propre filière à la présidence ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT v.StuID, e.LName, e.Fname, v.President_Vote FROM Voting_record AS v JOIN Student AS e ON e.StuID = v.StuID JOIN Student AS c ON c.StuID = v.President_Vote WHERE e.Major = c.Major ORDER BY v.StuID;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont reçu au moins un vote présidentiel et au moins un vote de vice-président ?","sql":"SELECT c.StuID, c.LName, c.Fname FROM Student AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record AS v WHERE v.President_Vote = c.StuID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record AS v WHERE v.Vice_President_Vote = c.StuID) ORDER BY c.StuID;"},{"question":"Quels bulletins ont été enregistrés par des étudiants de sexe féminin ?","sql":"SELECT v.StuID, v.Election_Cycle, v.Registration_Date FROM Voting_record AS v JOIN Student AS s ON s.StuID = v.StuID WHERE s.Sex = 'F' ORDER BY v.StuID;"},{"question":"Pour chaque cycle, quel est le nombre de candidats présidentiels distincts ?","sql":"SELECT Election_Cycle, COUNT(DISTINCT President_Vote) AS candidats_distincts FROM Voting_record WHERE President_Vote IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Election_Cycle ORDER BY Election_Cycle;"},{"question":"Quels candidats ont reçu des votes présidentiels provenant d'au moins deux villes différentes ?","sql":"SELECT c.StuID, c.LName, c.Fname, COUNT(DISTINCT e.city_code) AS nombre_de_villes FROM Student AS c JOIN Voting_record AS v ON v.President_Vote = c.StuID JOIN Student AS e ON e.StuID = v.StuID GROUP BY c.StuID, c.LName, c.Fname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.city_code) >= 2 ORDER BY nombre_de_villes DESC, c.StuID;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants sont à la fois électeurs et candidats à la présidence ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record AS v WHERE v.StuID = s.StuID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record AS v WHERE v.President_Vote = s.StuID) ORDER BY s.StuID;"},{"question":"Quel pourcentage des bulletins contient un vote présidentiel renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN President_Vote IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pourcentage_bulletins_presidentiels FROM Voting_record;"},{"question":"Quels étudiants n'ont jamais été choisis pour aucune fonction élective ?","sql":"SELECT s.StuID, s.LName, s.Fname FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Voting_record AS v WHERE s.StuID IN (v.President_Vote, v.Vice_President_Vote, v.Secretary_Vote, v.Treasurer_Vote, v.Class_President_Vote, v.Class_Senator_Vote)) ORDER BY s.StuID;"},{"question":"Quels enregistrements de vote ont un candidat présidentiel dont le nom est renseigné ?","sql":"SELECT v.StuID, v.Election_Cycle, c.LName, c.Fname FROM Voting_record AS v JOIN Student AS c ON c.StuID = v.President_Vote WHERE c.LName IS NOT NULL AND c.Fname IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v.StuID;"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les églises ouvertes depuis 1900, avec leur nom et leur organisateur ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Organized_by\" FROM \"church\" WHERE \"Open_Date\" >= 1900;"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms et les pays des personnes âgées d'au moins 30 ans ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Country\" FROM \"people\" WHERE \"Age\" >= 30;"},{"question":"Quels mariages ont eu lieu entre 2000 et 2010 inclus, avec les noms de l'homme, de la femme et de l'église ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Name\" AS \"Église\", h.\"Name\" AS \"Homme\", f.\"Name\" AS \"Femme\", w.\"Year\" AS \"Année\" FROM \"wedding\" AS w JOIN \"church\" AS c ON c.\"Church_ID\" = w.\"Church_ID\" JOIN \"people\" AS h ON h.\"People_ID\" = w.\"Male_ID\" JOIN \"people\" AS f ON f.\"People_ID\" = w.\"Female_ID\" WHERE w.\"Year\" BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010;"},{"question":"Combien de mariages sont associés à chaque église, y compris celles qui n'en ont aucun ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Name\", les pays distincts représentés dans la table des personnes ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Country\" FROM \"people\" WHERE \"Country\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY \"Country\";"},{"question":"Quelle est la personne la plus âgée et quel est son âge ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Age\" FROM \"people\" WHERE \"Age\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Age\") FROM \"people\");"},{"question":"Quels mariages unissent deux personnes originaires du même pays ?","sql":"SELECT w.\"Year\", h.\"Name\" AS \"Homme\", f.\"Name\" AS \"Femme\", h.\"Country\" FROM \"wedding\" AS w JOIN \"people\" AS h ON h.\"People_ID\" = w.\"Male_ID\" JOIN \"people\" AS f ON f.\"People_ID\" = w.\"Female_ID\" WHERE h.\"Country\" = f.\"Country\";"},{"question":"Quelles églises mentionnent une continuation dans leur description ?","sql":"SELECT \"Name\", \"Continuation_of\" FROM \"church\" WHERE \"Continuation_of\" IS NOT NULL AND \"Continuation_of\" <> '';"},{"question":"Combien de mariages ont été célébrés chaque année ?","sql":"SELECT \"Year\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_mariages\" FROM \"wedding\" GROUP BY \"Year\" ORDER BY \"Year\";"},{"question":"Quelles personnes n'apparaissent dans aucun mariage, ni comme homme ni comme femme ?","sql":"SELECT p.\"People_ID\", p.\"Name\" FROM \"people\" AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM \"wedding\" AS w WHERE w.\"Male_ID\" = p.\"People_ID\" OR w.\"Female_ID\" = p.\"People_ID\");"},{"question":"Quelle ou quelles églises ont accueilli le plus grand nombre de mariages ?","sql":"WITH compte AS (SELECT c.\"Church_ID\", c.\"Name\", COUNT(w.\"Church_ID\") AS \"Nombre_de_mariages\" FROM \"church\" AS c LEFT JOIN \"wedding\" AS w ON w.\"Church_ID\" = c.\"Church_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"Church_ID\", c.\"Name\") SELECT \"Name\", \"Nombre_de_mariages\" FROM compte WHERE \"Nombre_de_mariages\" = (SELECT MAX(\"Nombre_de_mariages\") FROM compte);"},{"question":"Quels pays comptent au moins deux personnes, et quel est l'âge moyen dans chacun ?","sql":"SELECT \"Country\", COUNT(*) AS \"Nombre_de_personnes\", AVG(\"Age\") AS \"Age_moyen\" FROM \"people\" GROUP BY \"Country\" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY \"Country\";"},{"question":"Pour chaque église ayant accueilli un mariage, quelle est l'année de son premier mariage ?","sql":"SELECT c.\"Name\", MIN(w.\"Year\") AS \"Première_année_de_mariage\" FROM \"church\" AS c JOIN \"wedding\" AS w ON w.\"Church_ID\" = c.\"Church_ID\" GROUP BY c.\"Church_ID\", c.\"Name\";"},{"question":"Quels sont les noms des femmes mariées dans une église organisée par une personne donnée par sa valeur de colonne ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT f.\"Name\" AS \"Femme\", c.\"Name\" AS \"Église\" FROM \"wedding\" AS w JOIN \"people\" AS f ON f.\"People_ID\" = w.\"Female_ID\" JOIN \"church\" AS c ON c.\"Church_ID\" = w.\"Church_ID\" WHERE c.\"Organized_by\" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.\"Name\";"}]}

{"examples":[{"question":"Quelles sont les soumissions classées par score décroissant ?","sql":"SELECT "Submission_ID", "Author", "College", "Scores"
FROM "submission"
ORDER BY "Scores" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels ateliers se déroulent dans la salle « Salle A » ?","sql":"SELECT "Workshop_ID", "Name", "Date"
FROM "workshop"
WHERE "Venue" = 'Salle A';"},{"question":"Quelles soumissions ont été acceptées ?","sql":"SELECT s."Submission_ID", s."Author", a."Workshop_ID"
FROM "submission" AS s
JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Submission_ID" = s."Submission_ID"
WHERE a."Result" = 'Accepted';"},{"question":"Combien de soumissions proviennent de chaque établissement ?","sql":"SELECT "College", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "submission"
GROUP BY "College"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_soumissions" DESC;"},{"question":"Quels sont les ateliers triés par date croissante ?","sql":"SELECT "Workshop_ID", "Name", "Date", "Venue"
FROM "workshop"
ORDER BY "Date" ASC;"},{"question":"Affichez le nom de chaque atelier ainsi que l'identifiant et le résultat de chaque soumission évaluée dans cet atelier.","sql":"SELECT w."Name", a."Submission_ID", a."Result"
FROM "workshop" AS w
JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
ORDER BY w."Name", a."Submission_ID";"},{"question":"Quel est le score moyen de l'ensemble des soumissions ?","sql":"SELECT AVG("Scores") AS "Score_moyen"
FROM "submission";"},{"question":"Quels ateliers n'ont encore aucune évaluation de soumission ?","sql":"SELECT w."Workshop_ID", w."Name"
FROM "workshop" AS w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Acceptance" AS a
    WHERE a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
);"},{"question":"Quelles soumissions sont associées à au moins deux ateliers ?","sql":"SELECT "Submission_ID", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_d_ateliers"
FROM "Acceptance"
GROUP BY "Submission_ID"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;"},{"question":"Quelles sont les soumissions ayant obtenu le score maximal ?","sql":"SELECT "Submission_ID", "Author", "Scores"
FROM "submission"
WHERE "Scores" = (SELECT MAX("Scores") FROM "submission");"},{"question":"Combien d'évaluations correspondent à chaque résultat ?","sql":"SELECT "Result", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_d_evaluations"
FROM "Acceptance"
GROUP BY "Result"
ORDER BY "Nombre_d_evaluations" DESC;"},{"question":"Combien de soumissions sont évaluées dans chaque atelier, y compris ceux qui n'en ont aucune ?","sql":"SELECT w."Workshop_ID", w."Name", COUNT(a."Submission_ID") AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "workshop" AS w
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
GROUP BY w."Workshop_ID", w."Name"
ORDER BY w."Workshop_ID";"},{"question":"Quels auteurs ont un score supérieur à la moyenne générale ?","sql":"SELECT "Submission_ID", "Author", "Scores"
FROM "submission"
WHERE "Scores" > (SELECT AVG("Scores") FROM "submission")
ORDER BY "Scores" DESC;"},{"question":"Pour chaque établissement, quels sont le score minimal et le score maximal ?","sql":"SELECT "College", MIN("Scores") AS "Score_minimal", MAX("Scores") AS "Score_maximal"
FROM "submission"
GROUP BY "College"
ORDER BY "College";"},{"question":"Quel est l'atelier dont la date est la plus récente ?","sql":"SELECT "Workshop_ID", "Name", "Date"
FROM "workshop"
ORDER BY "Date" DESC
LIMIT 1;"},{"question":"Quelles soumissions ne sont associées à aucun atelier ?","sql":"SELECT s."Submission_ID", s."Author", s."Scores"
FROM "submission" AS s
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Submission_ID" = s."Submission_ID"
WHERE a."Submission_ID" IS NULL;"},{"question":"Quels sont les trois ateliers ayant le plus de soumissions évaluées ?","sql":"SELECT w."Workshop_ID", w."Name", COUNT(a."Submission_ID") AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "workshop" AS w
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
GROUP BY w."Workshop_ID", w."Name"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_soumissions" DESC, w."Workshop_ID"
LIMIT 3;"},{"question":"Quels couples établissement-auteur correspondent à plusieurs soumissions ?","sql":"SELECT "College", "Author", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "submission"
GROUP BY "College", "Author"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_soumissions" DESC;"},{"question":"Quel rang occupe chaque soumission selon son score, du meilleur au moins bon ?","sql":"SELECT "Submission_ID", "Author", "Scores",
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Scores" DESC) AS "Rang"
FROM "submission"
ORDER BY "Rang", "Submission_ID";"},{"question":"Combien de soumissions chaque auteur a-t-il déposées ?","sql":"SELECT "Author", COUNT(*) AS "Nombre_de_soumissions"
FROM "submission"
GROUP BY "Author"
ORDER BY "Nombre_de_soumissions" DESC, "Author";"},{"question":"Quels sont les lieux distincts utilisés pour les ateliers ?","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT "Venue"
FROM "workshop"
ORDER BY "Venue";"},{"question":"Pour chaque atelier, quel est le nombre d'évaluations et quelle proportion de ses soumissions a reçu le résultat « Accepted » ?","sql":"SELECT w."Workshop_ID", w."Name",
       COUNT(a."Submission_ID") AS "Nombre_d_evaluations",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a."Result" = 'Accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(a."Submission_ID"), 0) AS "Pourcentage_accepte"
FROM "workshop" AS w
LEFT JOIN "Acceptance" AS a ON a."Workshop_ID" = w."Workshop_ID"
GROUP BY w."Workshop_ID", w."Name"
ORDER BY w."Workshop_ID";"}]}
